meaning: to suffer, to endure; to get (criticized, scolded, beaten)

example.zh: 他因为上班迟到挨了经理的批评。
example.py: Tā yīnwèi shàngbān chídào ái le jīnglǐ de pīpíng.
example.en: He got criticized by the manager for being late to work.

example.zh: 暴雨过后,岸边堆满了被洪水冲来的树枝和垃圾。
example.py: Bàoyǔ guòhòu, ànbiān duī mǎn le bèi hóngshuǐ chōng lái de shùzhī hé lājī.
example.en: After the heavy rain, the riverbank was piled with branches and rubbish carried there by the floodwater.

example.zh: 尽管这种药物价格昂贵,只要疗效显著,仍然值得纳入公共医疗保障的讨论。
example.py: Jǐnguǎn zhè zhǒng yàowù jiàgé ángguì, zhǐyào liáoxiào xiǎnzhù, réngrán zhíde nàrù gōnggòng yīliáo bǎozhàng de tǎolùn.
example.en: Although this medicine is expensive, if its effects are significant, it is still worth discussing whether to include it in public medical coverage.

example.zh: 这个案例说明,企业在追求效率的同时不能忽视员工的基本权益。
example.py: Zhège ànlì shuōmíng, qǐyè zài zhuīqiú xiàolǜ de tóngshí bù néng hūshì yuángōng de jīběn quányì.
example.en: This case shows that, while pursuing efficiency, companies must not ignore employees’ basic rights and interests.

example.zh: 长时间盯着屏幕后,他请理疗师按摩肩颈,缓解僵硬和疼痛。
example.py: Cháng shíjiān dīngzhe píngmù hòu, tā qǐng lǐliáoshī ànmó jiānjǐng, huǎnjiě jiāngyìng hé téngtòng.
example.en: After staring at a screen for a long time, he asked a physiotherapist to massage his neck and shoulders to ease stiffness and pain.

example.zh: 他没有直接拒绝,却用沉默暗示自己并不赞成这个方案。
example.py: Tā méiyǒu zhíjiē jùjué, què yòng chénmò ànshì zìjǐ bìng bú zànchéng zhège fāng'àn.
example.en: He did not refuse directly, but used silence to imply that he did not actually support the proposal.

example.zh: 他把所有证据都摆在桌上,却迟迟不肯说出自己的判断。
example.py: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu zhèngjù dōu bǎi zài zhuō shang, què chíchí bù kěn shuō chū zìjǐ de pànduàn.
example.en: He placed all the evidence on the table, yet for a long time refused to state his own judgement.

example.zh: 尽管准备充分,代表队仍在最后一轮败给了经验更丰富的对手。
example.py: Jǐnguǎn zhǔnbèi chōngfèn, dàibiǎoduì réng zài zuìhòu yì lún bài gěi le jīngyàn gèng fēngfù de duìshǒu.
example.en: Although fully prepared, the team was still defeated in the final round by a more experienced opponent.

example.zh: 如果没有清晰的计划,再多预算也可能被白白浪费掉。
example.py: Rúguǒ méiyǒu qīngxī de jìhuà, zài duō yùsuàn yě kěnéng bèi báibái làngfèi diào.
example.en: Without a clear plan, even a large budget may simply be wasted.

example.zh: 到达北京后,他第一件事不是参加会议,而是拜访曾经指导过他的老教授。
example.py: Dàodá Běijīng hòu, tā dì yī jiàn shì bú shì cānjiā huìyì, ér shì bàifǎng céngjīng zhǐdǎo guò tā de lǎo jiàoshòu.
example.en: After arriving in Beijing, the first thing he did was not attend the meeting, but visit the old professor who had once guided him.

example.zh: 展厅里的文物必须按照年代和主题摆放,不能只追求视觉效果。
example.py: Zhǎntīng lǐ de wénwù bìxū ànzhào niándài hé zhǔtí bǎifàng, bù néng zhǐ zhuīqiú shìjué xiàoguǒ.
example.en: The artefacts in the exhibition hall must be arranged according to era and theme, not merely for visual effect.

example.zh: 失业率上升了两个百分点,但不同地区受到的影响并不相同。
example.py: Shīyèlǜ shàngshēng le liǎng gè bǎifēndiǎn, dàn bùtóng dìqū shòudào de yǐngxiǎng bìng bù xiāngtóng.
example.en: The unemployment rate rose by two percentage points, but different regions were not affected in the same way.

example.zh: 老城区的那家百货曾经是市民购物和约会的地标,如今却被电商冲击得门庭冷落。
example.py: Lǎo chéngqū de nà jiā bǎihuò céngjīng shì shìmín gòuwù hé yuēhuì de dìbiāo, rújīn què bèi diànshāng chōngjī de méntíng lěngluò.
example.en: That department store in the old district used to be a landmark where residents shopped and met, but now e-commerce has left it deserted.

example.zh: 在大城市里,许多白领表面上收入稳定,实际上承受着房租和通勤的双重压力。
example.py: Zài dà chéngshì lǐ, xǔduō báilǐng biǎomiàn shang shōurù wěndìng, shíjì shang chéngshòu zhe fángzū hé tōngqín de shuāngchóng yālì.
example.en: In big cities, many white-collar workers appear to have stable incomes, but in reality they bear the double pressure of rent and commuting.

meaning: to pay a New Year’s visit

example.zh: 春节期间,很多年轻人选择通过视频拜年,以减少长途奔波。
example.py: Chūnjié qījiān, hěn duō niánqīng rén xuǎnzé tōngguò shìpín bàinián, yǐ jiǎnshǎo chángtú bēnbō.
example.en: During the Spring Festival, many young people choose to send New Year greetings by video to reduce long-distance travel.

meaning: to get rid of, to break away from

example.zh: 他终于摆脱了对父母意见的过度依赖,开始独立规划自己的职业道路。
example.py: Tā zhōngyú bǎituō le duì fùmǔ yìjiàn de guòdù yīlài, kāishǐ dúlì guīhuà zìjǐ de zhíyè dàolù.
example.en: He finally broke away from relying too heavily on his parents’ opinions and began planning his own career path independently.

meaning: edition, version; measure word for editions

example.zh: 这部小说的新版删去了几处争议内容,却保留了原来的叙事结构。
example.py: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō de xīnbǎn shān qù le jǐ chù zhēngyì nèiróng, què bǎoliú le yuánlái de xùshì jiégòu.
example.en: The new edition of this novel removed several controversial passages, but kept the original narrative structure.

example.zh: 不同版本的合同条款略有差异,签字前必须逐项核对。
example.py: Bùtóng bǎnběn de hétong tiáokuǎn lüèyǒu chāyì, qiānzì qián bìxū zhúxiàng héduì.
example.en: The terms in different versions of the contract vary slightly, so each item must be checked before signing.

example.zh: 我小时候并不懂棒球的规则,直到看完一场职业比赛,才明白它为什么那么吸引人。
example.py: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou bìng bù dǒng bàngqiú de guīzé, zhídào kàn wán yì chǎng zhíyè bǐsài, cái míngbai tā wèishénme nàme xīyǐn rén.
example.en: As a child, I did not understand the rules of baseball; only after watching a professional game did I realise why it is so appealing.

example.zh: 对许多基层员工来说,主管的一言一行都可能成为榜样或反面教材。
example.py: Duì xǔduō jīcéng yuángōng lái shuō, zhǔguǎn de yì yán yì xíng dōu kěnéng chéngwéi bǎngyàng huò fǎnmiàn jiàocái.
example.en: For many front-line employees, a manager’s every word and action may become either a model to follow or a negative example.

example.zh: 经济快速增长往往伴随着资源消耗增加和社会结构变化。
example.py: Jīngjì kuàisù zēngzhǎng wǎngwǎng bànsuí zhe zīyuán xiāohào zēngjiā hé shèhuì jiégòu biànhuà.
example.en: Rapid economic growth is often accompanied by increased resource consumption and changes in social structure.

meaning: to play the role of, to act as

example.zh: 在这场谈判中,第三方机构扮演了调解者的角色,使僵局逐渐缓和。
example.py: Zài zhè chǎng tánpàn zhōng, dì sānfāng jīgòu bànyǎn le tiáojiě zhě de juésè, shǐ jiāngjú zhújiàn huǎnhé.
example.en: In this negotiation, the third-party organisation acted as a mediator, gradually easing the deadlock.

example.zh: 高压锅使用不当可能会爆,所以安全阀必须定期检查。
example.py: Gāoyāguō shǐyòng bùdàng kěnéng huì bào, suǒyǐ ānquánfá bìxū dìngqī jiǎnchá.
example.en: A pressure cooker may explode if used improperly, so the safety valve must be checked regularly.

example.zh: 谈判破裂后,边境地区再次爆发冲突,数千名居民被迫撤离。
example.py: Tánpàn pòliè hòu, biānjìng dìqū zàicì bàofā chōngtū, shù qiān míng jūmín bèipò chèlí.
example.en: After the negotiations broke down, conflict broke out again in the border region, forcing thousands of residents to evacuate.

meaning: to take care of, to keep

example.zh: 这份合同涉及商业机密,请由法务部统一保管,不要随意复印或转发。
example.py: Zhè fèn hétong shèjí shāngyè jīmì, qǐng yóu fǎwùbù tǒngyī bǎoguǎn, bú yào suíyì fùyìn huò zhuǎnfā.
example.en: This contract involves commercial secrets, so please have the legal department keep it centrally and do not copy or forward it casually.

example.zh: 现代医学越来越强调预防,鼓励人们通过规律运动和均衡饮食来保健。
example.py: Xiàndài yīxué yuè lái yuè qiángdiào yùfáng, gǔlì rénmen tōngguò guīlǜ yùndòng hé jūnhéng yǐnshí lái bǎojiàn.
example.en: Modern medicine increasingly emphasises prevention and encourages people to maintain their health through regular exercise and a balanced diet.

example.zh: 在互联网普及以前,报刊是普通人了解国内外大事的重要渠道。
example.py: Zài hùliánwǎng pǔjí yǐqián, bàokān shì pǔtōngrén liǎojiě guónèi-wàidàshì de zhòngyào qúdào.
example.en: Before the internet became widespread, newspapers and magazines were an important channel for ordinary people to learn about major domestic and international events.

example.zh: 电影可以描写暴力,但如果只把血腥场面当作卖点,就会显得空洞。
example.py: Diànyǐng kěyǐ miáoxiě bàolì, dàn rúguǒ zhǐ bǎ xuèxīng chǎngmiàn dàngzuò màidiǎn, jiù huì xiǎnde kōngdòng.
example.en: A film can depict violence, but if it merely treats bloody scenes as a selling point, it will seem hollow.

example.zh: 调查结束后,公司的内部问题被逐渐暴露出来。
example.py: Diàochá jiéshù hòu, gōngsī de nèibù wèntí bèi zhújiàn bàolù chūlái.
example.en: After the investigation ended, the company’s internal problems were gradually exposed.

example.zh: 山区夜里气温骤降,即使白天很热,帐篷里也要注意保暖。
example.py: Shānqū yèlǐ qìwēn zhòujiàng, jíshǐ báitiān hěn rè, zhàngpéng lǐ yě yào zhùyì bǎonuǎn.
example.en: In the mountains the temperature drops sharply at night, so even if it is hot during the day, you still need to keep warm in the tent.

example.zh: 这家报社派记者前往灾区,连续报道救援进展。
example.py: Zhè jiā bàoshè pài jìzhě qiánwǎng zāiqū, liánxù bàodǎo jiùyuán jìnzhǎn.
example.en: This newspaper office sent reporters to the disaster area to report continuously on the progress of the rescue work.

example.zh: 这台洗衣机的电机由厂家保修十年,但人为损坏不在范围内。
example.py: Zhè tái xǐyījī de diànjī yóu chǎngjiā bǎoxiū shí nián, dàn rénwéi sǔnhuài bú zài fànwéi nèi.
example.en: The motor of this washing machine is guaranteed for repair by the manufacturer for ten years, but damage caused by the user is not covered.

example.zh: 工厂附近突然发生爆炸,警方立即封锁了现场。
example.py: Gōngchǎng fùjìn tūrán fāshēng bàozhà, jǐngfāng lìjí fēngsuǒ le xiànchǎng.
example.en: An explosion suddenly occurred near the factory, and the police immediately sealed off the scene.

example.zh: 稳定的供电系统是保障医院正常运转的基本条件。
example.py: Wěndìng de gōngdiàn xìtǒng shì bǎozhàng yīyuàn zhèngcháng yùnzhuǎn de jīběn tiáojiàn.
example.en: A stable power supply system is a basic condition for ensuring the normal operation of a hospital.

example.zh: 在谈判中一直保持被动,只会让对方掌握更多主动权。
example.py: Zài tánpàn zhōng yìzhí bǎochí bèidòng, zhǐ huì ràng duìfāng zhǎngwò gèng duō zhǔdòngquán.
example.en: Remaining passive throughout negotiations will only allow the other side to gain more initiative.

example.zh: 面对经济压力,他并没有变得悲观,而是重新调整了计划。
example.py: Miànduì jīngjì yālì, tā bìng méiyǒu biàn de bēiguān, érshì chóngxīn tiáozhěng le jìhuà.
example.en: Faced with economic pressure, he did not become pessimistic, but instead adjusted his plan again.

example.zh: 北极冰层的变化,被科学家视为气候变暖的重要信号。
example.py: Běijí bīngcéng de biànhuà, bèi kēxuéjiā shìwéi qìhòu biànnuǎn de zhòngyào xìnhào.
example.en: Changes in the Arctic ice are regarded by scientists as an important sign of climate warming.

example.zh: 那场事故本可以避免,却因为管理混乱最终演变成悲剧。
example.py: Nà chǎng shìgù běn kěyǐ bìmiǎn, què yīnwèi guǎnlǐ hùnluàn zuìzhōng yǎnbiàn chéng bēijù.
example.en: That accident could have been avoided, but because of chaotic management it ultimately turned into a tragedy.

example.zh: 北美洲的移民历史,使当地文化呈现出多元而复杂的面貌。
example.py: Běiměizhōu de yímín lìshǐ, shǐ dāngdì wénhuà chéngxiàn chū duōyuán ér fùzá de miànmào.
example.en: The history of immigration in North America has given local culture a diverse and complex character.

example.zh: 由于资金链断裂,公司被迫暂停了几个正在推进的项目。
example.py: Yóuyú zījīnliàn duànliè, gōngsī bèipò zàntíng le jǐ gè zhèngzài tuījìn de xiàngmù.
example.en: Because its cash flow chain broke, the company was forced to suspend several projects that were being advanced.

example.zh: 她尽量保持冷静,但声音里仍然透着悲伤。
example.py: Tā jǐnliàng bǎochí lěngjìng, dàn shēngyīn lǐ réngrán tòuzhe bēishāng.
example.en: She tried to stay calm, but there was still sadness in her voice.

example.zh: 他只穿了一件背心就出门,结果被夜里的冷风吹得直发抖。
example.py: Tā zhǐ chuān le yí jiàn bèixīn jiù chūmén, jiéguǒ bèi yèlǐ de lěngfēng chuī de zhí fādǒu.
example.en: He went out wearing only a vest, and ended up shivering in the cold night wind.

example.zh: 为了防止会议中断,技术人员提前准备了一台备用电脑。
example.py: Wèile fángzhǐ huìyì zhōngduàn, jìshù rényuán tíqián zhǔnbèi le yì tái bèiyòng diànnǎo.
example.en: To prevent the meeting being interrupted, the technician prepared a backup computer in advance.

example.zh: 新产品上线后,公司的线上订单在两个月内倍增。
example.py: Xīn chǎnpǐn shàngxiàn hòu, gōngsī de xiànshàng dìngdān zài liǎng gè yuè nèi bèizēng.
example.en: After the new product launched, the company’s online orders doubled within two months.

example.zh: 在危险靠近的一瞬间,她出于本能把孩子拉到自己身后。
example.py: Zài wēixiǎn kàojìn de yí shùnjiān, tā chūyú běnnéng bǎ háizi lā dào zìjǐ shēnhòu.
example.en: The moment danger approached, she instinctively pulled the child behind her.

example.zh: 孩子们在操场上尽情奔跑,仿佛整座校园都被他们的笑声点亮了。
example.py: Háizimen zài cāochǎng shàng jìnqíng bēnpǎo, fǎngfú zhěng zuò xiàoyuán dōu bèi tāmen de xiàoshēng diǎnliàng le.
example.en: The children ran freely on the playground, as if the whole campus had been lit up by their laughter.

example.zh: 这项政策本身并没有问题,关键在于执行过程是否透明。
example.py: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè běnshēn bìng méiyǒu wèntí, guānjiàn zàiyú zhíxíng guòchéng shìfǒu tòumíng.
example.en: The policy itself has no problem; the key is whether the implementation process is transparent.

example.zh: 这家公司虽然在海外发展很快,但仍把本土市场视为核心。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī suīrán zài hǎiwài fāzhǎn hěn kuài, dàn réng bǎ běntǔ shìchǎng shìwéi héxīn.
example.en: Although this company is expanding quickly overseas, it still regards the local market as its core.

example.zh: 家庭压力把他逼到了不得不重新选择职业的地步。
example.py: Jiātíng yālì bǎ tā bī dào le bùdébù chóngxīn xuǎnzé zhíyè de dìbù.
example.en: Family pressure forced him to the point where he had to choose a new career.

example.zh: 为了避开高峰期,我们把出发时间提前到了清晨。
example.py: Wèile bìkāi gāofēngqī, wǒmen bǎ chūfā shíjiān tíqián dào le qīngchén.
example.en: To avoid the rush hour, we moved the departure time forward to early morning.

example.zh: 她闭上眼睛,深吸一口气,才有勇气走进会议室。
example.py: Tā bì shàng yǎnjing, shēn xī yì kǒu qì, cái yǒu yǒngqì zǒu jìn huìyìshì.
example.en: She closed her eyes and took a deep breath before she had the courage to walk into the meeting room.

meaning: to weave, to edit, to write

example.zh: 奶奶坐在门口编竹篮,手上的动作熟练得几乎不用看。
example.py: Nǎinai zuò zài ménkǒu biān zhúlán, shǒu shàng de dòngzuò shúliàn de jīhū bú yòng kàn.
example.en: Grandma sat by the door weaving a bamboo basket, her hands moving so skilfully that she hardly needed to look.

example.zh: 大雨过后,公园里遍地都是被风吹落的树叶。
example.py: Dàyǔ guòhòu, gōngyuán lǐ biàndì dōu shì bèi fēng chuī luò de shùyè.
example.en: After the heavy rain, the park was covered everywhere with leaves blown down by the wind.

example.zh: 编辑在最后一轮审稿中删掉了几段重复的说明。
example.py: Biānjí zài zuìhòu yì lún shěngǎo zhōng shān diào le jǐ duàn chóngfù de shuōmíng.
example.en: In the final round of review, the editor deleted several repeated explanations.

example.zh: 这套系统最大的优势在于操作便捷,老人也能很快学会。
example.py: Zhè tào xìtǒng zuì dà de yōushì zài yú cāozuò biànjié, lǎorén yě néng hěn kuài xuéhuì.
example.en: The biggest advantage of this system is that it is convenient to operate, so even older people can learn it quickly.

example.zh: 项目组正在编写操作手册,以便新员工能够独立完成基本流程。
example.py: Xiàngmùzǔ zhèngzài biānxiě cāozuò shǒucè, yǐbiàn xīn yuángōng nénggòu dúlì wánchéng jīběn liúchéng.
example.en: The project team is writing an operations manual so that new employees can complete basic procedures independently.

example.zh: 这瓶牛奶已经变质,即使加热也不应该再喝。
example.py: Zhè píng niúnǎi yǐjīng biànzhì, jíshǐ jiārè yě bù yīnggāi zài hē.
example.en: This bottle of milk has already gone bad; even if it is heated, it should not be drunk.

example.zh: 你可以把数据安全比方成家里的门锁,越重要的房间越需要严格保护。
example.py: Nǐ kěyǐ bǎ shùjù ānquán bǐfang chéng jiālǐ de ménsuǒ, yuè zhòngyào de fángjiān yuè xūyào yángé bǎohù.
example.en: You can compare data security to the locks in a house: the more important the room, the stricter the protection needed.

example.zh: 他曾经只是边境部队里的一名普通士兵,后来却成了军事学院的教授。
example.py: Tā céngjīng zhǐ shì biānjìng bùduì lǐ de yì míng pǔtōng shìbīng, hòulái què chéng le jūnshì xuéyuàn de jiàoshòu.
example.en: He was once only an ordinary soldier in a border unit, but later became a professor at a military academy.

example.zh: 这种病毒虽然传播速度快,但多数感染者只会出现轻微症状。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng bìngdú suīrán chuánbō sùdù kuài, dàn duōshù gǎnrǎnzhě zhǐ huì chūxiàn qīngwēi zhèngzhuàng.
example.en: Although this virus spreads quickly, most infected people develop only mild symptoms.

example.zh: 这门课虽然是必修课,但老师仍然鼓励学生根据兴趣选择研究方向。
example.py: Zhè mén kè suīrán shì bìxiū kè, dàn lǎoshī réngrán gǔlì xuésheng gēnjù xìngqù xuǎnzé yánjiū fāngxiàng.
example.en: Although this course is compulsory, the teacher still encourages students to choose a research direction based on their interests.

example.zh: 服务业在这座城市经济中的比重逐年上升。
example.py: Fúwùyè zài zhè zuò chéngshì jīngjì zhōng de bǐzhòng zhúnián shàngshēng.
example.en: The proportion of the service sector in this city’s economy is rising year by year.

example.zh: 电台每天清晨都会播一段天气预报,提醒市民是否需要带伞。
example.py: Diàntái měitiān qīngchén dōu huì bō yí duàn tiānqì yùbào, tíxǐng shìmín shìfǒu xūyào dài sǎn.
example.en: Every morning, the radio station broadcasts a weather forecast to remind residents whether they need an umbrella.

example.zh: 这次国际博览会吸引了来自三十多个国家的参展商。
example.py: Zhè cì guójì bólǎnhuì xīyǐn le láizì sānshí duō gè guójiā de cānzhǎnshāng.
example.en: This international exposition attracted exhibitors from more than thirty countries.

example.zh: 这个项目的技术方案并不差,真正薄弱的是后期维护能力。
example.py: Zhège zhuān'àn de jìshù fāng'àn bìng bù chà, zhēnzhèng bóruò de shì hòuqī wéihù nénglì.
example.en: The project’s technical plan is not bad; what is truly weak is its capacity for later maintenance.

example.zh: 农民通常会根据土壤湿度和气温来决定何时播种。
example.py: Nóngmín tōngcháng huì gēnjù tǔrǎng shīdù hé qìwēn lái juédìng héshí bōzhǒng.
example.en: Farmers usually decide when to sow seeds according to soil moisture and temperature.

example.zh: 他低头工作了一整天,脖子僵得几乎转不过来。
example.py: Tā dītóu gōngzuò le yì zhěng tiān, bózi jiāng de jīhū zhuǎn bu guòlái.
example.en: He worked with his head lowered all day, and his neck became so stiff that he could hardly turn it.

example.zh: 这块布经过特殊处理,既防水又不容易褪色。
example.py: Zhè kuài bù jīngguò tèshū chǔlǐ, jì fángshuǐ yòu bù róngyì tuìsè.
example.en: This piece of cloth has been specially treated, so it is both waterproof and resistant to fading.

example.zh: 这种鸟受到保护,任何人不得私自捕捉。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng niǎo shòudào bǎohù, rènhé rén bùdé sīzì bǔzhuō.
example.en: This kind of bird is protected, and no one may catch it privately.

example.zh: 这份报告缺少数据分析,你最好再补一段相关说明。
example.py: Zhè fèn bàogào quēshǎo shùjù fēnxī, nǐ zuìhǎo zài bǔ yí duàn xiāngguān shuōmíng.
example.en: This report lacks data analysis, so you had better add another paragraph of explanation.

example.zh: 听到公司可能裁员的消息后,许多员工感到不安。
example.py: Tīngdào gōngsī kěnéng cáiyuán de xiāoxi hòu, xǔduō yuángōng gǎndào bù'ān.
example.en: After hearing that the company might lay people off, many employees felt uneasy.

example.zh: 他在公开场合不曾承认自己的判断失误。
example.py: Tā zài gōngkāi chǎnghé bùcéng chéngrèn zìjǐ de pànduàn shīwù.
example.en: He has never admitted his error of judgement in public.

example.zh: 企业如果因施工影响居民生活,就应依法给予补偿。
example.py: Qǐyè rúguǒ yīn shīgōng yǐngxiǎng jūmín shēnghuó, jiù yīng yīfǎ jǐyǔ bǔcháng.
example.en: If a company affects residents’ lives through construction work, it should provide compensation according to the law.

meaning: won’t do, not work; no good; used in rhetorical questions

example.zh: 这样处理不成,既浪费时间,也解决不了根本问题。
example.py: Zhèyàng chǔlǐ bùchéng, jì làngfèi shíjiān, yě jiějué bùliǎo gēnběn wèntí.
example.en: Handling it this way will not work; it wastes time and does not solve the fundamental problem.

example.zh: 未经许可,任何人不得进入实验区域。
example.py: Wèijīng xǔkě, rènhé rén bùdé jìnrù shíyàn qūyù.
example.en: Without permission, no one may enter the experimental area.

example.zh: 救灾部队抵达后,受困群众终于得到及时转移。
example.py: Jiùzāi bùduì dǐdá hòu, shòukùn qúnzhòng zhōngyú dédào jíshí zhuǎnyí.
example.en: After the disaster-relief troops arrived, the trapped people were finally evacuated in time.

example.zh: 他不顾家人的反对,还是决定辞职去偏远地区支教。
example.py: Tā búgù jiārén de fǎnduì, háishì juédìng cízhí qù piānyuǎn dìqū zhījiào.
example.en: Disregarding his family’s opposition, he still decided to resign and teach in a remote area.

meaning: cannot help but, cannot refrain from

example.zh: 看到孩子把自己的零花钱捐出来,老师不禁红了眼眶。
example.py: Kàndào háizi bǎ zìjǐ de línghuāqián juān chūlái, lǎoshī bùjīn hóng le yǎnkuàng.
example.en: Seeing the child donate his own pocket money, the teacher could not help getting teary-eyed.

meaning: to make up a missed lesson

example.zh: 因为老师临时请假,这节课安排在周六补课。
example.py: Yīnwèi lǎoshī línshí qǐngjià, zhè jié kè ānpái zài Zhōuliù bǔkè.
example.en: Because the teacher asked for leave at short notice, this lesson has been arranged as a make-up class on Saturday.

example.zh: 他原以为谈判会持续到深夜,不料对方半小时内就接受了条件。
example.py: Tā yuán yǐwéi tánpàn huì chíxù dào shēnyè, búliào duìfāng bàn xiǎoshí nèi jiù jiēshòu le tiáojiàn.
example.en: He originally thought the negotiation would last until late at night, but unexpectedly the other side accepted the terms within half an hour.

example.zh: 经理听了几分钟便露出不耐烦的表情,显然已经失去耐心。
example.py: Jīnglǐ tīng le jǐ fēnzhōng biàn lùchū bú nàifán de biǎoqíng, xiǎnrán yǐjīng shīqù nàixīn.
example.en: After listening for a few minutes, the manager showed an impatient expression and had clearly lost patience.

example.zh: 会议进行到深夜,走廊里不时传来低声讨论。
example.py: Huìyì jìnxíng dào shēnyè, zǒuláng lǐ bùshí chuánlái dīshēng tǎolùn.
example.en: As the meeting continued late into the night, low voices of discussion could occasionally be heard from the corridor.

example.zh: 如果服药后出现明显不适,应立即停止使用并咨询医生。
example.py: Rúguǒ fúyào hòu chūxiàn míngxiǎn búshì, yīng lìjí tíngzhǐ shǐyòng bìng zīxún yīshēng.
example.en: If obvious discomfort appears after taking the medicine, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor.

example.zh: 政府为低收入家庭提供取暖补贴,以减轻冬季开支压力。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ wèi dī shōurù jiātíng tígōng qǔnuǎn bǔtiē, yǐ jiǎnqīng dōngjì kāizhī yālì.
example.en: The government provides heating subsidies for low-income families to reduce the pressure of winter expenses.

example.zh: 手术前,医生必须准确确认受伤部位,以避免误伤周围组织。
example.py: Shǒushù qián, yīshēng bìxū zhǔnquè quèrèn shòushāng bùwèi, yǐ bìmiǎn wùshāng zhōuwéi zǔzhī.
example.en: Before surgery, the doctor must accurately confirm the injured part in order to avoid damaging surrounding tissue by mistake.

example.zh: 他并不反对孩子补习,但担心过度补习会压缩休息时间。
example.py: Tā bìng bù fǎnduì háizi bǔxí, dàn dānxīn guòdù bǔxí huì yāsuō xiūxi shíjiān.
example.en: He is not opposed to children taking supplementary lessons, but he worries that excessive tutoring will reduce their rest time.

example.zh: 施工现场不许随意进入,否则容易发生安全事故。
example.py: Shīgōng xiànchǎng bùxǔ suíyì jìnrù, fǒuzé róngyì fāshēng ānquán shìgù.
example.en: No one is allowed to enter the construction site at will, otherwise safety accidents may easily occur.

example.zh: 这种药不宜与酒精同时服用,否则可能加重副作用。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng yào bùyí yǔ jiǔjīng tóngshí fúyòng, fǒuzé kěnéng jiāzhòng fùzuòyòng.
example.en: This medicine should not be taken with alcohol, otherwise it may worsen the side effects.

example.zh: 听完他的经历,现场观众感动不已。
example.py: Tīng wán tā de jīnglì, xiànchǎng guānzhòng gǎndòng bùyǐ.
example.en: After hearing his experience, the audience at the scene was deeply moved.

example.zh: 雨下个不止,山区的救援队只能暂时停止搜救。
example.py: Yǔ xià ge bùzhǐ, shānqū de jiùyuánduì zhǐ néng zànshí tíngzhǐ sōujiù.
example.en: The rain kept falling without stopping, so the mountain rescue team could only temporarily stop the search and rescue.

example.zh: 为了迎接访问团,学校提前布置了会议室和展览区。
example.py: Wèile yíngjiē fǎngwèntuán, xuéxiào tíqián bùzhì le huìyìshì hé zhǎnlǎnqū.
example.en: To welcome the visiting delegation, the school arranged the meeting room and exhibition area in advance.

meaning: not to the extent of, unlikely to

example.zh: 这次失误虽然影响了进度,但还不至于让整个项目停下来。
example.py: Zhè cì shīwù suīrán yǐngxiǎng le jìndù, dàn hái búzhìyú ràng zhěnggè xiàngmù tíng xiàlai.
example.en: Although this mistake affected the schedule, it is not serious enough to bring the whole project to a halt.

example.zh: 申请签证的步骤看似简单,但任何一项材料出错都可能导致延误。
example.py: Shēnqǐng qiānzhèng de bùzhòu kànsì jiǎndān, dàn rènhé yí xiàng cáiliào chūcuò dōu kěnéng dǎozhì yánwù.
example.en: The steps for applying for a visa may look simple, but a mistake in any document could cause a delay.

example.zh: 会议结束时,他一不小心踩到了地上的电线,差点导致设备断电。
example.py: Huìyì jiéshù shí, tā yì bù xiǎoxīn cǎi dào le dìshàng de diànxiàn, chàdiǎn dǎozhì shèbèi duàndiàn.
example.en: At the end of the meeting, he accidentally stepped on the cable on the floor and almost caused the equipment to lose power.

example.zh: 在缺乏证据的情况下,任何猜测都可能误导公众。
example.py: Zài quēfá zhèngjù de qíngkuàng xià, rènhé cāicè dōu kěnéng wùdǎo gōngzhòng.
example.en: When evidence is lacking, any guess may mislead the public.

example.zh: 离婚协议中最难处理的,往往是共同财产的分配问题。
example.py: Líhūn xiéyì zhōng zuì nán chǔlǐ de, wǎngwǎng shì gòngtóng cáichǎn de fēnpèi wèntí.
example.en: The hardest part of a divorce agreement is often the distribution of shared property.

example.zh: 对一个国家来说,真正的财富不仅是资源,还有受过良好教育的人民。
example.py: Duì yí gè guójiā lái shuō, zhēnzhèng de cáifù bùjǐn shì zīyuán, hái yǒu shòuguò liánghǎo jiàoyù de rénmín.
example.en: For a country, true wealth is not only resources, but also a well-educated people.

example.zh: 公司决定把设备采购流程公开,以减少内部操作的灰色空间。
example.py: Gōngsī juédìng bǎ shèbèi cǎigòu liúchéng gōngkāi, yǐ jiǎnshǎo nèibù cāozuò de huīsè kōngjiān.
example.en: The company decided to make the equipment procurement process public in order to reduce the grey area in internal operations.

example.zh: 暴雨过后,远处的山谷上空出现了一道清晰的彩虹。
example.py: Bàoyǔ guòhòu, yuǎnchù de shāngǔ shàngkōng chūxiàn le yí dào qīngxī de cǎihóng.
example.en: After the downpour, a clear rainbow appeared in the sky above the distant valley.

example.zh: 她的才华早已得到认可,只是缺少一个真正展示自己的舞台。
example.py: Tā de cáihuá zǎo yǐ dédào rènkě, zhǐshì quēshǎo yí gè zhēnzhèng zhǎnshì zìjǐ de wǔtái.
example.en: Her talent has long been recognised; she simply lacks a stage on which to truly show herself.

example.zh: 科研团队在野外采集样本时,必须严格记录地点和时间。
example.py: Kēyán tuánduì zài yěwài cǎijí yàngběn shí, bìxū yángé jìlù dìdiǎn hé shíjiān.
example.en: When a research team collects samples in the field, it must record the location and time strictly.

example.zh: 委员会最终采纳了专家的建议,推迟实施新的收费制度。
example.py: Wěiyuánhuì zuìzhōng cǎinà le zhuānjiā de jiànyì, tuīchí shíshī xīn de shōufèi zhìdù.
example.en: The committee finally adopted the experts’ suggestion and postponed the implementation of the new charging system.

example.zh: 他的才能没有被埋没,反而在困难环境中逐渐显现出来。
example.py: Tā de cáinéng méiyǒu bèi máimò, fǎn'ér zài kùnnán huánjìng zhōng zhújiàn xiǎnxiàn chūlai.
example.en: His ability was not buried; on the contrary, it gradually revealed itself in a difficult environment.

example.zh: 他偶尔买一张彩票,但从不把中奖当成改变生活的计划。
example.py: Tā ǒu'ěr mǎi yì zhāng cǎipiào, dàn cóng bù bǎ zhòngjiǎng dàngchéng gǎibiàn shēnghuó de jìhuà.
example.en: He occasionally buys a lottery ticket, but never treats winning as a plan for changing his life.

example.zh: 新任财务主管上任后,首先重新审查了公司的现金流。
example.py: Xīnrèn cáiwù zhǔguǎn shàngrèn hòu, shǒuxiān chóngxīn shěnchá le gōngsī de xiànjīnliú.
example.en: After taking up the role, the new finance director first reviewed the company’s cash flow.

example.zh: 火灾发生后,学校提醒学生不要回宿舍抢救财物。
example.py: Huǒzāi fāshēng hòu, xuéxiào tíxǐng xuéshēng bú yào huí sùshè qiǎngjiù cáiwù.
example.en: After the fire broke out, the school reminded students not to return to the dormitory to rescue belongings.

example.zh: 这件外套的材质虽然轻薄,却能有效抵御寒风。
example.py: Zhè jiàn wàitào de cáizhì suīrán qīngbáo, què néng yǒuxiào dǐyù hánfēng.
example.en: Although the material of this coat is light and thin, it can effectively resist the cold wind.

example.zh: 仓库管理混乱会直接影响发货速度,甚至造成库存数据失真。
example.py: Cāngkù guǎnlǐ hùnluàn huì zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng fāhuò sùdù, shènzhì zàochéng kùcún shùjù shīzhēn.
example.en: Chaotic warehouse management directly affects dispatch speed and can even distort inventory data.

example.zh: 城市规划若忽视残疾人士的需求,就谈不上真正的公共服务。
example.py: Chéngshì guīhuà ruò hūshì cánjí rénshì de xūqiú, jiù tán bu shàng zhēnzhèng de gōnggòng fúwù.
example.en: If urban planning ignores the needs of disabled people, it cannot be called genuine public service.

example.zh: 这家初创公司首次参展,就获得了多家投资机构的关注。
example.py: Zhè jiā chūchuàng gōngsī shǒucì cānzhǎn, jiù huòdé le duō jiā tóuzī jīgòu de guānzhù.
example.en: The start-up attracted the attention of several investment institutions the first time it exhibited.

example.zh: 夏季的草原看似平静,却隐藏着复杂而脆弱的生态系统。
example.py: Xiàjì de cǎoyuán kànsì píngjìng, què yǐncángzhe fùzá ér cuìruò de shēngtài xìtǒng.
example.en: The summer grassland appears calm, yet it hides a complex and fragile ecosystem.

meaning: side; to lean to one side

example.zh: 他侧过身,让医护人员把担架顺利推了进去。
example.py: Tā cè guò shēn, ràng yīhù rényuán bǎ dānjià shùnlì tuī le jìnqu.
example.en: He turned sideways, allowing the medical staff to push the stretcher in smoothly.

example.zh: 这次公益活动策划得很细,连雨天的备用方案都考虑到了。
example.py: Zhè cì gōngyì huódòng cèhuà de hěn xì, lián yǔtiān de bèiyòng fāng'àn dōu kǎolǜ dào le.
example.en: This public-interest event was planned very carefully; even a backup plan for rainy weather was considered.

example.zh: 工程师在施工前反复测量地基的高度,以免日后出现偏差。
example.py: Gōngchéngshī zài shīgōng qián fǎnfù cèliáng dìjī de gāodù, yǐmiǎn rìhòu chūxiàn piānchā.
example.en: Before construction, the engineer repeatedly measured the height of the foundation to avoid deviations later.

example.zh: 面对激烈竞争,公司调整了定价策略,不再单纯依靠低价吸引客户。
example.py: Miànduì jīliè jìngzhēng, gōngsī tiáozhěng le dìngjià cèlüè, bú zài dānchún yīkào dījià xīyǐn kèhù.
example.en: Facing fierce competition, the company adjusted its pricing strategy and no longer relies purely on low prices to attract customers.

example.zh: 这篇文章的论证层次清楚,但结论仍显得有些保守。
example.py: Zhè piān wénzhāng de lùnzhèng céngcì qīngchu, dàn jiélùn réng xiǎnde yǒuxiē bǎoshǒu.
example.en: The levels of argument in this article are clear, but the conclusion still seems somewhat cautious.

example.zh: 这个决定不仅影响企业层面,也会改变整个行业的竞争格局。
example.py: Zhège juédìng bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng qǐyè céngmiàn, yě huì gǎibiàn zhěnggè hángyè de jìngzhēng géjú.
example.en: This decision affects not only the enterprise level, but will also change the competitive pattern of the whole industry.

example.zh: 她不会用叉子吃面条,最后还是换回了筷子。
example.py: Tā bú huì yòng chāzi chī miàntiáo, zuìhòu háishi huàn huí le kuàizi.
example.en: She could not use a fork to eat noodles, so in the end she switched back to chopsticks.

example.zh: 这座危楼已经被列入拆除计划,但居民安置问题还没有解决。
example.py: Zhè zuò wēilóu yǐjīng bèi lièrù chāichú jìhuà, dàn jūmín ānzhì wèntí hái méiyǒu jiějué.
example.en: This dangerous building has already been included in the demolition plan, but the issue of rehousing residents has not yet been resolved.

example.zh: 这项研究虽然投入不大,却产出了几项具有应用价值的成果。
example.py: Zhè xiàng yánjiū suīrán tóurù bú dà, què chǎnchū le jǐ xiàng jùyǒu yìngyòng jiàzhí de chéngguǒ.
example.en: Although the investment in this research was not large, it produced several results with practical value.

example.zh: 消费者越来越关心食品的产地以及生产过程是否透明。
example.py: Xiāofèizhě yuè lái yuè guānxīn shípǐn de chǎndì yǐjí shēngchǎn guòchéng shìfǒu tòumíng.
example.en: Consumers are increasingly concerned about the origin of food and whether the production process is transparent.

example.zh: 医生怀疑他的肠受到了感染,建议尽快做进一步检查。
example.py: Yīshēng huáiyí tā de cháng shòudào le gǎnrǎn, jiànyì jǐnkuài zuò jìn yí bù jiǎnchá.
example.en: The doctor suspected that his intestine had become infected and advised further checks as soon as possible.

example.zh: 由于观众人数增加,主办方临时增加了两个场次。
example.py: Yóuyú guānzhòng rénshù zēngjiā, zhǔbànfāng línshí zēngjiā le liǎng gè chǎngcì.
example.en: Because the audience numbers increased, the organiser temporarily added two sessions.

example.zh: 由于原定场地临时维修,组委会不得不把论坛改到市图书馆举行。
example.py: Yóuyú yuándìng chǎngdì línshí wéixiū, zǔwěihuì bùdébù bǎ lùntán gǎi dào shì túshūguǎn jǔxíng.
example.en: Because the original venue was undergoing temporary maintenance, the organising committee had to move the forum to the city library.

example.zh: 这根绳子的长短要根据窗户的高度来决定。
example.py: Zhè gēn shéngzi de chángduǎn yào gēnjù chuānghu de gāodù lái juédìng.
example.en: The length of this rope should be decided according to the height of the window.

example.zh: 新建的体育场馆配备了无障碍通道,方便残疾观众进出。
example.py: Xīnjiàn de tǐyù chǎngguǎn pèibèi le wú zhàng'ài tōngdào, fāngbiàn cánjí guānzhòng jìnchū.
example.en: The newly built sports venue is equipped with accessible passages, making it easier for disabled spectators to enter and leave.

example.zh: 按照常规,申请人需要先提交材料,再等待审核结果。
example.py: Ànzhào chángguī, shēnqǐngrén xūyào xiān tíjiāo cáiliào, zài děngdài shěnhé jiéguǒ.
example.en: According to the usual procedure, applicants need to submit materials first and then wait for the review result.

example.zh: 在正式场合随便打断别人发言,往往会被认为缺乏基本礼貌。
example.py: Zài zhèngshì chǎnghé suíbiàn dǎduàn biérén fāyán, wǎngwǎng huì bèi rènwéi quēfá jīběn lǐmào.
example.en: Interrupting other people casually on a formal occasion is often regarded as a lack of basic manners.

example.zh: 消费者要求厂家公开检测报告,而不是只在广告中强调安全。
example.py: Xiāofèizhě yāoqiú chǎngjiā gōngkāi jiǎncè bàogào, ér bù shì zhǐ zài guǎnggào zhōng qiángdiào ānquán.
example.en: Consumers demanded that the manufacturer publish the test report, rather than merely emphasise safety in advertisements.

example.zh: 纪录片中最震撼的场景,是孩子们在废墟旁继续上课。
example.py: Jìlùpiàn zhōng zuì zhènhàn de chǎngjǐng, shì háizimen zài fèixū páng jìxù shàngkè.
example.en: The most shocking scene in the documentary is of the children continuing their lessons beside the ruins.

example.zh: 比赛结束后,球迷冲进球场,场面一度相当混乱。
example.py: Bǐsài jiéshù hòu, qiúmí chōng jìn qiúchǎng, chǎngmiàn yídù xiāngdāng hùnluàn.
example.en: After the match ended, fans rushed onto the pitch, and the scene became quite chaotic for a while.

example.zh: 这个地区常年缺水,居民不得不依靠地下水和外地供水。
example.py: Zhège dìqū chángnián quēshuǐ, jūmín bùdébù yīkào dìxiàshuǐ hé wàidì gōngshuǐ.
example.en: This region lacks water all year round, so residents have to rely on groundwater and water supplied from elsewhere.

example.zh: 多家厂商已经宣布,将在明年推出更节能的电动汽车。
example.py: Duō jiā chǎngshāng yǐjīng xuānbù, jiāng zài míngnián tuīchū gèng jiénéng de diàndòng qìchē.
example.en: Several manufacturers have already announced that they will launch more energy-efficient electric cars next year.

example.zh: 均衡饮食和稳定的社交关系被认为有助于长寿。
example.py: Jūnhéng yǐnshí hé wěndìng de shèjiāo guānxì bèi rènwéi yǒuzhù yú chángshòu.
example.en: A balanced diet and stable social relationships are considered helpful for longevity.

example.zh: 台风过后,抢修人员连夜清理倒树,确保主干道尽快畅通。
example.py: Táifēng guòhòu, qiǎngxiū rényuán liányè qīnglǐ dǎoshù, quèbǎo zhǔgàndào jǐnkuài chàngtōng.
example.en: After the typhoon, repair crews cleared fallen trees overnight to ensure the main road became clear as soon as possible.

example.zh: 这种药应在常温下保存,避免阳光直射。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng yào yīng zài chángwēn xià bǎocún, bìmiǎn yángguāng zhíshè.
example.en: This medicine should be stored at room temperature and kept out of direct sunlight.

example.zh: 这款小说虽然没有大规模宣传,却凭借读者口碑长期畅销。
example.py: Zhè kuǎn xiǎoshuō suīrán méiyǒu dà guīmó xuānchuán, què píngjiè dúzhě kǒubēi chángqī chàngxiāo.
example.en: Although this novel had no large-scale publicity, it has sold well for a long time thanks to readers' word of mouth.

example.zh: 老师提醒学生,引用资料可以,但整段抄别人的文章就是学术不诚实。
example.py: Lǎoshī tíxǐng xuéshēng, yǐnyòng zīliào kěyǐ, dàn zhěng duàn chāo biérén de wénzhāng jiù shì xuéshù bù chéngshí.
example.en: The teacher reminded the students that citing sources is fine, but copying whole passages from someone else's article is academic dishonesty.

example.zh: 每个朝代都有自己的制度特色,但也会继承前人的政治经验。
example.py: Měi gè cháodài dōu yǒu zìjǐ de zhìdù tèsè, dàn yě huì jìchéng qiánrén de zhèngzhì jīngyàn.
example.en: Every dynasty has its own institutional features, but it also inherits political experience from those before it.

example.zh: 他原本只想把炒股当作兴趣,却逐渐投入了过多时间和精力。
example.py: Tā yuánběn zhǐ xiǎng bǎ chǎogǔ dàngzuò xìngqù, què zhújiàn tóurù le guò duō shíjiān hé jīnglì.
example.en: He originally only wanted to treat stock speculation as a hobby, but gradually put too much time and energy into it.

example.zh: 夫妻偶尔吵架并不可怕,可怕的是双方从不真正沟通。
example.py: Fūqī ǒu'ěr chǎojià bìng bù kěpà, kěpà de shì shuāngfāng cóng bù zhēnzhèng gōutōng.
example.en: It is not frightening for a couple to quarrel occasionally; what is frightening is that both sides never truly communicate.

example.zh: 年轻消费者追随潮流的同时,也越来越重视产品背后的价值观。
example.py: Niánqīng xiāofèizhě zhuīsuí cháoliú de tóngshí, yě yuèláiyuè zhòngshì chǎnpǐn bèihòu de jiàzhíguān.
example.en: While following trends, young consumers are also paying more and more attention to the values behind products.

example.zh: 地下室长期潮湿,墙面已经出现了明显的霉斑。
example.py: Dìxiàshì chángqī cháoshī, qiángmiàn yǐjīng chūxiàn le míngxiǎn de méibān.
example.en: The basement has been damp for a long time, and obvious mould marks have already appeared on the walls.

example.zh: 面对失败者,我们不该嘲笑,而应该分析失败背后的原因。
example.py: Miànduì shībàizhě, wǒmen bù gāi cháoxiào, ér yīnggāi fēnxī shībài bèihòu de yuányīn.
example.en: When facing someone who has failed, we should not mock them, but should analyse the reasons behind the failure.

example.zh: 这家公司的成功,并不只是超越了竞争对手,更改变了整个行业的规则。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī de chénggōng, bìng bù zhǐshì chāoyuè le jìngzhēng duìshǒu, gèng gǎibiàn le zhěnggè hángyè de guīzé.
example.en: The company’s success did more than surpass its competitors; it changed the rules of the entire industry.

example.zh: 乘客可以通过手机查询列车是否晚点。
example.py: Chéngkè kěyǐ tōngguò shǒujī cháxún lièchē shìfǒu wǎndiǎn.
example.en: Passengers can check on their phones whether the train is delayed.

example.zh: 不同地区的收入差异如果长期扩大,社会矛盾可能会加深。
example.py: Bùtóng dìqū de shōurù chāyì rúguǒ chángqī kuòdà, shèhuì máodùn kěnéng huì jiāshēn.
example.en: If income differences between regions continue to widen over the long term, social tensions may deepen.

example.zh: 为了安全起见,厨房里的插座都安装了防水保护盖。
example.py: Wèile ānquán qǐjiàn, chúfáng lǐ de chāzuò dōu ānzhuāng le fángshuǐ bǎohù gài.
example.en: For safety's sake, the sockets in the kitchen have all been fitted with waterproof protective covers.

example.zh: 由于证据不足,律师建议当事人暂时撤回起诉。
example.py: Yóuyú zhèngjù bùzú, lǜshī jiànyì dāngshìrén zànshí chèhuí qǐsù.
example.en: Because the evidence was insufficient, the lawyer advised the client to withdraw the lawsuit temporarily.

example.zh: 趁雨还没下大,我们先把设备搬到室内吧。
example.py: Chèn yǔ hái méi xià dà, wǒmen xiān bǎ shèbèi bān dào shìnèi ba.
example.en: Before the rain gets heavy, let’s move the equipment indoors first.

example.zh: 为了减少碳排放,越来越多的员工选择乘地铁上班。
example.py: Wèile jiǎnshǎo tàn páifàng, yuèláiyuè duō de yuángōng xuǎnzé chéng dìtiě shàngbān.
example.en: In order to reduce carbon emissions, more and more employees choose to take the underground to work.

example.zh: 这项政策实施后,企业投诉量减少了近三成。
example.py: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè shíshī hòu, qǐyè tóusù liàng jiǎnshǎo le jìn sān chéng.
example.en: After this policy was implemented, the number of company complaints fell by nearly thirty percent.

example.zh: 这根旧木柱勉强撑着屋顶,但已经不适合继续使用。
example.py: Zhè gēn jiù mùzhù miǎnqiǎng chēngzhe wūdǐng, dàn yǐjīng bù shìhé jìxù shǐyòng.
example.en: This old wooden post is barely supporting the roof, but it is no longer suitable for continued use.

example.zh: 这个陶罐看似普通,却能盛下两升左右的水。
example.py: Zhège táoguàn kànsì pǔtōng, què néng chéng xià liǎng shēng zuǒyòu de shuǐ.
example.en: This clay pot looks ordinary, yet it can hold about two litres of water.

example.zh: 这次国际论坛由本市大学承办,预计将吸引数百名学者。
example.py: Zhè cì guójì lùntán yóu běn shì dàxué chéngbàn, yùjì jiāng xīyǐn shù bǎi míng xuézhě.
example.en: This international forum is being hosted by the city’s university and is expected to attract hundreds of scholars.

example.zh: 教育的目的不只是惩罚错误,更是帮助学生理解后果。
example.py: Jiàoyù de mùdì bù zhǐ shì chéngfá cuòwù, gèng shì bāngzhù xuéshēng lǐjiě hòuguǒ.
example.en: The purpose of education is not only to punish mistakes, but also to help students understand the consequences.

example.zh: 这座城市获得“绿色示范区”的称号,并不是偶然的。
example.py: "Zhè zuò chéngshì huòdé ""lǜsè shìfànqū"" de chēnghào, bìng bú shì ǒurán de."
example.en: It was no accident that this city gained the title of “green demonstration zone”.

example.zh: 在正式场合,最好先确认对方希望别人怎样称呼他。
example.py: Zài zhèngshì chǎnghé, zuìhǎo xiān quèrèn duìfāng xīwàng biérén zěnyàng chēnghu tā.
example.en: In formal situations, it is best to first confirm how the other person wishes to be addressed.

meaning: to conclude a deal, to transact

example.zh: 这笔交易最终以低于预期的价格成交,令卖方不得不重新评估市场走势。
example.py: Zhè bǐ jiāoyì zuìzhōng yǐ dī yú yùqī de jiàgé chéngjiāo, lìng màifāng bùdébù chóngxīn pínggū shìchǎng zǒushì.
example.en: The deal was ultimately concluded at a lower-than-expected price, forcing the seller to reassess market trends.

example.zh: 政府承诺在三年内改善老旧小区的公共设施,但居民更关心资金是否能落实。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ chéngnuò zài sān nián nèi gǎishàn lǎojiù xiǎoqū de gōnggòng shèshī, dàn jūmín gèng guānxīn zījīn shìfǒu néng luòshí.
example.en: The government promised to improve public facilities in old residential communities within three years, but residents are more concerned about whether the funding will actually be put in place.

example.zh: 成千上万的志愿者在灾后赶到现场,协助分发物资和安置居民。
example.py: Chéngqiān-shàngwàn de zhìyuànzhě zài zāihòu gǎndào xiànchǎng, xiézhù fēnfā wùzī hé ānzhì jūmín.
example.en: Tens of thousands of volunteers arrived at the scene after the disaster to help distribute supplies and resettle residents.

example.zh: 数据经过整理后,呈现出一种与最初假设完全不同的趋势。
example.py: Shùjù jīngguò zhěnglǐ hòu, chéngxiàn chū yì zhǒng yǔ zuìchū jiǎshè wánquán bù tóng de qūshì.
example.en: After being organised, the data revealed a trend completely different from the original hypothesis.

example.zh: 如果培训只停留在形式上,即使投入再多资源也难以取得成效。
example.py: Rúguǒ péixùn zhǐ tíngliú zài xíngshì shàng, jíshǐ tóurù zài duō zīyuán yě nányǐ qǔdé chéngxiào.
example.en: If training remains merely a formality, it will be difficult to achieve results no matter how many resources are invested.

example.zh: 在长期合作中,诚信往往比短期利润更能决定一家公司的声誉。
example.py: Zài chángqī hézuò zhōng, chéngxìn wǎngwǎng bǐ duǎnqī lìrùn gèng néng juédìng yì jiā gōngsī de shēngyù.
example.en: In long-term cooperation, integrity often does more than short-term profit to determine a company’s reputation.

example.zh: 这个成语表面上讲的是动物,其实讽刺的是人的盲目自信。
example.py: Zhège chéngyǔ biǎomiàn shàng jiǎng de shì dòngwù, qíshí fěngcì de shì rén de mángmù zìxìn.
example.en: On the surface this idiom is about animals, but it actually satirises people’s blind self-confidence.

example.zh: 随着交通网络改善,偏远城镇与大城市之间的联系明显加强。
example.py: Suízhe jiāotōng wǎngluò gǎishàn, piānyuǎn chéngzhèn yǔ dà chéngshì zhījiān de liánxì míngxiǎn jiāqiáng.
example.en: As the transport network improves, the links between remote towns and big cities have clearly strengthened.

example.zh: 人们通常把这种转型称作产业升级,但过程远比口号复杂。
example.py: Rénmen tōngcháng bǎ zhè zhǒng zhuǎnxíng chēngzuò chǎnyè shēngjí, dàn guòchéng yuǎn bǐ kǒuhào fùzá.
example.en: People usually call this kind of transformation industrial upgrading, but the process is far more complex than the slogan.

example.zh: 听到事故消息后,整个办公室的气氛变得异常沉重。
example.py: Tīngdào shìgù xiāoxi hòu, zhěnggè bàngōngshì de qìfēn biàn de yìcháng chénzhòng.
example.en: After hearing the news of the accident, the atmosphere in the whole office became unusually heavy.

example.zh: 如果申请材料存在虚假信息,相关资格可能会被撤销。
example.py: Rúguǒ shēnqǐng cáiliào cúnzài xūjiǎ xìnxī, xiāngguān zīgé kěnéng huì bèi chèxiāo.
example.en: If the application materials contain false information, the relevant qualification may be revoked.

example.zh: 为了复原古建筑,工匠特意查阅旧图纸,把梁柱的长度精确到一尺以内。
example.py: Wèile fùyuán gǔ jiànzhù, gōngjiàng tèyì cháyuè jiù túzhǐ, bǎ liángzhù de chángdù jīngquè dào yì chǐ yǐnèi.
example.en: To restore the old building, the craftsmen consulted the original drawings and measured the beams and columns to within one chi.

example.zh: 这款书柜的尺寸虽然合适,但它的颜色与客厅整体风格并不协调。
example.py: Zhè kuǎn shūguì de chǐcùn suīrán héshì, dàn tā de yánsè yǔ kètīng zhěngtǐ fēnggé bìng bù xiétiáo.
example.en: Although the size of this bookcase is suitable, its colour does not match the overall style of the sitting room.

example.zh: 真正持久的竞争力来自制度创新,而不是一次性的营销活动。
example.py: Zhēnzhèng chíjiǔ de jìngzhēnglì láizì zhìdù chuàngxīn, ér bú shì yí cì xìng de yíngxiāo huódòng.
example.en: Genuinely lasting competitiveness comes from institutional innovation, not from one-off marketing campaigns.

example.zh: 投资者如果长期持有优质资产,往往比频繁买卖更容易获得稳定回报。
example.py: Tóuzīzhě rúguǒ chángqī chíyǒu yōuzhì zīchǎn, wǎngwǎng bǐ pínfán mǎimài gèng róngyì huòdé wěndìng huíbào.
example.en: Investors who hold high-quality assets over the long term are often more likely to obtain stable returns than those who trade frequently.

example.zh: 他冲我笑了笑,似乎是在暗示会议已经结束。
example.py: Tā chòng wǒ xiào le xiào, sìhū shì zài ànshì huìyì yǐjīng jiéshù.
example.en: He smiled at me, as if hinting that the meeting was already over.

example.zh: 他并不盲目崇拜名人,而是关注他们成功背后的长期努力。
example.py: Tā bìng bù mángmù chóngbài míngrén, ér shì guānzhù tāmen chénggōng bèihòu de chángqī nǔlì.
example.en: He does not blindly worship celebrities, but pays attention to the long-term effort behind their success.

example.zh: 他一时冲动辞了职,冷静下来后才意识到自己没有任何后续安排。
example.py: Tā yìshí chōngdòng cí le zhí, lěngjìng xiàlai hòu cái yìshí dào zìjǐ méiyǒu rènhé hòuxù ānpái.
example.en: He quit his job on impulse, and only after calming down did he realise he had no follow-up plan at all.

example.zh: 全球能源价格的波动,对制造业的成本结构造成了巨大冲击。
example.py: Quánqiú néngyuán jiàgé de bōdòng, duì zhìzàoyè de chéngběn jiégòu zàochéng le jùdà chōngjī.
example.en: Fluctuations in global energy prices have had a huge impact on the cost structure of manufacturing.

example.zh: 灾后重建不仅要恢复房屋,更要恢复居民对未来的信心。
example.py: Zāi hòu chóngjiàn bùjǐn yào huīfù fángwū, gèng yào huīfù jūmín duì wèilái de xìnxīn.
example.en: Post-disaster reconstruction must restore not only houses, but also residents’ confidence in the future.

example.zh: 志愿服务让他的暑假过得格外充实,也让他更理解社区工作的复杂性。
example.py: Zhìyuàn fúwù ràng tā de shǔjià guò de géwài chōngshí, yě ràng tā gèng lǐjiě shèqū gōngzuò de fùzáxìng.
example.en: Voluntary work made his summer holiday especially fulfilling and helped him better understand the complexity of community work.

example.zh: 当个人利益与公共规则发生冲突时,制度必须给出清晰的处理原则。
example.py: Dāng gèrén lìyì yǔ gōnggòng guīzé fāshēng chōngtū shí, zhìdù bìxū gěi chū qīngxī de chǔlǐ yuánzé.
example.en: When personal interests conflict with public rules, the system must provide clear principles for handling the situation.

example.zh: 资金还没有到位,项目经理愁得整晚睡不着。
example.py: Zījīn hái méiyǒu dàowèi, xiàngmù jīnglǐ chóu de zhěng wǎn shuì bù zháo.
example.en: Since the funding has not yet arrived, the project manager is so worried that he cannot sleep all night.

example.zh: 为了筹备这次国际会议,秘书处提前半年联系了各国代表。
example.py: Wèile chóubèi zhè cì guójì huìyì, mìshūchù tíqián bàn nián liánxì le gè guó dàibiǎo.
example.en: To prepare for this international conference, the secretariat contacted representatives from various countries half a year in advance.

meaning: to draw a prize, to enter a lucky draw

example.zh: 活动结束前,主办方安排了一轮抽奖,奖品由参展商共同提供。
example.py: Huódòng jiéshù qián, zhǔbànfāng ānpái le yì lún chōujiǎng, jiǎngpǐn yóu cānzhǎn shāng gòngtóng tígōng.
example.en: Before the event ended, the organisers arranged a lucky draw, with prizes jointly provided by the exhibitors.

example.zh: 这个概念过于抽象,如果没有案例支持,普通读者很难真正理解。
example.py: Zhège gàiniàn guòyú chōuxiàng, rúguǒ méiyǒu ànlì zhīchí, pǔtōng dúzhě hěn nán zhēnzhèng lǐjiě.
example.en: This concept is too abstract; without case support, ordinary readers find it hard to truly understand.

example.zh: 除少数紧急情况外,医院不接受没有预约的检查申请。
example.py: Chú shǎoshù jǐnjí qíngkuàng wài, yīyuàn bù jiēshòu méiyǒu yùyuē de jiǎnchá shēnqǐng.
example.en: Except for a small number of emergencies, the hospital does not accept examination requests without an appointment.

meaning: string, bunch; measure word for strings

example.zh: 他从市场买了一串葡萄,却发现有一半已经变质。
example.py: Tā cóng shìchǎng mǎi le yí chuàn pútao, què fāxiàn yǒu yíbàn yǐjīng biànzhì.
example.en: He bought a bunch of grapes at the market, only to find that half of them had already gone bad.

example.zh: 这门手艺之所以能够传承数百年,是因为每一代工匠都愿意耐心打磨细节。
example.py: Zhè mén shǒuyì zhī suǒyǐ nénggòu chuánchéng shù bǎi nián, shì yīnwèi měi yí dài gōngjiàng dōu yuànyì nàixīn dǎmó xìjié.
example.en: This craft has been passed down for hundreds of years because every generation of artisans has been willing to polish the details patiently.

example.zh: 请把会议结论准确传达给各部门,以免执行时出现误解。
example.py: Qǐng bǎ huìyì jiélùn zhǔnquè chuándá gěi gè bùmén, yǐmiǎn zhíxíng shí chūxiàn wùjiě.
example.en: Please accurately convey the meeting conclusions to each department, so that misunderstandings do not arise during implementation.

example.zh: 那名男子没预约就闯进会议室,打断了正在进行的谈判。
example.py: Nà míng nánzǐ méi yùyuē jiù chuǎng jìn huìyìshì, dǎduàn le zhèngzài jìnxíng de tánpàn.
example.en: The man rushed into the meeting room without an appointment and interrupted the negotiations in progress.

example.zh: 他辞去稳定工作后,和几位同学共同创办了一家环保科技公司。
example.py: Tā cíqù wěndìng gōngzuò hòu, hé jǐ wèi tóngxué gòngtóng chuàngbàn le yì jiā huánbǎo kējì gōngsī.
example.en: After resigning from a stable job, he and several classmates jointly founded an environmental technology company.

example.zh: 政府计划创建一个公开数据库,以便公众查询污染源信息。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ jìhuà chuàngjiàn yí ge gōngkāi shùjùkù, yǐbiàn gōngzhòng cháxún wūrǎnyuán xìnxī.
example.en: The government plans to create a public database so that the public can check information about sources of pollution.

example.zh: 市政府开设了网上服务窗口,方便居民查询办事进度。
example.py: Shì zhèngfǔ kāishè le wǎngshàng fúwù chuāngkǒu, fāngbiàn jūmín cháxún bànshì jìndù.
example.en: The municipal government opened an online service window, making it easier for residents to check the progress of administrative procedures.

example.zh: 这位学者创立的理论改变了人们对城市发展的理解。
example.py: Zhè wèi xuézhě chuànglì de lǐlùn gǎibiàn le rénmen duì chéngshì fāzhǎn de lǐjiě.
example.en: The theory founded by this scholar changed people’s understanding of urban development.

meaning: to go through, to pass through

example.zh: 调查小组穿过受灾地区,记录了道路和桥梁的损毁情况。
example.py: Diàochá xiǎozǔ chuānguò shòuzāi dìqū, jìlù le dàolù hé qiáoliáng de sǔnhuǐ qíngkuàng.
example.en: The investigation team passed through the disaster-stricken area and recorded the damage to roads and bridges.

example.zh: 这个广告的创意并不复杂,却准确抓住了年轻人的心理。
example.py: Zhège guǎnggào de chuàngyì bìng bù fùzá, què zhǔnquè zhuā zhù le niánqīng rén de xīnlǐ.
example.en: The idea behind this advertisement is not complicated, but it accurately captures the psychology of young people.

example.zh: 这种病毒主要通过空气传染,因此室内通风显得尤为重要。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng bìngdú zhǔyào tōngguò kōngqì chuánrǎn, yīncǐ shìnèi tōngfēng xiǎnde yóuwéi zhòngyào.
example.en: This virus is mainly transmitted through the air, so indoor ventilation is especially important.

example.zh: 面对传染病,最有效的公共政策往往是早发现、早隔离、早治疗。
example.py: Miànduì chuánrǎnbìng, zuì yǒuxiào de gōnggòng zhèngcè wǎngwǎng shì zǎo fāxiàn, zǎo gélí, zǎo zhìliáo.
example.en: When facing an infectious disease, the most effective public policy is often early detection, early isolation, and early treatment.

example.zh: 老师并不急于传授技巧,而是先培养学生独立思考的习惯。
example.py: Lǎoshī bìng bù jí yú chuánshòu jìqiǎo, ér shì xiān péiyǎng xuésheng dúlì sīkǎo de xíguàn.
example.en: The teacher is not eager to teach techniques, but first cultivates the students' habit of independent thinking.

example.zh: 由于网络不稳定,实验数据在传输过程中出现了明显延迟。
example.py: Yóuyú wǎngluò bù wěndìng, shíyàn shùjù zài chuánshū guòchéng zhōng chūxiàn le míngxiǎn yánchí.
example.en: Because the network was unstable, there was an obvious delay during the transmission of the experimental data.

example.zh: 虽然电子邮件已经普及,法院仍接受部分材料通过传真提交。
example.py: Suīrán diànzǐ yóujiàn yǐjīng pǔjí, fǎyuàn réng jiēshòu bùfen cáiliào tōngguò chuánzhēn tíjiāo.
example.en: Although email is already widespread, the court still accepts some materials submitted by fax.

example.zh: 台风靠近时,港口要求所有船只尽快返航并停止作业。
example.py: Táifēng kàojìn shí, gǎngkǒu yāoqiú suǒyǒu chuánzhī jǐnkuài fǎnháng bìng tíngzhǐ zuòyè.
example.en: When the typhoon approached, the port required all vessels to return as soon as possible and stop operations.

example.zh: 调查小组已经形成初步结论,但仍需进一步核实关键证据。
example.py: Diàochá xiǎozǔ yǐjīng xíngchéng chūbù jiélùn, dàn réng xū jìnyí bù héshí guānjiàn zhèngjù.
example.en: The investigation team has already formed a preliminary conclusion, but still needs to further verify key evidence.

meaning: to appear on stage, to enter

example.zh: 主角还没出场,观众已经因为音乐和灯光变得紧张起来。
example.py: Zhǔjué hái méi chūchǎng, guānzhòng yǐjīng yīnwèi yīnyuè hé dēngguāng biàn de jǐnzhāng qǐlai.
example.en: The main character had not yet appeared, but the audience had already become tense because of the music and lighting.

example.zh: 这座古城处处保留着历史痕迹,却并不显得陈旧。
example.py: Zhè zuò gǔchéng chùchù bǎoliú zhe lìshǐ hénjì, què bìng bù xiǎnde chénjiù.
example.en: This ancient city preserves traces of history everywhere, yet it does not seem outdated.

example.zh: 数据必须储存在加密服务器上,以降低被盗取的风险。
example.py: Shùjù bìxū chǔcún zài jiāmì sìfúqì shàng, yǐ jiàngdī bèi dàoqǔ de fēngxiǎn.
example.en: Data must be stored on encrypted servers to reduce the risk of being stolen.

example.zh: 这门课程虽然叫初等统计,但对数学基础薄弱的学生并不轻松。
example.py: Zhè mén kèchéng suīrán jiào chūděng tǒngjì, dàn duì shùxué jīchǔ bóruò de xuésheng bìng bù qīngsōng.
example.en: Although this course is called elementary statistics, it is not easy for students with a weak mathematical foundation.

example.zh: 对于故意泄露客户资料的员工,公司将依法处罚。
example.py: Duìyú gùyì xièlòu kèhù zīliào de yuángōng, gōngsī jiāng yīfǎ chǔfá.
example.en: The company will punish employees who deliberately leak customer data in accordance with the law.

example.zh: 除非证据更加充分,否则法院不会轻易改变原判。
example.py: Chúfēi zhèngjù gèngjiā chōngfèn, fǒuzé fǎyuàn bú huì qīngyì gǎibiàn yuánpàn.
example.en: Unless the evidence is more sufficient, the court will not easily change the original judgement.

example.zh: 这条线必须与地面保持垂直,否则测量结果会出现偏差。
example.py: Zhè tiáo xiàn bìxū yǔ dìmiàn bǎochí chuízhí, fǒuzé cèliáng jiéguǒ huì chūxiàn piānchā.
example.en: This line must remain vertical to the ground; otherwise, the measurement results will deviate.

example.zh: 由于护照即将过期,他在出境前被工作人员拦了下来。
example.py: Yóuyú hùzhào jíjiāng guòqī, tā zài chūjìng qián bèi gōngzuò rényuán lán le xiàlai.
example.en: Because his passport was about to expire, he was stopped by staff before leaving the country.

example.zh: 这项改革能否落实,关键在于各部门是否愿意真正出力。
example.py: Zhè xiàng gǎigé néngfǒu luòshí, guānjiàn zàiyú gè bùmén shìfǒu yuànyì zhēnzhèng chūlì.
example.en: Whether this reform can be implemented depends on whether each department is truly willing to make an effort.

example.zh: 这座小城因为传统手工艺而出名,每年都吸引大量游客。
example.py: Zhè zuò xiǎochéng yīnwèi chuántǒng shǒugōngyì ér chūmíng, měi nián dōu xīyǐn dàliàng yóukè.
example.en: This small city is famous for its traditional handicrafts and attracts large numbers of tourists every year.

example.zh: 这件衬衫是纯棉的,穿起来比化纤材料更舒服。
example.py: Zhè jiàn chènshān shì chúnmián de, chuān qǐlai bǐ huàxiān cáiliào gèng shūfu.
example.en: This shirt is pure cotton, so it feels more comfortable than synthetic fibre materials.

example.zh: 两份财务报表的数字有明显出入,必须重新核对原始凭证。
example.py: Liǎng fèn cáiwù bàobiǎo de shùzì yǒu míngxiǎn chūrù, bìxū chóngxīn héduì yuánshǐ píngzhèng.
example.en: The figures in the two financial statements have an obvious discrepancy, so the original vouchers must be checked again.

example.zh: 进入考场前,考生必须出示有效证件,否则不得参加考试。
example.py: Jìnrù kǎochǎng qián, kǎoshēng bìxū chūshì yǒuxiào zhèngjiàn, fǒuzé bùdé cānjiā kǎoshì.
example.en: Before entering the exam room, candidates must present valid ID; otherwise, they may not take the exam.

example.zh: 年轻人若能尽早养成储蓄习惯,抗风险能力会明显提高。
example.py: Niánqīng rén ruò néng jǐnzǎo yǎngchéng chǔxù xíguàn, kàng fēngxiǎn nénglì huì míngxiǎn tígāo.
example.en: If young people can develop a habit of saving early, their ability to withstand risk will improve significantly.

example.zh: 国庆期间,许多家庭选择错峰出游,以避开拥挤的交通。
example.py: Guóqìng qījiān, xǔduō jiātíng xuǎnzé cuòfēng chūyóu, yǐ bìkāi yōngjǐ de jiāotōng.
example.en: During the National Day holiday, many families choose to travel outside peak times to avoid crowded transport.

example.zh: 出于安全考虑,主办方临时限制了现场观众的人数。
example.py: Chūyú ānquán kǎolǜ, zhǔbànfāng línshí xiànzhì le xiànchǎng guānzhòng de rénshù.
example.en: Out of safety considerations, the organiser temporarily limited the number of spectators at the venue.

example.zh: 玫瑰枝上的刺很锋利,修剪时最好戴上厚手套。
example.py: Méiguī zhī shàng de cì hěn fēnglì, xiūjiǎn shí zuì hǎo dài shàng hòu shǒutào.
example.en: The thorns on the rose branches are sharp, so it is best to wear thick gloves when pruning them.

example.zh: 此刻最重要的不是追究责任,而是尽快把被困人员救出来。
example.py: Cǐkè zuì zhòngyào de bú shì zhuījiū zérèn, ér shì jǐnkuài bǎ bèi kùn rényuán jiù chūlai.
example.en: At this moment, the most important thing is not to assign blame, but to rescue the trapped people as quickly as possible.

example.zh: 博物馆展出的那批瓷器保存完好,釉色至今仍十分鲜亮。
example.py: Bówùguǎn zhǎnchū de nà pī cíqì bǎocún wánhǎo, yòusè zhìjīn réng shífēn xiānliàng.
example.en: The porcelain pieces exhibited by the museum are well preserved, and their glaze remains very bright to this day.

example.zh: 为了保证数据可靠,研究团队把每次实验的次数控制在同一范围内。
example.py: Wèile bǎozhèng shùjù kěkào, yánjiū tuánduì bǎ měi cì shíyàn de cìshù kòngzhì zài tóng yī fànwéi nèi.
example.en: To ensure the data was reliable, the research team kept the number of repetitions for each experiment within the same range.

example.zh: 会议结束后,他匆匆收起资料,赶去参加下一场谈判。
example.py: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, tā cōngcōng shōu qǐ zīliào, gǎn qù cānjiā xià yì chǎng tánpàn.
example.en: After the meeting ended, he hurriedly gathered up the documents and rushed to the next negotiation.

example.zh: 由于准备得过于匆忙,发布会上出现了几处技术失误。
example.py: Yóuyú zhǔnbèi de guòyú cōngmáng, fābùhuì shàng chūxiàn le jǐ chù jìshù shīwù.
example.en: Because the preparation was too rushed, several technical mistakes occurred at the press conference.

example.zh: 这家公司从未公开承认过产品存在设计缺陷。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī cóngwèi gōngkāi chéngrèn guò chǎnpǐn cúnzài shèjì quēxiàn.
example.en: This company has never publicly admitted that the product has design flaws.

meaning: to be employed, to work in a profession

example.zh: 医疗行业要求从业人员持续更新知识,否则很难应对新的挑战。
example.py: Yīliáo hángyè yāoqiú cóngyè rényuán chíxù gēngxīn zhīshi, fǒuzé hěn nán yìngduì xīn de tiǎozhàn.
example.en: The medical profession requires practitioners to keep updating their knowledge; otherwise it is hard to respond to new challenges.

example.zh: 这道凉菜只要加一点醋,味道就会立刻清爽许多。
example.py: Zhè dào liángcài zhǐyào jiā yìdiǎn cù, wèidào jiù huì lìkè qīngshuǎng xǔduō.
example.en: As long as a little vinegar is added to this cold dish, the taste immediately becomes much fresher.

example.zh: 这块饼干受潮以后不再脆,口感明显差了许多。
example.py: Zhè kuài bǐnggān shòucháo yǐhòu bú zài cuì, kǒugǎn míngxiǎn chà le xǔduō.
example.en: After this biscuit became damp, it was no longer crisp, and the texture was noticeably much worse.

example.zh: 在连续的冲击下,原本脆弱的供应链几乎陷入停顿。
example.py: Zài liánxù de chōngjī xià, yuánběn cuìruò de gōngyìngliàn jīhū xiànrù tíngdùn.
example.en: Under repeated shocks, the originally fragile supply chain almost came to a standstill.

example.zh: 这块屏幕只比旧款宽了半寸,使用体验却明显改善。
example.py: Zhè kuài píngmù zhǐ bǐ jiùkuǎn kuān le bàn cùn, shǐyòng tǐyàn què míngxiǎn gǎishàn.
example.en: This screen is only half a cun wider than the old model, yet the user experience has clearly improved.

example.zh: 为了防止资料丢失,公司把重要文件同时存储在本地和云端。
example.py: Wèile fángzhǐ zīliào diūshī, gōngsī bǎ zhòngyào wénjiàn tóngshí cúnchǔ zài běndì hé yúnduān.
example.en: To prevent data loss, the company stores important files both locally and in the cloud.

example.zh: 地震过后,救援队首先赶往交通最不便的村庄。
example.py: Dìzhèn guòhòu, jiùyuán duì shǒuxiān gǎnwǎng jiāotōng zuì bù fāngbiàn de cūnzhuāng.
example.en: After the earthquake, the rescue team first headed to the village with the most inconvenient transport links.

example.zh: 一次挫折并不足以决定项目的最终命运。
example.py: Yí cì cuòzhé bìng bù zúyǐ juédìng xiàngmù de zuìzhōng mìngyùn.
example.en: A single setback is not enough to decide the project’s eventual fate.

example.zh: 志愿者在体育馆里迅速搭起了临时救助站。
example.py: Zhìyuànzhě zài tǐyùguǎn lǐ xùnsù dā qǐ le línshí jiùzhùzhàn.
example.en: The volunteers quickly set up a temporary aid station inside the sports hall.

example.zh: 那位大臣表面上支持改革,实际上却一直在拖延执行。
example.py: Nà wèi dàchén biǎomiàn shàng zhīchí gǎigé, shíjì shàng què yìzhí zài tuōyán zhíxíng.
example.en: That minister publicly supports reform, but in reality has been delaying its implementation.

example.zh: 看到原本亏损的项目突然盈利,董事会成员都大吃一惊。
example.py: Kàndào yuánběn kuīsǔn de xiàngmù tūrán yínglì, dǒngshìhuì chéngyuán dōu dà chī yì jīng.
example.en: Seeing the project that had originally been losing money suddenly become profitable, the board members were all greatly surprised.

example.zh: 春雨过后,大地像被重新唤醒一样,到处充满生机。
example.py: Chūnyǔ guòhòu, dàdì xiàng bèi chóngxīn huànxǐng yíyàng, dàochù chōngmǎn shēngjī.
example.en: After the spring rain, the earth seemed to have been awakened again, full of life everywhere.

example.zh: 真正打动观众的不是华丽的场面,而是人物之间的情感。
example.py: Zhēnzhèng dǎdòng guānzhòng de bú shì huálì de chǎngmiàn, ér shì rénwù zhījiān de qínggǎn.
example.en: What truly moves the audience is not the magnificent spectacle, but the emotions between the characters.

example.zh: 参加培训的员工大都来自基层岗位,因此课程设计必须贴近实际。
example.py: Cānjiā péixùn de yuángōng dàdū láizì jīcéng gǎngwèi, yīncǐ kèchéng shèjì bìxū tiējìn shíjì.
example.en: Most employees attending the training are from front-line positions, so the course design must be close to reality.

example.zh: 他在会议上发言很大方,即使面对质疑也没有显得紧张。
example.py: Tā zài huìyì shàng fāyán hěn dàfang, jíshǐ miànduì zhìyí yě méiyǒu xiǎnde jǐnzhāng.
example.en: He speaks very naturally in meetings and does not seem nervous even when facing questions.

example.zh: 新政策实施后,小微企业的审批时间大幅缩短。
example.py: Xīn zhèngcè shíshī hòu, xiǎowēi qǐyè de shěnpī shíjiān dàfú suōduǎn.
example.en: After the new policy was implemented, approval times for small and micro enterprises were greatly reduced.

example.zh: 对方承诺会在三个工作日内给出正式答复。
example.py: Duìfāng chéngnuò huì zài sān ge gōngzuòrì nèi gěi chū zhèngshì dáfù.
example.en: The other party promised to give a formal reply within three working days.

example.zh: 听说项目终于通过审核,大伙儿都松了一口气。
example.py: Tīngshuō xiàngmù zhōngyú tōngguò shěnhé, dàhuǒr dōu sōng le yì kǒu qì.
example.en: Hearing that the project had finally passed review, everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

example.zh: 他听到这个消息后整个人都呆住了,半天说不出一句话。
example.py: Tā tīngdào zhège xiāoxi hòu zhěng gè rén dōu dāi zhù le, bàntiān shuō bù chū yí jù huà.
example.en: After hearing the news, he was completely stunned and could not say a word for quite a while.

example.zh: 由于航班延误,乘客被要求待在候机区等候进一步通知。
example.py: Yóuyú hángbān yánwù, chéngkè bèi yāoqiú dài zài hòujīqū děnghòu jìnyí bù tōngzhī.
example.en: Because the flight was delayed, passengers were asked to stay in the waiting area for further notice.

example.zh: 企业若忽视环保,最终会付出高昂的代价。
example.py: Qǐyè ruò hūshì huánbǎo, zuìzhōng huì fùchū gāo'áng de dàijià.
example.en: If companies ignore environmental protection, they will eventually pay a heavy price.

example.zh: 这家初创公司依靠银行贷款度过了最困难的现金流阶段。
example.py: Zhè jiā chūchuàng gōngsī yīkào yínháng dàikuǎn dùguò le zuì kùnnán de xiànjīnliú jiēduàn.
example.en: This start-up relied on a bank loan to get through the most difficult cash-flow stage.

meaning: to act as an agent, to represent

example.zh: 这家公司代理多个国际品牌,因此对售后服务要求很高。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī dàilǐ duō gè guójì pǐnpái, yīncǐ duì shòuhòu fúwù yāoqiú hěn gāo.
example.en: This company represents several international brands, so its requirements for after-sales service are very high.

example.zh: 老教授带领团队完成了多年无人攻克的实验难题。
example.py: Lǎo jiàoshòu dàilǐng tuánduì wánchéng le duōnián wú rén gōngkè de shíyàn nántí.
example.en: The old professor led the team in solving an experimental problem that no one had overcome for years.

example.zh: 连续降价对小型商家的利润造成了明显打击。
example.py: Liánxù jiàngjià duì xiǎoxíng shāngjiā de lìrùn zàochéng le míngxiǎn dǎjī.
example.en: Repeated price cuts caused an obvious blow to the profits of small businesses.

example.zh: 两名乘客因为座位问题在车厢里打架,导致列车临时停靠。
example.py: Liǎng míng chéngkè yīnwèi zuòwèi wèntí zài chēxiāng lǐ dǎjià, dǎozhì lièchē línshí tíngkào.
example.en: Two passengers fought in the carriage over a seating issue, causing the train to stop temporarily.

meaning: to come into contact with, to deal with

example.zh: 他长期和供应商打交道,特别了解行业里的潜规则。
example.py: Tā chángqī hé gōngyìngshāng dǎ jiāodao, tèbié liǎojiě hángyè lǐ de qiánguīzé.
example.en: He has dealt with suppliers for a long time and understands the industry’s hidden rules particularly well.

example.zh: 公司改用手机打卡后,外勤人员的考勤记录更准确了。
example.py: Gōngsī gǎi yòng shǒujī dǎkǎ hòu, wàiqín rényuán de kǎoqín jìlù gèng zhǔnquè le.
example.en: After the company switched to mobile clock-ins, the attendance records for field staff became more accurate.

example.zh: 昨晚打雷时,整栋楼的孩子都被惊醒了。
example.py: Zuówǎn dǎléi shí, zhěng dòng lóu de háizi dōu bèi jīngxǐng le.
example.en: During the thunder last night, all the children in the building were woken up.

example.zh: 运动后适量补充蛋白质,有助于肌肉修复和身体恢复。
example.py: Yùndòng hòu shìliàng bǔchōng dànbáizhì, yǒuzhù yú jīròu xiūfù hé shēntǐ huīfù.
example.en: A moderate amount of protein after exercise helps muscle repair and physical recovery.

example.zh: 他的问题并不单纯是技术问题,而牵涉到管理和责任分配。
example.py: Tā de wèntí bìng bù dānchún shì jìshù wèntí, ér qiānshè dào guǎnlǐ hé zérèn fēnpèi.
example.en: His problem is not simply a technical issue, but involves management and the allocation of responsibility.

example.zh: 如果课程内容过于单调,学生很难长期保持注意力。
example.py: Rúguǒ kèchéng nèiróng guòyú dāndiào, xuéshēng hěn nán chángqī bǎochí zhùyìlì.
example.en: If the course content is too monotonous, students find it hard to maintain attention over the long term.

example.zh: 这些档案保存了工厂改制期间的关键决策过程。
example.py: Zhèxiē dàng'àn bǎocún le gōngchǎng gǎizhì qījiān de guānjiàn juécè guòchéng.
example.en: These records preserve the key decision-making process during the factory’s restructuring.

meaning: on the spot, at the scene

example.zh: 质检人员发现问题后,当场要求厂家停止发货。
example.py: Zhìjiǎn rényuán fāxiàn wèntí hòu, dāngchǎng yāoqiú chǎngjiā tíngzhǐ fāhuò.
example.en: After quality inspectors found the problem, they demanded on the spot that the manufacturer stop shipping goods.

example.zh: 如果当初没有坚持改革,公司早就被市场淘汰了。
example.py: Rúguǒ dāngchū méiyǒu jiānchí gǎigé, gōngsī zǎo jiù bèi shìchǎng táotài le.
example.en: If they had not persisted with reform at the time, the company would have been eliminated by the market long ago.

example.zh: 当代文学越来越关注普通人在城市化进程中的困境。
example.py: Dāngdài wénxué yuèláiyuè guānzhù pǔtōng rén zài chéngshìhuà jìnchéng zhōng de kùnjìng.
example.en: Contemporary literature increasingly focuses on the difficulties ordinary people face in the process of urbanisation.

example.zh: 当今世界,数据安全已经成为各国共同面对的挑战。
example.py: Dāngjīn shìjiè, shùjù ānquán yǐjīng chéngwéi gè guó gòngtóng miànduì de tiǎozhàn.
example.en: In today’s world, data security has become a challenge faced jointly by all countries.

example.zh: 这么敏感的问题,最好还是当面解释,免得在邮件里产生误会。
example.py: Zhème mǐngǎn de wèntí, zuìhǎo háishi dāngmiàn jiěshì, miǎnde zài yóujiàn lǐ chǎnshēng wùhuì.
example.en: For such a sensitive issue, it is best to explain it face to face, to avoid misunderstandings in email.

example.zh: 订单当天确认后,系统会自动安排发货。
example.py: Dìngdān dàngtiān quèrèn hòu, xìtǒng huì zìdòng ānpái fāhuò.
example.en: Once the order is confirmed on that day, the system will automatically arrange dispatch.

meaning: at the present moment, right away; immediately, at once

example.zh: 当下最紧迫的任务,是稳定团队情绪并恢复正常生产。
example.py: Dāngxià zuì jǐnpò de rènwu, shì wěndìng tuánduì qíngxù bìng huīfù zhèngcháng shēngchǎn.
example.en: The most urgent task at the moment is to stabilise the team’s morale and restore normal production.

example.zh: 他以微弱优势当选为新一届协会主席。
example.py: Tā yǐ wēiruò yōushì dāngxuǎn wéi xīn yí jiè xiéhuì zhǔxí.
example.en: He was elected chair of the new association by a narrow margin.

example.zh: 这项技术的诞生,改变了人们处理信息的方式。
example.py: Zhè xiàng jìshù de dànshēng, gǎibiàn le rénmen chǔlǐ xìnxī de fāngshì.
example.en: The birth of this technology changed the way people process information.

example.zh: 由于前期沟通不足,项目整整耽误了两个月。
example.py: Yóuyú qiánqī gōutōng bùzú, xiàngmù zhěngzhěng dānwu le liǎng gè yuè.
example.en: Because early communication was insufficient, the project was delayed by a full two months.

example.zh: 专家担忧,长期干旱可能进一步影响粮食产量。
example.py: Zhuānjiā dānyōu, chángqī gānhàn kěnéng jìnyí bù yǐngxiǎng liángshi chǎnliàng.
example.en: Experts are worried that prolonged drought may further affect grain output.

example.zh: 这座岛虽然面积不大,却拥有非常独特的生态系统。
example.py: Zhè zuò dǎo suīrán miànjī bú dà, què yōngyǒu fēicháng dútè de shēngtài xìtǒng.
example.en: Although this island is not large, it has a very unique ecosystem.

example.zh: 如果资金链继续断裂,这家连锁企业可能在年底前倒闭。
example.py: Rúguǒ zījīnliàn jìxù duànliè, zhè jiā liánsuǒ qǐyè kěnéng zài niándǐ qián dǎobì.
example.en: If the cash flow chain continues to break, this chain company may go bankrupt before the end of the year.

example.zh: 在狭窄的巷子里倒车时,他差点撞到墙角。
example.py: Zài xiázhǎi de xiàngzi lǐ dǎochē shí, tā chàdiǎn zhuàngdào qiángjiǎo.
example.en: While reversing in the narrow alley, he almost hit the corner of the wall.

example.zh: 技术的发展越快,相关的道德争议就越值得重视。
example.py: Jìshù de fāzhǎn yuè kuài, xiāngguān de dàodé zhēngyì jiù yuè zhíde zhòngshì.
example.en: The faster technology develops, the more attention should be paid to the related ethical controversies.

example.zh: 这家餐馆环境一般,味道倒是比网上评价说的好很多。
example.py: Zhè jiā cānguǎn huánjìng yìbān, wèidào dàoshì bǐ wǎngshàng píngjià shuō de hǎo hěn duō.
example.en: The restaurant’s environment is ordinary, but the food actually tastes much better than the online reviews suggest.

example.zh: 他的导师不仅指导论文,还帮助他规划未来的研究方向。
example.py: Tā de dǎoshī bùjǐn zhǐdǎo lùnwén, hái bāngzhù tā guīhuà wèilái de yánjiū fāngxiàng.
example.en: His supervisor not only advises him on his thesis but also helps him plan his future research direction.

example.zh: 这套课程把理论讲解和实践训练搭配得很合理。
example.py: Zhè tào kèchéng bǎ lǐlùn jiǎngjiě hé shíjiàn xùnliàn dāpèi de hěn hélǐ.
example.en: This course matches theoretical explanation with practical training very reasonably.

example.zh: 新任大使在记者会上强调,两国合作不应受短期分歧影响。
example.py: Xīnrèn dàshǐ zài jìzhěhuì shàng qiángdiào, liǎng guó hézuò bù yīng shòu duǎnqī fēnqí yǐngxiǎng.
example.en: The newly appointed ambassador stressed at the press conference that cooperation between the two countries should not be affected by short-term differences.

example.zh: 这位建筑大师的作品既尊重传统,又体现出现代城市的精神。
example.py: Zhè wèi jiànzhù dàshī de zuòpǐn jì zūnzhòng chuántǒng, yòu tǐxiàn chū xiàndài chéngshì de jīngshén.
example.en: This master architect’s work both respects tradition and reflects the spirit of the modern city.

example.zh: 公司计划把可再生能源项目推广到大洋洲的一些岛国。
example.py: Gōngsī jìhuà bǎ kě zàishēng néngyuán xiàngmù tuīguǎng dào Dàyángzhōu de yìxiē dǎoguó.
example.en: The company plans to expand renewable energy projects to some island countries in Oceania.

example.zh: 这家公司希望通过长期投入,打造一个面向年轻用户的学习平台。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī xīwàng tōngguò chángqī tóurù, dǎzào yí ge miànxiàng niánqīng yònghù de xuéxí píngtái.
example.en: The company hopes to create a learning platform for young users through long-term investment.

meaning: to fight, to go to war

example.zh: 普通百姓最害怕的不是贫困,而是两个国家突然打仗。
example.py: Pǔtōng bǎixìng zuì hàipà de bú shì pínkùn, ér shì liǎng ge guójiā tūrán dǎzhàng.
example.en: What ordinary people fear most is not poverty, but two countries suddenly going to war.

example.zh: 调查结果大致符合我们的预期,但个别地区的数据仍需核实。
example.py: Diàochá jiéguǒ dàzhì fúhé wǒmen de yùqī, dàn gèbié dìqū de shùjù réng xū héshí.
example.en: The survey results roughly meet our expectations, but the data from some individual regions still needs to be verified.

meaning: to finish; used after verbs to express possibility

example.zh: 任务虽然复杂,但只要分工明确,两天内做得了。
example.py: Rènwù suīrán fùzá, dàn zhǐyào fēngōng míngquè, liǎng tiān nèi zuò de liǎo.
example.en: Although the task is complex, it can be completed within two days as long as responsibilities are clearly divided.

example.zh: 平台会根据用户信用等级决定是否提供更高额度的服务。
example.py: Píngtái huì gēnjù yònghù xìnyòng děngjí juédìng shìfǒu tígōng gèng gāo édù de fúwù.
example.en: The platform will decide whether to provide a higher service limit according to the user’s credit rating.

example.zh: 春节前夕,老街两侧挂满了红灯笼,节日气氛格外浓厚。
example.py: Chūnjié qiánxī, lǎo jiē liǎng cè guà mǎn le hóng dēnglong, jiérì qìfēn géwài nónghòu.
example.en: On the eve of Spring Festival, red lanterns hung all along both sides of the old street, making the festive atmosphere especially strong.

meaning: to be able to, so that

example.zh: 在多方协调下,被困旅客终于得以安全撤离。
example.py: Zài duōfāng xiétiáo xià, bèikùn lǚkè zhōngyú déyǐ ānquán chèlí.
example.en: With coordination from several parties, the stranded passengers were finally able to evacuate safely.

meaning: to learn of, to hear about

example.zh: 得知工厂即将搬迁后,许多员工开始重新规划生活。
example.py: Dézhī gōngchǎng jíjiāng bānqiān hòu, xǔduō yuángōng kāishǐ chóngxīn guīhuà shēnghuó.
example.en: After learning that the factory was about to relocate, many employees began to re-plan their lives.

example.zh: 雨水沿着屋檐一滴一滴落下,打破了夜里的寂静。
example.py: Yǔshuǐ yánzhe wūyán yì dī yì dī luò xià, dǎpò le yèli de jìjìng.
example.en: Rainwater fell drop by drop along the eaves, breaking the silence of the night.

example.zh: 她把米和水放进电饭锅后,便继续准备其他菜。
example.py: Tā bǎ mǐ hé shuǐ fàng jìn diànfànguō hòu, biàn jìxù zhǔnbèi qítā cài.
example.en: After putting the rice and water into the rice cooker, she continued preparing the other dishes.

example.zh: 用户只需点击屏幕右上角的图标,就能进入账户设置页面。
example.py: Yònghù zhǐ xū diǎnjī píngmù yòu shàng jiǎo de túbiāo, jiù néng jìnrù zhànghù shèzhì yèmiàn.
example.en: Users only need to click the icon in the top right corner of the screen to enter the account settings page.

example.zh: 毕业典礼虽然简短,却让每位学生都感到庄重而难忘。
example.py: Bìyè diǎnlǐ suīrán jiǎnduǎn, què ràng měi wèi xuéshēng dōu gǎndào zhuāngzhòng ér nánwàng.
example.en: Although the graduation ceremony was brief, it made every student feel solemn and left a lasting impression.

example.zh: 夏季用电高峰来临前,政府要求电力公司提前检查老旧线路。
example.py: Xiàjì yòngdiàn gāofēng láilín qián, zhèngfǔ yāoqiú diànlì gōngsī tíqián jiǎnchá lǎojiù xiànlù.
example.en: Before the summer peak in electricity use arrives, the government requires power companies to inspect ageing power lines in advance.

example.zh: 这条街上的老店铺虽然面积不大,却保留着本地人的生活记忆。
example.py: Zhè tiáo jiē shàng de lǎo diànpù suīrán miànjī bú dà, què bǎoliúzhe běndì rén de shēnghuó jìyì.
example.en: Although the old shops on this street are not large, they preserve the local people’s memories of everyday life.

example.zh: 一场公开辩论点燃了公众对教育公平的讨论。
example.py: Yì chǎng gōngkāi biànlùn diǎnrán le gōngzhòng duì jiàoyù gōngpíng de tǎolùn.
example.en: A public debate ignited public discussion about educational fairness.

example.zh: 这个案例是城市更新中兼顾商业开发与社区保护的典型。
example.py: Zhège ànlì shì chéngshì gēngxīn zhōng jiāngù shāngyè kāifā yǔ shèqū bǎohù de diǎnxíng.
example.en: This case is a model of balancing commercial development and community protection in urban renewal.

example.zh: 会议开始前,请确认投影仪和音响都已经接上电源。
example.py: Huìyì kāishǐ qián, qǐng quèrèn tóuyǐngyí hé yīnxiǎng dōu yǐjīng jiē shàng diànyuán.
example.en: Before the meeting starts, please confirm that the projector and speakers have both been connected to the power supply.

example.zh: 工人用起重机把沉重的设备吊到楼顶,整个过程十分谨慎。
example.py: Gōngrén yòng qǐzhòngjī bǎ chénzhòng de shèbèi diào dào lóudǐng, zhěnggè guòchéng shífēn jǐnshèn.
example.en: The workers used a crane to hoist the heavy equipment to the roof, and the whole process was carried out very carefully.

example.zh: 面对突发洪水,指挥部迅速调动附近的救援力量。
example.py: Miànduì tūfā hóngshuǐ, zhǐhuībù xùnsù diàodòng fùjìn de jiùyuán lìliàng.
example.en: Facing the sudden flood, the command centre quickly mobilised nearby rescue forces.

example.zh: 他周末常去河边钓鱼,但更享受安静等待的过程。
example.py: Tā zhōumò cháng qù hébiān diàoyú, dàn gèng xiǎngshòu ānjìng děngdài de guòchéng.
example.en: He often goes fishing by the river at weekends, but he enjoys the quiet process of waiting even more.

example.zh: 救援队连夜穿过山区,终于在清晨抵达受灾村庄。
example.py: Jiùyuán duì liányè chuānguò shānqū, zhōngyú zài qīngchén dǐdá shòuzāi cūnzhuāng.
example.en: The rescue team crossed the mountainous area overnight and finally reached the disaster-stricken village at dawn.

example.zh: 这家小店虽然不起眼,却能做出非常地道的川菜风味。
example.py: Zhè jiā xiǎodiàn suīrán bù qǐyǎn, què néng zuò chū fēicháng dìdao de Chuāncài fēngwèi.
example.en: Although this small shop is unremarkable, it can produce very authentic Sichuan flavours.

example.zh: 受全球需求下降影响,原材料价格连续三个月下跌。
example.py: Shòu quánqiú xūqiú xiàjiàng yǐngxiǎng, yuáncáiliào jiàgé liánxù sān gè yuè xiàdiē.
example.en: Affected by the decline in global demand, raw material prices have fallen for three consecutive months.

example.zh: 这个地方曾经荒废多年,如今被改造成公共艺术空间。
example.py: Zhège dìfāng céngjīng huāngfèi duō nián, rújīn bèi gǎizào chéng gōnggòng yìshù kōngjiān.
example.en: This place was abandoned for many years and has now been transformed into a public art space.

example.zh: 面对外来压力,社区居民选择联合起来抵抗不合理的拆迁方案。
example.py: Miànduì wàilái yālì, shèqū jūmín xuǎnzé liánhé qǐlái dǐkàng bù hélǐ de chāiqiān fāng'àn.
example.en: Faced with outside pressure, the community residents chose to unite and resist the unreasonable demolition plan.

meaning: top; to carry on the head; measure word for hats

example.zh: 山顶的风非常大,队员们只停留了几分钟就下撤。
example.py: Shāndǐng de fēng fēicháng dà, duìyuánmen zhǐ tíngliú le jǐ fēnzhōng jiù xiàchè.
example.en: The wind at the mountaintop was extremely strong, so the team members stayed only a few minutes before descending.

example.zh: 系统显示订单已经生成,但仓库还没有开始发货。
example.py: Xìtǒng xiǎnshì dìngdān yǐjīng shēngchéng, dàn cāngkù hái méiyǒu kāishǐ fāhuò.
example.en: The system shows that the order has been generated, but the warehouse has not yet started dispatching the goods.

meaning: to get engaged, to be betrothed

example.zh: 他们订婚后并没有急着办婚礼,而是先一起规划未来。
example.py: Tāmen dìnghūn hòu bìng méiyǒu jízhe bàn hūnlǐ, ér shì xiān yìqǐ guīhuà wèilái.
example.en: After getting engaged, they did not rush to hold a wedding, but first planned their future together.

example.zh: 商品的定价如果脱离消费者的承受范围,哪怕品质再好也很难畅销。
example.py: Shāngpǐn de dìngjià rúguǒ tuōlí xiāofèizhě de chéngshòu fànwéi, nǎpà pǐnzhì zài hǎo yě hěn nán chàngxiāo.
example.en: If the pricing of a product is beyond what consumers can afford, it will be hard to sell well no matter how good its quality is.

example.zh: 医生提醒他必须定时服药,否则治疗效果会大打折扣。
example.py: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā bìxū dìngshí fúyào, fǒuzé zhìliáo xiàoguǒ huì dà dǎ zhékòu.
example.en: The doctor reminded him that he must take his medicine at fixed times, otherwise the treatment would be much less effective.

example.zh: 这款产品的定位过于模糊,既吸引不了年轻人,也留不住老客户。
example.py: Zhè kuǎn chǎnpǐn de dìngwèi guòyú móhu, jì xīyǐn bùliǎo niánqīngrén, yě liú bù zhù lǎo kèhù.
example.en: This product’s positioning is too vague: it neither attracts young people nor keeps existing customers.

example.zh: 如果没有先定义核心概念,后面的讨论很容易陷入混乱。
example.py: Rúguǒ méiyǒu xiān dìngyì héxīn gàiniàn, hòumiàn de tǎolùn hěn róngyì xiànrù hùnluàn.
example.en: If the core concepts are not defined first, the later discussion can easily fall into confusion.

example.zh: 学校为不同水平的学生定制了分层阅读计划。
example.py: Xuéxiào wèi bùtóng shuǐpíng de xuésheng dìngzhì le fēncéng yuèdú jìhuà.
example.en: The school customised tiered reading plans for students at different levels.
