example.zh: 许多城市正在推广低碳交通,以减少空气污染和能源消耗。
example.py: Xǔduō chéngshì zhèngzài tuīguǎng dītàn jiāotōng, yǐ jiǎnshǎo kōngqì wūrǎn hé néngyuán xiāohào.
example.en: Many cities are promoting low-carbon transport to reduce air pollution and energy consumption.

example.zh: 复杂的地形增加了救援难度,直升机也无法立即降落。
example.py: Fùzá de dìxíng zēngjiā le jiùyuán nándù, zhíshēngjī yě wúfǎ lìjí jiàngluò.
example.en: The complex terrain increased the difficulty of the rescue, and helicopters could not land immediately.

example.zh: 不同地域的饮食习惯反映了气候、物产和历史的共同影响。
example.py: Bùtóng dìyù de yǐnshí xíguàn fǎnyìng le qìhòu, wùchǎn hé lìshǐ de gòngtóng yǐngxiǎng.
example.en: Dietary habits in different regions reflect the combined influence of climate, produce, and history.

example.zh: 施工前,专家对隧道沿线的地质条件进行了详细评估。
example.py: Shīgōng qián, zhuānjiā duì suìdào yánxiàn de dìzhì tiáojiàn jìnxíng le xiángxì pínggū.
example.en: Before construction, experts conducted a detailed assessment of the geological conditions along the tunnel route.

example.zh: 这栋楼在地震后出现裂缝,居民被临时转移到安全地点。
example.py: Zhè dòng lóu zài dìzhèn hòu chūxiàn lièfèng, jūmín bèi línshí zhuǎnyí dào ānquán dìdiǎn.
example.en: This building developed cracks after the earthquake, and the residents were temporarily moved to a safe place.

example.zh: 警方仍在调查嫌疑人的动机,暂时没有公布更多细节。
example.py: Jǐngfāng réng zài diàochá xiányírén de dòngjī, zànshí méiyǒu gōngbù gèng duō xìjié.
example.en: The police are still investigating the suspect’s motive and have not released further details for the time being.

example.zh: 清晰的目标能为团队提供持续推进项目的动力。
example.py: Qīngxī de mùbiāo néng wèi tuánduì tígōng chíxù tuījìn xiàngmù de dònglì.
example.en: Clear goals can provide the team with the drive to keep pushing the project forward.

example.zh: 这部动漫不只面向儿童,也讨论了战争与记忆之间的关系。
example.py: Zhè bù dòngmàn bùzhǐ miànxiàng értóng, yě tǎolùn le zhànzhēng yǔ jìyì zhījiān de guānxì.
example.en: This anime is not only aimed at children; it also discusses the relationship between war and memory.

example.zh: 我们需要及时掌握市场动态,才能调整采购计划。
example.py: Wǒmen xūyào jíshí zhǎngwò shìchǎng dòngtài, cái néng tiáozhěng cǎigòu jìhuà.
example.en: We need to keep track of market trends in time so that we can adjust the procurement plan.

example.zh: 这首民歌旋律动听,却隐藏着一段沉重的历史。
example.py: Zhè shǒu míngē xuánlǜ dòngtīng, què yǐncáng zhe yí duàn chénzhòng de lìshǐ.
example.en: The melody of this folk song is pleasant to listen to, yet it hides a heavy piece of history.

example.zh: 他故意逗孩子笑,想缓和紧张的气氛。
example.py: Tā gùyì dòu háizi xiào, xiǎng huǎnhé jǐnzhāng de qìfēn.
example.en: He deliberately made the child laugh, hoping to ease the tense atmosphere.

example.zh: 这场斗争不仅发生在市场上,也发生在观念层面。
example.py: Zhè chǎng dòuzhēng bùjǐn fāshēng zài shìchǎng shàng, yě fāshēng zài guānniàn céngmiàn.
example.en: This struggle takes place not only in the market, but also at the level of ideas.

example.zh: 这种植物的毒主要集中在根部,处理时必须戴手套。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù de dú zhǔyào jízhōng zài gēnbù, chǔlǐ shí bìxū dài shǒutào.
example.en: The poison of this plant is mainly concentrated in the roots, so gloves must be worn when handling it.

example.zh: 船夫等风浪平息后,才把游客渡到对岸。
example.py: Chuánfū děng fēnglàng píngxī hòu, cái bǎ yóukè dù dào duì'àn.
example.en: The boatman waited until the wind and waves had calmed before ferrying the tourists to the opposite bank.

example.zh: 服务员端来一壶热茶,请客人在大厅稍等。
example.py: Fúwùyuán duān lái yì hú rèchá, qǐng kèrén zài dàtīng shāo děng.
example.en: The waiter brought over a pot of hot tea and asked the guests to wait in the lobby.

example.zh: 由于芯片短缺,厂家不得不推迟新车交付。
example.py: Yóuyú jīngpiàn duǎnquē, chǎngjiā bùdébù tuīchí xīnchē jiāofù.
example.en: Because of the chip shortage, the manufacturer had to delay delivery of the new cars.

example.zh: 这座建筑的外观完全对称,却并不显得单调。
example.py: Zhè zuò jiànzhù de wàiguān wánquán duìchèn, què bìng bù xiǎnde dāndiào.
example.en: The exterior of this building is completely symmetrical, yet it does not look monotonous.

example.zh: 新系统上线前,技术团队要先完成与旧平台的对接。
example.py: Xīn xìtǒng shàngxiàn qián, jìshù tuánduì yào xiān wánchéng yǔ jiù píngtái de duìjiē.
example.en: Before the new system goes live, the technical team must first complete its integration with the old platform.

example.zh: 面对不公平待遇,员工选择通过法律途径进行对抗。
example.py: Miànduì bù gōngpíng dàiyù, yuángōng xuǎnzé tōngguò fǎlǜ tújìng jìnxíng duìkàng.
example.en: Facing unfair treatment, the employees chose to confront it through legal channels.

meaning: to oppose, to be in opposition

example.zh: 在这个问题上,双方观点明显对立,短期内难以达成一致。
example.py: Zài zhège wèntí shàng, shuāngfāng guāndiǎn míngxiǎn duìlì, duǎnqī nèi nányǐ dáchéng yízhì.
example.en: On this issue, the two sides’ views are clearly opposed, making agreement difficult in the short term.

example.zh: 表格中的编号必须与合同条款一一对应。
example.py: Biǎogé zhōng de biānhào bìxū yǔ hétong tiáokuǎn yīyī duìyìng.
example.en: The numbers in the table must correspond one by one with the clauses in the contract.

example.zh: 记者在医院门口蹲了一整夜,终于等到当事人出现。
example.py: Jìzhě zài yīyuàn ménkǒu dūn le yì zhěng yè, zhōngyú děngdào dāngshìrén chūxiàn.
example.en: The reporter squatted outside the hospital entrance all night and finally waited for the person involved to appear.

example.zh: 消息一公布,会议室里顿时安静下来。
example.py: Xiāoxi yì gōngbù, huìyìshì lǐ dùnshí ānjìng xiàlai.
example.en: As soon as the news was announced, the meeting room immediately fell silent.

example.zh: 在紧急情况下,他夺过方向盘,避免了车辆冲进河里。
example.py: Zài jǐnjí qíngkuàng xià, tā duó guò fāngxiàngpán, bìmiǎn le chēliàng chōng jìn hé lǐ.
example.en: In the emergency, he grabbed the steering wheel and prevented the vehicle from rushing into the river.

example.zh: 行人纷纷跑进商店躲避突如其来的暴雨。
example.py: Xíngrén fēnfēn pǎo jìn shāngdiàn duǒbì tūrúqílái de bàoyǔ.
example.en: Pedestrians rushed into shops one after another to take shelter from the sudden downpour.

example.zh: 这位演员多才多艺,不仅会表演,还能作曲和导演。
example.py: Zhè wèi yǎnyuán duōcái-duōyì, bùjǐn huì biǎoyǎn, hái néng zuòqǔ hé dǎoyǎn.
example.en: This actor is versatile: not only can he act, he can also compose and direct.

example.zh: 多亏志愿者及时赶到,受伤的游客才得到了救助。
example.py: Duōkuī zhìyuànzhě jíshí gǎndào, shòushāng de yóukè cái dédào le jiùzhù.
example.en: Thanks to the volunteers arriving in time, the injured tourist received help.

example.zh: 这门课大量使用多媒体资料,帮助学生理解抽象概念。
example.py: Zhè mén kè dàliàng shǐyòng duōméitǐ zīliào, bāngzhù xuéshēng lǐjiě chōuxiàng gàiniàn.
example.en: This course makes extensive use of multimedia materials to help students understand abstract concepts.

meaning: to capture, to take by force

example.zh: 起义军经过数日激战,终于夺取了那座战略要塞。
example.py: Qǐyìjūn jīngguò shù rì jīzhàn, zhōngyú duóqǔ le nà zuò zhànlüè yàosài.
example.en: After several days of fierce fighting, the rebel army finally captured that strategic fortress.

meaning: to be more than needed; superfluous, unnecessary

example.zh: 为了让文章更有力,编辑删掉了几段多余的说明。
example.py: Wèile ràng wénzhāng gèng yǒulì, biānjí shāndiào le jǐ duàn duōyú de shuōmíng.
example.en: To make the article stronger, the editor deleted several unnecessary explanatory passages.

example.zh: 一个多元的社会,应当允许不同声音被理性讨论。
example.py: Yí ge duōyuán de shèhuì, yīngdāng yǔnxǔ bùtóng shēngyīn bèi lǐxìng tǎolùn.
example.en: A diverse society should allow different voices to be discussed rationally.

example.zh: 快节奏的都市生活让许多人渴望重新接近自然。
example.py: Kuài jiézòu de dūshì shēnghuó ràng xǔduō rén kěwàng chóngxīn jiējìn zìrán.
example.en: Fast-paced urban life makes many people long to reconnect with nature.

example.zh: 由于天气恶劣,所有出海的船只都被要求返航。
example.py: Yóuyú tiānqì èliè, suǒyǒu chūhǎi de chuánzhī dōu bèi yāoqiú fǎnháng.
example.en: Because the weather was severe, all vessels that had gone out to sea were ordered to return.

example.zh: 她在典礼上戴了一对祖母留下来的银耳环。
example.py: Tā zài diǎnlǐ shang dài le yí duì zǔmǔ liú xiàlai de yín ěrhuán.
example.en: At the ceremony, she wore a pair of silver earrings left to her by her grandmother.

example.zh: 这家医院的儿科常年人满为患,预约非常困难。
example.py: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de érkē chángnián rénmǎn-wéihuàn, yùyuē fēicháng kùnnan.
example.en: The paediatrics department of this hospital is overcrowded all year round, so appointments are very difficult to get.

example.zh: 植物通过光合作用吸收二氧化碳并释放氧气。
example.py: Zhíwù tōngguò guānghé-zuòyòng xīshōu èryǎnghuàtàn bìng shìfàng yǎngqì.
example.en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen through photosynthesis.

example.zh: 闻到变质牛奶的味道后,他马上觉得恶心。
example.py: Wéndào biànzhì niúnǎi de wèidao hòu, tā mǎshàng juéde ěxin.
example.en: After smelling the spoiled milk, he immediately felt nauseous.

example.zh: 这种传染病通常在感染后三到五天发病。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng chuánrǎnbìng tōngcháng zài gǎnrǎn hòu sān dào wǔ tiān fābìng.
example.en: This infectious disease usually appears three to five days after infection.

example.zh: 面对不断上涨的成本,许多小店老板开始发愁。
example.py: Miànduì búduàn shàngzhǎng de chéngběn, xǔduō xiǎodiàn lǎobǎn kāishǐ fāchóu.
example.en: Faced with constantly rising costs, many small shop owners have begun to worry.

example.zh: 风力发电虽然受天气影响较大,但在沿海地区仍具有明显优势。
example.py: Fēnglì fādiàn suīrán shòu tiānqì yǐngxiǎng jiào dà, dàn zài yánhǎi dìqū réng jùyǒu míngxiǎn yōushì.
example.en: Although wind power generation is greatly affected by weather, it still has clear advantages in coastal areas.

example.zh: 法定假日加班,企业必须按照规定支付额外工资。
example.py: Fǎdìng jiàrì jiābān, qǐyè bìxū ànzhào guīdìng zhīfù éwài gōngzī.
example.en: For work on statutory holidays, companies must pay extra wages according to regulations.

example.zh: 新政策能否发动社会力量参与养老服务,仍有待观察。
example.py: Xīn zhèngcè néngfǒu fādòng shèhuì lìliàng cānyù yǎnglǎo fúwù, réng yǒudài guānchá.
example.en: Whether the new policy can mobilise social forces to participate in elderly care services remains to be seen.

example.zh: 学校将在开学前统一发放教材和校园卡。
example.py: Xuéxiào jiāng zài kāixué qián tǒngyī fāfàng jiàocái hé xiàoyuán kǎ.
example.en: The school will distribute textbooks and campus cards uniformly before the start of term.

example.zh: 法官在宣判前,认真听取了双方律师的陈述。
example.py: Fǎguān zài xuānpàn qián, rènzhēn tīngqǔ le shuāngfāng lǜshī de chénshù.
example.en: Before pronouncing the verdict, the judge carefully listened to the statements of the lawyers on both sides.

example.zh: 深海生物会发光,是为了吸引猎物或躲避天敌。
example.py: Shēnhǎi shēngwù huì fāguāng, shì wèile xīyǐn lièwù huò duǒbì tiāndí.
example.en: Deep-sea creatures emit light in order to attract prey or avoid natural enemies.

example.zh: 所有平台都必须遵守当地的数据保护法规。
example.py: Suǒyǒu píngtái dōu bìxū zūnshǒu dāngdì de shùjù bǎohù fǎguī.
example.en: All platforms must comply with local data protection regulations.

meaning: to commit a crime, to violate

example.zh: 任何人犯了错误,都应有改正的机会。
example.py: Rènhé rén fàn le cuòwù, dōu yīng yǒu gǎizhèng de jīhuì.
example.en: Anyone who has made a mistake should have the chance to correct it.

example.zh: 经过一番讨论,委员会决定修改原来的方案。
example.py: Jīngguò yī fān tǎolùn, wěiyuánhuì juédìng xiūgǎi yuánlái de fāng'àn.
example.en: After a round of discussion, the committee decided to revise the original plan.

example.zh: 过度审批会妨碍创新,甚至让优秀项目失去时机。
example.py: Guòdù shěnpī huì fáng'ài chuàngxīn, shènzhì ràng yōuxiù xiàngmù shīqù shíjī.
example.en: Excessive approval procedures can hinder innovation and may even make excellent projects miss their chance.

example.zh: 媒体报道若只强调个别案例,可能会放大公众的焦虑。
example.py: Méitǐ bàodào ruò zhǐ qiángdiào gèbié ànlì, kěnéng huì fàngdà gōngzhòng de jiāolǜ.
example.en: If media reports emphasise only individual cases, they may magnify public anxiety.

example.zh: 这项改革涉及教育、医疗、就业等方方面面。
example.py: Zhè xiàng gǎigé shèjí jiàoyù, yīliáo, jiùyè děng fāngfāngmiànmiàn.
example.en: This reform involves all aspects including education, healthcare, and employment.

example.zh: 孩子们在草地上放飞风筝,笑声传得很远。
example.py: Háizimen zài cǎodì shàng fàngfēi fēngzhēng, xiàoshēng chuán de hěn yuǎn.
example.en: The children flew kites on the grass, and their laughter carried far.

example.zh: 房价持续上涨,使许多年轻人不得不推迟购房计划。
example.py: Fángjià chíxù shàngzhǎng, shǐ xǔduō niánqīngrén bùdé bù tuīchí gòufáng jìhuà.
example.en: The continuous rise in housing prices has forced many young people to postpone their plans to buy a home.

example.zh: 在访谈中,她首次公开谈到创业初期所承受的压力。
example.py: Zài fǎngtán zhōng, tā shǒucì gōngkāi tándào chuàngyè chūqī suǒ chéngshòu de yālì.
example.en: In the interview, she spoke publicly for the first time about the pressure she endured in the early days of starting the business.

example.zh: 在陌生城市里,准确判断方位比盲目跟着地图走更重要。
example.py: Zài mòshēng chéngshì lǐ, zhǔnquè pànduàn fāngwèi bǐ mángmù gēnzhe dìtú zǒu gèng zhòngyào.
example.en: In an unfamiliar city, accurately judging direction is more important than blindly following a map.

example.zh: 在不少地区,方言承载着地方记忆,也影响着人们的身份认同。
example.py: Zài bù shǎo dìqū, fāngyán chéngzài zhe dìfāng jìyì, yě yǐngxiǎng zhe rénmen de shēnfèn rèntóng.
example.en: In many regions, dialects carry local memories and also influence people’s sense of identity.

example.zh: 防治传染病不能只依赖医院,还需要公众配合。
example.py: Fángzhì chuánrǎnbìng bù néng zhǐ yīlài yīyuàn, hái xūyào gōngzhòng pèihé.
example.en: Preventing and controlling infectious diseases cannot rely only on hospitals; it also requires public cooperation.

example.zh: 用户的反馈直接影响下一版产品的设计方向。
example.py: Yònghù de fǎnkuì zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng xià yī bǎn chǎnpǐn de shèjì fāngxiàng.
example.en: User feedback directly affects the design direction of the next version of the product.

example.zh: 城市中心的交通在节假日前夕格外繁忙。
example.py: Chéngshì zhōngxīn de jiāotōng zài jiéjiàrì qiánxī géwài fánmáng.
example.en: Traffic in the city centre is especially busy on the eve of public holidays.

example.zh: 凡是涉及个人隐私的数据,都应当受到严格保护。
example.py: Fánshì shèjí gèrén yǐnsī de shùjù, dōu yīngdāng shòudào yángé bǎohù.
example.en: All data involving personal privacy should be strictly protected.

example.zh: 失败之后,团队没有互相指责,而是认真反思决策过程。
example.py: Shībài zhīhòu, tuánduì méiyǒu hùxiāng zhǐzé, ér shì rènzhēn fǎnsī juécè guòchéng.
example.en: After the failure, the team did not blame one another, but seriously reflected on the decision-making process.

example.zh: 这种昆虫在潮湿环境中繁殖得特别快。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng kūnchóng zài cháoshī huánjìng zhōng fánzhí de tèbié kuài.
example.en: This kind of insect reproduces especially quickly in damp environments.

example.zh: 购买设备后,公司要求供应商开具正式发票。
example.py: Gòumǎi shèbèi hòu, gōngsī yāoqiú gōngyìngshāng kāijù zhèngshì fāpiào.
example.en: After purchasing the equipment, the company asked the supplier to issue an official invoice.

example.zh: 这部纪录片在海外发行后,引起了广泛讨论。
example.py: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn zài hǎiwài fāxíng hòu, yǐnqǐ le guǎngfàn tǎolùn.
example.en: After this documentary was released overseas, it sparked widespread discussion.

example.zh: 伤口如果处理不当,很容易发炎,甚至引发更严重的感染。
example.py: Shāngkǒu rúguǒ chǔlǐ bùdàng, hěn róngyì fāyán, shènzhì yǐnfā gèng yánzhòng de gǎnrǎn.
example.en: If a wound is not treated properly, it can easily become inflamed and even cause a more serious infection.

example.zh: 儿童的身体发育受营养、睡眠和运动等多种因素影响。
example.py: Értóng de shēntǐ fāyù shòu yíngyǎng, shuìmián hé yùndòng děng duō zhǒng yīnsù yǐngxiǎng.
example.en: Children's physical development is affected by many factors, including nutrition, sleep and exercise.

example.zh: 这块土地太肥,种香草反而容易长得过旺。
example.py: Zhè kuài tǔdì tài féi, zhòng xiāngcǎo fǎn'ér róngyì zhǎng de guò wàng.
example.en: This piece of land is too fertile; herbs planted there may actually grow too vigorously.

example.zh: 长期吸入污染空气会损害肺,并降低身体的运动耐力。
example.py: Chángqī xīrù wūrǎn kōngqì huì sǔnhài fèi, bìng jiàngdī shēntǐ de yùndòng nàilì.
example.en: Long-term inhalation of polluted air can damage the lungs and reduce the body’s exercise endurance.

example.zh: 肥胖不仅影响体形,也会增加多种慢性病的风险。
example.py: Féipàng bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng tǐxíng, yě huì zēngjiā duō zhǒng mànxìngbìng de fēngxiǎn.
example.en: Obesity not only affects body shape, but also increases the risk of various chronic diseases.

example.zh: 数字技术飞速发展,迫使传统行业重新调整商业模式。
example.py: Shùzì jìshù fēisù fāzhǎn, pòshǐ chuántǒng hángyè chóngxīn tiáozhěng shāngyè móshì.
example.en: Digital technology is developing rapidly, forcing traditional industries to readjust their business models.

example.zh: 这片河谷土地肥沃,几乎每年都能获得稳定的收成。
example.py: Zhè piàn hégǔ tǔdì féiwò, jīhū měi nián dōu néng huòdé wěndìng de shōuchéng.
example.en: The soil in this river valley is fertile, and it can produce stable harvests almost every year.

example.zh: 老人感染肺炎后,家人立刻安排他住院观察。
example.py: Lǎorén gǎnrǎn fèiyán hòu, jiārén lìkè ānpái tā zhùyuàn guānchá.
example.en: After the elderly man caught pneumonia, his family immediately arranged for him to be observed in hospital.

example.zh: 她把干辣椒磨成粉,装进密封罐里保存。
example.py: Tā bǎ gān làjiāo mó chéng fěn, zhuāng jìn mìfēng guàn lǐ bǎocún.
example.en: She ground the dried chillies into powder and stored them in a sealed jar.

example.zh: 政府在暴雨来临前封闭了通往山区的几条道路。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ zài bàoyǔ láilín qián fēngbì le tōngwǎng shānqū de jǐ tiáo dàolù.
example.en: The government closed several roads leading to the mountain area before the heavy rain arrived.

example.zh: 这条沿海公路风光优美,却因为维护不足存在安全隐患。
example.py: Zhè tiáo yánhǎi gōnglù fēngguāng yōuměi, què yīnwèi wéihù bùzú cúnzài ānquán yǐnhuàn.
example.en: This coastal road has beautiful scenery, but insufficient maintenance has created safety risks.

example.zh: 这里的风力资源充足,适合建设大型海上发电项目。
example.py: Zhèlǐ de fēnglì zīyuán chōngzú, shìhé jiànshè dàxíng hǎishàng fādiàn xiàngmù.
example.en: Wind resources here are abundant, making the area suitable for large offshore power-generation projects.

example.zh: 项目能按时完成,关键在于团队分工明确,责任落实到人。
example.py: Xiàngmù néng ànshí wánchéng, guānjiàn zàiyú tuánduì fēngōng míngquè, zérèn luòshí dào rén.
example.en: The project was completed on time mainly because the team’s division of labour was clear and responsibilities were assigned to individuals.

example.zh: 连续几场及时雨为今年的小麦丰收打下了基础。
example.py: Liánxù jǐ chǎng jíshíyǔ wèi jīnnián de xiǎomài fēngshōu dǎxià le jīchǔ.
example.en: Several timely rains in succession laid the foundation for this year’s bountiful wheat harvest.

example.zh: 这位医生把一生都奉献给了偏远地区的公共卫生事业。
example.py: Zhè wèi yīshēng bǎ yìshēng dōu fèngxiàn gěi le piānyuǎn dìqū de gōnggòng wèishēng shìyè.
example.en: This doctor devoted his whole life to public health work in remote areas.

example.zh: 这座桥经历了百年风雨,依然稳稳地连接着两岸。
example.py: Zhè zuò qiáo jīnglì le bǎinián fēngyǔ, yīrán wěnwěn de liánjiē zhe liǎng'àn.
example.en: This bridge has withstood a century of wind and rain and still firmly connects the two banks.

example.zh: 医院按照病情轻重对患者进行分级,以便优先处理急症。
example.py: Yīyuàn ànzhào bìngqíng qīngzhòng duì huànzhě jìnxíng fēnjí, yǐbiàn yōuxiān chǔlǐ jízhèng.
example.en: The hospital classified patients according to the severity of their condition so that emergencies could be dealt with first.

example.zh: 面对明显的不公,居民愤怒地要求政府公开调查结果。
example.py: Miànduì míngxiǎn de bùgōng, jūmín fènnù de yāoqiú zhèngfǔ gōngkāi diàochá jiéguǒ.
example.en: Faced with obvious injustice, the residents angrily demanded that the government publish the investigation results.

example.zh: 由于预算有限,我们决定把设备费用分期支付。
example.py: Yóuyú yùsuàn yǒuxiàn, wǒmen juédìng bǎ shèbèi fèiyòng fēnqī zhīfù.
example.en: Because the budget is limited, we decided to pay for the equipment in instalments.

example.zh: 为了降低风险,公司把供应商分散到不同地区。
example.py: Wèile jiàngdī fēngxiǎn, gōngsī bǎ gōngyìngshāng fēnsàn dào bùtóng dìqū.
example.en: In order to reduce risk, the company spread its suppliers across different regions.

example.zh: 会议室里的氛围十分紧张,几乎没有人主动发言。
example.py: Huìyìshì lǐ de fēnwéi shífēn jǐnzhāng, jīhū méiyǒu rén zhǔdòng fāyán.
example.en: The atmosphere in the meeting room was very tense, and almost no one spoke voluntarily.

example.zh: 他虽然只是副主任,却承担了整个项目的协调工作。
example.py: Tā suīrán zhǐ shì fùzhǔrèn, què chéngdān le zhěnggè xiàngmù de xiétiáo gōngzuò.
example.en: Although he was only the deputy director, he took on the coordination work for the entire project.

example.zh: 年轻人依法服兵役,不仅是义务,也是一种责任教育。
example.py: Niánqīngrén yīfǎ fú bīngyì, bùjǐn shì yìwù, yě shì yì zhǒng zérèn jiàoyù.
example.en: Young people serving military service according to the law is not only an obligation but also a form of education in responsibility.

example.zh: 海面上浮着一层油污,环保部门立即展开清理。
example.py: Hǎimiàn shàng fú zhe yì céng yóuwū, huánbǎo bùmén lìjí zhǎnkāi qīnglǐ.
example.en: A layer of oil pollution was floating on the sea, and the environmental department immediately began the clean-up.

example.zh: 军人必须服从命令,但命令本身也应符合法律原则。
example.py: Jūnrén bìxū fúcóng mìnglìng, dàn mìnglìng běnshēn yě yīng fúhé fǎlǜ yuánzé.
example.en: Soldiers must obey orders, but the orders themselves should also comply with legal principles.

example.zh: 导师不仅辅导论文写作,还帮助学生建立研究思路。
example.py: Dǎoshī bùjǐn fǔdǎo lùnwén xiězuò, hái bāngzhù xuéshēng jiànlì yánjiū sīlù.
example.en: The supervisor not only coaches students in thesis writing, but also helps them build a research framework.

example.zh: 调整的幅度虽然不大,却足以改变企业的成本结构。
example.py: Tiáozhěng de fúdù suīrán bú dà, què zúyǐ gǎibiàn qǐyè de chéngběn jiégòu.
example.en: Although the scale of the adjustment was not large, it was enough to change the company's cost structure.

example.zh: 大雪覆盖了山区道路,救援车辆不得不放慢速度。
example.py: Dàxuě fùgài le shānqū dàolù, jiùyuán chēliàng bùdébù fàngmàn sùdù.
example.en: Heavy snow covered the mountain roads, forcing rescue vehicles to slow down.

example.zh: 这种符号在古代文书中常被用来表示身份等级。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng fúhào zài gǔdài wénshū zhōng cháng bèi yòng lái biǎoshì shēnfèn děngjí.
example.en: This kind of symbol was often used in ancient documents to indicate social rank.

example.zh: 详细报价已放在附件里,请您查收后再确认订单。
example.py: Xiángxì bàojià yǐ fàng zài fùjiàn lǐ, qǐng nín cháshōu hòu zài quèrèn dìngdān.
example.en: The detailed quotation has been placed in the attachment; please check it and then confirm the order.

example.zh: 公司提高福利,并不只是为了吸引人才,也是为了降低人员流动率。
example.py: Gōngsī tígāo fúlì, bìng bú zhǐ shì wèile xīyǐn réncái, yě shì wèile jiàngdī rényuán liúdònglǜ.
example.en: The company improved its benefits not only to attract talent, but also to reduce staff turnover.

example.zh: 这起事故对公司的公众形象造成了明显的负面影响。
example.py: Zhè qǐ shìgù duì gōngsī de gōngzhòng xíngxiàng zàochéng le míngxiǎn de fùmiàn yǐngxiǎng.
example.en: This accident had a clear negative impact on the company's public image.

example.zh: 使馆举办招待会时,大使夫人也出席并发表了简短讲话。
example.py: Shǐguǎn jǔbàn zhāodàihuì shí, dàshǐ fūrén yě chūxí bìng fābiǎo le jiǎnduǎn jiǎnghuà.
example.en: When the embassy held the reception, the ambassador’s wife also attended and gave a brief speech.

example.zh: 这种药必须饭后服用,否则可能刺激胃部。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng yào bìxū fàn hòu fúyòng, fǒuzé kěnéng cìjī wèibù.
example.en: This medicine must be taken after meals, otherwise it may irritate the stomach.

example.zh: 这个地区并不富裕,但公共服务的覆盖率却相当高。
example.py: Zhège dìqū bìng bù fùyù, dàn gōnggòng fúwù de fùgài lǜ què xiāngdāng gāo.
example.en: This region is not wealthy, yet the coverage of public services is quite high.

example.zh: 法律赋予公民监督公共权力的权利。
example.py: Fǎlǜ fùyǔ gōngmín jiāndū gōnggòng quánlì de quánlì.
example.en: The law gives citizens the right to supervise public power.

example.zh: 这套系统可以辅助医生判断病情,但不能取代专业诊断。
example.py: Zhè tào xìtǒng kěyǐ fǔzhù yīshēng pànduàn bìngqíng, dàn bù néng qǔdài zhuānyè zhěnduàn.
example.en: This system can assist doctors in judging a patient's condition, but it cannot replace a professional diagnosis.

example.zh: 该项目若能按期完成,将显著改善沿岸交通。
example.py: Gāi xiàngmù ruò néng ànqī wánchéng, jiāng xiǎnzhù gǎishàn yán'àn jiāotōng.
example.en: If this project can be completed on schedule, it will significantly improve transport along the coast.

example.zh: 这部小说被改编成电视剧后,人物关系被处理得更复杂。
example.py: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō bèi gǎibiān chéng diànshìjù hòu, rénwù guānxì bèi chǔlǐ de gèng fùzá.
example.en: After this novel was adapted into a television drama, the relationships between the characters were handled in a more complex way.

example.zh: 在样本量不足的情况下,计算出的概率并不可靠。
example.py: Zài yàngběnliàng bùzú de qíngkuàng xià, jìsuàn chū de gàilǜ bìng bù kěkào.
example.en: When the sample size is insufficient, the calculated probability is not reliable.

example.zh: 老旧小区经过改造后,排水系统和公共空间都有明显改善。
example.py: Lǎojiù xiǎoqū jīngguò gǎizào hòu, páishuǐ xìtǒng hé gōnggòng kōngjiān dōu yǒu míngxiǎn gǎishàn.
example.en: After the old residential compound was renovated, both the drainage system and the public spaces were clearly improved.

example.zh: 医生提醒他,长期熬夜和饮酒都会增加肝的负担。
example.py: Yīshēng tíxǐng tā, chángqī áoyè hé yǐnjiǔ dōu huì zēngjiā gān de fùdān.
example.en: The doctor reminded him that staying up late for long periods and drinking alcohol both increase the burden on the liver.

example.zh: 他一听到对方继续推卸责任,干脆结束了会议。
example.py: Tā yì tīng dào duìfāng jìxù tuīxiè zérèn, gāncuì jiéshù le huìyì.
example.en: As soon as he heard the other side continue to shift responsibility, he simply ended the meeting.

example.zh: 由于双方都误解了合同条款,谈判一度变得十分尴尬。
example.py: Yóuyú shuāngfāng dōu wùjiě le hétong tiáokuǎn, tánpàn yídù biàn de shífēn gāngà.
example.en: Because both sides had misunderstood the contract terms, the negotiations became very awkward for a time.

example.zh: 虽然电子签名越来越普遍,他仍习惯用钢笔签署重要文件。
example.py: Suīrán diànzǐ qiānmíng yuè lái yuè pǔbiàn, tā réng xíguàn yòng gāngbǐ qiānshǔ zhòngyào wénjiàn.
example.en: Although electronic signatures are becoming more common, he is still used to signing important documents with a fountain pen.

example.zh: 这个港口经过改造后,货物吞吐能力大幅提升。
example.py: Zhège gǎngkǒu jīngguò gǎizào hòu, huòwù tūntǔ nénglì dàfú tíshēng.
example.en: After this port was renovated, its cargo handling capacity increased substantially.

example.zh: 公司根据项目需求重新调整了每个人的岗位。
example.py: Gōngsī gēnjù xiàngmù xūqiú chóngxīn tiáozhěng le měi gè rén de gǎngwèi.
example.en: The company readjusted everyone’s post according to the needs of the project.

example.zh: 连续几个月的干旱使当地粮食产量大幅下降。
example.py: Liánxù jǐ ge yuè de gānhàn shǐ dāngdì liángshi chǎnliàng dàfú xiàjiàng.
example.en: Several consecutive months of drought caused local grain production to fall sharply.

example.zh: 对于老师多年来的耐心指导,他始终心怀感激。
example.py: Duìyú lǎoshī duō nián lái de nàixīn zhǐdǎo, tā shǐzhōng xīnhuái gǎnjī.
example.en: For his teacher’s patient guidance over the years, he has always felt grateful.

example.zh: 听到设备发出警报,工程师赶忙切断电源并通知同事撤离。
example.py: Tīngdào shèbèi fāchū jǐngbào, gōngchéngshī gǎnmáng qiēduàn diànyuán bìng tōngzhī tóngshì chèlí.
example.en: Hearing the equipment sound an alarm, the engineer hurriedly cut off the power and notified his colleagues to evacuate.

example.zh: 这种病毒主要通过空气传播,老人和儿童更容易被感染。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng bìngdú zhǔyào tōngguò kōngqì chuánbō, lǎorén hé értóng gèng róngyì bèi gǎnrǎn.
example.en: This virus is mainly transmitted through the air, and older people and children are more easily infected.

example.zh: 外界噪音不断干扰实验数据的采集,研究小组只好重新安排测试时间。
example.py: Wàijiè zàoyīn búduàn gānrǎo shíyàn shùjù de cǎijí, yánjiū xiǎozǔ zhǐhǎo chóngxīn ānpái cèshì shíjiān.
example.en: External noise kept interfering with the collection of experimental data, so the research group had to reschedule the tests.

example.zh: 参观完博览会后,每位学生都要写一篇感想。
example.py: Cānguān wán bólǎnhuì hòu, měi wèi xuéshēng dōu yào xiě yì piān gǎnxiǎng.
example.en: After visiting the exposition, every student has to write a reflection.

example.zh: 冬季室内空气过于干燥,很多人会觉得喉咙不舒服。
example.py: Dōngjì shìnèi kōngqì guòyú gānzào, hěn duō rén huì juéde hóulóng bù shūfu.
example.en: In winter, indoor air is too dry, and many people feel discomfort in their throats.

example.zh: 高层管理者必须对企业的长期发展方向作出判断。
example.py: Gāocéng guǎnlǐzhě bìxū duì qǐyè de chángqī fāzhǎn fāngxiàng zuòchū pànduàn.
example.en: Senior managers must make judgements about the company’s long-term direction of development.

example.zh: 他的修复技术十分高超,几乎看不出瓷器曾经碎过。
example.py: Tā de xiūfù jìshù shífēn gāochāo, jīhū kàn bù chū cíqì céngjīng suì guò.
example.en: His restoration skill is so superb that one can hardly tell the porcelain was ever broken.

example.zh: 这所大学在高等教育改革中试行了更加灵活的课程制度。
example.py: Zhè suǒ dàxué zài gāoděng jiàoyù gǎigé zhōng shìxíng le gèngjiā línghuó de kèchéng zhìdù.
example.en: This university has trialled a more flexible curriculum system in higher education reform.

example.zh: 这家公司把普通零件重新设计后,成功打入了高端市场。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī bǎ pǔtōng língjiàn chóngxīn shèjì hòu, chénggōng dǎrù le gāoduān shìchǎng.
example.en: After redesigning ordinary components, this company successfully entered the high-end market.

example.zh: 春节前后是铁路客运的高峰,车票往往提前售空。
example.py: Chūnjié qiánhòu shì tiělù kèyùn de gāofēng, chēpiào wǎngwǎng tíqián shòu kōng.
example.en: The period around Spring Festival is the peak for railway passenger transport, and tickets are often sold out in advance.

example.zh: 编辑收到稿件后,会先检查格式,再安排专家审阅。
example.py: Biānjí shōudào gǎojiàn hòu, huì xiān jiǎnchá géshì, zài ānpái zhuānjiā shěnyuè.
example.en: After receiving a manuscript, the editor will first check the formatting and then arrange for an expert review.

example.zh: 他把大部分奖金捐给山区学校,这种精神令人觉得十分高尚。
example.py: Tā bǎ dà bùfen jiǎngjīn juān gěi shānqū xuéxiào, zhè zhǒng jīngshén lìng rén juéde shífēn gāoshàng.
example.en: He donated most of his prize money to schools in mountain areas, and this spirit feels truly noble.

example.zh: 在网络安全领域,他算得上是处理复杂攻击的高手。
example.py: Zài wǎnglù ānquán lǐngyù, tā suàndeshàng shì chǔlǐ fùzá gōngjí de gāoshǒu.
example.en: In the field of cyber security, he can be counted as an expert in handling complex attacks.

example.zh: 政府设立基金,鼓励高新技术企业加快成果转化。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ shèlì jījīn, gǔlì gāoxīn jìshù qǐyè jiākuài chéngguǒ zhuǎnhuà.
example.en: The government has set up a fund to encourage high and new technology enterprises to speed up the transformation of research results.

example.zh: 初到高原地区的人,往往需要几天时间适应缺氧环境。
example.py: Chū dào gāoyuán dìqū de rén, wǎngwǎng xūyào jǐ tiān shíjiān shìyìng quēyǎng huánjìng.
example.en: People who first arrive in plateau areas often need several days to adapt to the low-oxygen environment.

example.zh: 她把稿子改了好几遍,还是觉得论证不够有力。
example.py: Tā bǎ gǎozi gǎi le hǎo jǐ biàn, háishi juéde lùnzhèng bú gòu yǒulì.
example.en: She revised the draft several times, but still felt the argument was not strong enough.

example.zh: 为了防止伤口扩大,医生先把坏死的组织割掉,再进行清创处理。
example.py: Wèile fángzhǐ shāngkǒu kuòdà, yīshēng xiān bǎ huàisǐ de zǔzhī gēdiào, zài jìnxíng qīngchuāng chǔlǐ.
example.en: To stop the wound from worsening, the doctor first cut away necrotic tissue and then cleaned the wound.

example.zh: 隔壁那家公司倒闭后,整层楼突然安静了许多。
example.py: Gébì nà jiā gōngsī dǎobì hòu, zhěng céng lóu tūrán ānjìng le xǔduō.
example.en: After the company next door went bankrupt, the whole floor suddenly became much quieter.

example.zh: 那位老人用沙哑的声音歌唱故乡,台下许多人都红了眼眶。
example.py: Nà wèi lǎorén yòng shāyǎ de shēngyīn gēchàng gùxiāng, táixià xǔduō rén dōu hóng le yǎnkuàng.
example.en: The elderly man sang of his hometown in a hoarse voice, and many people in the audience had tears in their eyes.

example.zh: 工业革命改变了生产方式,也重新塑造了城市结构。
example.py: Gōngyè gémìng gǎibiàn le shēngchǎn fāngshì, yě chóngxīn sùzào le chéngshì jiégòu.
example.en: The Industrial Revolution changed methods of production and also reshaped urban structures.

example.zh: 孩子站在老师跟前,紧张得一句话也说不出来。
example.py: Háizi zhàn zài lǎoshī gēnqián, jǐnzhāng de yí jù huà yě shuō bù chūlái.
example.en: The child stood in front of the teacher, so nervous that not a single word would come out.

example.zh: 新员工跟随师傅实习了三个月,才独立处理客户投诉。
example.py: Xīn yuángōng gēnsuí shīfu shíxí le sān ge yuè, cái dúlì chǔlǐ kèhù tóusù.
example.en: The new employee followed a mentor for three months of practice before handling customer complaints independently.

example.zh: 系统会自动跟踪订单状态,并在货物抵达时提醒客户。
example.py: Xìtǒng huì zìdòng gēnzōng dìngdān zhuàngtài, bìng zài huòwù dǐdá shí tíxǐng kèhù.
example.en: The system automatically tracks order status and reminds customers when the goods arrive.

example.zh: 在大规模调查中,研究者既关注整体趋势,也记录个体差异。
example.py: Zài dàguīmó diàochá zhōng, yánjiūzhě jì guānzhù zhěngtǐ qūshì, yě jìlù gètǐ chāyì.
example.en: In a large-scale survey, researchers pay attention to both overall trends and individual differences.

example.zh: 这笔钱属于公款,任何人都不能私自挪用。
example.py: Zhè bǐ qián shǔyú gōngkuǎn, rènhé rén dōu bù néng sīzì nuóyòng.
example.en: This money is public funds, and no one may privately misappropriate it.

example.zh: 这座古老的宫建在山腰上,游客需要沿石阶慢慢上去。
example.py: Zhè zuò gǔlǎo de gōng jiàn zài shānyāo shàng, yóukè xūyào yán shíjiē mànmàn shàngqù.
example.en: This ancient palace was built on the mountainside, so visitors need to slowly climb up the stone steps.

example.zh: 公安部门提醒居民不要随意点击陌生链接。
example.py: Gōng'ān bùmén tíxǐng jūmín bú yào suíyì diǎnjī mòshēng liànjiē.
example.en: The public security department reminded residents not to click unfamiliar links casually.

example.zh: 工地周围设置了围栏,防止行人误入危险区域。
example.py: Gōngdì zhōuwéi shèzhì le wéilán, fángzhǐ xíngrén wùrù wēixiǎn qūyù.
example.en: Fencing was set up around the construction site to prevent pedestrians from entering a dangerous area by mistake.

example.zh: 为了让这篇报告更有说服力,他在数据分析上下了不少工夫。
example.py: Wèile ràng zhè piān bàogào gèng yǒu shuōfúlì, tā zài shùjù fēnxī shàng xià le bù shǎo gōngfu.
example.en: To make this report more persuasive, he put considerable effort into the data analysis.

example.zh: 学校在网站上发布公告,说明期末考试的具体安排。
example.py: Xuéxiào zài wǎngzhàn shàng fābù gōnggào, shuōmíng qīmò kǎoshì de jùtǐ ānpái.
example.en: The school published an announcement on its website explaining the detailed arrangements for the final exams.

example.zh: 复习不是简单重复,而是为了巩固已经形成的理解。
example.py: Fùxí bú shì jiǎndān chóngfù, ér shì wèile gǒnggù yǐjīng xíngchéng de lǐjiě.
example.en: Revision is not simple repetition, but is intended to consolidate understanding that has already formed.

example.zh: 如果电力供给不足,工厂的生产线就会被迫停下来。
example.py: Rúguǒ diànlì gōngjǐ bùzú, gōngchǎng de shēngchǎnxiàn jiù huì bèipò tíng xiàlai.
example.en: If the electricity supply is insufficient, the factory’s production line will be forced to stop.

example.zh: 本次调查共计回收有效问卷三千二百份。
example.py: Běn cì diàochá gòngjì huíshōu yǒuxiào wènjuàn sān qiān èr bǎi fèn.
example.en: This survey collected a total of 3,200 valid questionnaires.

example.zh: 专家指出,网络攻击往往从一个看似普通的附件开始。
example.py: Zhuānjiā zhǐchū, wǎngluò gōngjī wǎngwǎng cóng yí gè kàn sì pǔtōng de fùjiàn kāishǐ.
example.en: Experts pointed out that cyberattacks often begin with an attachment that appears ordinary.

example.zh: 调查结果将于下周公开,任何人都可以查询。
example.py: Diàochá jiéguǒ jiāng yú xià zhōu gōngkāi, rènhé rén dōu kěyǐ cháxún.
example.en: The results of the investigation will be made public next week, and anyone will be able to check them.

example.zh: 每个公民都应了解自己的权利,同时承担相应的责任。
example.py: Měi ge gōngmín dōu yīng liǎojiě zìjǐ de quánlì, tóngshí chéngdān xiāngyìng de zérèn.
example.en: Every citizen should understand their rights while also taking on the corresponding responsibilities.

example.zh: 他是业内公认的高手,处理复杂故障尤其有经验。
example.py: Tā shì yènèi gōngrèn de gāoshǒu, chǔlǐ fùzá gùzhàng yóuqí yǒu jīngyàn.
example.en: He is a recognised expert in the industry and is especially experienced in handling complex faults.

example.zh: 这种药物的功效仍需通过长期临床观察来验证。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng yàowù de gōngxiào réng xū tōngguò chángqī línchuáng guānchá lái yànzhèng.
example.en: This medicine’s efficacy still needs to be verified through long-term clinical observation.

example.zh: 这家工厂把每道工序都记录下来,方便追查质量问题。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng bǎ měi dào gōngxù dōu jìlù xiàlai, fāngbiàn zhuīchá zhìliàng wèntí.
example.en: This factory records every procedure so that quality problems can be traced more easily.

example.zh: 她长期参与公益项目,希望改善偏远地区儿童的教育条件。
example.py: Tā chángqī cānyù gōngyì xiàngmù, xīwàng gǎishàn piānyuǎn dìqū értóng de jiàoyù tiáojiàn.
example.en: She has long taken part in public welfare projects, hoping to improve educational conditions for children in remote areas.

example.zh: 受天气影响,部分蔬菜的供应一度变得紧张。
example.py: Shòu tiānqì yǐngxiǎng, bùfen shūcài de gōngyìng yí dù biànde jǐnzhāng.
example.en: Affected by the weather, the supply of some vegetables became tight for a time.

example.zh: 这座古城大约建于公元前二世纪。
example.py: Zhè zuò gǔchéng dàyuē jiàn yú gōngyuán qián èr shìjì.
example.en: This ancient city was probably built in the second century BC.

example.zh: 只有程序足够透明,结果才更容易被认为是公正的。
example.py: Zhǐyǒu chéngxù zúgòu tòumíng, jiéguǒ cái gèng róngyì bèi rènwéi shì gōngzhèng de.
example.en: Only when the procedure is sufficiently transparent is the result more likely to be regarded as fair.

example.zh: 政府在制定新法规前,应充分听取公众意见。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ zài zhìdìng xīn fǎguī qián, yīng chōngfèn tīngqǔ gōngzhòng yìjiàn.
example.en: Before making new regulations, the government should fully listen to public opinion.

example.zh: 在这部改编电影中,公主不再等待救援,而是亲自领导反抗。
example.py: Zài zhè bù gǎibiān diànyǐng zhōng, gōngzhǔ bú zài děngdài jiùyuán, ér shì qīnzì lǐngdǎo fǎnkàng.
example.en: In this adapted film, the princess no longer waits to be rescued, but personally leads the resistance.

example.zh: 暴雨把路边的沟冲得更深,村民只好临时搭桥通行。
example.py: Bàoyǔ bǎ lùbiān de gōu chōng de gèng shēn, cūnmín zhǐhǎo línshí dā qiáo tōngxíng.
example.en: The heavy rain washed the roadside ditch even deeper, so the villagers had to build a temporary bridge to pass.

example.zh: 工程师用轻型材料构造了一个可以快速拆卸的展台。
example.py: Gōngchéngshī yòng qīngxíng cáiliào gòuzào le yí gè kěyǐ kuàisù chāixiè de zhǎntái.
example.en: The engineers used lightweight materials to construct a display stand that can be quickly dismantled.

meaning: to attend to, to look after

example.zh: 他只顾追求短期利润,最终忽视了产品质量。
example.py: Tā zhǐ gù zhuīqiú duǎnqī lìrùn, zuìzhōng hūshì le chǎnpǐn pǐnzhì.
example.en: He only cared about pursuing short-term profits and ultimately ignored product quality.

example.zh: 司机在路口突然拐向小巷,差点撞上骑车的人。
example.py: Sījī zài lùkǒu tūrán guǎi xiàng xiǎoxiàng, chàdiǎn zhuàng shàng qí chē de rén.
example.en: The driver suddenly turned into a small alley at the junction and nearly hit a cyclist.

example.zh: 公交车快到桥头时突然拐弯,乘客都晃了一下。
example.py: Gōngjiāochē kuài dào qiáotóu shí tūrán guǎiwān, chéngkè dōu huàng le yí xià.
example.en: When the bus was almost at the bridgehead, it suddenly turned, and the passengers all swayed.

example.zh: 这名地方官因长期忽视民生问题而受到调查。
example.py: Zhè míng dìfāng guān yīn chángqī hūshì mínshēng wèntí ér shòudào diàochá.
example.en: This local official was investigated for long ignoring issues affecting people’s livelihoods.

example.zh: 仓库里堆着上千罐备用燃料,必须定期检查密封情况。
example.py: Cāngkù li duīzhe shàng qiān guàn bèiyòng ránliào, bìxū dìngqī jiǎnchá mìfēng qíngkuàng.
example.en: Thousands of cans of backup fuel are piled in the warehouse, and their seals must be checked regularly.

meaning: to care for, to show concern

example.zh: 社会应该给予残疾儿童更多关爱,而不仅仅是同情。
example.py: Shèhuì yīnggāi jǐyǔ cánjí értóng gèng duō guān'ài, ér bù jǐnjǐn shì tóngqíng.
example.en: Society should give disabled children more care, not merely sympathy.

example.zh: 由于地下管道老化,居民区不时出现供水中断的问题。
example.py: Yóuyú dìxià guǎndào lǎohuà, jūmínqū bùshí chūxiàn gōngshuǐ zhōngduàn de wèntí.
example.en: Because the underground pipes have aged, the residential area occasionally experiences interruptions to the water supply.

example.zh: 官方尚未公布事故原因,网络上的猜测不宜轻信。
example.py: Guānfāng shàng wèi gōngbù shìgù yuányīn, wǎngluò shàng de cāicè bù yí qīngxìn.
example.en: The authorities have not yet announced the cause of the accident, so online speculation should not be readily believed.

example.zh: 站在高原上远望,广阔的草原一直延伸到天边。
example.py: Zhàn zài gāoyuán shang yuǎnwàng, guǎngkuò de cǎoyuán yìzhí yánshēn dào tiānbiān.
example.en: Looking into the distance from the plateau, the vast grassland stretches all the way to the horizon.

example.zh: 这座古城不再满足于单纯吸引游客观光,而是试图让他们理解当地文化。
example.py: Zhè zuò gǔchéng bù zài mǎnzú yú dānchún xīyǐn yóukè guānguāng, ér shì shìtú ràng tāmen lǐjiě dāngdì wénhuà.
example.en: This ancient city is no longer satisfied with simply attracting tourists to sightsee, but is trying to help them understand local culture.

meaning: to care for, to show concern

example.zh: 制度的价值不只在于效率,更在于它能否体现对弱势群体的关怀。
example.py: Zhìdù de jiàzhí bù zhǐ zài yú xiàolǜ, gèng zài yú tā néng fǒu tǐxiàn duì ruòshì qúntǐ de guānhuái.
example.en: The value of a system lies not only in efficiency, but also in whether it can show care for vulnerable groups.

meaning: to be related, to be connected

example.zh: 这两项政策表面上互不相关,实际上却与同一个财政问题密切关联。
example.py: Zhè liǎng xiàng zhèngcè biǎomiàn shang hù bù xiāngguān, shíjì shang què yǔ tóng yí gè cáizhèng wèntí mìqiè guānlián.
example.en: These two policies appear unrelated on the surface, but in fact they are closely connected to the same fiscal issue.

example.zh: 这座园林最适合在雨后观赏,因为石阶与花木都会呈现出不同的层次。
example.py: Zhè zuò yuánlín zuì shìhé zài yǔ hòu guānshǎng, yīnwèi shíjiē yǔ huāmù dōu huì chéngxiàn chū bùtóng de céngcì.
example.en: This garden is best viewed after rain, because the stone steps, flowers and trees all reveal different layers.

example.zh: 这位官员在记者会上承诺,所有补贴发放情况都会及时公开。
example.py: Zhè wèi guānyuán zài jìzhěhuì shang chéngnuò, suǒyǒu bǔtiē fāfàng qíngkuàng dōu huì jíshí gōngkāi.
example.en: At the press conference, this official promised that the distribution of all subsidies would be made public promptly.

example.zh: 他对古典文学的兴趣,来自小时候听祖父讲《红楼梦》的经历。
example.py: Tā duì gǔdiǎn wénxué de xìngqù, láizì xiǎoshíhou tīng zǔfù jiǎng Hónglóu Mèng de jīnglì.
example.en: His interest in classical literature comes from listening to his grandfather talk about Dream of the Red Chamber when he was young.

example.zh: 尽管身边有很多同事,他在异国工作时仍常感到孤独。
example.py: Jǐnguǎn shēnbiān yǒu hěn duō tóngshì, tā zài yìguó gōngzuò shí réng cháng gǎndào gūdú.
example.en: Although he had many colleagues around him, he still often felt lonely while working in a foreign country.

example.zh: 我姑姑年轻时在报社工作,后来成了一名资深编辑。
example.py: Wǒ gūgu niánqīng shí zài bàoshè gōngzuò, hòulái chéng le yì míng zīshēn biānjí.
example.en: My aunt worked at a newspaper office when she was young and later became a senior editor.

example.zh: 这批出土文物最终归国家所有,任何个人不得私自买卖。
example.py: Zhè pī chūtǔ wénwù zuìzhōng guī guójiā suǒyǒu, rènhé gèrén bùdé sīzì mǎimai.
example.en: This batch of unearthed cultural relics ultimately belongs to the state, and no individual may trade them privately.

example.zh: 他跪在老人面前道歉,这一幕让在场的人都沉默了。
example.py: Tā guì zài lǎorén miànqián dàoqiàn, zhè yí mù ràng zài chǎng de rén dōu chénmò le.
example.en: He knelt in front of the old man to apologise, and the scene left everyone present silent.

example.zh: 卫星进入预定轨道后,地面控制中心开始接收数据。
example.py: Wèixīng jìnrù yùdìng guǐdào hòu, dìmiàn kòngzhì zhōngxīn kāishǐ jiēshōu zīliào.
example.en: After the satellite entered its planned orbit, the ground control centre began receiving data.

meaning: norm, standard, rule; standard, normative; to standardize, to regulate

example.zh: 为了规范网约车市场,交通部门公布了新的审核标准。
example.py: Wèile guīfàn wǎngyuēchē shìchǎng, jiāotōng bùmén gōngbù le xīn de shěnhé biāozhǔn.
example.en: In order to regulate the ride-hailing market, the transport department announced new review standards.

example.zh: 城市规划若只追求速度,往往会忽视居民长期生活的便利性。
example.py: Chéngshì guīhuà ruò zhǐ zhuīqiú sùdù, wǎngwǎng huì hūshì jūmín chángqī shēnghuó de biànlìxìng.
example.en: If urban planning only pursues speed, it often overlooks the long-term convenience of residents’ lives.

example.zh: 借来的设备必须按时归还,否则会影响后续实验的安排。
example.py: Jiè lái de shèbèi bìxū ànshí guīhuán, fǒuzé huì yǐngxiǎng hòuxù shíyàn de ānpái.
example.en: Borrowed equipment must be returned on time, otherwise it will affect the arrangement of later experiments.

example.zh: 新员工刚入职时,最好先熟悉公司的规矩,再提出改进建议。
example.py: Xīn yuángōng gāng rùzhí shí, zuìhǎo xiān shúxī gōngsī de guīju, zài tíchū gǎijìn jiànyì.
example.en: When new employees first join, it is best for them to understand the company’s rules before suggesting improvements.

example.zh: 贵重物品应存放在酒店保险箱内,以免遗失。
example.py: Guìzhòng wùpǐn yīng cúnfàng zài jiǔdiàn bǎoxiǎnxiāng nèi, yǐmiǎn yíshī.
example.en: Valuable items should be stored in the hotel safe to avoid loss.

example.zh: 修复古迹不能只追求速度,更要尊重原有的历史层次。
example.py: Xiūfù gǔjì bù néng zhǐ zhuīqiú sùdù, gèng yào zūnzhòng yuányǒu de lìshǐ céngcì.
example.en: Restoring historic sites must not only pursue speed; it must also respect the original historical layers.

example.zh: 他随手捡起一根木棍,把堵在排水口的杂物拨开。
example.py: Tā suíshǒu jiǎn qǐ yì gēn mùgùn, bǎ dǔ zài páishuǐkǒu de záwù bō kāi.
example.en: He casually picked up a wooden stick and cleared away the debris blocking the drain.

example.zh: 大熊猫被视为中国国宝,也成为国际交流中的重要象征。
example.py: Dàxióngmāo bèi shì wéi Zhōngguó guóbǎo, yě chéngwéi guójì jiāoliú zhōng de zhòngyào xiàngzhēng.
example.en: The giant panda is regarded as a Chinese national treasure and has also become an important symbol in international exchange.

example.zh: 这家医院开始使用国产医疗设备,维护成本明显降低。
example.py: Zhè jiā yīyuàn kāishǐ shǐyòng guóchǎn yīliáo shèbèi, wéihù chéngběn míngxiǎn jiàngdī.
example.en: This hospital has begun using domestically produced medical equipment, and maintenance costs have clearly fallen.

example.zh: 从传统制造向智能生产过渡,需要技术升级,也需要员工培训。
example.py: Cóng chuántǒng zhìzào xiàng zhìnéng shēngchǎn guòdù, xūyào jìshù shēngjí, yě xūyào yuángōng péixùn.
example.en: Transitioning from traditional manufacturing to intelligent production requires both technological upgrading and staff training.

example.zh: 比赛开始前,全场观众起立唱国歌,气氛十分庄严。
example.py: Bǐsài kāishǐ qián, quánchǎng guānzhòng qǐlì chàng guógē, qìfēn shífēn zhuāngyán.
example.en: Before the match began, the whole audience stood and sang the national anthem, creating a solemn atmosphere.

example.zh: 暴风雨过后,救援人员立即开始检查受损的房屋和道路。
example.py: Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, jiùyuán rényuán lìjí kāishǐ jiǎnchá shòusǔn de fángwū hé dàolù.
example.en: After the storm, rescue workers immediately began inspecting damaged houses and roads.

example.zh: 清晨,国旗在广场上缓缓升起,提醒人们珍惜来之不易的和平。
example.py: Qīngchén, guóqí zài guǎngchǎng shang huǎnhuǎn shēngqǐ, tíxǐng rénmen zhēnxī lái zhī bù yì de hépíng.
example.en: At dawn, the national flag rose slowly in the square, reminding people to cherish hard-won peace.

example.zh: 制定教育政策不能照搬别国经验,而要充分考虑本国国情。
example.py: Zhìdìng jiàoyù zhèngcè bù néng zhàobān biéguó jīngyàn, ér yào chōngfèn kǎolǜ běnguó guóqíng.
example.en: When formulating education policy, one must not copy other countries’ experience mechanically, but should fully consider one’s own national conditions.

meaning: to go out of fashion; outdated, obsolete

example.zh: 这种管理方式已经过时,很难适应远程办公的现实需求。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng guǎnlǐ fāngshì yǐjīng guòshí, hěn nán shìyìng yuǎnchéng bàngōng de xiànshí xūqiú.
example.en: This management approach is already outdated and struggles to meet the real needs of remote working.

example.zh: 在这个童话里,国王最终承认,真正的权力来自人民的信任。
example.py: Zài zhège tónghuà li, guówáng zuìzhōng chéngrèn, zhēnzhèng de quánlì láizì rénmín de xìnrèn.
example.en: In this fairy tale, the king finally admits that true power comes from the people’s trust.

example.zh: 他购买股票之前,会先研究公司的财务状况和长期战略。
example.py: Tā gòumǎi gǔpiào zhīqián, huì xiān yánjiū gōngsī de cáiwù zhuàngkuàng hé chángqī zhànlüè.
example.en: Before buying shares, he first studies the company’s financial situation and long-term strategy.

example.zh: 古人虽然没有现代仪器,却能通过长期观察总结自然规律。
example.py: Gǔrén suīrán méiyǒu xiàndài yíqì, què néng tōngguò chángqī guānchá zǒngjié zìrán guīlǜ.
example.en: Although ancient people did not have modern instruments, they could still summarise natural laws through long-term observation.

example.zh: 股市在短期内受到情绪影响,但长期仍取决于经济基本面。
example.py: Gǔshì zài duǎnqī nèi shòudào qíngxù yǐngxiǎng, dàn chángqī réng qǔjué yú jīngjì jīběnmiàn.
example.en: The stock market is affected by sentiment in the short term, but in the long term it still depends on economic fundamentals.

example.zh: 在常温下,这种物质既不是液体,也不是固体。
example.py: Zài chángwēn xià, zhè zhǒng wùzhì jì bú shì yètǐ, yě bú shì gùtǐ.
example.en: At room temperature, this substance is neither a liquid nor a solid.

example.zh: 医生检查后发现,他手腕的一块骨头出现了细小裂纹。
example.py: Yīshēng jiǎnchá hòu fāxiàn, tā shǒuwàn de yí kuài gǔtou chūxiàn le xìxiǎo lièwén.
example.en: After the examination, the doctor found that a small bone in his wrist had a hairline crack.

example.zh: 公司聘请了一位法律顾问,专门处理跨境合同问题。
example.py: Gōngsī pìnqǐng le yí wèi fǎlǜ gùwèn, zhuānmén chǔlǐ kuàjìng hétong wèntí.
example.en: The company hired a legal consultant to handle cross-border contract issues specifically.

example.zh: 这封来自前线的信极大地鼓舞了救援队员的士气。
example.py: Zhè fēng láizì qiánxiàn de xìn jídà de gǔwǔ le jiùyuán duìyuán de shìqì.
example.en: This letter from the front line greatly raised the morale of the rescue team.

example.zh: 系统出现故障后,技术人员连夜恢复了数据。
example.py: Xìtǒng chūxiàn gùzhàng hòu, jìshù rényuán liányè huīfù le shùjù.
example.en: After the system malfunctioned, the technicians restored the data overnight.

example.zh: 过度开发不仅会害了环境,也会影响后代的利益。
example.py: Guòdù kāifā bùjǐn huì hài le huánjìng, yě huì yǐngxiǎng hòudài de lìyì.
example.en: Excessive development will not only harm the environment, but also affect the interests of future generations.

example.zh: 由于海岸线不断后退,当地政府不得不加强防护工程。
example.py: Yóuyú hǎi'ànxiàn búduàn hòutuì, dāngdì zhèngfǔ bùdébù jiāqiáng fánghù gōngchéng.
example.en: As the coastline keeps retreating, the local government has had to strengthen protective works.

example.zh: 这座村庄海拔较高,昼夜温差比山下明显得多。
example.py: Zhè zuò cūnzhuāng hǎibá jiào gāo, zhòuyè wēnchā bǐ shānxià míngxiǎn de duō.
example.en: This village is at a relatively high altitude, so the temperature difference between day and night is much more obvious than at the foot of the mountain.

example.zh: 清晨的海面异常平静,几乎看不出昨夜曾经有风暴。
example.py: Qīngchén de hǎimiàn yìcháng píngjìng, jīhū kàn bù chū zuóyè céngjīng yǒu fēngbào.
example.en: The sea surface was unusually calm in the early morning, with almost no sign that there had been a storm the night before.

example.zh: 这位科学家的研究成果受到海内外同行的广泛关注。
example.py: Zhè wèi kēxuéjiā de yánjiū chéngguǒ shòudào hǎi nèiwài tóngháng de guǎngfàn guānzhù.
example.en: This scientist’s research findings have attracted wide attention from peers both at home and abroad.

example.zh: 为了保护渔业资源,政府暂时禁止船只进入这片海域。
example.py: Wèile bǎohù yúyè zīyuán, zhèngfǔ zànshí jìnzhǐ chuánzhī jìnrù zhè piàn hǎiyù.
example.en: To protect fishery resources, the government temporarily banned vessels from entering this sea area.

example.zh: 在漫长的寒冬里,牧民必须提前储存足够的饲料。
example.py: Zài màncháng de hándōng lǐ, mùmín bìxū tíqián chǔcún zúgòu de sìliào.
example.en: During the long cold winter, herdsmen must store enough fodder in advance.

example.zh: 航空公司因天气恶劣取消了多趟国际航班。
example.py: Hángkōng gōngsī yīn tiānqì èliè qǔxiāo le duō tàng guójì hángbān.
example.en: The airline cancelled multiple international flights because of severe weather.

example.zh: 这种罕见疾病发病率很低,因此早期诊断并不容易。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng hǎnjiàn jíbìng fābìnglǜ hěn dī, yīncǐ zǎoqī zhěnduàn bìng bù róngyì.
example.en: The incidence of this rare disease is very low, so early diagnosis is not easy.

example.zh: 这个成语的含义并不难懂,但使用场合很有讲究。
example.py: Zhège chéngyǔ de hányì bìng bù nándǒng, dàn shǐyòng chǎnghé hěn yǒu jiǎngjiu.
example.en: The meaning of this idiom is not hard to understand, but the occasion for using it needs careful attention.

example.zh: 严重的旱灾使农作物大幅减产,粮价也随之上涨。
example.py: Yánzhòng de hànzāi shǐ nóngzuòwù dàfú jiǎnchǎn, liángjià yě suí zhī shàngzhǎng.
example.en: The severe drought caused a large reduction in crop yields, and grain prices rose accordingly.

example.zh: 春节晚会上的舞龙表演好不热闹,孩子们都舍不得离开。
example.py: Chūnjié wǎnhuì shàng de wǔlóng biǎoyǎn hǎobù rènào, háizimen dōu shěbude líkāi.
example.en: The dragon dance at the Spring Festival gala was extremely lively, and the children were reluctant to leave.

example.zh: 面对质疑,他毫不犹豫地公开了全部数据。
example.py: Miànduì zhìyí, tā háo bù yóuyù de gōngkāi le quánbù shùjù.
example.en: Faced with doubts, he made all the data public without the slightest hesitation.

example.zh: 他在面试中既坦诚又礼貌,给评委留下了很强的好感。
example.py: Tā zài miànshì zhōng jì tǎnchéng yòu lǐmào, gěi píngwěi liúxià le hěn qiáng de hǎogǎn.
example.en: He was both frank and polite in the interview, leaving the judges with a very favourable impression.

example.zh: 这个海边村庄的居民十分好客,常邀请游客到家里喝茶。
example.py: Zhège hǎibiān cūnzhuāng de jūmín shífēn hàokè, cháng yāoqǐng yóukè dào jiā lǐ hē chá.
example.en: The residents of this seaside village are very hospitable and often invite visitors into their homes for tea.

example.zh: 这块零件的误差不能超过一毫米,否则整台机器都会受影响。
example.py: Zhè kuài língjiàn de wùchā bù néng chāoguò yì háomǐ, fǒuzé zhěng tái jīqì dū huì shòu yǐngxiǎng.
example.en: The error in this component must not exceed one millimetre, otherwise the whole machine will be affected.

example.zh: 我们好容易才订到回家的车票,千万别把时间记错了。
example.py: Wǒmen hǎoróngyì cái dìng dào huí jiā de chēpiào, qiānwàn bié bǎ shíjiān jì cuò le.
example.en: We only managed with great difficulty to book tickets home, so be sure not to get the time wrong.

example.zh: 医生建议他每次服用二十毫升药水,不要随意增加剂量。
example.py: Yīshēng jiànyì tā měi cì fúyòng èrshí háoshēng yàoshuǐ, bú yào suíyì zēngjiā jìliàng.
example.en: The doctor advised him to take twenty millilitres of the medicine each time and not to increase the dose at will.

example.zh: 如果决策过程毫无透明度,公众自然难以信任结果。
example.py: Rúguǒ juécè guòchéng háo wú tòumíngdù, gōngzhòng zìrán nányǐ xìnrèn jiéguǒ.
example.en: If the decision-making process has no transparency at all, the public will naturally find it hard to trust the result.

example.zh: 这名年轻工程师特别好学,遇到不懂的问题总会主动请教。
example.py: Zhè míng niánqīng gōngchéngshī tèbié hàoxué, yùdào bù dǒng de wèntí zǒng huì zhǔdòng qǐngjiào.
example.en: This young engineer is especially eager to learn and always asks questions actively when he encounters something he does not understand.

example.zh: 市政府号召市民减少一次性塑料制品的使用。
example.py: Shì zhèngfǔ hàozhào shìmín jiǎnshǎo yícìxìng sùliào zhìpǐn de shǐyòng.
example.en: The city government called on residents to reduce the use of disposable plastic products.

example.zh: 两个部门合并以后,原有的岗位需要重新调整。
example.py: Liǎng gè bùmén hébìng yǐhòu, yuányǒu de gǎngwèi xūyào chóngxīn tiáozhěng.
example.en: After the two departments merge, the existing posts will need to be readjusted.

example.zh: 科学家正在研究如何利用细菌合成可降解材料。
example.py: Kēxuéjiā zhèngzài yánjiū rúhé lìyòng xìjūn héchéng kě jiàngjiě cáiliào.
example.en: Scientists are studying how to use bacteria to synthesise biodegradable materials.

example.zh: 嘿,你先别急着反驳,听我把背景解释完。
example.py: Hēi, nǐ xiān bié jízhe fǎnbó, tīng wǒ bǎ bèijǐng jiěshì wán.
example.en: Hey, do not rush to object; listen to me explain the background first.

example.zh: 隧道里一片黑暗,救援人员只能靠手电筒继续前进。
example.py: Suìdào lǐ yí piàn hēi'àn, jiùyuán rényuán zhǐ néng kào shǒudiàntǒng jìxù qiánjìn.
example.en: It was completely dark in the tunnel, so the rescue workers could only rely on torches to keep moving forward.

example.zh: 他并不怨别人,只恨自己当时没有坚持到底。
example.py: Tā bìng bù yuàn biérén, zhǐ hèn zìjǐ dāngshí méiyǒu jiānchí dàodǐ.
example.en: He does not blame others; he only hates that he did not persist to the end at the time.

meaning: fierce, cruel; to harden one’s heart; fiercely

example.zh: 他的竞争手段太狠,连合作多年的伙伴也被排挤出去。
example.py: Tā de jìngzhēng shǒuduàn tài hěn, lián hézuò duō nián de huǒbàn yě bèi páijǐ chūqù.
example.en: His competitive methods were so ruthless that even partners of many years were pushed out.

meaning: horizontal, across; to cross; horizontal line

example.zh: 请在表格最上方画一条横线,方便区分标题和内容。
example.py: Qǐng zài biǎogé zuì shàngfāng huà yì tiáo héngxiàn, fāngbiàn qūfēn biāotí hé nèiróng.
example.en: Please draw a horizontal line at the top of the table to separate the title from the content.

example.zh: 衡量一项政策是否成功,不能只看短期数据。
example.py: Héngliáng yí xiàng zhèngcè shìfǒu chénggōng, bù néng zhǐ kàn duǎnqī shùjù.
example.en: When measuring whether a policy is successful, one must not look only at short-term data.

example.zh: 雪地上留下了一串清晰的痕迹,警方据此判断嫌疑人的路线。
example.py: Xuědì shàng liúxià le yí chuàn qīngxī de hénjì, jǐngfāng jùcǐ pànduàn xiányírén de lùxiàn.
example.en: A clear trail was left in the snow, and the police used it to judge the suspect’s route.

example.zh: 真正的和平不仅意味着没有战争,也意味着人们能够有尊严地生活。
example.py: Zhēnzhèng de hépíng bùjǐn yìwèizhe méiyǒu zhànzhēng, yě yìwèizhe rénmen nénggòu yǒu zūnyán de shēnghuó.
example.en: True peace means not only the absence of war, but also that people can live with dignity.

example.zh: 一个和谐的社区并不意味着没有分歧,而是人们愿意通过协商解决冲突。
example.py: Yí gè héxié de shèqū bìng bù yìwèizhe méiyǒu fēnqí, ér shì rénmen yuànyì tōngguò xiéshāng jiějué chōngtū.
example.en: A harmonious community does not mean there are no disagreements, but that people are willing to resolve conflicts through consultation.

example.zh: 这项改革的核心在于把资源真正分配到基层。
example.py: Zhè xiàng gǎigé de héxīn zàiyú bǎ zīyuán zhēnzhèng fēnpèi dào jīcéng.
example.en: The core of this reform lies in genuinely allocating resources to the grassroots level.

example.zh: 这座博物馆的设计宏大而不奢华,体现了城市的历史厚度。
example.py: Zhè zuò bówùguǎn de shèjì hóngdà ér bù shēhuá, tǐxiàn le chéngshì de lìshǐ hòudù.
example.en: The design of this museum is grand but not extravagant, reflecting the historical depth of the city.

example.zh: 连续暴雨引发的洪水淹没了低洼地区,迫使数千户居民转移。
example.py: Liánxù bàoyǔ yǐnfā de hóngshuǐ yānmò le dīwā dìqū, pòshǐ shùqiān hù jūmín zhuǎnyí.
example.en: The flood caused by continuous heavy rain submerged low-lying areas, forcing thousands of households to relocate.

example.zh: 我们今天如何对待自然资源,将直接影响后代的生存条件。
example.py: Wǒmen jīntiān rúhé duìdài zìrán zīyuán, jiāng zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng hòudài de shēngcún tiáojiàn.
example.en: How we treat natural resources today will directly affect the living conditions of future generations.

example.zh: 项目后期最容易出现预算超支,因此每个步骤都需要严格审核。
example.py: Xiàngmù hòuqī zuì róngyì chūxiàn yùsuàn chāozhī, yīncǐ měi gè bùzhòu dōu xūyào yángé shěnhé.
example.en: Overspending is most likely to occur in the later stage of a project, so every step needs strict review.

meaning: later generations, people of later times

example.zh: 这座古桥虽然历经风雨,却为后人留下了宝贵的建筑经验。
example.py: Zhè zuò gǔqiáo suīrán lìjīng fēngyǔ, què wèi hòurén liúxià le bǎoguì de jiànzhù jīngyàn.
example.en: Although this ancient bridge has endured many hardships, it has left valuable architectural experience for later generations.

example.zh: 听到爆炸声后,围观群众立刻后退到警戒线以外。
example.py: Tīngdào bàozhà shēng hòu, wéiguān qúnzhòng lìkè hòutuì dào jǐngjièxiàn yǐwài.
example.en: After hearing the explosion, the onlookers immediately retreated beyond the cordon.

example.zh: 效率和公平都很重要,但在这项政策中,后者更需要被优先考虑。
example.py: Xiàolǜ hé gōngpíng dōu hěn zhòngyào, dàn zài zhè xiàng zhèngcè zhōng, hòuzhě gèng xūyào bèi yōuxiān kǎolǜ.
example.en: Efficiency and fairness are both important, but in this policy, the latter needs to be prioritised more.

example.zh: 爷爷把一壶热茶端到院子里,招呼客人慢慢品尝。
example.py: Yéye bǎ yì hú rèchá duān dào yuànzi lǐ, zhāohu kèrén mànmàn pǐncháng.
example.en: Grandfather carried a pot of hot tea into the courtyard and invited the guests to taste it slowly.

example.zh: 这项补贴将优先发放给受灾最严重的一千户家庭。
example.py: Zhè xiàng bǔtiē jiāng yōuxiān fāfàng gěi shòuzāi zuì yánzhòng de yì qiān hù jiātíng.
example.en: This subsidy will be distributed first to the one thousand households most severely affected by the disaster.

example.zh: 船夫用力划着小船,把游客送到对岸的村庄。
example.py: Chuánfū yònglì huá zhe xiǎochuán, bǎ yóukè sòng dào duì'àn de cūnzhuāng.
example.en: The boatman rowed the small boat with effort, taking the tourists to the village on the opposite bank.

example.zh: 湖面完全结冰以后,当地人才会允许游客在指定区域滑冰。
example.py: Húmiàn wánquán jiébīng yǐhòu, dāngdì rén cái huì yǔnxǔ yóukè zài zhǐdìng qūyù huábīng.
example.en: Only after the lake surface has completely frozen will locals allow visitors to skate in the designated area.

example.zh: 春天一到,校园里的花朵陆续开放,把灰色的建筑衬得柔和了许多。
example.py: Chūntiān yí dào, xiàoyuán lǐ de huāduǒ lùxù kāifàng, bǎ huīsè de jiànzhù chènde róuhé le xǔduō.
example.en: As soon as spring arrives, the flowers on campus open one after another, making the grey buildings look much softer.

example.zh: 政府按照地形和人口密度重新划分了几个行政区域。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ ànzhào dìxíng hé rénkǒu mìdù chóngxīn huàfēn le jǐ gè xíngzhèng qūyù.
example.en: The government redivided several administrative regions according to terrain and population density.

meaning: chest, bosom; to hold in mind

example.zh: 他怀里抱着一只受伤的小狗,匆忙赶往附近的兽医站。
example.py: Tā huái lǐ bàozhe yì zhī shòushāng de xiǎogǒu, cōngmáng gǎnwǎng fùjìn de shòuyī zhàn.
example.en: He held an injured puppy in his arms and hurried to the nearby veterinary clinic.

example.zh: 每到春节,离乡多年的老人都会格外怀念故乡的年夜饭。
example.py: Měi dào Chūnjié, líxiāng duōnián de lǎorén dū huì géwài huáiniàn gùxiāng de niányèfàn.
example.en: Every Spring Festival, elderly people who have been away from home for many years especially miss their hometown New Year’s Eve dinner.

example.zh: 怀孕期间,医生建议她定期检查,并避免服用未经确认的药物。
example.py: Huáiyùn qījiān, yīshēng jiànyì tā dìngqī jiǎnchá, bìng bìmiǎn fúyòng wèijīng quèrèn de yàowù.
example.en: During pregnancy, the doctor advised her to have regular check-ups and avoid taking unconfirmed medicines.

example.zh: 长期吸烟会显著增加患肺炎和其他呼吸系统疾病的风险。
example.py: Chángqī xīyān huì xiǎnzhù zēngjiā huàn fèiyán hé qítā hūxī xìtǒng jíbìng de fēngxiǎn.
example.en: Long-term smoking significantly increases the risk of contracting pneumonia and other respiratory diseases.

meaning: ring, loop; measure word for rings; to surround

example.zh: 这个银环看似普通,却是考古人员判断年代的重要线索。
example.py: Zhège yín huán kànsì pǔtōng, què shì kǎogǔ rényuán pànduàn niándài de zhòngyào xiànsuǒ.
example.en: This silver ring looks ordinary, but it is an important clue for archaeologists in judging the period.

example.zh: 这幅画以黄为主色,却并没有给人温暖的感觉,反而显得有些荒凉。
example.py: Zhè fú huà yǐ huáng wéi zhǔsè, què bìng méiyǒu gěi rén wēnnuǎn de gǎnjué, fǎn'ér xiǎnde yǒuxiē huāngliáng.
example.en: This painting uses yellow as its main colour, yet it does not feel warm; instead, it seems rather desolate.

example.zh: 这位皇帝在位期间推行改革,却也因用人失误留下争议。
example.py: Zhè wèi huángdì zài wèi qījiān tuīxíng gǎigé, què yě yīn yòngrén shīwù liúxià zhēngyì.
example.en: During his reign, this emperor carried out reforms, but he also left controversy because of mistakes in appointing people.

example.zh: 节日的广场上充满欢乐,连平时严肃的老人也跟着音乐跳了起来。
example.py: Jiérì de guǎngchǎng shàng chōngmǎn huānlè, lián píngshí yánsù de lǎorén yě gēnzhe yīnyuè tiào le qǐlái.
example.en: The festival square was full of joy, and even the usually serious elderly people began dancing along to the music.

example.zh: 科学幻想常常启发真实技术的发展,而不是毫无价值的空想。
example.py: Kēxué huànxiǎng chángcháng qǐfā zhēnshí jìshù de fāzhǎn, ér bú shì háo wú jiàzhí de kōngxiǎng.
example.en: Science fantasy often inspires the development of real technology; it is not worthless daydreaming.

meaning: to restore, to return to original state

example.zh: 调查人员根据现场痕迹,还原了事故发生前后的关键过程。
example.py: Diàochá rényuán gēnjù xiànchǎng hénjì, huányuán le shìgù fāshēng qiánhòu de guānjiàn guòchéng.
example.en: Based on the traces at the scene, the investigators reconstructed the key process before and after the accident.

example.zh: 医院为重症患者开设了绿色通道,确保他们能够及时接受治疗。
example.py: Yīyuàn wèi zhòngzhèng huànzhě kāishè le lǜsè tōngdào, quèbǎo tāmen nénggòu jíshí jiēshòu zhìliáo.
example.en: The hospital opened a fast-track channel for critically ill patients to ensure that they could receive treatment in time.

example.zh: 这种酱里含有少量花生,过敏者购买前一定要查看标签。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng jiàng lǐ hányǒu shǎoliàng huāshēng, guòmǐnzhě gòumǎi qián yídìng yào chákàn biāoqiān.
example.en: This sauce contains a small amount of peanut, so people with allergies must check the label before buying it.

example.zh: 这块化石保存了植物叶片的痕迹,对研究古代气候很有价值。
example.py: Zhè kuài huàshí bǎocún le zhíwù yèpiàn de hénjì, duì yánjiū gǔdài qìhòu hěn yǒu jiàzhí.
example.en: This fossil preserves the traces of plant leaves and is very valuable for studying ancient climates.

example.zh: 发言人拿起话筒后,现场的嘈杂声很快安静下来。
example.py: Fāyánrén náqǐ huàtǒng hòu, xiànchǎng de cáozá shēng hěn kuài ānjìng xiàlái.
example.en: After the speaker picked up the microphone, the noise at the scene quickly died down.

example.zh: 飞机降落后在跑道上继续滑行,直到地勤人员发出引导信号。
example.py: Fēijī jiàngluò hòu zài pǎodào shàng jìxù huáxíng, zhídào dìqín rényuán fāchū yǐndǎo xìnhào.
example.en: After landing, the plane continued to taxi along the runway until the ground crew gave a guiding signal.

example.zh: 他去高原滑雪前,特意购买了保暖性能更好的装备。
example.py: Tā qù gāoyuán huáxuě qián, tèyì gòumǎi le bǎonuǎn xìngnéng gèng hǎo de zhuāngbèi.
example.en: Before going skiing on the plateau, he deliberately bought equipment with better thermal performance.

example.zh: 为了让角色更符合朝代背景,演员提前两个小时开始化妆。
example.py: Wèile ràng juésè gèng fúhé cháodài bèijǐng, yǎnyuán tíqián liǎng gè xiǎoshí kāishǐ huàzhuāng.
example.en: To make the character better fit the historical setting, the actor began putting on make-up two hours early.

example.zh: 请把货款汇到合同上注明的账户,并在备注里写清订单号。
example.py: Qǐng bǎ huòkuǎn huì dào hétong shàng zhùmíng de zhànghù, bìng zài bèizhù lǐ xiě qīng dìngdānhào.
example.en: Please remit the payment to the account stated in the contract and write the order number clearly in the notes.

example.zh: 他把多年积累的经验传授给年轻人,算是对社会的一种回报。
example.py: Tā bǎ duōnián jīlěi de jīngyàn chuánshòu gěi niánqīng rén, suàn shì duì shèhuì de yì zhǒng huíbào.
example.en: He passed on the experience he had accumulated over many years to young people, seeing it as a kind of return to society.

meaning: to report, to give an account

example.zh: 他把调查结果整理成图表,准备在例会上向领导汇报。
example.py: Tā bǎ diàochá jiéguǒ zhěnglǐ chéng túbiǎo, zhǔnbèi zài lìhuì shàng xiàng lǐngdǎo huìbào.
example.en: He organised the investigation results into charts and prepared to report them to the leadership at the regular meeting.

example.zh: 仓库封闭多年,货架上积了厚厚一层灰尘,连标签都看不清。
example.py: Cāngkù fēngbì duōnián, huòjià shàng jī le hòuhòu yì céng huīchén, lián biāoqiān dōu kàn bu qīng.
example.en: The warehouse had been sealed for years, and a thick layer of dust had gathered on the shelves, making even the labels hard to read.

example.zh: 回顾过去十年的发展,我们不难发现技术改变了许多行业的规则。
example.py: Huígù guòqù shí nián de fāzhǎn, wǒmen bù nán fāxiàn jìshù gǎibiàn le xǔduō hángyè de guīzé.
example.en: Looking back at the development of the past ten years, it is not hard to see that technology has changed the rules of many industries.

example.zh: 他从小学习绘画,后来把这种能力用于建筑和舞台设计。
example.py: Tā cóng xiǎo xuéxí huìhuà, hòulái bǎ zhè zhǒng nénglì yòng yú jiànzhú hé wǔtái shèjì.
example.en: He studied painting from childhood and later used this ability in architecture and stage design.

example.zh: 总理将在峰会期间会见多国代表,就气候合作交换意见。
example.py: Zǒnglǐ jiāng zài fēnghuì qījiān huìjiàn duō guó dàibiǎo, jiù qìhòu hézuò jiāohuàn yìjiàn.
example.en: The premier will meet representatives from several countries during the summit to exchange views on climate cooperation.

example.zh: 为了避免延误,请在汇款后把凭证上传到系统。
example.py: Wèile bìmiǎn yánwù, qǐng zài huìkuǎn hòu bǎ píngzhèng shàngchuán dào xìtǒng.
example.en: To avoid delays, please upload the proof to the system after making the remittance.

example.zh: 她刚走出门又回头看了一眼,似乎还有什么话没有说完。
example.py: Tā gāng zǒuchū mén yòu huítóu kàn le yì yǎn, sìhū hái yǒu shénme huà méiyǒu shuōwán.
example.en: She had just walked out of the door when she turned back for another look, as if there were still something she had not finished saying.

example.zh: 第一次实验失败后,团队并没有灰心,而是重新检查了每一个步骤。
example.py: Dì yī cì shíyàn shībài hòu, tuánduì bìng méiyǒu huīxīn, ér shì chóngxīn jiǎnchá le měi yí gè bùzhòu.
example.en: After the first experiment failed, the team did not become discouraged, but checked every step again.

example.zh: 制定方案时不能忽略少数群体的实际需求。
example.py: Zhìdìng fāng'àn shí bù néng hūlüè shǎoshù qúntǐ de shíjì xūqiú.
example.en: When making a plan, one must not overlook the real needs of minority groups.

example.zh: 不同来源的数据不能随便混在一起,否则结论会失去可信度。
example.py: Bùtóng láiyuán de shùjù bù néng suíbiàn hùn zài yìqǐ, fǒuzé jiélùn huì shīqù kěxìndù.
example.en: Data from different sources must not be casually mixed together, otherwise the conclusion will lose credibility.

example.zh: 研究人员将两种材料混合后,观察其强度是否有所提升。
example.py: Yánjiū rényuán jiāng liǎng zhǒng cáiliào hùnhé hòu, guānchá qí qiángdù shìfǒu yǒu suǒ tíshēng.
example.en: After mixing the two materials, the researchers observed whether their strength had improved.

example.zh: 发布会现场一度十分混乱,工作人员不得不临时调整入场秩序。
example.py: Fābùhuì xiànchǎng yídù shífēn hùnluàn, gōngzuò rényuán bùdébù línshí tiáozhěng rùchǎng zhìxù.
example.en: The press conference venue was extremely chaotic for a while, and staff had to temporarily adjust the entry order.

example.zh: 稳定的婚姻并不意味着没有冲突,而是双方愿意共同解决问题。
example.py: Wěndìng de hūnyīn bìng bù yìwèizhe méiyǒu chōngtū, ér shì shuāngfāng yuànyì gòngtóng jiějué wèntí.
example.en: A stable marriage does not mean there are no conflicts; rather, both sides are willing to solve problems together.

example.zh: 如果货币发行过快,普通家庭的购买力可能会被削弱。
example.py: Rúguǒ huòbì fāxíng guò kuài, pǔtōng jiātíng de gòumǎilì kěnéng huì bèi xuēruò.
example.en: If currency is issued too quickly, the purchasing power of ordinary households may be weakened.

example.zh: 这盒火柴已经受潮,划了好几次都没有点燃。
example.py: Zhè hé huǒchái yǐjīng shòucháo, huá le hǎo jǐ cì dōu méiyǒu diǎnrán.
example.en: This box of matches has already become damp; even after striking them several times, none lit.

example.zh: 这辆货车在高速公路上突然爆胎,导致后方车辆紧急避让。
example.py: Zhè liàng huòchē zài gāosù gōnglù shàng tūrán bàotāi, dǎozhì hòufāng chēliàng jǐnjí bìràng.
example.en: This truck suddenly had a tyre blowout on the motorway, causing the vehicles behind it to swerve urgently.

example.zh: 新政策为传统产业注入了活力,使许多小企业重新获得订单。
example.py: Xīn zhèngcè wèi chuántǒng chǎnyè zhùrù le huólì, shǐ xǔduō xiǎo qǐyè chóngxīn huòdé dìngdān.
example.en: The new policy injected vitality into traditional industries, enabling many small businesses to regain orders.

example.zh: 春节过后,旅游市场迅速活跃起来,酒店订单大幅增加。
example.py: Chūnjié guòhòu, lǚyóu shìchǎng xùnsù huóyuè qǐlai, jiǔdiàn dìngdān dàfú zēngjiā.
example.en: After Spring Festival, the tourism market quickly became active, and hotel orders increased substantially.

example.zh: 这场火灾暴露了商场消防管理中的严重漏洞。
example.py: Zhè chǎng huǒzāi bàolù le shāngchǎng xiāofáng guǎnlǐ zhōng de yánzhòng lòudòng.
example.en: This fire exposed serious loopholes in the shopping centre’s fire safety management.

example.zh: 在灾后重建过程中,邻里之间的互助比任何口号都更能稳定人心。
example.py: Zài zāihòu chóngjiàn guòchéng zhōng, línlǐ zhījiān de hùzhù bǐ rènhé kǒuhào dōu gèng néng wěndìng rénxīn.
example.en: During post-disaster reconstruction, mutual aid among neighbours can stabilise people’s hearts more than any slogan.

example.zh: 他剃掉胡子以后,整个人显得年轻了不少。
example.py: Tā tìdiào húzi yǐhòu, zhěng gè rén xiǎnde niánqīng le bù shǎo.
example.en: After shaving off his beard, he looked considerably younger.

example.zh: 她把文件夹在书里,结果开会时怎么也找不到。
example.py: Tā bǎ wénjiàn jiā zài shū lǐ, jiéguǒ kāihuì shí zěnme yě zhǎo bú dào.
example.en: She tucked the document inside a book, and then could not find it at all during the meeting.

example.zh: 她并不急着嫁人,而是想先完成自己的学业。
example.py: Tā bìng bù jí zhe jià rén, ér shì xiǎng xiān wánchéng zìjǐ de xuéyè.
example.en: She is not in a hurry to marry; she wants to finish her studies first.

example.zh: 为了按时完成项目,团队决定加倍检查每一个细节。
example.py: Wèile ànshí wánchéng xiàngmù, tuánduì juédìng jiābèi jiǎnchá měi yí gè xìjié.
example.en: To complete the project on time, the team decided to double-check every detail.

example.zh: 母亲最喜欢和邻居坐在门口聊家常。
example.py: Mǔqīn zuì xǐhuan hé línjū zuò zài ménkǒu liáo jiācháng.
example.en: Mother most enjoys sitting at the doorway with neighbours and chatting about everyday life.

example.zh: 春节前,社区把消防提醒贴到了家家户户的门口。
example.py: Chūnjié qián, shèqū bǎ xiāofáng tíxǐng tiē dào le jiājiāhùhù de ménkǒu.
example.en: Before Spring Festival, the community posted fire-safety reminders on the door of every household.

example.zh: 连续高温加剧了城市用水的压力。
example.py: Liánxù gāowēn jiājù le chéngshì yòngshuǐ de yālì.
example.en: Continuous high temperatures intensified the pressure on urban water use.

example.zh: 这家公司专门设计适合小户型的智能家居。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhuānmén shèjì shìhé xiǎo hùxíng de zhìnéng jiājū.
example.en: This company specialises in designing smart home products for small flats.

example.zh: 博物馆里展出了一把保存完好的古剑。
example.py: Bówùguǎn lǐ zhǎnchū le yì bǎ bǎocún wánhǎo de gǔjiàn.
example.en: The museum displayed a well-preserved ancient sword.

example.zh: 这把刀的尖已经磨钝了,切东西不太方便。
example.py: Zhè bǎ dāo de jiān yǐjīng módùn le, qiē dōngxi bù tài fāngbiàn.
example.en: The tip of this knife has become blunt, so it is not very convenient for cutting things.

example.zh: 箭离弦以后,几乎没有回头的可能。
example.py: Jiàn lí xián yǐhòu, jīhū méiyǒu huítóu de kěnéng.
example.en: Once an arrow leaves the string, there is almost no possibility of turning back.

example.zh: 长时间背着沉重的电脑包,他的肩膀开始酸痛。
example.py: Cháng shíjiān bēi zhe chénzhòng de diànnǎobāo, tā de jiānbǎng kāishǐ suāntòng.
example.en: After carrying a heavy laptop bag for a long time, his shoulders began to ache.

example.zh: 医院已经对样本进行了检测,结果明天上午公布。
example.py: Yīyuàn yǐjīng duì yàngběn jìnxíng le jiǎncè, jiéguǒ míngtiān shàngwǔ gōngbù.
example.en: The hospital has already tested the sample, and the result will be announced tomorrow morning.

example.zh: 医院需要持续监测病人的血压和心率。
example.py: Yīyuàn xūyào chíxù jiāncè bìngrén de xuèyā hé xīnlǜ.
example.en: The hospital needs to continuously monitor the patient’s blood pressure and heart rate.

example.zh: 尽管外界压力很大,他的态度依然坚定。
example.py: Jǐnguǎn wàijiè yālì hěn dà, tā de tàidu yīrán jiāndìng.
example.en: Although external pressure was great, his attitude remained firm.

example.zh: 专家正在鉴定这幅画是否出自名家之手。
example.py: Zhuānjiā zhèngzài jiàndìng zhè fú huà shìfǒu chūzì míngjiā zhī shǒu.
example.en: Experts are identifying whether this painting was created by a famous artist.

example.zh: 新制度要求第三方机构监督资金的使用情况。
example.py: Xīn zhìdù yāoqiú dì sānfāng jīgòu jiāndū zījīn de shǐyòng qíngkuàng.
example.en: The new system requires a third-party organisation to supervise the use of funds.

example.zh: 这道菜的酱太咸,盖住了蔬菜本身的味道。
example.py: Zhè dào cài de jiàng tài xián, gàizhù le shūcài běnshēn de wèidào.
example.en: The sauce in this dish is too salty and covers the flavour of the vegetables themselves.

example.zh: 两次会议之间的间隔只有十分钟。
example.py: Liǎng cì huìyì zhījiān de jiàngé zhǐ yǒu shí fēnzhōng.
example.en: The interval between the two meetings is only ten minutes.

example.zh: 老师把复杂的语法点讲解得很清楚。
example.py: Lǎoshī bǎ fùzá de yǔfǎ diǎn jiǎngjiě de hěn qīngchǔ.
example.en: The teacher explained the complicated grammar point very clearly.

example.zh: 这位将军在战争结束后主动推动和平谈判。
example.py: Zhè wèi jiāngjūn zài zhànzhēng jiéshù hòu zhǔdòng tuīdòng hépíng tánpàn.
example.en: This general actively promoted peace talks after the war ended.

example.zh: 运动员把奖牌挂在胸前,眼里含着泪。
example.py: Yùndòngyuán bǎ jiǎngpái guà zài xiōngqián, yǎn lǐ hán zhe lèi.
example.en: The athlete hung the medal on his chest, with tears in his eyes.

example.zh: 获胜者可以选择现金或等值奖品。
example.py: Huòshèng zhě kěyǐ xuǎnzé xiànjīn huò děngzhí jiǎngpǐn.
example.en: The winner may choose cash or a prize of equal value.

example.zh: 这座桥的结构非常坚固,可以承受强风和洪水。
example.py: Zhè zuò qiáo de jiégòu fēicháng jiāngù, kěyǐ chéngshòu qiángfēng hé hóngshuǐ.
example.en: The structure of this bridge is very solid and can withstand strong winds and floods.

example.zh: 炒青菜时放一点酱油,就能增加香味。
example.py: Chǎo qīngcài shí fàng yìdiǎn jiàngyóu, jiù néng zēngjiā xiāngwèi.
example.en: Adding a little soy sauce when stir-frying greens can enhance the aroma.

example.zh: 为了提高效率,公司决定简化审批流程。
example.py: Wèile tígāo xiàolǜ, gōngsī juédìng jiǎnhuà shěnpī liúchéng.
example.en: To improve efficiency, the company decided to simplify the approval process.

example.zh: 请先看一下项目简介,再决定是否参加。
example.py: Qǐng xiān kàn yíxià xiàngmù jiǎnjiè, zài juédìng shìfǒu cānjiā.
example.en: Please look at the project introduction first, then decide whether to take part.

example.zh: 这项政策的间接影响可能要几年后才会显现。
example.py: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè de jiànjiē yǐngxiǎng kěnéng yào jǐ nián hòu cái huì xiǎnxiàn.
example.en: The indirect impact of this policy may not become apparent until several years later.

example.zh: 公司坚决反对任何形式的商业贿赂。
example.py: Gōngsī jiānjué fǎnduì rènhé xíngshì de shāngyè huìlù.
example.en: The company firmly opposes any form of commercial bribery.

example.zh: 在经济下行时期,许多小企业面临艰难的选择。
example.py: Zài jīngjì xiàxíng shíqī, xǔduō xiǎo qǐyè miànlín jiānnán de xuǎnzé.
example.en: During an economic downturn, many small businesses face difficult choices.

example.zh: 一个健全的制度应该既有监督,也有纠错机制。
example.py: Yí ge jiànquán de zhìdù yīnggāi jì yǒu jiāndū, yě yǒu jiūcuò jīzhì.
example.en: A sound system should have both supervision and a mechanism for correcting errors.

example.zh: 随着距离增加,信号会逐渐减弱。
example.py: Suízhe jùlí zēngjiā, xìnhào huì zhújiàn jiǎnruò.
example.en: As the distance increases, the signal will gradually weaken.

example.zh: 这项成果背后是科研人员多年的艰辛努力。
example.py: Zhè xiàng chéngguǒ bèihòu shì kēyán rényuán duō nián de jiānxīn nǔlì.
example.en: Behind this achievement lie many years of arduous effort by researchers.

example.zh: 他每天跑步半小时,用这种方式减压。
example.py: Tā měitiān pǎobù bàn xiǎoshí, yòng zhè zhǒng fāngshì jiǎnyā.
example.en: He runs for half an hour every day and uses this method to relieve pressure.

example.zh: 这项政策的效果还需要时间来检验。
example.py: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè de xiàoguǒ hái xūyào shíjiān lái jiǎnyàn.
example.en: The effect of this policy still needs time to be tested.

example.zh: 这块土地被太阳晒得很坚硬,必须先浇水再翻土。
example.py: Zhè kuài tǔdì bèi tàiyáng shài de hěn jiānyìng, bìxū xiān jiāo shuǐ zài fān tǔ.
example.en: This piece of land has been baked hard by the sun, so it must be watered before the soil is turned.

meaning: to hold multiple jobs; part-time job

example.zh: 她白天在公司上班,晚上兼职教中文。
example.py: Tā báitiān zài gōngsī shàngbān, wǎnshang jiānzhí jiāo Zhōngwén.
example.en: She works at a company during the day and teaches Chinese part-time in the evening.

example.zh: 这片老城区里,许多建筑物都有上百年的历史。
example.py: Zhè piàn lǎo chéngqū lǐ, xǔduō jiànzhùwù dōu yǒu shàng bǎi nián de lìshǐ.
example.en: In this old urban area, many buildings have a history of over a hundred years.

example.zh: 箱子封好后,再用胶带把边缘固定住。
example.py: Xiāngzi fēng hǎo hòu, zài yòng jiāodài bǎ biānyuán gùdìng zhù.
example.en: After sealing the box, use tape to secure the edges.

example.zh: 这次会议的焦点不是预算,而是如何重新赢得公众信任。
example.py: Zhè cì huìyì de jiāodiǎn bú shì yùsuàn, ér shì rúhé chóngxīn yíngdé gōngzhòng xìnrèn.
example.en: The focus of this meeting is not the budget, but how to regain public trust.

example.zh: 良好的交际能力能帮助新人更快适应复杂的工作环境。
example.py: Liánghǎo de jiāojì nénglì néng bāngzhù xīnrén gèng kuài shìyìng fùzá de gōngzuò huánjìng.
example.en: Good social skills can help newcomers adapt more quickly to a complex work environment.

example.zh: 临近考试时,她明显变得焦虑,连睡眠质量都下降了。
example.py: Línjìn kǎoshì shí, tā míngxiǎn biànde jiāolǜ, lián shuìmián zhìliàng dōu xiàjiàng le.
example.en: As the exam approached, she clearly became anxious, and even the quality of her sleep declined.

example.zh: 会议室的角落放着一台旧打印机,已经很少有人使用。
example.py: Huìyìshì de jiǎoluò fàngzhe yì tái jiù dǎyìnjī, yǐjīng hěn shǎo yǒu rén shǐyòng.
example.en: There is an old printer in the corner of the meeting room, and very few people use it now.

example.zh: 这款胶水干得很快,使用前必须先把材料的位置对准。
example.py: Zhè kuǎn jiāoshuǐ gān de hěn kuài, shǐyòng qián bìxū xiān bǎ cáiliào de wèizhi duìzhǔn.
example.en: This glue dries very quickly, so you must first align the materials before using it.

example.zh: 面试结束后,经理又和他交谈了十分钟,了解他的长期计划。
example.py: Miànshì jiéshù hòu, jīnglǐ yòu hé tā jiāotán le shí fēnzhōng, liǎojiě tā de chángqī jìhuà.
example.en: After the interview ended, the manager talked with him for another ten minutes to understand his long-term plans.

example.zh: 周末我们打算去郊外走走,暂时离开城市的噪音。
example.py: Zhōumò wǒmen dǎsuàn qù jiāowài zǒuzou, zànshí líkāi chéngshì de zàoyīn.
