example.en: At the weekend, we plan to take a walk in the suburbs and temporarily get away from the noise of the city.

example.zh: 这份报告的结论较为谨慎,没有轻易预测市场趋势。
example.py: Zhè fèn bàogào de jiélùn jiàowéi jǐnshèn, méiyǒu qīngyì yùcè shìchǎng qūshì.
example.en: The conclusion of this report is relatively cautious and does not casually predict market trends.

example.zh: 这次失败给团队留下了深刻的教训,尤其是在风险管理方面。
example.py: Zhè cì shībài gěi tuánduì liúxià le shēnkè de jiàoxùn, yóuqí shì zài fēngxiǎn guǎnlǐ fāngmiàn.
example.en: This failure left the team with a profound lesson, especially in terms of risk management.

example.zh: 雨后的泥路上留下了一串清晰的脚印。
example.py: Yǔ hòu de nílù shàng liúxià le yì chuàn qīngxī de jiǎoyìn.
example.en: A series of clear footprints was left on the muddy road after the rain.

example.zh: 我们先假设数据是准确的,再讨论结论是否合理。
example.py: Wǒmen xiān jiǎshè shùjù shì zhǔnquè de, zài tǎolùn jiélùn shìfǒu hélǐ.
example.en: Let us first suppose the data is accurate, and then discuss whether the conclusion is reasonable.

example.zh: 手术结束后,医生向家属详细说明了病人的情况。
example.py: Shǒushù jiéshù hòu, yīshēng xiàng jiāshǔ xiángxì shuōmíng le bìngrén de qíngkuàng.
example.en: After the operation, the doctor explained the patient’s condition in detail to the family members.

meaning: to apply, to add; in addition

example.zh: 对于学生提出的合理建议,学校应该认真加以考虑。
example.py: Duìyú xuéshēng tíchū de hélǐ jiànyì, xuéxiào yīnggāi rènzhēn jiāyǐ kǎolǜ.
example.en: The school should seriously consider the reasonable suggestions put forward by students.

example.zh: 洪水退去后,村民们开始重建自己的家园。
example.py: Hóngshuǐ tuìqù hòu, cūnmín men kāishǐ chóngjiàn zìjǐ de jiāyuán.
example.en: After the floodwaters receded, the villagers began rebuilding their homes.

meaning: to increase in weight, to aggravate

example.zh: 长期熬夜会加重身体的疲劳感。
example.py: Chángqī áoyè huì jiāzhòng shēntǐ de píláogǎn.
example.en: Staying up late for a long time will worsen the body’s sense of fatigue.

example.zh: 尽管对手准备充分,我们的队伍仍在决赛中击败了他们。
example.py: Jǐnguǎn duìshǒu zhǔnbèi chōngfèn, wǒmen de duìwu réng zài juésài zhōng jībài le tāmen.
example.en: Although the opponents were well prepared, our team still defeated them in the final.

example.zh: 即便预算有限,我们也不能降低安全标准。
example.py: Jíbiàn yùsuàn yǒuxiàn, wǒmen yě bùnéng jiàngdī ānquán biāozhǔn.
example.en: Even if the budget is limited, we must not lower safety standards.

example.zh: 他继承了父亲的手艺,却没有完全照搬旧方法。
example.py: Tā jìchéng le fùqīn de shǒuyì, què méiyǒu wánquán zhàobān jiù fāngfǎ.
example.en: He inherited his father's craft, but he did not simply copy the old methods.

example.zh: 科研团队在海拔很高的地区建立了长期观测基地。
example.py: Kēyán tuánduì zài hǎibá hěn gāo de dìqū jiànlì le chángqī guāncè jīdì.
example.en: The research team established a long-term observation base in a high-altitude area.

example.zh: 机动车进入校园前必须登记,以免影响学生安全。
example.py: Jīdòngchē jìnrù xiàoyuán qián bìxū dēngjì, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng xuésheng ānquán.
example.en: Motor vehicles must be registered before entering the campus so as not to affect student safety.

example.zh: 在极端天气下,老人和儿童需要特别照顾。
example.py: Zài jíduān tiānqì xià, lǎorén hé értóng xūyào tèbié zhàogù.
example.en: In extreme weather, elderly people and children need special care.

example.zh: 这棵苹果树去年没有开花,今年却结了不少果子。
example.py: Zhè kē píngguǒ shù qùnián méiyǒu kāihuā, jīnnián què jiē le bù shǎo guǒzi.
example.en: This apple tree did not blossom last year, but this year it has borne quite a lot of fruit.

example.zh: 这道题看似复杂,其实换个角度就能解。
example.py: Zhè dào tí kànsì fùzá, qíshí huàn gè jiǎodù jiù néng jiě.
example.en: This problem seems complicated, but it can be solved from another angle.

example.zh: 连续工作十几个小时后,他又累又饥饿,几乎说不出话来。
example.py: Liánxù gōngzuò shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí hòu, tā yòu lèi yòu jī'è, jīhū shuō bù chū huà lái.
example.en: After working continuously for more than ten hours, he was so tired and hungry that he could hardly speak.

example.zh: 她在公共卫生领域作出了杰出贡献,获得了国际认可。
example.py: Tā zài gōnggòng wèishēng lǐngyù zuòchū le jiéchū gòngxiàn, huòdé le guójì rènkě.
example.en: She made outstanding contributions in the field of public health and gained international recognition.

example.zh: 专家在线解答了居民关于养老金政策的疑问。
example.py: Zhuānjiā zàixiàn jiědá le jūmín guānyú yǎnglǎojīn zhèngcè de yíwèn.
example.en: Experts answered residents' questions about the pension policy online.

example.zh: 媒体对这份报告的解读过于片面,忽视了长期背景。
example.py: Méitǐ duì zhè fèn bàogào de jiědú guòyú piànmiàn, hūshì le chángqī bèijǐng.
example.en: The media interpretation of this report was too one-sided and ignored the long-term background.

example.zh: 新技术把员工从重复劳动中解放出来。
example.py: Xīn jìshù bǎ yuángōng cóng chóngfù láodòng zhōng jiěfàng chūlái.
example.en: New technology frees employees from repetitive labour.

meaning: to bear fruit, to produce a result

example.zh: 这片果园管理得当,三年后终于开始结果。
example.py: Zhè piàn guǒyuán guǎnlǐ dédàng, sān nián hòu zhōngyú kāishǐ jiēguǒ.
example.en: This orchard was managed properly and finally began to bear fruit after three years.

example.zh: 我们可以借鉴国外经验,但不能照搬他们的制度。
example.py: Wǒmen kěyǐ jièjiàn guówài jīngyàn, dàn bù néng zhàobān tāmen de zhìdù.
example.en: We can draw on foreign experience, but we cannot copy their system directly.

meaning: in a row, one after another; repeatedly

example.zh: 这个地区接连发生强降雨,交通和供电都受到了影响。
example.py: Zhège dìqū jiēlián fāshēng qiáng jiàngyǔ, jiāotōng hé gōngdiàn dōu shòudào le yǐngxiǎng.
example.en: This area experienced heavy rainfall one after another, affecting both transport and power supply.

example.zh: 新建办公楼采用了节能玻璃和智能空调系统。
example.py: Xīnjiàn bàngōnglóu cǎiyòng le jiénéng bōli hé zhìnéng kōngtiáo xìtǒng.
example.en: The newly built office building uses energy-saving glass and an intelligent air-conditioning system.

example.zh: 这把椅子看起来普通,但结构很结实,用了十年也没坏。
example.py: Zhè bǎ yǐzi kàn qǐlái pǔtōng, dàn jiégòu hěn jiēshi, yòng le shí nián yě méi huài.
example.en: This chair looks ordinary, but its structure is very sturdy and it still has not broken after ten years of use.

example.zh: 导游用生动的语言解说了古城的防御体系。
example.py: Dǎoyóu yòng shēngdòng de yǔyán jiěshuō le gǔchéng de fángyù tǐxì.
example.en: The guide explained the ancient city’s defence system in vivid language.

example.zh: 节日晚上,街头到处都是音乐声和欢笑声。
example.py: Jiérì wǎnshang, jiētóu dàochù dōu shì yīnyuè shēng hé huānxiào shēng.
example.en: On the evening of the festival, the streets were full of music and laughter.

example.zh: 这部电影的结尾出人意料,却让整个故事更加完整。
example.py: Zhè bù diànyǐng de jiéwěi chū rén yìliào, què ràng zhěnggè gùshì gèngjiā wánzhěng.
example.en: The ending of this film is unexpected, but it makes the whole story more complete.

example.zh: 她把戒指放进抽屉里,决定暂时不谈那段关系。
example.py: Tā bǎ jièzhi fàng jìn chōutì lǐ, juédìng zànshí bù tán nà duàn guānxì.
example.en: She put the ring into the drawer and decided not to talk about that relationship for the time being.

example.zh: 报名将在周五下午五点截止,请提前提交材料。
example.py: Bàomíng jiāng zài zhōuwǔ xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn jiézhǐ, qǐng tíqián tíjiāo cáiliào.
example.en: Registration will close at five o'clock on Friday afternoon, so please submit the materials in advance.

example.zh: 截至本月底,项目已经完成了百分之八十。
example.py: Jiézhì běn yuèdǐ, xiàngmù yǐjīng wánchéng le bǎifēn zhī bāshí.
example.en: As of the end of this month, the project has already been eighty percent completed.

example.zh: 借助人工智能,医生可以更快发现早期风险。
example.py: Jièzhù réngōng zhìnéng, yīshēng kěyǐ gèng kuài fāxiàn zǎoqī fēngxiǎn.
example.en: With the help of artificial intelligence, doctors can discover early risks more quickly.

example.zh: 他故意放慢谈判节奏,以便为团队争取更多准备时间。
example.py: Tā gùyì fàngmàn tánpàn jiézòu, yǐbiàn wèi tuánduì zhēngqǔ gèng duō zhǔnbèi shíjiān.
example.en: He deliberately slowed the pace of the negotiations to win more preparation time for the team.

example.zh: 一个好的问题往往能激发学生继续探索的兴趣。
example.py: Yí gè hǎo de wèntí wǎngwǎng néng jīfā xuésheng jìxù tànsuǒ de xìngqù.
example.en: A good question can often inspire students’ interest in continuing to explore.

example.zh: 这项基金专门支持年轻科学家的早期研究。
example.py: Zhè xiàng jījīn zhuānmén zhīchí niánqīng kēxuéjiā de zǎoqī yánjiū.
example.en: This fund is dedicated to supporting the early-stage research of young scientists.

example.zh: 他学过急救,所以在救护车到来前保持了冷静。
example.py: Tā xué guò jíjiù, suǒyǐ zài jiùhùchē dàolái qián bǎochí le lěngjìng.
example.en: He had learnt first aid, so he stayed calm before the ambulance arrived.

example.zh: 虽然只获得季军,他仍然为国家赢得了荣誉。
example.py: Suīrán zhǐ huòdé jìjūn, tā réngrán wèi guójiā yíngdé le róngyù.
example.en: Although he only came third, he still won honour for his country.

example.zh: 老师的一句话激励了他多年,直到他考上理想的大学。
example.py: Lǎoshī de yí jù huà jīlì le tā duōnián, zhídào tā kǎo shàng lǐxiǎng de dàxué.
example.en: One sentence from the teacher motivated him for years, until he got into his ideal university.

example.zh: 没有严格的纪律,再优秀的团队也难以完成任务。
example.py: Méiyǒu yángé de jìlǜ, zài yōuxiù de tuánduì yě nányǐ wánchéng rènwu.
example.en: Without strict discipline, even an excellent team will struggle to complete its tasks.

example.zh: 搬到陌生城市后,她第一次感到真正的寂寞。
example.py: Bān dào mòshēng chéngshì hòu, tā dì yī cì gǎndào zhēnzhèng de jìmò.
example.en: After moving to an unfamiliar city, she felt truly lonely for the first time.

meaning: to exhaust, to use up; (to the utmost)

example.zh: 为了按时完成任务,团队已经尽了最大努力。
example.py: Wèile ànshí wánchéng rènwù, tuánduì yǐjīng jìn le zuìdà nǔlì.
example.en: To complete the task on time, the team has already done its utmost.

example.zh: 项目进度比预期慢,主要原因是审批时间延长了。
example.py: Xiàngmù jìndù bǐ yùqī màn, zhǔyào yuányīn shì shěnpī shíjiān yáncháng le.
example.en: The project progress is slower than expected, mainly because the approval time has been extended.

example.zh: 合同上写明了付款金额和最后期限。
example.py: Hétong shàng xiěmíng le fùkuǎn jīn'é hé zuìhòu qīxiàn.
example.en: The contract clearly states the payment amount and the final deadline.

example.zh: 数据先被整理成图表,进而用于判断市场趋势。
example.py: Shùjù xiān bèi zhěnglǐ chéng túbiǎo, jìn'ér yòng yú pànduàn shìchǎng qūshì.
example.en: The data is first organised into charts, and then used to judge market trends.

example.zh: 村里的老井已经不用了,但仍被保留下来作为历史记忆。
example.py: Cūn lǐ de lǎo jǐng yǐjīng bú yòng le, dàn réng bèi bǎoliú xiàlái zuòwéi lìshǐ jìyì.
example.en: The old well in the village is no longer used, but it has still been preserved as a historical memory.

example.zh: 扣除各项成本后,公司今年的净利润仍然保持增长。
example.py: Kòuchú gè xiàng chéngběn hòu, gōngsī jīnnián de jìng lìrùn réngrán bǎochí zēngzhǎng.
example.en: After deducting all costs, the company’s net profit still maintained growth this year.

example.zh: 系统多次警告用户密码过于简单,但他一直没有修改。
example.py: Xìtǒng duō cì jǐnggào yònghù mìmǎ guòyú jiǎndān, dàn tā yìzhí méiyǒu xiūgǎi.
example.en: The system repeatedly warned the user that the password was too simple, but he never changed it.

example.zh: 这条河两岸的景观经过改造后,成了市民散步的好地方。
example.py: Zhè tiáo hé liǎng àn de jǐngguān jīngguò gǎizào hòu, chéng le shìmín sànbù de hǎo dìfang.
example.en: After the landscape on both sides of the river was improved, it became a good place for residents to walk.

example.zh: 博物馆展出了许多精美的青铜器,吸引了大批游客。
example.py: Bówùguǎn zhǎnchū le xǔduō jīngměi de qīngtóngqì, xīyǐn le dàpī yóukè.
example.en: The museum displayed many exquisite bronze objects, attracting large numbers of visitors.

example.zh: 这台仪器能够进行精确测量,误差几乎可以忽略。
example.py: Zhè tái yíqì nénggòu jìnxíng jīngquè cèliáng, wùchā jīhū kěyǐ hūlüè.
example.en: This instrument can make precise measurements, with errors that can almost be ignored.

example.zh: 这家公司五年内的增长速度十分惊人。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī wǔ nián nèi de zēngzhǎng sùdù shífēn jīngrén.
example.en: This company’s growth rate over five years has been astonishing.

example.zh: 几家企业在同一领域竞赛,推动了技术快速进步。
example.py: Jǐ jiā qǐyè zài tóng yī lǐngyù jìngsài, tuīdòng le jìshù kuàisù jìnbù.
example.en: Several companies compete in the same field, driving rapid technological progress.

example.zh: 他年轻时曾在东南亚经商,积累了丰富经验。
example.py: Tā niánqīng shí céng zài Dōngnányà jīngshāng, jīlěi le fēngfù jīngyàn.
example.en: When he was young, he once did business in Southeast Asia and gained rich experience.

example.zh: 他精通多种编程语言,能迅速解决复杂问题。
example.py: Tā jīngtōng duō zhǒng biānchéng yǔyán, néng xùnsù jiějué fùzá wèntí.
example.en: He is proficient in several programming languages and can quickly solve complex problems.

example.zh: 导演用一个长镜头表现人物内心的变化。
example.py: Dǎoyǎn yòng yí ge cháng jìngtóu biǎoxiàn rénwù nèixīn de biànhuà.
example.en: The director used a long shot to show the character’s inner changes.

example.zh: 洪水退去后,街道上一片混乱的景象令人心痛。
example.py: Hóngshuǐ tuìqù hòu, jiēdào shàng yí piàn hùnluàn de jǐngxiàng lìng rén xīntòng.
example.en: After the flood receded, the chaotic scene on the streets was heartbreaking.

example.zh: 这次展览经过精心安排,参观路线非常清晰。
example.py: Zhè cì zhǎnlǎn jīngguò jīngxīn ānpái, cānguān lùxiàn fēicháng qīngxī.
example.en: This exhibition has been carefully arranged, and the visitor route is very clear.

example.zh: 听到公司突然改变计划,大家都感到十分惊讶。
example.py: Tīngdào gōngsī tūrán gǎibiàn jìhuà, dàjiā dōu gǎndào shífēn jīngyà.
example.en: Everyone felt very surprised when they heard that the company had suddenly changed its plan.

example.zh: 这家小店的菜量不大,但摆盘非常精致。
example.py: Zhè jiā xiǎo diàn de cài liàng bú dà, dàn bǎipán fēicháng jīngzhì.
example.en: The portions at this small restaurant are not large, but the presentation is very refined.

example.zh: 长期低头工作容易造成颈椎不适,需要定时活动。
example.py: Chángqī dītóu gōngzuò róngyì zàochéng jǐngzhuī bùshì, xūyào dìngshí huódòng.
example.en: Working with your head bent down for long periods can easily cause cervical spine discomfort, so regular movement is needed.

example.zh: 这次广告投放非常精准,几乎直接触达了目标客户。
example.py: Zhè cì guǎnggào tóufàng fēicháng jīngzhǔn, jīhū zhíjiē chùdá le mùbiāo kèhù.
example.en: This advertising campaign was very precise and almost directly reached the target customers.

example.zh: 人类语言的进化与社会合作方式密切相关。
example.py: Rénlèi yǔyán de jìnhuà yǔ shèhuì hézuò fāngshì mìqiè xiāngguān.
example.en: The evolution of human language is closely related to forms of social cooperation.

example.zh: 近来天气变化很大,医院里呼吸道患者明显增多。
example.py: Jìnlái tiānqì biànhuà hěn dà, yīyuàn lǐ hūxīdào huànzhě míngxiǎn zēngduō.
example.en: Recently, the weather has changed a great deal, and respiratory patients in hospitals have clearly increased.

example.zh: 她在国际比赛中赢得金牌后,仍然坚持每天训练。
example.py: Tā zài guójì bǐsài zhōng yíngdé jīnpái hòu, réngrán jiānchí měitiān xùnliàn.
example.en: After winning a gold medal in an international competition, she still kept training every day.

example.zh: 在公共服务领域,金钱不能成为衡量一切的唯一标准。
example.py: Zài gōnggòng fúwù lǐngyù, jīnqián bù néng chéngwéi héngliáng yíqiè de wéiyī biāozhǔn.
example.en: In the field of public services, money cannot become the only standard for measuring everything.

example.zh: 金融市场的变化会影响企业融资和普通人的生活成本。
example.py: Jīnróng shìchǎng de biànhuà huì yǐngxiǎng qǐyè róngzī hé pǔtōngrén de shēnghuó chéngběn.
example.en: Changes in financial markets can affect corporate financing and ordinary people’s cost of living.

example.zh: 很多孩子长期盯着电子屏幕,近视问题越来越普遍。
example.py: Hěn duō háizi chángqī dīngzhe diànzǐ píngmù, jìnshì wèntí yuèláiyuè pǔbiàn.
example.en: Nearsightedness is becoming increasingly common among children who stare at electronic screens for long periods.

example.zh: 这种金属耐高温,常用于航空发动机的关键部件。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng jīnshǔ nài gāowēn, cháng yòng yú hángkōng fādòngjī de guānjiàn bùjiàn.
example.en: This metal is resistant to high temperatures and is often used in key parts of aircraft engines.

example.zh: 谈判取得了明显进展,双方终于同意继续合作。
example.py: Tánpàn qǔdé le míngxiǎn jìnzhǎn, shuāngfāng zhōngyú tóngyì jìxù hézuò.
example.en: The negotiations made clear progress, and the two sides finally agreed to continue cooperating.

example.zh: 他并不相信天上会掉金子,所以对投资承诺保持警惕。
example.py: Tā bìng bù xiāngxìn tiānshàng huì diào jīnzi, suǒyǐ duì tóuzī chéngnuò bǎochí jǐngtì.
example.en: He does not believe gold will fall from the sky, so he remains wary of investment promises.

example.zh: 掌握谈判技巧,可以帮助双方更快找到共同点。
example.py: Zhǎngwò tánpàn jìqiǎo, kěyǐ bāngzhù shuāngfāng gèng kuài zhǎodào gòngtóngdiǎn.
example.en: Mastering negotiation techniques can help both sides find common ground more quickly.

example.zh: 她急切地想知道面试结果,一上午都没有安心工作。
example.py: Tā jíqiè de xiǎng zhīdào miànshì jiéguǒ, yí shàngwǔ dōu méiyǒu ānxīn gōngzuò.
example.en: She was eager to know the interview result and could not work at ease all morning.

example.zh: 他演讲时充满激情,很快就调动了全场的情绪。
example.py: Tā yǎnjiǎng shí chōngmǎn jīqíng, hěn kuài jiù diàodòng le quánchǎng de qíngxù.
example.en: When he spoke, he was full of passion and quickly stirred the emotions of the whole audience.

example.zh: 这家集团计划在东南亚建立新的生产基地。
example.py: Zhè jiā jítuán jìhuà zài Dōngnányà jiànlì xīn de shēngchǎn jīdì.
example.en: This corporation plans to establish a new production base in Southeast Asia.

example.zh: 她目前就读于上海一所以医学闻名的大学。
example.py: Tā mùqián jiùdú yú Shànghǎi yì suǒ yǐ yīxué wénmíng de dàxué.
example.en: She is currently studying at a university in Shanghai known for medicine.

example.zh: 双方因合同细节产生纠纷,最终通过调解解决。
example.py: Shuāngfāng yīn hétong xìjié chǎnshēng jiūfēn, zuìzhōng tōngguò tiáojiě jiějué.
example.en: The two sides had a dispute over contract details and finally resolved it through mediation.

example.zh: 医生提醒我们,酒精只能用于外部消毒,不能随便饮用。
example.py: Yīshēng tíxǐng wǒmen, jiǔjīng zhǐ néng yòng yú wàibù xiāodú, bùnéng suíbiàn yǐnyòng.
example.en: The doctor reminded us that alcohol can only be used for external disinfection and must not be drunk casually.

example.zh: 舅舅从小就鼓励我读书,所以我一直很尊敬他。
example.py: Jiùjiu cóng xiǎo jiù gǔlì wǒ dúshū, suǒyǐ wǒ yìzhí hěn zūnjìng tā.
example.en: My uncle encouraged me to study from a young age, so I have always respected him.

example.zh: 在野外突然失温时,这种急救知识真的能救命。
example.py: Zài yěwài túrán shīwēn shí, zhè zhǒng jíjiù zhīshi zhēn de néng jiùmìng.
example.en: When hypothermia suddenly occurs outdoors, this kind of first-aid knowledge can genuinely save lives.

example.zh: 这家餐厅的酒水价格偏高,点餐前最好先看清楚。
example.py: Zhè jiā cāntīng de jiǔshuǐ jiàgé piān gāo, diǎncān qián zuìhǎo xiān kàn qīngchǔ.
example.en: The alcoholic drinks in this restaurant are rather expensive, so it is best to check carefully before ordering.

example.zh: 就算预算有限,我们也不能降低安全标准。
example.py: Jiùsuàn yùsuàn yǒuxiàn, wǒmen yě bùnéng jiàngdī ānquán biāozhǔn.
example.en: Even if the budget is limited, we cannot lower safety standards.

example.zh: 洪水发生后,救援队连夜赶往受灾村庄。
example.py: Hóngshuǐ fāshēng hòu, jiùyuán duì liányè gǎnwǎng shòuzāi cūnzhuāng.
example.en: After the flood occurred, the rescue team rushed to the affected village overnight.

example.zh: 地震发生后,各地志愿者迅速赶来救灾。
example.py: Dìzhèn fāshēng hòu, gèdì zhìyuànzhě xùnsù gǎnlái jiùzāi.
example.en: After the earthquake occurred, volunteers from many places quickly came to provide disaster relief.

example.zh: 老师耐心地纠正了我的发音,还给出了具体的练习方法。
example.py: Lǎoshī nàixīn de jiūzhèng le wǒ de fāyīn, hái gěi chū le jùtǐ de liànxí fāngfǎ.
example.en: The teacher patiently corrected my pronunciation and also gave me specific practice methods.

example.zh: 这个基金会长期救助失学儿童。
example.py: Zhège jījīn huì chángqī jiùzhù shīxué értóng.
example.en: This foundation has long helped children who have dropped out of school.

example.zh: 这份报告的数据来源极为复杂,需要逐项核对。
example.py: Zhè fèn bàogào de shùjù láiyuán jíwéi fùzá, xūyào zhúxiàng héduì.
example.en: The data sources in this report are extremely complex and need to be checked item by item.

example.zh: 春节期间,人们喜欢贴上吉祥的春联,表达对新年的期待。
example.py: Chūnjié qījiān, rénmen xǐhuan tiē shàng jíxiáng de chūnlián, biǎodá duì xīnnián de qīdài.
example.en: During the Spring Festival, people like to put up auspicious couplets to express their hopes for the new year.

example.zh: 这家工厂正在更新机械,以减少能耗并提高生产效率。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng zhèngzài gēngxīn jīxiè, yǐ jiǎnshǎo nénghào bìng tígāo shēngchǎn xiàolǜ.
example.en: This factory is updating its machinery in order to reduce energy consumption and improve production efficiency.

example.zh: 这位木匠的技艺十分精湛,细节处理得几乎无可挑剔。
example.py: Zhè wèi mùjiang de jìyì shífēn jīngzhàn, xìjié chǔlǐ de jīhū wú kě tiāotī.
example.en: This carpenter's craftsmanship is highly refined, and the details are almost beyond criticism.

example.zh: 科学家发现,这种疾病与某些基因变化有关。
example.py: Kēxuéjiā fāxiàn, zhè zhǒng jíbìng yǔ mǒu xiē jīyīn biànhuà yǒuguān.
example.en: Scientists found that this disease is related to changes in certain genes.

example.zh: 经济转型给小城市带来了新的发展机遇。
example.py: Jīngjì zhuǎnxíng gěi xiǎo chéngshì dàilái le xīn de fāzhǎn jīyù.
example.en: Economic transformation has brought new development opportunities to small cities.

example.zh: 学校应当给予贫困学生更多支持,而不是只强调成绩排名。
example.py: Xuéxiào yīngdāng jǐyǔ pínkùn xuéshēng gèng duō zhīchí, ér bú shì zhǐ qiángdiào chéngjì páimíng.
example.en: Schools should give disadvantaged students more support, rather than emphasising only grade rankings.

example.zh: 公司建立了投诉处理机制,要求三天内给出答复。
example.py: Gōngsī jiànlì le tóusù chǔlǐ jīzhì, yāoqiú sān tiān nèi gěi chū dáfù.
example.en: The company established a complaint-handling mechanism requiring a response within three days.

example.zh: 这局棋下到最后,他才发现自己已经没有退路了。
example.py: Zhè jú qí xià dào zuìhòu, tā cái fāxiàn zìjǐ yǐjīng méiyǒu tuìlù le.
example.en: Only at the end of this game of chess did he realise that he already had no way out.

example.zh: 这局棋下到最后,他才发现自己已经没有退路了。
example.py: Zhè jú qí xià dào zuìhòu, tā cái fāxiàn zìjǐ yǐjīng méiyǒu tuìlù le.
example.en: Only at the end of this game of chess did he realise that he already had no way out.

meaning: to roll, to curl; roll; measure word for rolls

example.zh: 她把海报卷起来,放进纸筒里带走。
example.py: Tā bǎ hǎibào juǎn qǐlái, fàng jìn zhǐtǒng lǐ dài zǒu.
example.en: She rolled up the poster and put it into a paper tube to take away.

example.zh: 这套小说一共有三卷,内容围绕同一个家族展开。
example.py: Zhè tào xiǎoshuō yí gòng yǒu sān juàn, nèiróng wéirào tóng yí gè jiāzú zhǎnkāi.
example.en: This set of novels has three volumes in total, with the content centred on the same family.

example.zh: 公司决定向受灾地区捐款,帮助居民重建家园。
example.py: Gōngsī juédìng xiàng shòuzāi dìqū juānkuǎn, bāngzhù jūmín chóngjiàn jiāyuán.
example.en: The company decided to donate money to the disaster-hit area to help residents rebuild their homes.

example.zh: 医院接受了企业捐赠的检测设备,提高了诊断效率。
example.py: Yīyuàn jiēshòu le qǐyè juānzèng de jiǎncè shèbèi, tígāo le zhěnduàn xiàolǜ.
example.en: The hospital accepted testing equipment donated by a company, improving diagnostic efficiency.

example.zh: 这个剧本虽然情节简单,却把人物关系写得很细腻。
example.py: Zhège jùběn suīrán qíngjié jiǎndān, què bǎ rénwù guānxì xiě de hěn xìnì.
example.en: Although this script has a simple plot, it portrays the relationships between the characters very delicately.

example.zh: 他突然辞职的举动让整个团队都感到意外。
example.py: Tā tūrán cízhí de jǔdòng ràng zhěnggè tuánduì dōu gǎndào yìwài.
example.en: His sudden move to resign made the whole team feel surprised.

example.zh: 重大项目启动前,管理层必须进行充分的决策讨论。
example.py: Zhòngdà xiàngmù qǐdòng qián, guǎnlǐcéng bìxū jìnxíng chōngfèn de juécè tǎolùn.
example.en: Before a major project starts, management must hold thorough decision-making discussions.

example.zh: 多次求助无果后,他一度感到绝望。
example.py: Duō cì qiúzhù wú guǒ hòu, tā yí dù gǎndào juéwàng.
example.en: After seeking help many times without success, he once felt despair.

example.zh: 秋天一到,公园里的菊花便开得格外热闹。
example.py: Qiūtiān yí dào, gōngyuán lǐ de júhuā biàn kāi de géwài rènào.
example.en: As soon as autumn arrives, the chrysanthemums in the park bloom especially vividly.

example.zh: 暴雨过后,许多居民聚集在临时安置点等待通知。
example.py: Bàoyǔ guòhòu, xǔduō jūmín jùjí zài línshí ānzhìdiǎn děngdài tōngzhī.
example.en: After the heavy rain, many residents gathered at the temporary resettlement site to wait for notices.

example.zh: 他加入了学校的辩论俱乐部,表达能力提高了很多。
example.py: Tā jiārù le xuéxiào de biànlùn jùlèbù, biǎodá nénglì tígāo le hěn duō.
example.en: He joined the school debating club, and his ability to express himself improved a lot.

example.zh: 地震发生时,整栋楼都在剧烈摇晃。
example.py: Dìzhèn fāshēng shí, zhěng dòng lóu dōu zài jùliè yáohuàng.
example.en: When the earthquake occurred, the whole building was shaking violently.

example.zh: 谈判进入关键阶段,双方都不愿意让局面失控。
example.py: Tánpàn jìnrù guānjiàn jiēduàn, shuāngfāng dōu bú yuànyì ràng júmiàn shīkòng.
example.en: The negotiations have entered a critical stage, and neither side wants the situation to get out of control.

example.zh: 军队迅速展开救援,确保道路恢复通行。
example.py: Jūnduì xùnsù zhǎnkāi jiùyuán, quèbǎo dàolù huīfù tōngxíng.
example.en: The army quickly launched a rescue operation to ensure the roads were reopened.

example.zh: 许多军人在退役后继续从事公益服务。
example.py: Xǔduō jūnrén zài tuìyì hòu jìxù cóngshì gōngyì fúwù.
example.en: Many soldiers continue to take part in public service after leaving the military.

example.zh: 搅拌时要让调料分布均匀,味道才不会忽淡忽重。
example.py: Jiǎobàn shí yào ràng tiáoliào fēnbù jūnyún, wèidào cái bú huì hū dàn hū zhòng.
example.en: When stirring, make sure the seasoning is evenly distributed so the flavour is not sometimes weak and sometimes strong.

example.zh: 这项研究局限于小样本数据,还需要进一步验证。
example.py: Zhè xiàng yánjiū júxiàn yú xiǎo yàngběn shùjù, hái xūyào jìnyíbù yànzhèng.
example.en: This study is limited to small-sample data and still needs further verification.

example.zh: 这项改革开创了社区治理的新模式。
example.py: Zhè xiàng gǎigé kāichuàng le shèqū zhìlǐ de xīn móshì.
example.en: This reform created a new model for community governance.

example.zh: 出门前请检查电源开关,避免设备长时间运行。
example.py: Chūmén qián qǐng jiǎnchá diànyuán kāiguān, bìmiǎn shèbèi cháng shíjiān yùnxíng.
example.en: Before going out, please check the power switch to avoid leaving the equipment running for a long time.

example.zh: 输入密码后,系统会自动开启安全验证。
example.py: Shūrù mìmǎ hòu, xìtǒng huì zìdòng kāiqǐ ānquán yànzhèng.
example.en: After the password is entered, the system will automatically start security verification.

meaning: to open a business or course

example.zh: 学校计划下学期开设人工智能基础课程。
example.py: Xuéxiào jìhuà xià xuéqī kāishè réngōng zhìnéng jīchǔ kèchéng.
example.en: The school plans to offer a basic artificial intelligence course next term.

example.zh: 演讲开头要抓住听众注意力,否则后面很难展开。
example.py: Yǎnjiǎng kāitóu yào zhuā zhù tīngzhòng zhùyìlì, fǒuzé hòumiàn hěn nán zhǎnkāi.
example.en: The beginning of a speech should catch the audience’s attention, otherwise it is hard to develop the rest.

example.zh: 工人先把枯枝砍掉,避免大风时砸到路人。
example.py: Gōngrén xiān bǎ kūzhī kǎn diào, bìmiǎn dàfēng shí zá dào lùrén.
example.en: The workers first cut off the dead branches to prevent them hitting passers-by in strong winds.

example.zh: 不要因为别人学历低就看不起他们,能力需要时间证明。
example.py: Bú yào yīnwèi biérén xuélì dī jiù kànbuqǐ tāmen, nénglì xūyào shíjiān zhèngmíng.
example.en: Do not look down on people just because their level of education is low; ability needs time to be proven.

example.zh: 我们应该理性看待技术进步带来的风险和机会。
example.py: Wǒmen yīnggāi lǐxìng kàndài jìshù jìnbù dài lái de fēngxiǎn hé jīhuì.
example.en: We should view the risks and opportunities brought by technological progress rationally.

example.zh: 老师看得起这个学生,不只是因为成绩好,更因为他肯努力。
example.py: Lǎoshī kàndeqǐ zhège xuésheng, bù zhǐ shì yīnwèi chéngjì hǎo, gèng yīnwèi tā kěn nǔlì.
example.en: The teacher thinks highly of this student not only because of his good grades, but also because he is willing to work hard.

example.zh: 手术后,他需要几个月的时间才能完全康复。
example.py: Shǒushù hòu, tā xūyào jǐ ge yuè de shíjiān cái néng wánquán kāngfù.
example.en: After the operation, he will need several months before he can fully recover.

meaning: to be optimistic about, to fancy

example.zh: 分析师看好新能源行业未来几年的发展。
example.py: Fēnxīshī kànhǎo xīn néngyuán hángyè wèilái jǐ nián de fāzhǎn.
example.en: Analysts are optimistic about the development of the new energy industry over the next few years.

example.zh: 这个办法看似简单,实际执行起来却需要很多协调。
example.py: Zhège bànfǎ kànsì jiǎndān, shíjì zhíxíng qǐlái què xūyào hěn duō xiétiáo.
example.en: This method seems simple, but actually carrying it out requires a lot of coordination.

example.zh: 公司看中了他的国际经验,决定让他负责新市场。
example.py: Gōngsī kànzhòng le tā de guójì jīngyàn, juédìng ràng tā fùzé xīn shìchǎng.
example.en: The company took a liking to his international experience and decided to let him handle the new market.

meaning: to value, to regard as important

example.zh: 我们更看重候选人的责任感,而不是学历本身。
example.py: Wǒmen gèng kànzhòng hòuxuǎnrén de zérèngǎn, ér bú shì xuélì běnshēn.
example.en: We value a candidate's sense of responsibility more than the qualification itself.

example.zh: 代表团将前往沿海城市,考察当地的港口建设。
example.py: Dàibiǎotuán jiāng qiánwǎng yánhǎi chéngshì, kǎochá dāngdì de gǎngkǒu jiànshè.
example.en: The delegation will go to coastal cities to inspect the local port construction.

example.zh: 这支考古队在沙漠边缘发现了古代城市遗址。
example.py: Zhè zhī kǎogǔ duì zài shāmò biānyuán fāxiàn le gǔdài chéngshì yízhǐ.
example.en: This archaeological team discovered the ruins of an ancient city on the edge of the desert.

example.zh: 年底考核不仅看业绩,也会看团队合作能力。
example.py: Niándǐ kǎohé bùjǐn kàn yèjì, yě huì kàn tuánduì hézuò nénglì.
example.en: The year-end assessment looks not only at performance, but also at teamwork ability.

meaning: to test, to put to the test

example.zh: 连续加班对他的体力和意志都是一种考验。
example.py: Liánxù jiābān duì tā de tǐlì hé yìzhì dōu shì yì zhǒng kǎoyàn.
example.en: Working overtime continuously is a test of both his physical strength and his willpower.

example.zh: 请把重要信息写在卡片上,方便复习时快速查看。
example.py: Qǐng bǎ zhòngyào xìnxī xiě zài kǎpiàn shàng, fāngbiàn fùxí shí kuàisù chákàn.
example.en: Please write the important information on the card so it is easy to check quickly when reviewing.

example.zh: 他高中时选择了理科,后来进入工程学院。
example.py: Tā gāozhōng shí xuǎnzé le lǐkē, hòulái jìnrù gōngchéng xuéyuàn.
example.en: In high school he chose the science track and later entered an engineering college.

example.zh: 由于高速公路封闭,长途客车只能绕道行驶。
example.py: Yóuyú gāosù gōnglù fēngbì, chángtú kèchē zhǐ néng ràodào xíngshǐ.
example.en: Because the motorway was closed, the long-distance bus had to take a detour.

example.zh: 这部科幻小说描写了人类移民火星后的社会冲突。
example.py: Zhè bù kēhuàn xiǎoshuō miáoxiě le rénlèi yímín Huǒxīng hòu de shèhuì chōngtū.
example.en: This science fiction novel describes social conflicts after humans migrate to Mars.

example.zh: 这道汤虽然做法家常,味道却十分可口。
example.py: Zhè dào tāng suīrán zuòfǎ jiācháng, wèidào què shífēn kěkǒu.
example.en: Although this soup is made in a home-style way, it tastes very delicious.

example.zh: 那只流浪狗又瘦又脏,看起来很可怜。
example.py: Nà zhī liúlànggǒu yòu shòu yòu zāng, kàn qǐlái hěn kělián.
example.en: That stray dog is thin and dirty, and it looks very pitiful.

example.zh: 这学期他选了三门科目,其中最难的是统计学。
example.py: Zhè xuéqī tā xuǎn le sān mén kēmù, qízhōng zuì nán de shì tǒngjìxué.
example.en: This term he chose three subjects, the hardest of which is statistics.

example.zh: 只要你肯认真练习,发音一定会慢慢改善。
example.py: Zhǐyào nǐ kěn rènzhēn liànxí, fāyīn yídìng huì mànmàn gǎishàn.
example.en: As long as you are willing to practise seriously, your pronunciation will certainly improve gradually.

example.zh: 这位医生经常在网上科普急救知识,语言简单却很准确。
example.py: Zhè wèi yīshēng jīngcháng zài wǎngshàng kēpǔ jíjiù zhīshi, yǔyán jiǎndān què hěn zhǔnquè.
example.en: This doctor often popularizes first-aid knowledge online, using simple yet accurate language.

example.zh: 他的博士课题主要研究城市交通与空气质量的关系。
example.py: Tā de bóshì kètí zhǔyào yánjiū chéngshì jiāotōng yǔ kōngqì zhìliàng de guānxì.
example.en: His doctoral research topic mainly studies the relationship between urban transport and air quality.

meaning: to long for, to thirst for

example.zh: 许多年轻人渴望在大城市找到发展的机会。
example.py: Xǔduō niánqīngrén kěwàng zài dà chéngshì zhǎodào fāzhǎn de jīhuì.
example.en: Many young people long to find opportunities for development in big cities.

example.zh: 这个方案听起来大胆,但从技术上看是可行的。
example.py: Zhège fāng'àn tīng qǐlái dàdǎn, dàn cóng jìshù shàng kàn shì kěxíng de.
example.en: This plan sounds bold, but from a technical point of view it is feasible.

example.zh: 市中心很难找到大块空地,新的停车场只能建在郊外。
example.py: Shì zhōngxīn hěn nán zhǎodào dà kuài kòngdì, xīn de tíngchēchǎng zhǐ néng jiàn zài jiāowài.
example.en: It is hard to find large open spaces in the city centre, so the new car park can only be built in the suburbs.

example.zh: 面对未知的疾病,人们最初往往会感到恐惧。
example.py: Miànduì wèizhī de jíbìng, rénmen zuìchū wǎngwǎng huì gǎndào kǒngjù.
example.en: Facing an unknown disease, people often feel fear at first.

example.zh: 他工作很忙,只有晚上十点以后才有一点空闲。
example.py: Tā gōngzuò hěn máng, zhǐyǒu wǎnshang shí diǎn yǐhòu cái yǒu yìdiǎn kòngxián.
example.en: He is very busy with work and only has a little free time after ten at night.

example.zh: 迟到超过十分钟,公司会从奖金里扣一部分钱。
example.py: Chídào chāoguò shí fēnzhōng, gōngsī huì cóng jiǎngjīn lǐ kòu yí bùfen qián.
example.en: If someone is more than ten minutes late, the company deducts part of the bonus.

example.zh: 这款面包的口感松软,但甜度对我来说有点高。
example.py: Zhè kuǎn miànbāo de kǒugǎn sōngruǎn, dàn tiándù duì wǒ lái shuō yǒudiǎn gāo.
example.en: This bread has a soft texture, but the sweetness is a little high for me.

example.zh: 这个口号听起来响亮,但如果没有行动就毫无意义。
example.py: Zhège kǒuhào tīng qǐlái xiǎngliàng, dàn rúguǒ méiyǒu xíngdòng jiù háo wú yìyì.
example.en: This slogan sounds powerful, but it is meaningless without action.

example.zh: 口腔健康不仅影响牙齿,也会影响整体生活质量。
example.py: Kǒuqiāng jiànkāng bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng yáchǐ, yě huì yǐngxiǎng zhěngtǐ shēnghuó zhìliàng.
example.en: Oral health affects not only the teeth, but also overall quality of life.

example.zh: 双方只是达成了口头协议,还没有签正式合同。
example.py: Shuāngfāng zhǐshì dáchéng le kǒutóu xiéyì, hái méiyǒu qiān zhèngshì héyuē.
example.en: The two sides have only reached a verbal agreement and have not yet signed a formal contract.

example.zh: 这款电动车外形很酷,但续航能力才是我最关心的。
example.py: Zhè kuǎn diàndòngchē wàixíng hěn kù, dàn xùháng nénglì cái shì wǒ zuì guānxīn de.
example.en: This electric car looks cool, but its range is what I care about most.

example.zh: 别只夸孩子聪明,也要肯定他努力的过程。
example.py: Bié zhǐ kuā háizi cōngmíng, yě yào kěndìng tā nǔlì de guòchéng.
example.en: Do not only praise a child for being clever; also acknowledge the effort he puts in.

example.zh: 会计仔细核对每一笔款项,避免月底结账出错。
example.py: Kuàijì zǐxì héduì měi yì bǐ kuǎnxiàng, bìmiǎn yuèdǐ jiézhàng chūcuò.
example.en: The accountant carefully checks every payment to avoid errors when closing the accounts at the end of the month.

example.zh: 这套系统让员工能够快捷地查找客户资料。
example.py: Zhè tào xìtǒng ràng yuángōng nénggòu kuàijié de cházhǎo kèhù zīliào.
example.en: This system allows employees to find customer records quickly.

example.zh: 经理公开夸奖他的细心,让团队更重视工作流程。
example.py: Jīnglǐ gōngkāi kuājiǎng tā de xìxīn, ràng tuánduì gèng zhòngshì gōngzuò liúchéng.
example.en: The manager publicly praised his carefulness, making the team pay more attention to work processes.

meaning: sum of money; measure word for items

example.zh: 这笔款已经到账,可以安排下一步采购。
example.py: Zhè bǐ kuǎn yǐjīng dào zhàng, kěyǐ ānpái xià yí bù cǎigòu.
example.en: This sum of money has already arrived in the account, so the next stage of purchasing can be arranged.

example.zh: 这件外套款式简单,适合正式和休闲场合。
example.py: Zhè jiàn wàitào kuǎnshì jiǎndān, shìhé zhèngshì hé xiūxián chǎnghé.
example.en: This coat has a simple design and is suitable for both formal and casual occasions.

example.zh: 他的表达有些夸张,但问题本身确实值得重视。
example.py: Tā de biǎodá yǒuxiē kuāzhāng, dàn wèntí běnshēn quèshí zhíde zhòngshì.
example.en: His way of putting it is a little exaggerated, but the problem itself really deserves attention.

example.zh: 由于原材料价格上涨,工厂连续两个季度亏损。
example.py: Yóuyú yuáncáiliào jiàgé shàngzhǎng, gōngchǎng liánxù liǎng ge jìdù kuīsǔn.
example.en: Because raw material prices rose, the factory lost money for two consecutive quarters.

example.zh: 交通噪音长期困扰附近居民,投诉数量不断增加。
example.py: Jiāotōng zàoyīn chángqī kùnrǎo fùjìn jūmín, tóusù shùliàng búduàn zēngjiā.
example.en: Traffic noise has long troubled nearby residents, and the number of complaints keeps rising.

example.zh: 公司计划把业务扩展到东南亚市场。
example.py: Gōngsī jìhuà bǎ yèwù kuòzhǎn dào Dōngnányà shìchǎng.
example.en: The company plans to expand its business into the Southeast Asian market.

example.zh: 纯理论内容如果没有案例,会显得十分枯燥。
example.py: Chún lǐlùn nèiróng rúguǒ méiyǒu ànlì, huì xiǎnde shífēn kūzào.
example.en: Purely theoretical content can seem very dry if there are no examples.

example.zh: 别担心啦,这个问题我们已经找到解决办法了。
example.py: Bié dānxīn la, zhège wèntí wǒmen yǐjīng zhǎodào jiějué bànfǎ le.
example.en: Do not worry; we have already found a solution to this problem.

meaning: to leave behind, to lag behind

example.zh: 他出门太急,把钥匙落在办公室了。
example.py: Tā chūmén tài jí, bǎ yàoshi là zài bàngōngshì le.
example.en: He left his keys in the office because he went out in too much of a hurry.

meaning: bad; to rely on, to depend on

example.zh: 他总是赖在沙发上不肯起身,难怪身体越来越差。
example.py: Tā zǒng shì lài zài shāfā shang bù kěn qǐshēn, nánguài shēntǐ yuè lái yuè chà.
example.en: He is always lounging on the sofa and unwilling to get up; no wonder his health is getting worse.

example.zh: 随着雨季来临,山区道路的安全风险明显增加。
example.py: Suízhe yǔjì láilín, shānqū dàolù de ānquán fēngxiǎn míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
example.en: As the rainy season arrives, the safety risks on mountain roads clearly increase.

example.zh: 这条路上货车来往频繁,行人过马路要特别小心。
example.py: Zhè tiáo lù shang huòchē láiwǎng pínfán, xíngrén guò mǎlù yào tèbié xiǎoxīn.
example.en: Trucks come and go frequently on this road, so pedestrians need to be especially careful when crossing.

example.zh: 这道菜放了太多辣椒,味道刺激但很下饭。
example.py: Zhè dào cài fàng le tài duō làjiāo, wèidào cìjī dàn hěn xiàfàn.
example.en: This dish has too many chilli peppers; the flavour is intense but goes very well with rice.

example.zh: 保安把车辆拦在入口外,先核对预约信息。
example.py: Bǎo'ān bǎ chēliàng lán zài rùkǒu wài, xiān héduì yùyuē xìnxī.
example.en: The security guard stopped the vehicles outside the entrance and first checked the booking information.

example.zh: 楼梯旁的栏有些松动,物业已经安排维修。
example.py: Lóutī páng de lán yǒuxiē sōngdòng, wùyè yǐjīng ānpái wéixiū.
example.en: The railing beside the stairs is a little loose, and the property management has arranged repairs.

example.zh: 这只苹果已经烂了,最好不要再吃。
example.py: Zhè zhī píngguǒ yǐjīng làn le, zuìhǎo bú yào zài chī.
example.en: This apple has already gone rotten, so it is best not to eat it.

example.zh: 夜里远处传来狼的叫声,牧民立刻检查羊圈。
example.py: Yèlǐ yuǎnchù chuán lái láng de jiàoshēng, mùmín lìkè jiǎnchá yángjuàn.
example.en: At night, the howl of a wolf came from the distance, and the herder immediately checked the sheep pen.

example.zh: 老师建议学生每天朗读一段新闻,以提高语感和表达能力。
example.py: Lǎoshī jiànyì xuéshēng měi tiān lǎngdú yí duàn xīnwén, yǐ tígāo yǔgǎn hé biǎodá nénglì.
example.en: The teacher suggested that students read a piece of news aloud every day to improve their language sense and ability to express themselves.

example.zh: 办公室角落摆着一盆兰花,给严肃的环境增添了生气。
example.py: Bàngōngshì jiǎoluò bǎizhe yì pén lánhuā, gěi yánsù de huánjìng zēngtiān le shēngqì.
example.en: There is a pot of orchids in the corner of the office, adding some life to the serious environment.

example.zh: 那个罪犯被关进牢里以后,才开始反思自己的行为。
example.py: Nà ge zuìfàn bèi guān jìn láo li yǐhòu, cái kāishǐ fǎnsī zìjǐ de xíngwéi.
example.en: Only after the criminal was put in prison did he begin to reflect on his actions.

example.zh: 随着年轻人外出工作,农村劳动力明显减少。
example.py: Suízhe niánqīngrén wàichū gōngzuò, nóngcūn láodònglì míngxiǎn jiǎnshǎo.
example.en: As young people leave to work elsewhere, the rural labour force has clearly decreased.

example.zh: 他为人老实,不会为了利益故意隐瞒事实。
example.py: Tā wéirén lǎoshi, bú huì wèile lìyì gùyì yǐnmán shìshí.
example.en: He is honest by nature and would not deliberately hide the facts for personal gain.

example.zh: 仓库里发现了老鼠,管理人员马上安排了清理和消毒。
example.py: Cāngkù li fāxiàn le lǎoshǔ, guǎnlǐ rényuán mǎshàng ānpái le qīnglǐ hé xiāodú.
example.en: A mouse was found in the warehouse, so the managers immediately arranged cleaning and disinfection.

example.zh: 那位老太太每天清晨都会到公园里散步。
example.py: Nà wèi lǎotàitai měi tiān qīngchén dōu huì dào gōngyuán li sànbù.
example.en: That old lady goes to the park for a walk every morning.

example.zh: 半夜一声雷把孩子吓醒了,窗外很快下起大雨。
example.py: Bànyè yì shēng léi bǎ háizi xià xǐng le, chuāngwài hěn kuài xià qǐ dàyǔ.
example.en: A clap of thunder woke the child in the middle of the night, and soon it began raining heavily outside.

example.zh: 这些文件要按照类别整理,否则以后很难查找。
example.py: Zhèxiē wénjiàn yào ànzhào lèibié zhěnglǐ, fǒuzé yǐhòu hěn nán cházhǎo.
example.en: These documents need to be organised by category, otherwise they will be difficult to find later.

meaning: to be happy to, to be willing to

example.zh: 他乐于分享经验,所以新员工遇到问题都愿意请教他。
example.py: Tā lèyú fēnxiǎng jīngyàn, suǒyǐ xīn yuángōng yùdào wèntí dōu yuànyì qǐngjiào tā.
example.en: He is happy to share his experience, so new employees are willing to ask him for advice when they run into problems.

example.zh: 他说得很有理,大家听完以后都改变了看法。
example.py: Tā shuō de hěn yǒu lǐ, dàjiā tīng wán yǐhòu dōu gǎibiàn le kànfǎ.
example.en: What he said made a lot of sense, and everyone changed their view after listening.

example.zh: 大厅中央立着一块纪念碑,记录了这座城市的历史。
example.py: Dàtīng zhōngyāng lì zhe yí kuài jìniànbēi, jìlù le zhè zuò chéngshì de lìshǐ.
example.en: A monument stands in the centre of the hall, recording the history of the city.

meaning: grain; measure word for small particles

example.zh: 她把每一粒种子都埋进土里,希望春天能发芽。
example.py: Tā bǎ měi yì lì zhǒngzi dōu mái jìn tǔ li, xīwàng chūntiān néng fāyá.
example.en: She buried every seed in the soil, hoping they would sprout in spring.

example.zh: 雨停后,她把湿衣服拿到阳台上晾。
example.py: Yǔ tíng hòu, tā bǎ shī yīfu ná dào yángtái shang liàng.
example.en: After the rain stopped, she took the wet clothes to the balcony to air-dry.

example.zh: 这座大桥连接了两岸的工业区和居民区。
example.py: Zhè zuò dàqiáo liánjiē le liǎng'àn de gōngyèqū hé jūmínqū.
example.en: This bridge connects the industrial and residential areas on both sides.

example.zh: 他的评价呈现两极分化:有人很喜欢,也有人强烈反对。
example.py: Tā de píngjià chéngxiàn liǎngjí fēnhuà: yǒu rén hěn xǐhuan, yě yǒu rén qiángliè fǎnduì.
example.en: Opinions about him show polarisation: some people like him very much, while others strongly oppose him.

example.zh: 联合国呼吁各国加强合作,共同应对气候变化。
example.py: Liánhéguó hūyù gè guó jiāqiáng hézuò, gòngtóng yìngduì qìhòu biànhuà.
example.en: The United Nations called on all countries to strengthen cooperation and respond jointly to climate change.

example.zh: 请把会议资料的链接发到工作群里。
example.py: Qǐng bǎ huìyì zīliào de liànjiē fā dào gōngzuò qún lǐ.
example.en: Please send the link to the meeting materials to the work group chat.

meaning: to network, to connect to the internet

example.zh: 新设备必须先联网,才能完成系统更新。
example.py: Xīn shèbèi bìxū xiān liánwǎng, cái néng wánchéng xìtǒng gēngxīn.
example.en: The new device must connect to the internet first before it can complete the system update.

example.zh: 一听到这首歌,我就联想到高中毕业那天的情景。
example.py: Yì tīng dào zhè shǒu gē, wǒ jiù liánxiǎng dào gāozhōng bìyè nà tiān de qíngjǐng.
example.en: As soon as I hear this song, I associate it with the scene on the day of my high school graduation.

example.zh: 这件外套的料很厚,适合冬天穿。
example.py: Zhè jiàn wàitào de liào hěn hòu, shìhé dōngtiān chuān.
example.en: The material of this coat is thick, so it is suitable for winter.

example.zh: 这件外套的料很厚,适合冬天穿。
example.py: Zhè jiàn wàitào de liào hěn hòu, shìhé dōngtiān chuān.
example.en: The material of this coat is thick, so it is suitable for winter.

example.zh: 他开始理财以后,才意识到记录每一笔支出有多重要。
example.py: Tā kāishǐ lǐcái yǐhòu, cái yìshí dào jìlù měi yì bǐ zhīchū yǒu duō zhòngyào.
example.en: After he started managing his money, he realised how important it is to record every expense.

example.zh: 在这个问题上,他的立场一直很明确,没有轻易改变。
example.py: Zài zhège wèntí shang, tā de lìchǎng yìzhí hěn míngquè, méiyǒu qīngyì gǎibiàn.
example.en: On this issue, his position has always been clear and has not changed easily.

example.zh: 政府加大了监管力度,以减少类似事故再次发生。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ jiādà le jiānguǎn lìdù, yǐ jiǎnshǎo lèisì shìgù zàicì fāshēng.
example.en: The government increased the intensity of supervision in order to reduce the recurrence of similar accidents.

example.zh: 这家企业历经多次危机,仍然坚持自主研发。
example.py: Zhè jiā qǐyè lìjīng duō cì wēijī, réngrán jiānchí zìzhǔ yánfā.
example.en: This company has gone through many crises and still insists on independent research and development.

example.zh: 他高中时选择理科,因为对物理和化学特别感兴趣。
example.py: Tā gāozhōng shí xuǎnzé lǐkē, yīnwèi duì wùlǐ hé huàxué tèbié gǎn xìngqù.
example.en: He chose the sciences in high school because he was especially interested in physics and chemistry.

example.zh: 他忘了带伞,被突如其来的大雨淋得浑身湿透。
example.py: Tā wàng le dài sǎn, bèi tūrúqílái de dàyǔ lín de húnshēn shītòu.
example.en: He forgot to bring an umbrella and was soaked through by the sudden heavy rain.

example.zh: 凌晨三点,救援队仍在山里搜索失踪人员。
example.py: Língchén sān diǎn, jiùyuán duì réng zài shān lǐ sōusuǒ shīzōng rényuán.
example.en: At three in the early morning, the rescue team was still searching the mountains for the missing person.

example.zh: 学校把历年考试题整理成册,供学生复习参考。
example.py: Xuéxiào bǎ lìnián kǎoshì tí zhěnglǐ chéng cè, gōng xuéshēng fùxí cānkǎo.
example.en: The school organised past years’ exam questions into a booklet for students to use when revising.

example.zh: 公司的管理理念发生变化后,员工的参与度明显提高。
example.py: Gōngsī de guǎnlǐ lǐniàn fāshēng biànhuà hòu, yuángōng de cānyùdù míngxiǎn tígāo.
example.en: After the company’s management philosophy changed, employee participation clearly increased.

example.zh: 为了减少错误,公司重新设计了报销流程。
example.py: Wèile jiǎnshǎo cuòwù, gōngsī chóngxīn shèjì le bàoxiāo liúchéng.
example.en: In order to reduce errors, the company redesigned the reimbursement process.

example.zh: 节假日期间,城市人口流动明显增加。
example.py: Jiéjiàrì qījiān, chéngshì rénkǒu liúdòng míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
example.en: During public holidays, population movement in the city increases noticeably.

example.zh: 如果网页打不开,先换一个浏览器试试。
example.py: Rúguǒ wǎngyè dǎ bù kāi, xiān huàn yí ge liúlǎnqì shìshi.
example.en: If the webpage will not open, try changing to another browser first.

example.zh: 这个网站的流量突然上升,系统一度无法承受。
example.py: Zhège wǎngzhàn de liúliàng tūrán shàngshēng, xìtǒng yídù wúfǎ chéngshòu.
example.en: Traffic to this website suddenly increased, and the system could not handle it for a while.

example.zh: 大量资金流入新能源行业,推动了技术创新。
example.py: Dàliàng zījīn liúrù xīn néngyuán hángyè, tuīdòng le jìshù chuàngxīn.
example.en: Large amounts of capital flowed into the new energy industry, driving technological innovation.

example.zh: 货币只有在市场中流通,才能发挥作用。
example.py: Huòbì zhǐyǒu zài shìchǎng zhōng liútōng, cái néng fāhuī zuòyòng.
example.en: Currency can only play its role when it circulates in the market.

example.zh: 公司的报销规定很严格,任何人都不能例外。
example.py: Gōngsī de bàoxiāo guīdìng hěn yángé, rènhé rén dōu bù néng lìwài.
example.en: The company’s reimbursement rules are strict, and no one can be an exception.

example.zh: 这笔贷款的利息不高,但还款期限比较短。
example.py: Zhè bǐ dàikuǎn de lìxī bù gāo, dàn huánkuǎn qīxiàn bǐjiào duǎn.
example.en: The interest on this loan is not high, but the repayment period is relatively short.

example.zh: 面对激烈的争论,我们需要保持理性,而不是互相攻击。
example.py: Miànduì jīliè de zhēnglùn, wǒmen xūyào bǎochí lǐxìng, ér bú shì hùxiāng gōngjī.
example.en: Faced with intense debate, we need to remain rational rather than attack one another.

example.zh: 他一紧张就容易露出真实想法。
example.py: Tā yì jǐnzhāng jiù róngyì lòu chū zhēnshí xiǎngfǎ.
example.en: As soon as he gets nervous, he easily reveals his true thoughts.

example.zh: 请不要把自行车停在楼道里,以免影响逃生。
example.py: Qǐng bú yào bǎ zìxíngchē tíng zài lóudào lǐ, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng táoshēng.
example.en: Please do not park bicycles in the corridor, so as not to affect escape routes.

example.zh: 合同里有一个明显的漏洞,可能会引起纠纷。
example.py: Hétong lǐ yǒu yí ge míngxiǎn de lòudòng, kěnéng huì yǐnqǐ jiūfēn.
example.en: There is an obvious loophole in the contract, which may cause a dispute.

example.zh: 今年的就业率比去年有所提高。
example.py: Jīnnián de jiùyèlǜ bǐ qùnián yǒu suǒ tígāo.
example.en: This year’s employment rate has increased somewhat compared with last year.

example.zh: 云散开后,远处的山峰慢慢露出轮廓。
example.py: Yún sàn kāi hòu, yuǎnchù de shānfēng mànmàn lù chū lúnkuò.
example.en: After the clouds dispersed, the distant mountain peaks slowly revealed their outline.

example.zh: 这次旅程让他重新思考了生活的意义。
example.py: Zhè cì lǚchéng ràng tā chóngxīn sīkǎo le shēnghuó de yìyì.
example.en: This journey made him rethink the meaning of life.

example.zh: 从车站到景区的路程大约需要两个小时。
example.py: Cóng chēzhàn dào jǐngqū de lùchéng dàyuē xūyào liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
example.en: The journey from the station to the scenic area takes about two hours.

example.zh: 城市绿化改善了居民的生活环境。
example.py: Chéngshì lǜhuà gǎishàn le jūmín de shēnghuó huánjìng.
example.en: Urban greening has improved residents’ living environment.

example.zh: 出发前最好查看一下高速公路的路况。
example.py: Chūfā qián zuìhǎo chákàn yíxià gāosù gōnglù de lùkuàng.
example.en: Before setting off, it is best to check the motorway conditions.

example.zh: 雨后路面很滑,骑车时一定要放慢速度。
example.py: Yǔ hòu lùmiàn hěn huá, qí chē shí yídìng yào fàngmàn sùdù.
example.en: After rain, the road surface is very slippery, so you must slow down when cycling.

meaning: wheel; to take turns; measure word for rounds

example.zh: 比赛进入最后一轮,双方都很紧张。
example.py: Bǐsài jìnrù zuìhòu yì lún, shuāngfāng dōu hěn jǐnzhāng.
example.en: The competition entered its final round, and both sides were very nervous.

example.zh: 这艘轮船将沿海航行三天。
example.py: Zhè sōu lúnchuán jiāng yánhǎi hángxíng sān tiān.
example.en: This ship will sail along the coast for three days.

example.zh: 小组成员轮流汇报研究进度。
example.py: Xiǎozǔ chéngyuán lúnliú huìbào yánjiū jìndù.
example.en: Group members take turns reporting on the research progress.

example.zh: 这个论坛聚集了许多年轻的创业者。
example.py: Zhège lùntán jùjí le xǔduō niánqīng de chuàngyèzhě.
example.en: This forum has brought together many young entrepreneurs.

example.zh: 医院入口专门设置了轮椅通道。
example.py: Yīyuàn rùkǒu zhuānmén shèzhì le lúnyǐ tōngdào.
example.en: The hospital entrance has a special wheelchair passage.

example.zh: 行李箱的轮子坏了,拖起来很费劲。
example.py: Xínglixiāng de lúnzi huài le, tuō qǐlái hěn fèijìn.
example.en: The wheels of the suitcase are broken, so it is hard to pull.

example.zh: 飞机因天气原因比原计划晚了半小时落地。
example.py: Fēijī yīn tiānqì yuányīn bǐ yuán jìhuà wǎn le bàn xiǎoshí luòdì.
example.en: Because of the weather, the plane landed half an hour later than originally planned.

example.zh: 如果企业不持续创新,就很容易在竞争中落后。
example.py: Rúguǒ qǐyè bù chíxù chuàngxīn, jiù hěn róngyì zài jìngzhēng zhōng luòhòu.
example.en: If a company does not keep innovating, it can easily fall behind in competition.

example.zh: 这次旅途虽然辛苦,却让他结识了许多朋友。
example.py: Zhè cì lǚtú suīrán xīnkǔ, què ràng tā jiéshí le xǔduō péngyou.
example.en: Although this journey was tough, it allowed him to make many friends.

example.zh: 会议全程录像,方便缺席的人会后查看。
example.py: Huìyì quánchéng lùxiàng, fāngbiàn quēxí de rén huì hòu chákàn.
example.en: The meeting was recorded throughout so that absent people could view it afterwards.

example.zh: 政府承诺会按时履行环保责任。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ chéngnuò huì ànshí lǚxíng huánbǎo zérèn.
example.en: The government promised to fulfil its environmental responsibilities on time.

example.zh: 经过三轮面试,公司决定录用她。
example.py: Jīngguò sān lún miànshì, gōngsī juédìng lùyòng tā.
example.en: After three rounds of interviews, the company decided to hire her.

example.zh: 节目将在今晚录制,明天正式播出。
example.py: Jiémù jiāng zài jīnwǎn lùzhì, míngtiān zhèngshì bōchū.
example.en: The programme will be recorded tonight and officially broadcast tomorrow.

example.zh: 这件事本来就是你的责任嘛,别再推给别人。
example.py: Zhè jiàn shì běnlái jiù shì nǐ de zérèn ma, bié zài tuī gěi biérén.
example.en: This was your responsibility in the first place, so stop pushing it onto others.

example.zh: 财务报表不能马虎,一个小数点都可能造成损失。
example.py: Cáiwù bàobiǎo bù néng mǎhu, yí ge xiǎoshùdiǎn dōu kěnéng zàochéng sǔnshī.
example.en: Financial statements must not be handled carelessly; even one decimal point could cause losses.

example.zh: 工人把电缆埋在地下,以免影响路面交通。
example.py: Gōngrén bǎ diànlǎn mái zài dìxià, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng lùmiàn jiāotōng.
example.en: The workers buried the cable underground so that it would not affect road traffic.

example.zh: 他迈出第一步后,发现困难并没有想象中那么大。
example.py: Tā mài chū dì yī bù hòu, fāxiàn kùnnán bìng méiyǒu xiǎngxiàng zhōng nàme dà.
example.en: After taking the first step, he found that the difficulty was not as great as he had imagined.

example.zh: 会议开始前,请检查麦克风是否连接正常。
example.py: Huìyì kāishǐ qián, qǐng jiǎnchá màikèfēng shìfǒu liánjiē zhèngcháng.
example.en: Before the meeting starts, please check whether the microphone is connected properly.

example.zh: 漫长的谈判终于取得了实质性进展。
example.py: Màncháng de tánpàn zhōngyú qǔdé le shízhìxìng jìnzhǎn.
example.en: The lengthy negotiations finally achieved substantial progress.

example.zh: 城市设计应考虑盲人的出行需求。
example.py: Chéngshì shèjì yīng kǎolǜ mángrén de chūxíng xūqiú.
example.en: Urban design should consider the travel needs of blind people.

example.zh: 这本漫画用幽默的方式讨论了环境问题。
example.py: Zhè běn mànhuà yòng yōumò de fāngshì tǎolùn le huánjìng wèntí.
example.en: This comic discusses environmental issues in a humorous way.

example.zh: 水壶刚烧开,壶口就冒出白色的热气。
example.py: Shuǐhú gāng shāokāi, húkǒu jiù mào chū báisè de rèqì.
example.en: The kettle had just boiled, and white steam began to come out of its spout.

example.zh: 在没有足够准备的情况下登山,是一种不必要的冒险。
example.py: Zài méiyǒu zúgòu zhǔnbèi de qíngkuàng xià dēngshān, shì yì zhǒng bù bìyào de màoxiǎn.
example.en: Climbing a mountain without enough preparation is an unnecessary risk.

example.zh: 两国之间的贸易往来受到汇率变化的影响。
example.py: Liǎng guó zhījiān de màoyì láiwǎng shòudào huìlǜ biànhuà de yǐngxiǎng.
example.en: Trade between the two countries is affected by changes in the exchange rate.

example.zh: 清晨的码头十分忙碌,货车一辆接一辆进出。
example.py: Qīngchén de mǎtóu shífēn mánglù, huòchē yí liàng jiē yì liàng jìnchū.
example.en: The dock is very busy in the early morning, with trucks coming in and out one after another.

example.zh: 蚂蚁虽然很小,却能共同搬动比身体重很多的食物。
example.py: Mǎyǐ suīrán hěn xiǎo, què néng gòngtóng bāndòng bǐ shēntǐ zhòng hěnduō de shíwù.
example.en: Although ants are very small, they can work together to move food much heavier than their bodies.

example.zh: 过去,这座城市主要依靠煤来供暖。
example.py: Guòqù, zhè zuò chéngshì zhǔyào yīkào méi lái gōngnuǎn.
example.en: In the past, this city mainly relied on coal for heating.

example.zh: 这座桥不仅坚固,而且设计得十分美观。
example.py: Zhè zuò qiáo bùjǐn jiāngù, érqiě shèjì de shífēn měiguān.
example.en: This bridge is not only solid but also very beautiful in design.

example.zh: 冬天一到,公园里的梅花就陆续开放。
example.py: Dōngtiān yí dào, gōngyuán lǐ de méihuā jiù lùxù kāifàng.
example.en: Once winter arrives, the plum blossoms in the park open one after another.

example.zh: 他皱起眉毛,似乎对这个决定并不满意。
example.py: Tā zhòu qǐ méimao, sìhū duì zhège juédìng bìng bù mǎnyì.
example.en: He frowned, seeming not to be satisfied with the decision.

example.zh: 山路两旁的树林很密,几乎看不到远处的村庄。
example.py: Shānlù liǎng páng de shùlín hěn mì, jīhū kàn bu dào yuǎnchù de cūnzhuāng.
example.en: The woods on both sides of the mountain road are so dense that you can hardly see the village in the distance.

example.zh: 为了免受干扰,他把手机调成了静音。
example.py: Wèile miǎn shòu gānrǎo, tā bǎ shǒujī tiáo chéng le jìngyīn.
example.en: To avoid being disturbed, he set his phone to silent.

example.zh: 这件外套里面加了棉,冬天穿起来很暖和。
example.py: Zhè jiàn wàitào lǐmiàn jiā le mián, dōngtiān chuān qǐlai hěn nuǎnhuo.
example.en: This coat has cotton padding inside, so it is warm to wear in winter.

example.zh: 面部表情往往比语言更能透露真实情绪。
example.py: Miànbù biǎoqíng wǎngwǎng bǐ yǔyán gèng néng tòulù zhēnshí qíngxù.
example.en: Facial expressions often reveal real emotions more than words do.

example.zh: 这种面粉蛋白质含量较高,适合用来做面包。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng miànfěn dànbáizhì hánliàng jiào gāo, shìhé yòng lái zuò miànbāo.
example.en: This flour has a relatively high protein content and is suitable for making bread.

example.zh: 他身体还没恢复,不要勉强参加训练。
example.py: Tā shēntǐ hái méi huīfù, bú yào miǎnqiǎng cānjiā xùnliàn.
example.en: He has not recovered yet, so do not force him to take part in training.

example.zh: 这些商品在机场购买时可以免税。
example.py: Zhèxiē shāngpǐn zài jīchǎng gòumǎi shí kěyǐ miǎnshuì.
example.en: These goods can be bought tax-free at the airport.

example.zh: 接种疫苗后,人体会逐渐产生免疫反应。
example.py: Jiēzhòng yìmiáo hòu, réntǐ huì zhújiàn chǎnshēng miǎnyì fǎnyìng.
example.en: After vaccination, the human body gradually develops an immune response.

example.zh: 他不愿当众承认错误,主要是怕丢面子。
example.py: Tā bù yuàn dāngzhòng chéngrèn cuòwù, zhǔyào shì pà diū miànzi.
example.en: He was unwilling to admit his mistake in public mainly because he feared losing face.

example.zh: 这个办法很妙,既省钱又节省时间。
example.py: Zhège bànfǎ hěn miào, jì shěng qián yòu jiéshěng shíjiān.
example.en: This method is excellent; it saves both money and time.

example.zh: 这部小说细致地描绘了海边小镇的生活。
example.py: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō xìzhì de miáohuì le hǎibiān xiǎozhèn de shēnghuó.
example.en: This novel depicts life in a seaside town in great detail.

example.zh: 作者通过细节描写,展现了人物内心的矛盾。
example.py: Zuòzhě tōngguò xìjié miáoxiě, zhǎnxiàn le rénwù nèixīn de máodùn.
example.en: Through detailed description, the author shows the character’s inner conflict.

meaning: to compensate, to make up for

example.zh: 他通过加倍练习来弥补基础薄弱的不足。
example.py: Tā tōngguò jiābèi liànxí lái míbǔ jīchǔ bóruò de bùzú.
example.en: He made up for his weak foundation through extra practice.

example.zh: 人口密度过高会给交通和住房带来压力。
example.py: Rénkǒu mìdù guò gāo huì gěi jiāotōng hé zhùfáng dài lái yālì.
example.en: Excessive population density will put pressure on transport and housing.

example.zh: 消防员终于把仓库里的大火灭了。
example.py: Xiāofángyuán zhōngyú bǎ cāngkù lǐ de dàhuǒ miè le.
example.en: The firefighters finally put out the big fire in the warehouse.

example.zh: 蜜蜂在花丛中飞来飞去,帮助植物传播花粉。
example.py: Mìfēng zài huācóng zhōng fēi lái fēi qù, bāngzhù zhíwù chuánbō huāfěn.
example.en: Bees fly around among the flowers and help plants spread pollen.

example.zh: 这一带工厂密集,空气质量长期受到关注。
example.py: Zhè yí dài gōngchǎng mìjí, kōngqì zhìliàng chángqī shòudào guānzhù.
example.en: Factories are densely concentrated in this area, so air quality has long been a concern.

example.zh: 这个培训班只有三十个名额,报名当天就满了。
example.py: Zhège péixùn bān zhǐyǒu sānshí ge míng'é, bàomíng dāngtiān jiù mǎn le.
example.en: This training course has only thirty places, and it filled up on the day registration opened.

example.zh: 这首民歌在当地流传了几百年。
example.py: Zhè shǒu míngē zài dāngdì liúchuán le jǐ bǎi nián.
example.en: This folk song has been passed down locally for several hundred years.

example.zh: 这间办公室朝南,白天显得特别明亮。
example.py: Zhè jiān bàngōngshì cháo nán, báitiān xiǎnde tèbié míngliàng.
example.en: This office faces south, so it looks especially bright during the day.

example.zh: 指挥官命令队伍立即撤离危险区域。
example.py: Zhǐhuīguān mìnglìng duìwu lìjí chèlí wēixiǎn qūyù.
example.en: The commander ordered the team to leave the dangerous area immediately.

example.zh: 这条新街道以一位著名科学家的名字命名。
example.py: Zhè tiáo xīn jiēdào yǐ yí wèi zhùmíng kēxuéjiā de míngzi mìngmíng.
example.en: This new street was named after a famous scientist.

example.zh: 你明明答应今天交报告,为什么又推迟了?
example.py: Nǐ míngmíng dāyìng jīntiān jiāo bàogào, wèishénme yòu tuīchí le?
example.en: You clearly promised to hand in the report today, so why has it been delayed again?

example.zh: 这位医生名气很大,但他对每个病人都很耐心。
example.py: Zhè wèi yīshēng míngqi hěn dà, dàn tā duì měi ge bìngrén dōu hěn nàixīn.
example.en: This doctor has a strong reputation, but he is still very patient with every patient.

example.zh: 这座古城保存了许多名胜,每年吸引大量游客。
example.py: Zhè zuò gǔchéng bǎocún le xǔduō míngshèng, měi nián xīyǐn dàliàng yóukè.
example.en: This ancient city has preserved many famous scenic spots and attracts large numbers of tourists every year.

example.zh: 许多民间故事反映了普通人的愿望和想象。
example.py: Xǔduō mínjiān gùshi fǎnyìng le pǔtōng rén de yuànwàng hé xiǎngxiàng.
example.en: Many folk stories reflect ordinary people’s wishes and imagination.

example.zh: 春节期间,各地的民俗活动吸引了大量游客。
example.py: Chūnjié qījiān, gèdì de mínsú huódòng xīyǐn le dàliàng yóukè.
example.en: During the Spring Festival, folk custom activities in various places attracted many tourists.

example.zh: 我们在山村住了一晚民宿,房东还带我们参观了茶园。
example.py: Wǒmen zài shāncūn zhù le yì wǎn mínsù, fángdōng hái dài wǒmen cānguān le cháyuán.
example.en: We stayed one night in a homestay in the mountain village, and the host also took us to visit the tea garden.

example.zh: 这项政策公布后,民众最关心的是医疗费用会不会下降。
example.py: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè gōngbù hòu, mínzhòng zuì guānxīn de shì yīliáo fèiyòng huì bú huì xiàjiàng.
example.en: After this policy was announced, what the public cared about most was whether medical costs would fall.

example.zh: 学生会通过民主投票决定活动的主题。
example.py: Xuéshēnghuì tōngguò mínzhǔ tóupiào juédìng huódòng de zhǔtí.
example.en: The student union decided the theme of the activity through a democratic vote.

example.zh: 这座小城的夜景格外迷人,吸引了不少游客。
example.py: Zhè zuò xiǎochéng de yèjǐng géwài mírén, xīyǐn le bù shǎo yóukè.
example.en: The night view of this small city is especially charming and attracts many tourists.

example.zh: 孩子喜欢模仿大人的语气说话,有时让全家人都笑起来。
example.py: Háizi xǐhuān mófǎng dàrén de yǔqì shuōhuà, yǒushí ràng quán jiā rén dōu xiào qǐlai.
example.en: Children like to imitate the way adults speak, sometimes making the whole family laugh.

example.zh: 她默默照顾生病的父亲,从来没有向别人抱怨。
example.py: Tā mòmò zhàogù shēngbìng de fùqīn, cónglái méiyǒu xiàng biéren bàoyuàn.
example.en: She silently cared for her sick father and never complained to others.

example.zh: 研究人员用电脑模拟城市洪水的扩散过程。
example.py: Yánjiū rényuán yòng diànnǎo mónǐ chéngshì hóngshuǐ de kuòsàn guòchéng.
example.en: Researchers used computers to simulate the process by which floodwater spreads through a city.

example.zh: 那位模特儿在发布会上展示了一款环保材料做成的外套。
example.py: Nà wèi mótèr zài fābùhuì shang zhǎnshì le yì kuǎn huánbǎo cáiliào zuò chéng de wàitào.
example.en: That model showed a coat made from environmentally friendly materials at the launch event.

example.zh: 山路太窄,汽车进不去,只能骑摩托车上山。
example.py: Shānlù tài zhǎi, qìchē jìn bu qù, zhǐ néng qí mótuōchē shàng shān.
example.en: The mountain road is too narrow for cars to enter, so people can only ride motorcycles up the mountain.

example.zh: 这个建筑模型按照真实比例缩小,细节非常精致。
example.py: Zhège jiànzhù móxíng ànzhào zhēnshí bǐlì suōxiǎo, xìjié fēicháng jīngzhì.
example.en: This architectural model is reduced according to real proportions, and the details are extremely refined.

example.zh: 这只母猫刚生下三只小猫,需要安静的环境。
example.py: Zhè zhī mǔ māo gāng shēng xià sān zhī xiǎo māo, xūyào ānjìng de huánjìng.
example.en: This female cat has just given birth to three kittens and needs a quiet environment.

example.zh: 这种木材密度高,适合做结实的家具。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng mùcái mìdù gāo, shìhé zuò jiēshi de jiājù.
example.en: This kind of timber has a high density and is suitable for making sturdy furniture.

example.zh: 请先查看目录,确认需要复习的章节在哪里。
example.py: Qǐng xiān chákàn mùlù, quèrèn xūyào fùxí de zhāngjié zài nǎlǐ.
example.en: Please check the table of contents first to confirm where the chapter you need to review is.

example.zh: 几年不见,他的模样几乎没有变化,只是更成熟了。
example.py: Jǐ nián bú jiàn, tā de múyàng jīhū méiyǒu biànhuà, zhǐshì gèng chéngshú le.
example.en: After not seeing him for several years, his appearance has hardly changed; he just looks more mature.

example.zh: 对他来说,汉语不是母语,但他已经说得很流利了。
example.py: Duì tā lái shuō, Hànyǔ bú shì mǔyǔ, dàn tā yǐjīng shuō de hěn liúlì le.
example.en: For him, Chinese is not his mother tongue, but he already speaks it very fluently.

example.zh: 这种奶粉适合一岁以上的孩子,冲泡时水温不能太高。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng nǎifěn shìhé yí suì yǐshàng de háizi, chōngpào shí shuǐwēn bù néng tài gāo.
example.en: This milk powder is suitable for children over one year old, and the water should not be too hot when preparing it.

example.zh: 这个项目最大的难点不是技术,而是各部门之间的协调。
example.py: Zhège xiàngmù zuì dà de nándiǎn bú shì jìshù, érshì gè bùmén zhījiān de xiétiáo.
example.en: The biggest difficulty in this project is not technology, but coordination between departments.

example.zh: 南极洲的冰层变化对全球海平面有重要影响。
example.py: Nánjízhōu de bīngcéng biànhuà duì quánqiú hǎipíngmiàn yǒu zhòngyào yǐngxiǎng.
example.en: Changes in Antarctica’s ice sheets have an important impact on global sea levels.

example.zh: 南美洲拥有丰富的自然资源和多样的文化传统。
example.py: Nánměizhōu yōngyǒu fēngfù de zìrán zīyuán hé duōyàng de wénhuà chuántǒng.
example.en: South America has rich natural resources and diverse cultural traditions.

example.zh: 第一次负责这么大的项目,难免会有些紧张。
example.py: Dì yī cì fùzé zhème dà de xiàngmù, nánmiǎn huì yǒu xiē jǐnzhāng.
example.en: When being responsible for such a large project for the first time, it is hard to avoid feeling a little nervous.

example.zh: 他低着脑袋走进会议室,看起来有点不好意思。
example.py: Tā dī zhe nǎodai zǒu jìn huìyìshì, kàn qǐlai yǒudiǎn bù hǎoyìsi.
example.en: He walked into the meeting room with his head lowered, looking a little embarrassed.

example.zh: 连续工作十几个小时后,我的脑子已经转不动了。
example.py: Liánxù gōngzuò shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí hòu, wǒ de nǎozi yǐjīng zhuàn bu dòng le.
example.en: After working continuously for more than ten hours, my brain could no longer function properly.

example.zh: 这句话的内涵很丰富,不能只从字面上理解。
example.py: Zhè jù huà de nèihán hěn fēngfù, bù néng zhǐ cóng zìmiàn shang lǐjiě.
example.en: The connotation of this sentence is very rich, and it cannot be understood only literally.

example.zh: 他咳嗽了两个星期,医生建议他去内科做进一步检查。
example.py: Tā késou le liǎng ge xīngqī, yīshēng jiànyì tā qù nèikē zuò jìn yí bù jiǎnchá.
example.en: He had been coughing for two weeks, so the doctor advised him to go to internal medicine for further examination.

example.zh: 这座古城经过修复后,城墙内外都设置了清晰的导览标志。
example.py: Zhè zuò gǔchéng jīngguò xiūfù hòu, chéngqiáng nèiwài dōu shèzhì le qīngxī de dǎolǎn biāozhì.
example.en: After restoration, clear guide signs were installed both inside and outside the ancient city walls.

example.zh: 出差前,她把内衣和洗漱用品单独放进一个小袋子里。
example.py: Chūchāi qián, tā bǎ nèiyī hé xǐshù yòngpǐn dāndú fàng jìn yí ge xiǎo dàizi lǐ.
example.en: Before the business trip, she put her underwear and toiletries into a separate small bag.

example.zh: 充足的睡眠能帮助身体恢复能量,提高第二天的效率。
example.py: Chōngzú de shuìmián néng bāngzhù shēntǐ huīfù néngliàng, tígāo dì èr tiān de xiàolǜ.
example.en: Sufficient sleep can help the body restore energy and improve efficiency the next day.

example.zh: 发展可再生能源是减少碳排放的重要途径。
example.py: Fāzhǎn kě zàishēng néngyuán shì jiǎnshǎo tàn páifàng de zhòngyào tújìng.
example.en: Developing renewable energy is an important way to reduce carbon emissions.

example.zh: 雨后的小路全是泥,孩子们的鞋很快就脏了。
example.py: Yǔ hòu de xiǎolù quán shì ní, háizimen de xié hěn kuài jiù zāng le.
example.en: After the rain, the path was full of mud, and the children's shoes quickly got dirty.

example.zh: 年度报告显示,公司在研发方面的投入明显增加。
example.py: Niándù bàogào xiǎnshì, gōngsī zài yánfā fāngmiàn de tóurù míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
example.en: The annual report shows that the company’s investment in research and development has clearly increased.

example.zh: 她小时候在乡下念书,后来靠奖学金去了省城。
example.py: Tā xiǎo shíhou zài xiāngxià niànshū, hòulái kào jiǎngxuéjīn qù le shěngchéng.
example.en: She attended school in the countryside as a child, and later went to the provincial capital on a scholarship.

example.zh: 年终总结不仅要列出成绩,也要分析存在的问题。
example.py: Niánzhōng zǒngjié bùjǐn yào liè chū chéngjì, yě yào fēnxī cúnzài de wèntí.
example.en: A year-end summary should list achievements and also analyse existing problems.

example.zh: 他下楼时不小心扭了脚,只好请假休息一天。
example.py: Tā xià lóu shí bù xiǎoxīn niǔ le jiǎo, zhǐhǎo qǐngjià xiūxi yì tiān.
example.en: He accidentally twisted his ankle while going downstairs, so he had to take a day off to rest.

example.zh: 当地农产品通过直播平台销售,价格比以前更透明。

example.en: Local agricultural products are sold through live-streaming platforms, making prices more transparent than before.

example.zh: 这部纪录片带有浓厚的地方色彩,很多细节都来自真实生活。
example.py: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn dài yǒu nónghòu de dìfāng sècǎi, hěn duō xìjié dōu láizì zhēnshí shēnghuó.
example.en: This documentary has a strong local flavour, and many details come from real life.

example.zh: 春耕之前,村民们先清理排水沟,避免农田被雨水淹没。
example.py: Chūngēng zhīqián, cūnmínmen xiān qīnglǐ páishuǐgōu, bìmiǎn nóngtián bèi yǔshuǐ yānmò.
example.en: Before spring ploughing, the villagers first clear the drainage ditches to prevent the farmland from being flooded.

example.zh: 太阳一出来,屋子里慢慢暖了起来。
example.py: Tàiyáng yì chūlai, wūzi lǐ mànmàn nuǎn le qǐlai.
example.en: As soon as the sun came out, the room slowly warmed up.

example.zh: 暖气突然坏了,整栋楼的居民都感到很不方便。
example.py: Nuǎnqì tūrán huài le, zhěng dòng lóu de jūmín dōu gǎndào hěn bù fāngbiàn.
example.en: The heating suddenly broke, and residents of the whole building found it very inconvenient.

example.zh: 他把那位科学家当作偶像,立志将来也从事研究工作。
example.py: Tā bǎ nà wèi kēxuéjiā dàngzuò ǒuxiàng, lìzhì jiānglái yě cóngshì yánjiū gōngzuò.
example.en: He regards that scientist as his idol and is determined to do research work in the future too.

example.zh: 在没有足够证据之前,警方不能排除任何可能性。
example.py: Zài méiyǒu zúgòu zhèngjù zhīqián, jǐngfāng bù néng páichú rènhé kěnéngxìng.

example.zh: 工厂必须减少废气排放,否则将面临罚款。

example.en: The factory must reduce exhaust emissions, otherwise it will face a fine.

example.zh: 演出前一周,演员们每天都要排练到很晚。
example.py: Yǎnchū qián yì zhōu, yǎnyuánmen měitiān dōu yào páiliàn dào hěn wǎn.
example.en: In the week before the performance, the actors have to rehearse until very late every day.

example.zh: 这所大学在最新榜单中排名明显上升。
example.py: Zhè suǒ dàxué zài zuìxīn bǎngdān zhōng páimíng míngxiǎn shàngshēng.
example.en: This university’s ranking has risen noticeably in the latest list.

meaning: measure word for plates, coils; (to coil)
