example.py: Fúwùyuán duān shànglai yì pán rè cài, xiāngwèi lìkè piāo mǎn le fángjiān.
example.en: The waiter brought up a plate of hot food, and the aroma immediately filled the room.

example.zh: 这家公司拥有庞大的销售网络,几乎覆盖全国。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī yōngyǒu pángdà de xiāoshòu wǎngluò, jīhū fùgài quánguó.
example.en: This company has a huge sales network that covers almost the whole country.

meaning: to long for, to look forward to

example.zh: 孩子们盼望已久的春游终于确定了日期。
example.py: Háizimen pànwàng yǐjiǔ de chūnyóu zhōngyú quèdìng le rìqī.
example.en: The spring outing the children had long looked forward to finally had a confirmed date.

example.zh: 他把旧观念抛在一边,重新设计了整个方案。
example.py: Tā bǎ jiù guānniàn pāo zài yìbiān, chóngxīn shèjì le zhěnggè fāng'àn.
example.en: He put old ideas aside and redesigned the entire plan.

example.zh: 她每天早晨都要泡一杯绿茶,让自己慢慢清醒。
example.py: Tā měitiān zǎochén dōu yào pào yì bēi lǜchá, ràng zìjǐ mànmàn qīngxǐng.
example.en: Every morning she makes a cup of green tea to help herself wake up slowly.

example.zh: 过年的时候，孩子们喜欢在院子里放鞭炮。
example.py: Guònián de shíhou, háizimen xǐhuan zài yuànzi lǐ fàng biānpào.
example.en: During the New Year, children like to set off firecrackers in the yard.

example.zh: 新建的救援队已经配备了先进的通讯设备。
example.py: Xīnjiàn de jiùyuánduì yǐjīng pèibèi le xiānjìn de tōngxùn shèbèi.
example.en: The newly formed rescue team has already been equipped with advanced communication equipment.

example.zh: 由于合同违约,公司必须向客户赔偿损失。
example.py: Yóuyú hétong wéiyuē, gōngsī bìxū xiàng kèhù péicháng sǔnshī.
example.en: Because of the breach of contract, the company must compensate the client for the losses.

example.zh: 我很佩服她在困难面前仍然保持冷静。
example.py: Wǒ hěn pèifú tā zài kùnnan miànqián réngrán bǎochí lěngjìng.
example.en: I really admire her for remaining calm in the face of difficulties.

example.zh: 新小区不仅房子建好了,配套设施也逐步完善。
example.py: Xīn xiǎoqū bùjǐn fángzi jiàn hǎo le, pèitào shèshī yě zhúbù wánshàn.
example.en: In the new residential area, not only have the buildings been completed, but the supporting facilities are also being improved step by step.

example.zh: 代表团访问期间,将由两名翻译全程陪同。
example.py: Dàibiǎotuán fǎngwèn qījiān, jiāng yóu liǎng míng fānyì quánchéng péitóng.
example.en: During the delegation's visit, two interpreters will accompany them throughout.

example.zh: 学校不仅传授知识,也要培育学生的责任感。
example.py: Xuéxiào bùjǐn chuánshòu zhīshi, yě yào péiyù xuéshēng de zérèngǎn.
example.en: Schools should not only pass on knowledge, but also cultivate students' sense of responsibility.

example.zh: 园丁把水雾喷在花苗上,避免阳光太强时叶子被晒伤。
example.py: Yuándīng bǎ shuǐwù pēn zài huāmiáo shàng, bìmiǎn yángguāng tài qiáng shí yèzi bèi shàishāng.
example.en: The gardener sprayed mist onto the seedlings to prevent the leaves from being scorched when the sun was too strong.

meaning: to hold in both hands; (measure word for handfuls)

example.zh: 她小心地捧着那只受伤的小鸟,等救助人员赶来。
example.py: Tā xiǎoxīn de pěng zhe nà zhī shòushāng de xiǎoniǎo, děng jiùzhù rényuán gǎnlái.
example.en: She carefully held the injured bird in both hands and waited for the rescue staff to arrive.

example.zh: 两辆货车在路口发生碰撞,造成道路暂时封闭。
example.py: Liǎng liàng huòchē zài lùkǒu fāshēng pèngzhuàng, zàochéng dàolù zànshí fēngbì.
example.en: Two trucks collided at the junction, causing the road to be temporarily closed.

example.zh: 他披上一件外套,匆匆走进寒冷的夜色。
example.py: Tā pī shàng yí jiàn wàitào, cōngcōng zǒu jìn hánlěng de yèsè.
example.en: He threw on a coat and hurried into the cold night.

example.zh: 这种水果的皮很薄,轻轻一剥就能吃。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng shuǐguǒ de pí hěn báo, qīngqīng yì bāo jiù néng chī.
example.en: The skin of this fruit is very thin; it can be eaten after being peeled gently.

example.zh: 请你在门口等片刻,医生马上就会出来。
example.py: Qǐng nǐ zài ménkǒu děng piànkè, yīshēng mǎshàng jiù huì chūlái.
example.en: Please wait at the door for a short moment; the doctor will come out soon.

example.zh: 只看销售数据就下结论,难免有些片面。
example.py: Zhǐ kàn xiāoshòu shùjù jiù xià jiélùn, nánmiǎn yǒuxiē piànmiàn.
example.en: Drawing a conclusion from sales data alone is inevitably rather one-sided.

example.zh: 那个骗子利用虚假链接骗走了不少人的钱。
example.py: Nà ge piànzi lìyòng xūjiǎ liànjiē piàn zǒu le bù shǎo rén de qián.
example.en: That swindler used fake links to cheat quite a few people out of their money.

example.zh: 一片树叶顺着河水慢慢漂向远处。
example.py: Yí piàn shùyè shùn zhe héshuǐ mànmàn piāo xiàng yuǎnchù.
example.en: A leaf slowly drifted along the river towards the distance.

example.zh: 秋天一到,树叶就会从街头慢慢飘落。
example.py: Qiūtiān yí dào, shùyè jiù huì cóng jiētóu mànmàn piāo luò.
example.en: As soon as autumn arrives, leaves slowly drift down from the street trees.

example.zh: 长时间盯着电脑屏幕容易造成眼睛疲劳。
example.py: Cháng shíjiān dīng zhe diànnǎo píngmù róngyì zàochéng yǎnjing píláo.
example.en: Staring at a computer screen for a long time can easily cause eye fatigue.

example.zh: 游客可以在展会上品尝不同地区的特色农产品。
example.py: Yóukè kěyǐ zài zhǎnhuì shàng pǐncháng bùtóng dìqū de tèsè nóngchǎnpǐn.
example.en: Visitors can taste special agricultural products from different regions at the exhibition.

example.zh: 这个频道专门播放科普节目,适合孩子和家长一起看。
example.py: Zhège píndào zhuānmén bōfàng kēpǔ jiémù, shìhé háizi hé jiāzhǎng yìqǐ kàn.
example.en: This channel specialises in science programmes and is suitable for children and parents to watch together.

example.zh: 近来系统故障频繁出现,技术部门决定重新检测服务器。
example.py: Jìnlái xìtǒng gùzhàng pínfán chūxiàn, jìshù bùmén juédìng chóngxīn jiǎncè fúwùqì.
example.en: System faults have appeared frequently recently, so the technical department decided to test the server again.

example.zh: 学校强调师生之间应当保持平等而尊重的沟通。
example.py: Xuéxiào qiángdiào shīshēng zhījiān yīngdāng bǎochí píngděng ér zūnzhòng de gōutōng.
example.en: The school emphasises that communication between teachers and students should remain equal and respectful.

example.zh: 他从事一份平凡的工作,却始终保持认真负责的态度。
example.py: Tā cóngshì yí fèn píngfán de gōngzuò, què shǐzhōng bǎochí rènzhēn fùzé de tàidu.
example.en: He does an ordinary job, yet he has always maintained a serious and responsible attitude.

example.zh: 这个房间只有十二平方,家具摆放必须精心设计。
example.py: Zhège fángjiān zhǐyǒu shí'èr píngfāng, jiājù bǎifàng bìxū jīngxīn shèjì.
example.en: This room is only twelve square metres, so the arrangement of the furniture must be carefully designed.

example.zh: 这套公寓的面积是八十五平方米,适合三口之家居住。
example.py: Zhè tào gōngyù de miànjī shì bāshíwǔ píngfāngmǐ, shìhé sānkǒu zhī jiā jūzhù.
example.en: This flat is eighty-five square metres, making it suitable for a family of three to live in.

example.zh: 在推出新政策之前,政府需要先评估它对中小企业的影响。
example.py: Zài tuīchū xīn zhèngcè zhīqián, zhèngfǔ xūyào xiān pínggū tā duì zhōngxiǎo qǐyè de yǐngxiǎng.
example.en: Before introducing a new policy, the government needs to first assess its impact on small and medium-sized businesses.

example.zh: 他在会议上评论了这项改革的优点和不足。
example.py: Tā zài huìyì shàng pínglùn le zhè xiàng gǎigé de yōudiǎn hé bùzú.
example.en: He commented on the strengths and shortcomings of this reform at the meeting.

example.zh: 学校每年都会评选表现突出的志愿者。
example.py: Xuéxiào měinián dōu huì píngxuǎn biǎoxiàn tūchū de zhìyuànzhě.
example.en: The school selects volunteers with outstanding performance every year.

example.zh: 这个基金主要帮助贫困地区的学生继续念书。
example.py: Zhège jījīn zhǔyào bāngzhù pínkùn dìqū de xuésheng jìxù niànshū.
example.en: This fund mainly helps students in poor areas continue their studies.

example.zh: 医生建议他记录头痛发生的频率,以便进一步诊断。
example.py: Yīshēng jiànyì tā jìlù tóutòng fāshēng de pínlǜ, yǐbiàn jìnyíbù zhěnduàn.
example.en: The doctor advised him to record how frequently the headaches occur for further diagnosis.

example.zh: 雨后这段坡很滑,骑车下去一定要减速。
example.py: Yǔ hòu zhè duàn pō hěn huá, qí chē xiàqu yídìng yào jiǎnsù.
example.en: After the rain, this slope is very slippery, so you must slow down when cycling down it.

example.zh: 孩子不小心把水泼到了地毯上。
example.py: Háizi bù xiǎoxīn bǎ shuǐ pō dào le dìtǎn shàng.
example.en: The child accidentally splashed water onto the carpet.

example.zh: 由于资金链断裂,那家小公司最终破产了。
example.py: Yóuyú zījīnliàn duànliè, nà jiā xiǎo gōngsī zuìzhōng pòchǎn le.
example.en: Because its funding chain broke, that small company eventually went bankrupt.

example.zh: 偏远地区对稳定能源的需求十分迫切。
example.py: Piānyuǎn dìqū duì wěndìng néngyuán de xūqiú shífēn pòqiè.
example.en: Remote areas have an extremely urgent need for stable energy supplies.

example.zh: 小狗一看见主人,就兴奋地扑了上去。
example.py: Xiǎogǒu yí kànjiàn zhǔrén, jiù xīngfèn de pū le shàngqu.
example.en: As soon as the puppy saw its owner, it excitedly pounced forward.

example.zh: 工人正在把新的路面铺得更加平整。
example.py: Gōngrén zhèngzài bǎ xīn de lùmiàn pū de gèngjiā píngzhěng.
example.en: The workers are paving the new road surface so that it is even smoother.

example.zh: 消防员花了两个小时才把大火扑灭。
example.py: Xiāofángyuán huā le liǎng gè xiǎoshí cái bǎ dàhuǒ pūmiè.
example.en: It took the firefighters two hours to extinguish the fire.

example.zh: 他的衣着很朴素,但谈吐中透出不凡的气质。
example.py: Tā de yīzhuó hěn pǔsù, dàn tántǔ zhōng tòu chū bùfán de qìzhì.
example.en: His clothing is very plain, but his speech reveals an uncommon quality.

example.zh: 在正式场合,选择恰当的表达方式非常重要。
example.py: Zài zhèngshì chǎnghé, xuǎnzé qiàdàng de biǎodá fāngshì fēicháng zhòngyào.
example.en: In formal settings, choosing an appropriate way of expressing oneself is very important.

example.zh: 我到车站时,下一班车恰好进站。
example.py: Wǒ dào chēzhàn shí, xià yì bān chē qiàhǎo jìn zhàn.
example.en: When I arrived at the station, the next bus was just pulling in.

example.zh: 护士轻轻牵着老人,让他慢慢走进检查室。
example.py: Hùshi qīngqīng qiān zhe lǎorén, ràng tā mànmàn zǒu jìn jiǎncháshì.
example.en: The nurse gently held the elderly man and led him slowly into the examination room.

example.zh: 警方在行动中缴获了一把枪,并控制了现场。
example.py: Jǐngfāng zài xíngdòng zhōng jiǎohuò le yì bǎ qiāng, bìng kòngzhì le xiànchǎng.
example.en: During the operation, the police seized a gun and brought the scene under control.

example.zh: 潮湿的天气使老房子的墙壁开始发霉。
example.py: Cháoshī de tiānqì shǐ lǎo fángzi de qiángbì kāishǐ fāméi.
example.en: The damp weather caused the walls of the old house to start going mouldy.

example.zh: 学校计划强化学生的实践能力,而不只是提高考试成绩。
example.py: Xuéxiào jìhuà qiánghuà xuésheng de shíjiàn nénglì, ér bù zhǐshì tígāo kǎoshì chéngjì.
example.en: The school plans to strengthen students' practical abilities, rather than merely improve exam results.

example.zh: 父母不该强迫孩子选择自己不喜欢的专业。
example.py: Fùmǔ bù gāi qiǎngpò háizi xuǎnzé zìjǐ bù xǐhuan de zhuānyè.
example.en: Parents should not force children to choose a major they do not like.

example.zh: 经过康复训练后,他的身体比以前强壮多了。
example.py: Jīngguò kāngfù xùnliàn hòu, tā de shēntǐ bǐ yǐqián qiángzhuàng duō le.
example.en: After rehabilitation training, his body became much stronger than before.

example.zh: 稳定的能源供应关系到千家万户的日常生活。
example.py: Wěndìng de néngyuán gōngyìng guānxì dào qiānjiā-wànhù de rìcháng shēnghuó.
example.en: A stable energy supply concerns the daily lives of countless households.

example.zh: 随着成本下降,新能源汽车的市场前景更加广阔。
example.py: Suízhe chéngběn xiàjiàng, xīn néngyuán qìchē de shìchǎng qiánjǐng gèngjiā guǎngkuò.
example.en: As costs fall, the market prospects for new energy vehicles are becoming broader.

example.zh: 这个年轻演员虽然经验不多,但发展潜力很大。
example.py: Zhège niánqīng yǎnyuán suīrán jīngyàn bù duō, dàn fāzhǎn qiánlì hěn dà.
example.en: Although this young actor does not have much experience, he has great development potential.

example.zh: 前期准备越充分,后期执行时遇到的阻力就越小。
example.py: Qiánqī zhǔnbèi yuè chōngfèn, hòuqī zhíxíng shí yùdào de zǔlì jiù yuè xiǎo.
example.en: The more thorough the early-stage preparation is, the less resistance will be encountered during later implementation.

example.zh: 充分尊重事实,是展开理性讨论的前提。
example.py: Chōngfèn zūnzhòng shìshí, shì zhǎnkāi lǐxìng tǎolùn de qiántí.
example.en: Fully respecting the facts is the premise for carrying out rational discussion.

example.zh: 即便取得了突出成绩,他在同事面前仍然很谦虚。
example.py: Jíbiàn qǔdé le tūchū chéngjì, tā zài tóngshì miànqián réngrán hěn qiānxū.
example.en: Even though he achieved outstanding results, he remained modest in front of his colleagues.

example.zh: 网络课程和面授课程各有优势,前者更加灵活。
example.py: Wǎngluò kèchéng hé miànshòu kèchéng gè yǒu yōushì, qiánzhě gèngjiā línghuó.
example.en: Online courses and face-to-face courses each have advantages; the former is more flexible.

example.zh: 你瞧,这些数据恰恰说明市场正在恢复。
example.py: Nǐ qiáo, zhèxiē shùjù qiàqià shuōmíng shìchǎng zhèngzài huīfù.
example.en: Look, these figures show exactly that the market is recovering.

example.zh: 这座桥梁连接了两岸,也带动了周边贸易。
example.py: Zhè zuò qiáoliáng liánjiē le liǎng'àn, yě dàidòng le zhōubiān màoyì.
example.en: This bridge connects the two sides and has also boosted surrounding trade.

example.zh: 这个设计巧妙地利用了狭小空间。
example.py: Zhège shèjì qiǎomiào de lìyòng le xiáxiǎo kōngjiān.
example.en: This design cleverly made use of the narrow space.

example.zh: 问题恰恰出在沟通不够,而不是技术本身太复杂。
example.py: Wèntí qiàqià chū zài gōutōng bú gòu, ér bú shì jìshù běnshēn tài fùzá.
example.en: The problem lies exactly in insufficient communication, not in the technology itself being too complicated.

example.zh: 起初大家都反对这个方案,后来才逐渐理解它的价值。
example.py: Qǐchū dàjiā dōu fǎnduì zhège fāng'àn, hòulái cái zhújiàn lǐjiě tā de jiàzhí.
example.en: At first everyone opposed this plan, and only later did they gradually understand its value.

example.zh: 公平的教育机会是社会流动的重要起点。
example.py: Gōngpíng de jiàoyù jīhuì shì shèhuì liúdòng de zhòngyào qǐdiǎn.
example.en: Fair educational opportunities are an important starting point for social mobility.

example.zh: 市政府明天将启动新的节能计划。
example.py: Shì zhèngfǔ míngtiān jiāng qǐdòng xīn de jiénéng jìhuà.
example.en: The municipal government will launch a new energy-saving plan tomorrow.

example.zh: 政府需要采取切实措施,减轻小企业的压力。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ xūyào cǎiqǔ qièshí cuòshī, jiǎnqīng xiǎo qǐyè de yālì.
example.en: The government needs to take practical measures to reduce pressure on small businesses.

example.zh: 导师的报告启发了几个年轻工程师重新思考设计方案。
example.py: Dǎoshī de bàogào qǐfā le jǐ gè niánqīng gōngchéngshī chóngxīn sīkǎo shèjì fāng'àn.
example.en: The tutor's report inspired several young engineers to rethink the design plan.

example.zh: 比赛开始前,体育馆里的气氛已经十分紧张。
example.py: Bǐsài kāishǐ qián, tǐyùguǎn lǐ de qìfēn yǐjīng shífēn jǐnzhāng.
example.en: Before the match began, the atmosphere in the stadium was already extremely tense.

example.zh: 会议持续了三个小时,其间没有人离开会场。
example.py: Huìyì chíxù le sān gè xiǎoshí, qíjiān méiyǒu rén líkāi huìchǎng.
example.en: The meeting lasted three hours, during which no one left the venue.

example.zh: 河水很清,能看见水底的石头。
example.py: Héshuǐ hěn qīng, néng kànjiàn shuǐdǐ de shítou.
example.en: The river water is very clear, so you can see the stones at the bottom.

example.zh: 清晨的空气很凉,街上还没有多少行人。
example.py: Qīngchén de kōngqì hěn liáng, jiē shàng hái méiyǒu duōshao xíngrén.
example.en: The air in the early morning is cool, and there are still not many pedestrians on the street.

example.zh: 青春不只是年龄,也是一种愿意尝试的心态。
example.py: Qīngchūn bù zhǐshì niánlíng, yě shì yì zhǒng yuànyì chángshì de xīntài.
example.en: Youth is not only an age, but also a mindset of being willing to try things.

example.zh: 青春期的孩子需要理解,也需要明确的界限。
example.py: Qīngchūnqī de háizi xūyào lǐjiě, yě xūyào míngquè de jièxiàn.
example.en: Adolescents need understanding, but they also need clear boundaries.

example.zh: 这道汤味道清淡,适合刚康复的病人。
example.py: Zhè dào tāng wèidào qīngdàn, shìhé gāng kāngfù de bìngrén.
example.en: This soup has a light flavour and is suitable for patients who have just recovered.

example.zh: 这部小说的情节紧凑,读者很难停下来。
example.py: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō de qíngjié jǐncòu, dúzhě hěn nán tíng xiàlai.
example.en: The plot of this novel is tight, making it hard for readers to stop.

example.zh: 医院必须保持环境清洁,防止细菌传播。
example.py: Yīyuàn bìxū bǎochí huánjìng qīngjié, fángzhǐ xìjūn chuánbō.
example.en: Hospitals must keep the environment clean to prevent bacteria from spreading.

example.zh: 天气晴朗时,从山顶可以看到远处的海岸线。
example.py: Tiānqì qínglǎng shí, cóng shāndǐng kěyǐ kàn dào yuǎnchù de hǎi'ànxiàn.
example.en: When the weather is clear, you can see the distant coastline from the mountaintop.

example.zh: 暴风雨过后,工人们连夜清理道路上的树枝。
example.py: Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, gōngrénmen liányè qīnglǐ dàolù shàng de shùzhī.
example.en: After the storm, the workers cleared the branches on the road overnight.

example.zh: 志愿者每周六都会清扫社区周围的街道。
example.py: Zhìyuànzhě měi zhōu liù dōu huì qīngsǎo shèqū zhōuwéi de jiēdào.
example.en: Volunteers sweep the streets around the community every Saturday.

example.zh: 管理者愿意倾听员工意见,团队才会更有活力。
example.py: Guǎnlǐzhě yuànyì qīngtīng yuángōng yìjiàn, tuánduì cái huì gèng yǒu huólì.
example.en: Only when managers are willing to listen carefully to employees' opinions will the team have more vitality.

example.zh: 这份报告结构清晰,关键数据也列得很完整。
example.py: Zhè fèn bàogào jiégòu qīngxī, guānjiàn shùjù yě liè de hěn wánzhěng.
example.en: This report has a clear structure, and the key data is also listed very completely.

example.zh: 这家医院每天清洗手术器械,确保所有设备符合卫生标准。
example.py: Zhè jiā yīyuàn měitiān qīngxǐ shǒushù qìxiè, quèbǎo suǒyǒu shèbèi fúhé wèishēng biāozhǔn.
example.en: This hospital washes surgical instruments every day to ensure all equipment meets hygiene standards.

example.zh: 调查显示,年轻消费者更倾向于选择环保包装。
example.py: Diàochá xiǎnshì, niánqīng xiāofèizhě gèng qīngxiàng yú xuǎnzé huánbǎo bāozhuāng.
example.en: The survey shows that young consumers tend more towards choosing environmentally friendly packaging.

example.zh: 当前的情形比预想复杂,需要重新评估风险。
example.py: Dāngqián de qíngxing bǐ yùxiǎng fùzá, xūyào chóngxīn pínggū fēngxiǎn.
example.en: The current situation is more complex than expected and requires a reassessment of the risks.

example.zh: 休息半小时后,他的头脑终于清醒了一些。
example.py: Xiūxi bàn xiǎoshí hòu, tā de tóunǎo zhōngyú qīngxǐng le yìxiē.
example.en: After resting for half an hour, his mind finally became a little clearer.

example.zh: 勤劳的农民用多年的经验改善了这片土地。
example.py: Qínláo de nóngmín yòng duōnián de jīngyàn gǎishàn le zhè piàn tǔdì.
example.en: The hard-working farmer used years of experience to improve this piece of land.

example.zh: 多年的合作让两家公司建立了亲密关系。
example.py: Duōnián de hézuò ràng liǎng jiā gōngsī jiànlì le qīnmì guānxì.
example.en: Years of cooperation allowed the two companies to build a close relationship.

example.zh: 医院要求患者的一名亲属在手术前签字。
example.py: Yīyuàn yāoqiú huànzhě de yì míng qīnshǔ zài shǒushù qián qiānzì.
example.en: The hospital requires one of the patient's relatives to sign before the operation.

example.zh: 虚假广告可能欺骗消费者,监管部门必须及时处理。
example.py: Xūjiǎ guǎnggào kěnéng qīpiàn xiāofèizhě, jiānguǎn bùmén bìxū jíshí chǔlǐ.
example.en: False advertising may deceive consumers, and regulators must deal with it promptly.

example.zh: 这家医院设备齐全,能处理多数急救情况。
example.py: Zhè jiā yīyuàn shèbèi qíquán, néng chǔlǐ duōshù jíjiù qíngkuàng.
example.en: This hospital is fully equipped and can handle most emergency treatment situations.

example.zh: 门口张贴了一则启事,通知居民本周停水。
example.py: Ménkǒu zhāngtiē le yì zé qǐshì, tōngzhī jūmín běn zhōu tíng shuǐ.
example.en: A notice was posted at the entrance informing residents that the water would be cut off this week.

example.zh: 那起事故给管理层一个重要启示:安全不能只靠口号。
example.py: Nà qǐ shìgù gěi guǎnlǐcéng yí gè zhòngyào qǐshì: ānquán bù néng zhǐ kào kǒuhào.
example.en: That accident gave management an important lesson: safety cannot rely only on slogans.

example.zh: 这种气体没有颜色,但大量吸入会危害健康。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng qìtǐ méiyǒu yánsè, dàn dàliàng xīrù huì wēihài jiànkāng.
example.en: This gas has no colour, but inhaling a large amount can harm health.

example.zh: 他不愿意求人帮忙,总想先靠自己解决问题。
example.py: Tā bù yuànyì qiú rén bāngmáng, zǒng xiǎng xiān kào zìjǐ jiějué wèntí.
example.en: He is unwilling to ask others for help and always wants to solve problems by himself first.

example.zh: 他在两人的纪念日向女友求婚,现场没有安排得太夸张。
example.py: Tā zài liǎng rén de jìniànrì xiàng nǚyǒu qiúhūn, xiànchǎng méiyǒu ānpái de tài kuāzhāng.
example.en: He proposed to his girlfriend on their anniversary, and the scene was not arranged too extravagantly.

example.zh: 登山队在暴风雪中迷路,只好通过卫星电话求救。
example.py: Dēngshān duì zài bàofēngxuě zhōng mílù, zhǐhǎo tōngguò wèixīng diànhuà qiújiù.
example.en: The mountaineering team got lost in the snowstorm and had to call for help by satellite phone.

example.zh: 他毕业后没有急着求职,而是先整理作品集和实习经历。
example.py: Tā bìyè hòu méiyǒu jízhe qiúzhí, ér shì xiān zhěnglǐ zuòpǐnjí hé shíxí jīnglì.
example.en: After graduating, he did not rush to apply for jobs, but first organised his portfolio and internship experience.

example.zh: 遇到法律问题时,许多人会先向社区服务中心求助。
example.py: Yùdào fǎlǜ wèntí shí, xǔduō rén huì xiān xiàng shèqū fúwù zhōngxīn qiúzhù.
example.en: When they encounter legal problems, many people first ask the community service centre for help.

example.zh: 家长对孩子有期望,但不应把压力全部转给他们。
example.py: Jiāzhǎng duì háizi yǒu qīwàng, dàn bù yīng bǎ yālì quánbù zhuǎn gěi tāmen.
example.en: Parents have expectations for their children, but should not pass all the pressure on to them.

example.zh: 厨房里飘来咖啡的气味,让人立刻精神起来。
example.py: Chúfáng lǐ piāo lái kāfēi de qìwèi, ràng rén lìkè jīngshen qǐlai.
example.en: The smell of coffee drifted from the kitchen, immediately making people feel more alert.

example.zh: 申请材料必须在规定期限内提交。
example.py: Shēnqǐng cáiliào bìxū zài guīdìng qīxiàn nèi tíjiāo.
example.en: The application materials must be submitted within the specified time limit.

example.zh: 这个节日的起源可以追溯到几百年前的民间习俗。
example.py: Zhège jiérì de qǐyuán kěyǐ zhuīsù dào jǐ bǎi nián qián de mínjiān xísú.
example.en: The origin of this festival can be traced back to folk customs from several hundred years ago.

example.zh: 她的气质安静而坚定,给人很深的印象。
example.py: Tā de qìzhì ānjìng ér jiāndìng, gěi rén hěn shēn de yìnxiàng.
example.en: Her temperament is quiet yet firm, leaving a deep impression on people.

example.zh: 棋子虽小,却能影响整盘棋的局面。
example.py: Qízǐ suī xiǎo, què néng yǐngxiǎng zhěng pán qí de júmiàn.
example.en: Although a chess piece is small, it can affect the situation of the whole game.

example.zh: 他决定先完成学业,再考虑娶谁共度一生。
example.py: Tā juédìng xiān wánchéng xuéyè, zài kǎolǜ qǔ shuí gòngdù yìshēng.
example.en: He decided to finish his studies first before considering whom to marry and spend his life with.

example.zh: 乐队在结尾演奏了一曲节奏明快的民歌。
example.py: Yuèduì zài jiéwěi yǎnzòu le yì qǔ jiézòu míngkuài de míngē.
example.en: At the end, the band performed a folk song with a bright rhythm.

example.zh: 这张优惠券月底前有效,过期就不能使用了。
example.py: Zhè zhāng yōuhuìquàn yuèdǐ qián yǒuxiào, guòqī jiù bù néng shǐyòng le.
example.en: This discount coupon is valid until the end of the month; after it expires, it cannot be used.

example.zh: 请在表格里把错误的金额圈出来。
example.py: Qǐng zài biǎogé lǐ bǎ cuòwù de jīn'é quān chūlai.
example.en: Please circle the incorrect amount in the form.

example.zh: 会议全程都有录音,方便之后整理纪要。
example.py: Huìyì quánchéng dōu yǒu lùyīn, fāngbiàn zhīhòu zhěnglǐ jìyào.
example.en: The whole meeting was recorded, making it easier to organise the minutes afterwards.

example.zh: 过于集中的权力容易导致决策缺乏监督。
example.py: Guòyú jízhōng de quánlì róngyì dǎozhì juécè quēfá jiāndū.
example.en: Overly concentrated power can easily lead to decision-making that lacks oversight.

example.zh: 新技术不会完全取代教师,但会改变教学方式。
example.py: Xīn jìshù bú huì wánquán qǔdài jiàoshī, dàn huì gǎibiàn jiàoxué fāngshì.
example.en: New technology will not completely replace teachers, but it will change teaching methods.

example.zh: 公司希望通过更多线上渠道接触年轻消费者。
example.py: Gōngsī xīwàng tōngguò gèng duō xiànshàng qúdào jiēchù niánqīng xiāofèizhě.
example.en: The company hopes to reach young consumers through more online channels.

example.zh: 这项法律确立了公民个人信息保护的基本原则。
example.py: Zhè xiàng fǎlǜ quèlì le gōngmín gèrén xìnxī bǎohù de jīběn yuánzé.
example.en: This law established the basic principles for protecting citizens’ personal information.

example.zh: 这款软件的安全缺陷已经在最新版本中修复。
example.py: Zhè kuǎn ruǎnjiàn de ānquán quēxiàn yǐjīng zài zuìxīn bǎnběn zhōng xiūfù.
example.en: This software’s security defect has already been fixed in the latest version.

example.zh: 研究者必须区分事实、推测和个人观点。
example.py: Yánjiūzhě bìxū qūfēn shìshí, tuīcè hé gèrén guāndiǎn.
example.en: Researchers must differentiate between facts, speculation, and personal opinions.

example.zh: 政策调整前,政府部门应充分听取群众意见。
example.py: Zhèngcè tiáozhěng qián, zhèngfǔ bùmén yīng chōngfèn tīngqǔ qúnzhòng yìjiàn.
example.en: Before adjusting policy, government departments should fully listen to the public’s views.

example.zh: 这本书把科学知识讲得很有趣味,适合青少年阅读。
example.py: Zhè běn shū bǎ kēxué zhīshi jiǎng de hěn yǒu qùwèi, shìhé qīngshàonián yuèdú.
example.en: This book presents scientific knowledge in an interesting way and is suitable for teenagers to read.

example.zh: 她把旧窗帘染成了深蓝色,看起来像新的一样。
example.py: Tā bǎ jiù chuānglián rǎn chéng le shēn lán sè, kàn qǐlai xiàng xīn de yíyàng.
example.en: She dyed the old curtains dark blue, and they looked like new.

example.zh: 航空公司正在研究如何减少传统燃料的使用。
example.py: Hángkōng gōngsī zhèngzài yánjiū rúhé jiǎnshǎo chuántǒng ránliào de shǐyòng.
example.en: The airline is studying how to reduce the use of traditional fuels.

example.zh: 城市更新已经成为当地媒体讨论的热点。
example.py: Chéngshì gēngxīn yǐjīng chéngwéi dāngdì méitǐ tǎolùn de rèdiǎn.
example.en: Urban renewal has already become a hot topic discussed by the local media.

example.zh: 这部电影上映两周后,网络热度仍然很高。
example.py: Zhè bù diànyǐng shàngyìng liǎng zhōu hòu, wǎngluò rèdù réngrán hěn gāo.
example.en: Two weeks after this film was released, its online popularity was still very high.

example.zh: 人工智能是近来最热门的研究方向之一。
example.py: Réngōng zhìnéng shì jìnlái zuì rèmén de yánjiū fāngxiàng zhī yī.
example.en: Artificial intelligence has recently been one of the most popular research directions.

example.zh: 项目出问题后,负责人主动认错,并提出了补救方案。
example.py: Xiàngmù chū wèntí hòu, fùzérén zhǔdòng rèncuò, bìng tíchū le bǔjiù fāng'àn.
example.en: After the project had problems, the person in charge admitted the mistake voluntarily and proposed a remedy.

example.zh: 法院最终认定这份合同有效,双方都必须履行。
example.py: Fǎyuàn zuìzhōng rèndìng zhè fèn hétong yǒuxiào, shuāngfāng dōu bìxū lǚxíng.
example.en: The court finally determined that the contract was valid, and both parties must fulfil it.

example.zh: 尽管成本上涨,这家小店仍旧坚持使用新鲜原料。
example.py: Jǐnguǎn chéngběn shàngzhǎng, zhè jiā xiǎodiàn réngjiù jiānchí shǐyòng xīnxiān yuánliào.
example.en: Although costs have risen, this small shop still insists on using fresh ingredients.

example.zh: 人工智能正在改变医疗、教育和交通等多个行业。
example.py: Réngōng zhìnéng zhèngzài gǎibiàn yīliáo, jiàoyù hé jiāotōng děng duō gè hángyè.
example.en: Artificial intelligence is changing many industries, including healthcare, education and transport.

example.zh: 人家已经道歉了,你就别再追究这件事了。
example.py: Rénjia yǐjīng dàoqiàn le, nǐ jiù bié zài zhuījiū zhè jiàn shì le.
example.en: They have already apologised, so stop pursuing the matter.

example.zh: 这个城市的人均收入近年稳步提高。
example.py: Zhège chéngshì de rénjūn shōurù jìnnián wěnbù tígāo.
example.en: The per capita income of this city has risen steadily in recent years.

example.zh: 这个方案得到了多数专家的认可,但仍需进一步检验。
example.py: Zhège fāng'àn dédào le duōshù zhuānjiā de rènkě, dàn réng xū jìnyíbù jiǎnyàn.
example.en: This plan has won the approval of most experts, but still needs further testing.

example.zh: 节日期间,景区入口处人山人海,排队至少要半小时。
example.py: Jiérì qíjiān, jǐngqū rùkǒu chù rénshān-rénhǎi, páiduì zhìshǎo yào bàn xiǎoshí.
example.en: During the festival, the entrance to the scenic area was packed with people, and queuing took at least half an hour.

example.zh: 公司人事部门正在审核新员工的入职材料。
example.py: Gōngsī rénshì bùmén zhèngzài shěnhé xīn yuángōng de rùzhí cáiliào.
example.en: The company’s personnel department is reviewing the onboarding materials for new employees.

example.zh: 多位环保人士呼吁政府尽快限制污染排放。
example.py: Duō wèi huánbǎo rénshì hūyù zhèngfǔ jǐnkuài xiànzhì wūrǎn páifàng.
example.en: Several environmental figures called on the government to restrict pollution emissions as soon as possible.

example.zh: 他无法忍受长期加班带来的压力,最终决定换工作。
example.py: Tā wúfǎ rěnshòu chángqī jiābān dài lái de yālì, zuìzhōng juédìng huàn gōngzuò.
example.en: He could not endure the pressure caused by long-term overtime, and finally decided to change jobs.

example.zh: 许多年轻人认同环保理念,却觉得生活中真正做到很难。
example.py: Xǔduō niánqīngrén rèntóng huánbǎo lǐniàn, què juéde shēnghuó zhōng zhēnzhèng zuòdào hěn nán.
example.en: Many young people identify with environmental ideas, but feel it is difficult to truly practise them in daily life.

example.zh: 调查结果表明,事故主要是人为操作失误造成的。
example.py: Diàochá jiéguǒ biǎomíng, shìgù zhǔyào shì rénwéi cāozuò shīwù zàochéng de.
example.en: The investigation showed that the accident was mainly caused by human operational error.

example.zh: 施工期间,学校门口的人行道被临时封闭,学生只能从旁边绕行。
example.py: Shīgōng qījiān, xuéxiào ménkǒu de rénxíngdào bèi línshí fēngbì, xuésheng zhǐ néng cóng pángbiān ràoxíng.
example.en: During construction, the pavement outside the school was temporarily closed, so students had to go round the side.

meaning: to recognize, to be aware of

example.zh: 儿童对时间的认知会随着年龄增长而逐渐形成。
example.py: Értóng duì shíjiān de rènzhī huì suízhe niánlíng zēngzhǎng ér zhújiàn xíngchéng.
example.en: Children’s understanding of time gradually forms as they grow older.

example.zh: 这台热水器使用了节能技术,冬天洗澡也不会耗电太多。
example.py: Zhè tái rèshuǐqì shǐyòng le jiénéng jìshù, dōngtiān xǐzǎo yě bú huì hàodiàn tài duō.
example.en: This water heater uses energy-saving technology, so showering in winter does not use too much electricity.

example.zh: 遇到紧急情况时,可以拨打这条热线寻求帮助。
example.py: Yùdào jǐnjí qíngkuàng shí, kěyǐ bōdǎ zhè tiáo rèxiàn xúnqiú bāngzhù.
example.en: In an emergency, you can call this hotline to seek help.

example.zh: 这项教育改革在网上引发热议,支持和反对的声音都很多。
example.py: Zhè xiàng jiàoyù gǎigé zài wǎngshàng yǐnfā rèyì, zhīchí hé fǎnduì de shēngyīn dōu hěn duō.
example.en: This education reform sparked heated discussion online, with many voices both supporting and opposing it.

example.zh: 这份记录必须妥善保存,以便日后查阅。
example.py: Zhè fèn jìlù bìxū tuǒshàn bǎocún, yǐbiàn rìhòu cháyuè.
example.en: This record must be kept properly so that it can be consulted in the future.

example.zh: 公司日前公布了年度报告,收入比去年增长了百分之八。
example.py: Gōngsī rìqián gōngbù le niándù bàogào, shōurù bǐ qùnián zēngzhǎng le bǎifēn zhī bā.
example.en: The company announced its annual report a few days ago, with revenue up eight per cent from last year.

example.zh: 为了赶在汛期前完成加固工程,施工队日夜在大坝上工作。
example.py: Wèile gǎn zài xùnqī qián wánchéng jiāgù gōngchéng, shīgōngduì rìyè zài dàbà shang gōngzuò.
example.en: To finish the reinforcement project before flood season, the construction team worked day and night on the dam.

example.zh: 随着能源价格上涨,企业对节能技术的需求日益迫切。
example.py: Suízhe néngyuán jiàgé shàngzhǎng, qǐyè duì jiénéng jìshù de xūqiú rìyì pòqiè.
example.en: As energy prices rise, companies’ need for energy-saving technology is increasingly urgent.

example.zh: 这家餐厅把本地食材和东南亚风味巧妙融合在一起。
example.py: Zhè jiā cāntīng bǎ běndì shícái hé Dōngnányà fēngwèi qiǎomiào rónghé zài yìqǐ.
example.en: This restaurant cleverly blends local ingredients with Southeast Asian flavours.

example.zh: 春天一到,山顶的积雪开始慢慢融化。
example.py: Chūntiān yí dào, shāndǐng de jīxuě kāishǐ mànmàn rónghuà.
example.en: When spring arrives, the snow on the mountaintop begins to melt slowly.

example.zh: 这个水库的容量有限,连续暴雨可能导致水位迅速上升。
example.py: Zhège shuǐkù de róngliàng yǒuxiàn, liánxù bàoyǔ kěnéng dǎozhì shuǐwèi xùnsù shàngshēng.
example.en: This reservoir has limited capacity, and continuous heavy rain may cause the water level to rise rapidly.

example.zh: 刚到国外时,他努力学习当地语言,尽快融入新的环境。
example.py: Gāng dào guówài shí, tā nǔlì xuéxí dāngdì yǔyán, jǐnkuài róngrù xīn de huánjìng.
example.en: When he first arrived abroad, he worked hard to learn the local language and integrate into the new environment as soon as possible.

example.zh: 对这位科学家来说,真正的荣誉来自研究成果被社会使用。
example.py: Duì zhè wèi kēxuéjiā lái shuō, zhēnzhèng de róngyù láizì yánjiū chéngguǒ bèi shèhuì shǐyòng.
example.en: For this scientist, true honour comes from research results being used by society.

example.zh: 这款面包外皮很薄,里面却十分柔软。
example.py: Zhè kuǎn miànbāo wàipí hěn báo, lǐmiàn què shífēn róuruǎn.
example.en: This bread has a thin crust, but the inside is very soft.

example.zh: 旅客入境时必须如实填写健康申报信息。
example.py: Lǚkè rùjìng shí bìxū rúshí tiánxiě jiànkāng shēnbào xìnxī.
example.en: Travellers must truthfully fill in health declaration information when entering the country.

example.zh: 这本书适合人工智能入门,但后面的章节也有一定深度。
example.py: Zhè běn shū shìhé réngōng zhìnéng rùmén, dàn hòumiàn de zhāngjié yě yǒu yídìng shēndù.
example.en: This book is suitable as an introduction to artificial intelligence, but later chapters also have some depth.

example.zh: 这份报告直接指出了公司管理机制中的弱点。
example.py: Zhè fèn bàogào zhíjiē zhǐchū le gōngsī guǎnlǐ jīzhì zhōng de ruòdiǎn.
example.en: This report directly pointed out the weaknesses in the company’s management mechanism.

example.zh: 这部纪录片最终入选了国际电影节的竞赛单元。
example.py: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn zuìzhōng rùxuǎn le guójì diànyǐngjié de jìngsài dānyuán.
example.en: This documentary was eventually selected for the competition section of the international film festival.

example.zh: 厨师在汤面上撒了一点葱花,颜色立刻好看多了。
example.py: Chúshī zài tāngmiàn shàng sǎ le yìdiǎn cōnghuā, yánsè lìkè hǎokàn duō le.
example.en: The chef sprinkled a little chopped spring onion on the noodle soup, and the colour immediately looked much better.

example.zh: 他把文件塞进包里,匆匆赶往会议室。
example.py: Tā bǎ wénjiàn sāi jìn bāo li, cōngcōng gǎnwǎng huìyìshì.
example.en: He stuffed the documents into his bag and hurried to the meeting room.

example.zh: 这项国际赛事吸引了来自三十多个国家的选手。
example.py: Zhè xiàng guójì sàishì xīyǐn le láizì sānshí duō ge guójiā de xuǎnshǒu.
example.en: This international competition attracted competitors from more than thirty countries.

example.zh: 他把零钱散在桌上,仔细数了一遍。
example.py: Tā bǎ língqián sǎn zài zhuō shàng, zǐxì shǔ le yí biàn.
example.en: He scattered the small change on the table and counted it carefully.

example.zh: 会议结束后,人群很快散了,广场恢复了平静。
example.py: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, rénqún hěn kuài sàn le, guǎngchǎng huīfù le píngjìng.
example.en: After the meeting ended, the crowd quickly dispersed and the square became calm again.

example.zh: 新买的木材散发出淡淡的香味。
example.py: Xīn mǎi de mùcái sànfā chū dàndàn de xiāngwèi.
example.en: The newly bought timber gives off a faint fragrance.

example.zh: 他在事故中丧失了部分听力,但仍坚持工作。
example.py: Tā zài shìgù zhōng sàngshī le bùfen tīnglì, dàn réng jiānchí gōngzuò.
example.en: He lost part of his hearing in the accident, but still kept working.

example.zh: 他连续讲解了两个小时,嗓子有些发哑。
example.py: Tā liánxù jiǎngjiě le liǎng ge xiǎoshí, sǎngzi yǒuxiē fā yǎ.
example.en: After explaining for two hours straight, his throat became a little hoarse.

example.zh: 这篇散文语言朴素,却能描绘出很深的乡愁。
example.py: Zhè piān sǎnwén yǔyán pǔsù, què néng miáohuì chū hěn shēn de xiāngchóu.
example.en: The language of this prose essay is plain, yet it can depict a deep homesickness.

example.zh: 请先扫描二维码,再填写个人信息。
example.py: Qǐng xiān sǎomiáo èrwéimǎ, zài tiánxiě gèrén xìnxī.
example.en: Please scan the QR code first, then fill in your personal information.

example.zh: 这种药能杀死大部分细菌,但不能代替清洁。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng yào néng shā sǐ dà bùfen xìjūn, dàn bù néng dàitì qīngjié.
example.en: This medicine can kill most bacteria, but it cannot replace cleaning.

example.zh: 看到前方有人横穿马路,司机立刻刹车。
example.py: Kàndào qiánfāng yǒu rén héngchuān mǎlù, sījī lìkè shāchē.
example.en: Seeing someone crossing the road ahead, the driver braked immediately.

example.zh: 我们需要先筛选数据,再进行深入分析。
example.py: Wǒmen xūyào xiān shāixuǎn shùjù, zài jìnxíng shēnrù fēnxī.
example.en: We need to filter the data first, then carry out a deeper analysis.

example.zh: 这扇窗户朝南,清晨阳光能直接照进来。
example.py: Zhè shàn chuānghu cháo nán, qīngchén yángguāng néng zhíjiē zhào jìnlai.
example.en: This window faces south, so morning sunlight can shine directly in.

example.zh: 一道光突然闪过,大家都抬头看向窗外。
example.py: Yí dào guāng tūrán shǎn guò, dàjiā dōu táitóu kàn xiàng chuāngwài.
example.en: A flash of light suddenly passed by, and everyone looked up towards the window.

example.zh: 暴雨来临时,天空中划过一道闪电。
example.py: Bàoyǔ láilín shí, tiānkōng zhōng huá guò yí dào shǎndiàn.
example.en: When the storm arrived, a bolt of lightning crossed the sky.

example.zh: 他们终于爬到山顶,看见了壮丽的日出。
example.py: Tāmen zhōngyú pá dào shāndǐng, kànjiàn le zhuànglì de rìchū.
example.en: They finally climbed to the mountaintop and saw a magnificent sunrise.

example.zh: 远处的山峰被雪覆盖,轮廓十分清晰。
example.py: Yuǎnchù de shānfēng bèi xuě fùgài, lúnkuò shífēn qīngxī.
example.en: The distant mountain peak was covered with snow, and its outline was very clear.

example.zh: 这个商标已经注册,其他公司不能随便使用。
example.py: Zhège shāngbiāo yǐjīng zhùcè, qítā gōngsī bù néng suíbiàn shǐyòng.
example.en: This trademark has already been registered, so other companies cannot use it casually.

meaning: to be cheated, to fall for a trick

example.zh: 他轻信了陌生人的承诺,结果上当了。
example.py: Tā qīngxìn le mòshēngrén de chéngnuò, jiéguǒ shàngdàng le.
example.en: He trusted a stranger’s promise too easily and ended up being cheated.

example.zh: 这个方案需要得到上级批准才能实施。
example.py: Zhège fāng'àn xūyào dédào shàngjí pīzhǔn cái néng shíshī.
example.en: This plan needs approval from higher levels before it can be carried out.

example.zh: 她工作认真,也很上进,所以进步很快。
example.py: Tā gōngzuò rènzhēn, yě hěn shàngjìn, suǒyǐ jìnbù hěn kuài.
example.en: She works seriously and is very motivated, so she makes quick progress.

example.zh: 伤口虽然不深,但仍然需要及时清洗。
example.py: Shāngkǒu suīrán bù shēn, dàn réngrán xūyào jíshí qīngxǐ.
example.en: Although the wound is not deep, it still needs to be cleaned promptly.

example.zh: 这家公司计划明年在上海证券交易所上市。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī jìhuà míngnián zài Shànghǎi zhèngquàn jiāoyìsuǒ shàngshì.
example.en: This company plans to go public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange next year.

example.zh: 上述问题如果得不到解决,项目很难按时完成。
example.py: Shàngshù wèntí rúguǒ dé bù dào jiějué, xiàngmù hěn nán ànshí wánchéng.
example.en: If the above-mentioned problems are not solved, the project will be difficult to complete on time.

example.zh: 新经理上台后,立即调整了公司的销售策略。
example.py: Xīn jīnglǐ shàngtái hòu, lìjí tiáozhěng le gōngsī de xiāoshòu cèlüè.
example.en: After the new manager came into office, they immediately adjusted the company’s sales strategy.

example.zh: 这次事故造成了多人伤亡,原因仍在调查。
example.py: Zhè cì shìgù zàochéng le duō rén shāngwáng, yuányīn réng zài diàochá.
example.en: This accident caused many casualties, and the cause is still under investigation.

example.zh: 报名时间安排在六月上旬,请提前准备材料。
example.py: Bàomíng shíjiān ānpái zài liù yuè shàngxún, qǐng tíqián zhǔnbèi cáiliào.
example.en: Registration is scheduled for early June, so please prepare the materials in advance.

example.zh: 医护人员把伤员迅速送往附近医院。
example.py: Yīhù rényuán bǎ shāngyuán xùnsù sòng wǎng fùjìn yīyuàn.
example.en: Medical staff quickly sent the wounded person to a nearby hospital.

example.zh: 雨后山坡上的泥变得很滑,行人要小心。
example.py: Yǔ hòu shānpō shàng de ní biàn de hěn huá, xíngrén yào xiǎoxīn.
example.en: After the rain, the mud on the mountain slope became very slippery, so pedestrians should be careful.

example.zh: 这家图书馆专门设立了少儿阅读区。
example.py: Zhè jiā túshūguǎn zhuānmén shèlì le shào'ér yuèdúqū.
example.en: This library has set up a reading area especially for children.

example.zh: 纪录片展示了鲨鱼在海洋生态中的重要作用。
example.py: Jìlùpiàn zhǎnshì le shāyú zài hǎiyáng shēngtài zhōng de zhòngyào zuòyòng.
example.en: The documentary showed the important role sharks play in the marine ecosystem.

example.zh: 运动员稳定呼吸后才把箭射出去。
example.py: Yùndòngyuán wěndìng hūxī hòu cái bǎ jiàn shè chūqu.
example.en: The athlete only shot the arrow after steadying their breathing.

example.zh: 学校的文学社吸引了许多喜欢写作的学生。
example.py: Xuéxiào de wénxuéshè xīyǐn le xǔduō xǐhuan xiězuò de xuésheng.
example.en: The school’s literary society attracted many students who enjoy writing.

example.zh: 射击比赛要求选手保持高度冷静。
example.py: Shèjī bǐsài yāoqiú xuǎnshǒu bǎochí gāodù lěngjìng.
example.en: Shooting competitions require competitors to remain highly calm.

example.zh: 这项改革涉及教育、医疗和住房等多个领域。
example.py: Zhè xiàng gǎigé shèjí jiàoyù, yīliáo hé zhùfáng děng duō ge lǐngyù.
example.en: This reform involves several fields, including education, healthcare and housing.

example.zh: 老师的解释太神了,复杂的问题一下子变得清楚。
example.py: Lǎoshī de jiěshì tài shén le, fùzá de wèntí yíxiàzi biàn de qīngchu.
example.en: The teacher’s explanation was amazing; the complicated problem became clear at once.

example.zh: 这辆车每百公里大约耗油六升。
example.py: Zhè liàng chē měi bǎi gōnglǐ dàyuē hàoyóu liù shēng.
example.en: This car uses about six litres of fuel per hundred kilometres.

example.zh: 系统会根据用户输入自动生成报告。
example.py: Xìtǒng huì gēnjù yònghù shūrù zìdòng shēngchéng bàogào.
example.en: The system will automatically generate a report based on user input.

example.zh: 普通话有四个基本声调,读错声调可能会改变词义。
example.py: Pǔtōnghuà yǒu sì ge jīběn shēngdiào, dú cuò shēngdiào kěnéng huì gǎibiàn cíyì.
example.en: Mandarin has four basic tones, and reading a tone incorrectly may change the meaning of a word.

example.zh: 这片森林经历火灾后仍然显示出强大的生命力。
example.py: Zhè piàn sēnlín lìjīng huǒzāi hòu réngrán xiǎnshì chū qiángdà de shēngmìnglì.
example.en: After going through a fire, this forest still showed great vitality.

example.zh: 过度开发会破坏当地生态,影响长期发展。
example.py: Guòdù kāifā huì pòhuài dāngdì shēngtài, yǐngxiǎng chángqī fāzhǎn.
example.en: Excessive development can damage the local ecology and affect long-term development.

meaning: to go on to higher education

example.zh: 许多家庭在孩子升学前,会认真比较不同学校的课程。
example.py: Xǔduō jiātíng zài háizi shēngxué qián, huì rènzhēn bǐjiào bùtóng xuéxiào de kèchéng.
example.en: Before their child goes on to higher education, many families carefully compare different schools' courses.

example.zh: 活动结束后,工作人员把剩余物资送给了社区中心。
example.py: Huódòng jiéshù hòu, gōngzuò rényuán bǎ shèngyú wùzī sòng gěi le shèqū zhōngxīn.
example.en: After the event ended, the staff sent the remaining supplies to the community centre.

example.zh: 长期压力会使神经一直处于紧张状态。
example.py: Chángqī yālì huì shǐ shénjīng yìzhí chǔyú jǐnzhāng zhuàngtài.
example.en: Long-term pressure can keep the nerves in a constant state of tension.

example.zh: 艺术教育能帮助学生提高审美能力。
example.py: Yìshù jiàoyù néng bāngzhù xuéshēng tígāo shěnměi nénglì.
example.en: Arts education can help students improve their aesthetic appreciation.

example.zh: 这种材料很神奇,遇水后会自动变硬。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng cáiliào hěn shénqí, yù shuǐ hòu huì zìdòng biàn yìng.
example.en: This material is magical; after it meets water, it automatically becomes hard.

example.zh: 长期加班会影响身心健康,管理者不应忽视这一点。
example.py: Chángqī jiābān huì yǐngxiǎng shēnxīn jiànkāng, guǎnlǐzhě bù yīng hūshì zhè yì diǎn.
example.en: Long-term overtime can affect physical and mental health, and managers should not ignore this.

example.zh: 深夜的街道格外安静,只听得见远处车辆的声音。
example.py: Shēnyè de jiēdào géwài ānjìng, zhǐ tīng de jiàn yuǎnchù chēliàng de shēngyīn.
example.en: The streets late at night were especially quiet; only the sound of vehicles in the distance could be heard.

example.zh: 他喝汤太急,把舌头烫了一下。
example.py: Tā hē tāng tài jí, bǎ shétou tàng le yí xià.
example.en: He drank the soup too quickly and burned his tongue.

example.zh: 记者在事故现场摄像,并采访了几位目击者。
example.py: Jìzhě zài shìgù xiànchǎng shèxiàng, bìng cǎifǎng le jǐ wèi mùjīzhě.
example.en: The reporter filmed at the accident scene and interviewed several witnesses.

example.zh: 政府在制定政策时,必须设想各种可能出现的后果。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ zài zhìdìng zhèngcè shí, bìxū shèxiǎng gè zhǒng kěnéng chūxiàn de hòuguǒ.
example.en: When making policy, the government must imagine all kinds of possible consequences.

example.zh: 办公楼入口安装了高清摄像头,以便记录进出情况。
example.py: Bàngōnglóu rùkǒu ānzhuāng le gāoqīng shèxiàngtóu, yǐbiàn jìlù jìnchū qíngkuàng.
example.en: A high-definition camera was installed at the office building entrance to record people coming and going.

example.zh: 孩子把地上的卡片拾起来,交还给老师。
example.py: Háizi bǎ dìshang de kǎpiàn shí qǐlai, jiāohuán gěi lǎoshī.
example.en: The child picked up the card from the floor and returned it to the teacher.

example.zh: 他自幼识字不多,却凭经验把生意做得很稳。
example.py: Tā zìyòu shízì bù duō, què píng jīngyàn bǎ shēngyì zuò de hěn wěn.
example.en: He did not know many characters from childhood, yet he ran the business steadily through experience.

example.zh: 这套系统能识别车辆牌照,并自动记录进出时间。
example.py: Zhè tào xìtǒng néng shíbié chēliàng páizhào, bìng zìdòng jìlù jìnchū shíjiān.
example.en: This system can identify vehicle number plates and automatically record entry and exit times.

example.zh: 那名士兵在救灾现场连续工作了十几个小时。
example.py: Nà míng shìbīng zài jiùzāi xiànchǎng liánxù gōngzuò le shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí.
example.en: That soldier worked at the disaster-relief site for more than ten hours continuously.

example.zh: 爷爷喜欢朗读古代诗词,尤其欣赏其中的节奏和意境。
example.py: Yéye xǐhuan lǎngdú gǔdài shīcí, yóuqí xīnshǎng qízhōng de jiézòu hé yìjìng.
example.en: Grandad likes reading ancient poetry aloud and especially appreciates its rhythm and imagery.

example.zh: 如果室内湿度太高,墙壁和家具都容易发霉。
example.py: Rúguǒ shìnèi shīdù tài gāo, qiángbì hé jiājù dōu róngyì fāméi.
example.en: If indoor humidity is too high, walls and furniture can easily go mouldy.

example.zh: 适度运动有助于减压,但过量训练反而会造成疲劳。
example.py: Shìdù yùndòng yǒuzhù yú jiǎnyā, dàn guòliàng xùnliàn fǎn'ér huì zàochéng píláo.
example.en: Moderate exercise helps reduce stress, but excessive training can instead cause fatigue.

example.zh: 老师先示范了一遍实验流程,再让学生自己操作。
example.py: Lǎoshī xiān shìfàn le yí biàn shíyàn liúchéng, zài ràng xuésheng zìjǐ cāozuò.
example.en: The teacher first demonstrated the experiment procedure once, then let the students operate by themselves.

example.zh: 改革释放了市场活力,也带来了新的监管挑战。
example.py: Gǎigé shìfàng le shìchǎng huólì, yě dàilái le xīn de jiānguǎn tiǎozhàn.
example.en: The reform released market vitality, but also brought new regulatory challenges.

example.zh: 这位师父从十六岁起学习木工,如今技艺十分精湛。
example.py: Zhè wèi shīfu cóng shíliù suì qǐ xuéxí mùgōng, rújīn jìyì shífēn jīngzhàn.
example.en: This master began learning carpentry at sixteen, and his skill is now extremely refined.

example.zh: 这首诗歌用简单的语言表达了深厚的感情。
example.py: Zhè shǒu shīgē yòng jiǎndān de yǔyán biǎodá le shēnhòu de gǎnqíng.
example.en: This poem uses simple language to express deep feelings.

example.zh: 那段在乡下生活的时光,后来成了他写作的重要素材。
example.py: Nà duàn zài xiāngxià shēnghuó de shíguāng, hòulái chéng le tā xiězuò de zhòngyào sùcái.
example.en: That period of living in the countryside later became important material for his writing.

example.zh: 事故发生后,负责人事后才承认安全培训不足。
example.py: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, fùzérén shìhòu cái chéngrèn ānquán péixùn bùzú.
example.en: After the accident happened, the person in charge admitted only afterwards that safety training had been insufficient.

example.zh: 面对调查,他终于说了实话,承认数据有误。
example.py: Miànduì diàochá, tā zhōngyú shuō le shíhuà, chéngrèn shùjù yǒu wù.
example.en: Facing the investigation, he finally told the truth and admitted there was an error in the data.

example.zh: 这家餐馆价格不高,菜量又足,特别实惠。
example.py: Zhè jiā cānguǎn jiàgé bù gāo, cài liàng yòu zú, tèbié shíhuì.
example.en: This restaurant is not expensive, the portions are generous, and it is especially good value.

example.zh: 公司选择在市场稳定后推出新产品,是为了等待更好的时机。
example.py: Gōngsī xuǎnzé zài shìchǎng wěndìng hòu tuīchū xīn chǎnpǐn, shì wèile děngdài gèng hǎo de shíjī.
example.en: The company chose to launch the new product after the market stabilised in order to wait for a better opportunity.

example.zh: 门被卡住了,他使劲推了几次才打开。
example.py: Mén bèi qiǎ zhù le, tā shǐjìn tuī le jǐ cì cái dǎkāi.
example.en: The door was stuck; he had to push hard several times before it opened.

example.zh: 这部纪录片通过强烈的视觉对比,表现了城市发展的速度。
example.py: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn tōngguò qiángliè de shìjué duìbǐ, biǎoxiàn le chéngshì fāzhǎn de sùdù.
example.en: This documentary uses strong visual contrasts to show the speed of urban development.

example.zh: 这个地区的地方势力复杂,改革推进得并不顺利。
example.py: Zhège dìqū de dìfāng shìlì fùzá, gǎigé tuījìn de bìng bù shùnlì.
example.en: Local power structures in this region are complicated, so the reform has not advanced smoothly.

example.zh: 儿童视力下降往往与户外活动不足和用眼时间过长有关。
example.py: Értóng shìlì xiàjiàng wǎngwǎng yǔ hùwài huódòng bùzú hé yòngyǎn shíjiān guò cháng yǒuguān.
example.en: A decline in children’s eyesight is often related to insufficient outdoor activity and excessive time using their eyes.

example.zh: 这位设计师把传统元素和现代时尚结合得很自然。
example.py: Zhè wèi shèjìshī bǎ chuántǒng yuánsù hé xiàndài shíshàng jiéhé de hěn zìrán.
example.en: This designer combines traditional elements and modern fashion very naturally.

example.zh: 平台会实时更新路况,帮助司机避开拥堵。
example.py: Píngtái huì shíshí gēngxīn lùkuàng, bāngzhù sījī bì kāi yōngdǔ.
example.en: The platform updates road conditions in real time, helping drivers avoid congestion.

example.zh: 高铁在平稳路段的时速可以超过三百公里。
example.py: Gāotiě zài píngwěn lùduàn de shísù kěyǐ chāoguò sānbǎi gōnglǐ.
example.en: On stable sections of track, high-speed trains can exceed 300 kilometres per hour.

example.zh: 公司试图通过降价吸引顾客,但效果并不明显。
example.py: Gōngsī shìtú tōngguò jiàngjià xīyǐn gùkè, dàn xiàoguǒ bìng bù míngxiǎn.
example.en: The company attempted to attract customers by lowering prices, but the effect was not obvious.

example.zh: 她负责处理公司的日常事务,工作内容非常繁杂。
example.py: Tā fùzé chǔlǐ gōngsī de rìcháng shìwù, gōngzuò nèiróng fēicháng fánzá.
example.en: She is responsible for handling the company’s daily affairs, and the work is very complicated.

example.zh: 请在会议开始前确认所有事项,避免临时出现混乱。
example.py: Qǐng zài huìyì kāishǐ qián quèrèn suǒyǒu shìxiàng, bìmiǎn línshí chūxiàn hùnluàn.
example.en: Please confirm all items before the meeting starts to avoid last-minute confusion.

example.zh: 这片土地排水良好,很适宜种植薰衣草和其他耐旱植物。
example.py: Zhè piàn tǔdì páishuǐ liánghǎo, hěn shìyí zhòngzhí xūnyīcǎo hé qítā nàihàn zhíwù.
example.en: This plot of land drains well and is very suitable for planting lavender and other drought-tolerant plants.

example.zh: 全球石油价格波动时,许多国家会重新评估能源战略。
example.py: Quánqiú shíyóu jiàgé bōdòng shí, xǔduō guójiā huì chóngxīn pínggū néngyuán zhànlüè.
example.en: When global petroleum prices fluctuate, many countries reassess their energy strategies.

example.zh: 连续加班让他食欲下降,医生建议他先调整作息。
example.py: Liánxù jiābān ràng tā shíyù xiàjiàng, yīshēng jiànyì tā xiān tiáozhěng zuòxī.
example.en: Working overtime continuously reduced his appetite, and the doctor advised him to adjust his routine first.

example.zh: 双方意见看似不同,实质上都希望降低风险。
example.py: Shuāngfāng yìjiàn kànsì bùtóng, shízhì shang dōu xīwàng jiàngdī fēngxiǎn.
example.en: The two sides’ opinions seem different, but in essence both hope to reduce risk.

example.zh: 纪录片展示了狮子在草原上合作捕猎的过程。
example.py: Jìlùpiàn zhǎnshì le shīzi zài cǎoyuán shàng hézuò bǔliè de guòchéng.
example.en: The documentary showed the process of lions hunting together on the grassland.

example.zh: 这位年轻导演经验不多,但创作热情十足。
example.py: Zhè wèi niánqīng dǎoyǎn jīngyàn bù duō, dàn chuàngzuò rèqíng shízú.
example.en: This young director has little experience, but is full of creative enthusiasm.

example.zh: 连续搬了一下午箱子,他的手臂酸得几乎抬不起来。
example.py: Liánxù bān le yí xiàwǔ xiāngzi, tā de shǒubì suān de jīhū tái bu qǐlái.
example.en: After carrying boxes all afternoon, his arms were so sore that he could hardly lift them.

example.zh: 他收藏了许多老照片,记录了这座城市几十年的变化。
example.py: Tā shōucáng le xǔduō lǎo zhàopiàn, jìlù le zhè zuò chéngshì jǐ shí nián de biànhuà.
example.en: He has collected many old photographs, recording several decades of changes in this city.

example.zh: 这位导演的叙事手法很特别,观众需要耐心看完。
example.py: Zhè wèi dǎoyǎn de xùshì shǒufǎ hěn tèbié, guānzhòng xūyào nàixīn kàn wán.
example.en: This director’s narrative technique is very unusual, so viewers need patience to watch it through.

example.zh: 这家公司计划收购一家小型科技企业,扩大自己的研发团队。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī jìhuà shōugòu yì jiā xiǎoxíng kējì qǐyè, kuòdà zìjǐ de yánfā tuánduì.
example.en: This company plans to acquire a small technology firm in order to expand its own research and development team.

example.zh: 正确保养可以延长机器的寿命,减少维修成本。
example.py: Zhèngquè bǎoyǎng kěyǐ yáncháng jīqì de shòumìng, jiǎnshǎo wéixiū chéngběn.
example.en: Proper maintenance can extend a machine’s lifespan and reduce repair costs.

example.zh: 平台不得在用户不知情的情况下收取额外费用。
example.py: Píngtái bùdé zài yònghù bù zhīqíng de qíngkuàng xià shōuqǔ éwài fèiyòng.
example.en: Platforms must not collect extra fees without users being aware of it.

example.zh: 他做了一个安静的手势,示意大家不要打断发言人。
example.py: Tā zuò le yí ge ānjìng de shǒushì, shìyì dàjiā bú yào dǎduàn fāyánrén.
example.en: He made a quiet gesture to indicate that everyone should not interrupt the speaker.

example.zh: 发生事故后,首要任务是确认人员是否安全。
example.py: Fāshēng shìgù hòu, shǒuyào rènwu shì quèrèn rényuán shìfǒu ānquán.
example.en: After an accident, the primary task is to confirm whether people are safe.

example.zh: 这项投资短期内收益不高,但风险相对可控。
example.py: Zhè xiàng tóuzī duǎnqī nèi shōuyì bù gāo, dàn fēngxiǎn xiāngduì kěkòng.
example.en: This investment does not bring high returns in the short term, but the risk is relatively controllable.

meaning: to be hit by a disaster

example.zh: 受灾群众被临时安置在学校体育馆里。
example.py: Shòuzāi qúnzhòng bèi línshí ānzhì zài xuéxiào tǐyùguǎn lǐ.
example.en: The people affected by the disaster were temporarily settled in the school gymnasium.

example.zh: 这片湿地属国家保护区,任何开发都需要审批。
example.py: Zhè piàn shīdì shǔ guójiā bǎohùqū, rènhé kāifā dōu xūyào shěnpī.
example.en: This wetland belongs to a national protected area, so any development requires approval.

example.zh: 请把这张海报竖着贴,横着贴会挡住窗户。
example.py: Qǐng bǎ zhè zhāng hǎibào shùzhe tiē, héngzhe tiē huì dǎngzhù chuānghu.
example.en: Please put this poster up vertically; if you put it horizontally, it will block the window.

example.zh: 适度运动可以减缓身体衰老,但不能完全阻止它。
example.py: Shìdù yùndòng kěyǐ jiǎnhuǎn shēntǐ shuāilǎo, dàn bù néng wánquán zǔzhǐ tā.
example.en: Moderate exercise can slow physical ageing, but it cannot stop it completely.

example.zh: 军官率领救援队进入山区,寻找被洪水困住的村民。
example.py: Jūnguān shuàilǐng jiùyuán duì jìnrù shānqū, xúnzhǎo bèi hóngshuǐ kùn zhù de cūnmín.
example.en: The officer led the rescue team into the mountain area to search for villagers trapped by the floodwater.

example.zh: 这家公司率先推出环保包装,带动了整个行业的变化。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī shuàixiān tuīchū huánbǎo bāozhuāng, dàidòng le zhěnggè hángyè de biànhuà.
example.en: This company was the first to introduce eco-friendly packaging, driving changes across the whole industry.

example.zh: 系统会自动输出一份报告,方便管理人员查看结果。
example.py: Xìtǒng huì zìdòng shūchū yí fèn bàogào, fāngbiàn guǎnlǐ rényuán chákàn jiéguǒ.
example.en: The system will automatically output a report, making it easier for managers to view the results.

example.zh: 这家博物馆新开设了书画展厅,吸引了不少游客。
example.py: Zhè jiā bówùguǎn xīn kāishè le shūhuà zhǎntīng, xīyǐn le bù shǎo yóukè.
example.en: This museum has newly opened a calligraphy and painting exhibition hall, attracting quite a few visitors.

example.zh: 南方许多地区依靠水稻种植维持生计。
example.py: Nánfāng xǔduō dìqū yīkào shuǐdào zhòngzhí wéichí shēngjì.
example.en: Many regions in the south rely on rice cultivation to make a living.

example.zh: 这座水库不仅供水,还承担防洪和发电的任务。
example.py: Zhè zuò shuǐkù bùjǐn gōngshuǐ, hái chéngdān fánghóng hé fādiàn de rènwù.
example.en: This reservoir not only supplies water, but also undertakes flood-control and power-generation tasks.

example.zh: 山谷里的水流很急,游客被提醒不要靠近河边。
example.py: Shāngǔ lǐ de shuǐliú hěn jí, yóukè bèi tíxǐng bú yào kàojìn hébiān.
example.en: The current in the valley is very fast, so visitors are reminded not to go near the riverbank.

example.zh: 清晨的水面十分平静,远处的山影清晰可见。
example.py: Qīngchén de shuǐmiàn shífēn píngjìng, yuǎnchù de shānyǐng qīngxī kějiàn.
example.en: The water surface was very calm in the early morning, and the distant mountain shadows were clearly visible.

example.zh: 新铺的水泥还没有完全干,行人暂时不能通过。
example.py: Xīn pū de shuǐní hái méiyǒu wánquán gān, xíngrén zànshí bù néng tōngguò.
example.en: The newly laid cement is not completely dry yet, so pedestrians cannot pass through for the time being.

example.zh: 电子书很方便,但纸质书籍仍然有稳定的读者群。
example.py: Diànzǐshū hěn fāngbiàn, dàn zhǐzhì shūjí réngrán yǒu wěndìng de dúzhě qún.
example.en: E-books are very convenient, but printed books still have a stable readership.

example.zh: 政府希望通过公开数据树立更透明的形象。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ xīwàng tōngguò gōngkāi shùjù shùlì gèng tòumíng de xíngxiàng.
example.en: The government hopes to establish a more transparent image by releasing public data.

example.zh: 所有投诉都必须以书面形式提交,方便后续核查。
example.py: Suǒyǒu tóusù dōu bìxū yǐ shūmiàn xíngshì tíjiāo, fāngbiàn hòuxù héchá.
example.en: All complaints must be submitted in written form to facilitate later verification.

example.zh: 申请人数目超过预期,主办方不得不增加场次。
example.py: Shēnqǐng rén shùmù chāoguò yùqī, zhǔbànfāng bùdébù zēngjiā chǎngcì.
example.en: The number of applicants exceeded expectations, so the organisers had to add more sessions.

example.zh: 灯光熄灭的瞬间,整个大厅陷入了短暂的安静。
example.py: Dēngguāng xīmiè de shùnjiān, zhěnggè dàtīng xiànrù le duǎnzàn de ānjìng.
example.en: The instant the lights went out, the whole hall fell into a brief silence.

example.zh: 他一边看电影一边吃薯片,很快就吃完了一整包。
example.py: Tā yìbiān kàn diànyǐng yìbiān chī shǔpiàn, hěn kuài jiù chīwán le yì zhěng bāo.
example.en: He ate potato crisps while watching a film and quickly finished a whole packet.

example.zh: 这条管道主要用于输送天然气,维护要求很高。
example.py: Zhè tiáo guǎndào zhǔyào yòngyú shūsòng tiānránqì, wéihù yāoqiú hěn gāo.
example.en: This pipeline is mainly used to transport natural gas, so its maintenance requirements are high.

example.zh: 孩子刚开始学习书写时,笔画顺序非常重要。
example.py: Háizi gāng kāishǐ xuéxí shūxiě shí, bǐhuà shùnxù fēicháng zhòngyào.
example.en: When children first learn to write, stroke order is very important.

example.zh: 医院正在把旧病历数字化,以便医生快速查询。
example.py: Yīyuàn zhèngzài bǎ jiù bìnglì shùzìhuà, yǐbiàn yīshēng kuàisù cháxún.
example.en: The hospital is digitising old medical records so doctors can look them up quickly.

example.zh: 老师没有直接给答案,而是引导学生整理自己的思路。
example.py: Lǎoshī méiyǒu zhíjiē gěi dá'àn, ér shì yǐndǎo xuéshēng zhěnglǐ zìjǐ de sīlù.
example.en: The teacher did not give the answer directly, but guided the students to organise their own train of thought.

example.zh: 离开家乡多年后,他依然思念那条安静的小河。
example.py: Líkāi jiāxiāng duōnián hòu, tā yīrán sīniàn nà tiáo ānjìng de xiǎohé.
example.en: After leaving his hometown for many years, he still misses that quiet little river.

example.zh: 事故发生后,官方确认有三人死亡,另有多人受伤。
example.py: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, guānfāng quèrèn yǒu sān rén sǐwáng, lìng yǒu duō rén shòushāng.
example.en: After the accident, officials confirmed that three people had died and several others were injured.

example.zh: 这颗螺丝有点松,机器运行时会发出噪音。
example.py: Zhè kē luósī yǒu diǎn sōng, jīqì yùnxíng shí huì fāchū zàoyīn.
example.en: This screw is a bit loose, so the machine makes noise when it is running.

example.zh: 港口外停着一艘科研船,准备前往南海采集样本。
example.py: Gǎngkǒu wài tíngzhe yì sōu kēyán chuán, zhǔnbèi qiánwǎng Nánhǎi cǎijí yàngběn.
example.en: A research vessel was moored outside the port, preparing to go to the South China Sea to collect samples.

example.zh: 为了写报告,她花了两个月搜集第一手资料。
example.py: Wèile xiě bàogào, tā huā le liǎng gè yuè sōují dìyīshǒu zīliào.
example.en: To write the report, she spent two months collecting first-hand materials.

example.zh: 既然大家意见分歧这么大,这件事就算了吧。
example.py: Jìrán dàjiā yìjiàn fēnqí zhème dà, zhè jiàn shì jiù suànle ba.
example.en: Since everyone’s opinions differ so much, let’s just drop this matter.

example.zh: 这次谈判虽然没有达成协议,但也算是取得了一些进展。
example.py: Zhè cì tánpàn suīrán méiyǒu dáchéng xiéyì, dàn yě suànshì qǔdé le yìxiē jìnzhǎn.
example.en: Although this negotiation did not reach an agreement, it can still be regarded as having made some progress.

example.zh: 这项改革虽有争议,但长期效果值得观察。
example.py: Zhè xiàng gǎigé suī yǒu zhēngyì, dàn chángqī xiàoguǒ zhídé guānchá.
example.en: Although this reform is controversial, its long-term effect is worth observing.

example.zh: 他岁数不小了,却依然每天坚持学习新技术。
example.py: Tā suìshu bù xiǎo le, què yīrán měitiān jiānchí xuéxí xīn jìshù.
example.en: He is no longer young, but he still insists on learning new technology every day.

example.zh: 这些照片记录了父母年轻时一起走过的岁月。
example.py: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn jìlù le fùmǔ niánqīng shí yìqǐ zǒu guò de suìyuè.
example.en: These photos record the years my parents spent together when they were young.

example.zh: 运输过程中包装被挤压,里面的设备没有受到损坏。
example.py: Yùnshū guòchéng zhōng bāozhuāng bèi jǐyā, lǐmiàn de shèbèi méiyǒu shòudào sǔnhuài.
example.en: The packaging was squeezed during transport, but the equipment inside was not damaged.

example.zh: 长期缺乏睡眠会损伤记忆力和判断力。
example.py: Chángqī quēfá shuìmián huì sǔnshāng jìyìlì hé pànduànlì.
example.en: Long-term lack of sleep can harm memory and judgement.

meaning: particle used to indicate passive voice or to nominalize verbs

example.zh: 他所提出的建议虽然简单,却解决了最核心的问题。
example.py: Tā suǒ tíchū de jiànyì suīrán jiǎndān, què jiějué le zuì héxīn de wèntí.
example.en: The suggestion he put forward was simple, but it solved the most central problem.

example.zh: 家庭教育会在很大程度上塑造孩子的价值观。
example.py: Jiātíng jiàoyù huì zài hěn dà chéngdù shàng sùzào háizi de jiàzhíguān.
example.en: Family education shapes children’s values to a great extent.

example.zh: 员工的专业素质直接影响服务质量和客户信任。
example.py: Yuángōng de zhuānyè sùzhì zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng fúwù zhìliàng hé kèhù xìnrèn.
example.en: Employees’ professional calibre directly affects service quality and customer trust.

example.zh: 这座古塔经历了多次地震,仍然保存得相当完整。
example.py: Zhè zuò gǔtǎ jīnglì le duō cì dìzhèn, réngrán bǎocún de xiāngdāng wánzhěng.
example.en: This ancient pagoda has been through several earthquakes and is still preserved quite completely.

example.zh: 台风登陆前,沿海居民被安排转移到安全地点。
example.py: Táifēng dēnglù qián, yánhǎi jūmín bèi ānpái zhuǎnyí dào ānquán dìdiǎn.
example.en: Before the typhoon made landfall, coastal residents were moved to safe places.

example.zh: 人类对太空的探索推动了许多新技术的发展。
example.py: Rénlèi duì tàikōng de tànsuǒ tuīdòng le xǔduō xīn jìshù de fāzhǎn.
example.en: Human exploration of space has promoted the development of many new technologies.

example.zh: 他每周练习台球,不只是为了娱乐,也为了培养专注力。
example.py: Tā měi zhōu liànxí táiqiú, bù zhǐshì wèile yúlè, yě wèile péiyǎng zhuānzhùlì.
example.en: He practises billiards every week, not only for entertainment but also to develop concentration.

example.zh: 这个村庄利用太阳能供电,减少了对柴油发电机的依赖。
example.py: Zhège cūnzhuāng lìyòng tàiyángnéng gōngdiàn, jiǎnshǎo le duì cháiyóu fādiànjī de yīlài.
example.en: This village uses solar energy for electricity, reducing its reliance on diesel generators.

example.zh: 刚倒出来的茶很烫,别急着喝。
example.py: Gāng dào chūlai de chá hěn tàng, bié jí zhe hē.
example.en: The tea has just been poured and is very hot, so do not rush to drink it.

example.zh: 医生建议他减少糖果摄入,以免影响牙齿健康。
example.py: Yīshēng jiànyì tā jiǎnshǎo tángguǒ shèrù, yǐmiǎn yǐngxiǎng yáchǐ jiànkāng.
example.en: The doctor advised him to reduce his intake of sweets so as not to affect his dental health.

example.zh: 元宵节那天,奶奶亲手包了芝麻馅的汤圆。
example.py: Yuánxiāo Jié nà tiān, nǎinai qīnshǒu bāo le zhīma xiàn de tāngyuán.
example.en: On the Lantern Festival, Grandma made sesame-filled tangyuan by hand.

example.zh: 会议结束后,大家仍在走廊里谈论改革方案的细节。
example.py: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, dàjiā réng zài zǒuláng lǐ tánlùn gǎigé fāng'àn de xìjié.
example.en: After the meeting ended, everyone was still discussing the details of the reform plan in the corridor.

example.zh: 双方经过三轮谈判,终于在价格上达成了初步一致。
example.py: Shuāngfāng jīngguò sān lún tánpàn, zhōngyú zài jiàgé shàng dáchéng le chūbù yízhì.
example.en: After three rounds of negotiation, the two sides finally reached initial agreement on the price.

example.zh: 科学家正在探索这种材料在医疗领域的应用。
example.py: Kēxuéjiā zhèngzài tànsuǒ zhè zhǒng cáiliào zài yīliáo lǐngyù de yìngyòng.
example.en: Scientists are exploring the applications of this material in the medical field.

example.zh: 专家们将在论坛上探讨城市老龄化带来的挑战。
example.py: Zhuānjiāmen jiāng zài lùntán shàng tàntǎo chéngshì lǎolínghuà dài lái de tiǎozhàn.
example.en: Experts will discuss the challenges brought by urban ageing at the forum.

example.zh: 这家公司允许员工弹性上班,以提高工作效率。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī yǔnxǔ yuángōng tánxìng shàngbān, yǐ tígāo gōngzuò xiàolǜ.
example.en: This company allows employees to work flexible hours to improve efficiency.

meaning: to pull out, to dig out

example.zh: 他从口袋里掏出一张皱巴巴的车票。
example.py: Tā cóng kǒudài lǐ tāo chū yì zhāng zhòubābā de chēpiào.
example.en: He pulled a crumpled ticket out of his pocket.

example.zh: 火警响起后,大家按照指示从安全通道逃了出去。
example.py: Huǒjǐng xiǎngqǐ hòu, dàjiā ànzhào zhǐshì cóng ānquán tōngdào táo le chūqu.
example.en: After the fire alarm sounded, everyone escaped through the emergency exit according to the instructions.

example.zh: 午餐套餐包括一份主菜、一碗汤和一杯饮料。
example.py: Wǔcān tàocān bāokuò yí fèn zhǔcài, yì wǎn tāng hé yì bēi yǐnliào.
example.en: The lunch set meal includes a main dish, a bowl of soup, and a drink.

example.zh: 嫌疑人试图从后门逃跑,却被警察及时拦住。
example.py: Xiányírén shìtú cóng hòumén táopǎo, què bèi jǐngchá jíshí lán zhù.
example.en: The suspect tried to run away through the back door, but was stopped by the police in time.

example.zh: 这个孩子虽然有点淘气,但心地很善良。
example.py: Zhège háizi suīrán yǒudiǎn táoqì, dàn xīndì hěn shànliáng.
example.en: Although this child is a bit naughty, he is very kind-hearted.

example.zh: 这家公司如果不及时创新,很快就会被市场淘汰。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī rúguǒ bù jíshí chuàngxīn, hěn kuài jiù huì bèi shìchǎng táotài.
example.en: If this company does not innovate in time, it will soon be eliminated by the market.

example.zh: 把基础工作做好,心里才会觉得踏实。
example.py: Bǎ jīchǔ gōngzuò zuò hǎo, xīnli cái huì juéde tāshi.
example.en: Only after doing the basic work well will you feel settled inside.

example.zh: 这条山路特窄,两辆车很难同时通过。
example.py: Zhè tiáo shānlù tè zhǎi, liǎng liàng chē hěn nán tóngshí tōngguò.
example.en: This mountain road is especially narrow, so it is hard for two cars to pass at the same time.

example.zh: 每个学生都有自己的特长,学校不应该只看考试成绩。
example.py: Měi ge xuésheng dōu yǒu zìjǐ de tècháng, xuéxiào bù yīnggāi zhǐ kàn kǎoshì chéngjì.
example.en: Every student has their own strengths, and schools should not look only at exam results.

example.zh: 他特地请了一天假,陪母亲去医院复查。
example.py: Tā tèdì qǐng le yì tiān jià, péi mǔqīn qù yīyuàn fùchá.
example.en: He specially took a day off to accompany his mother to the hospital for a follow-up check.

example.zh: 这项政策只适用于特定行业,并不影响普通消费者。

example.en: This policy applies only to specific industries and does not affect ordinary consumers.

example.zh: 这种植物的最大特性是能在干旱环境中存活。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù de zuì dà tèxìng shì néng zài gānhàn huánjìng zhōng cúnhuó.
example.en: The main characteristic of this plant is that it can survive in dry environments.

example.zh: 她特意把声音压低,免得吵醒正在睡觉的孩子。
example.py: Tā tèyì bǎ shēngyīn yā dī, miǎnde chǎo xǐng zhèngzài shuìjiào de háizi.
example.en: She deliberately lowered her voice so as not to wake the sleeping child.

example.zh: 她在汤里添了一点盐,味道立刻更自然了。
example.py: Tā zài tāng lǐ tiān le yì diǎn yán, wèidào lìkè gèng zìrán le.
example.en: She added a little salt to the soup, and the flavour immediately became more natural.

example.zh: 这片田经过多年耕作,土壤已经变得十分肥沃。
example.py: Zhè piàn tián jīngguò duō nián gēngzuò, tǔrǎng yǐjīng biàn de shífēn féiwò.
example.en: After many years of cultivation, this field’s soil has become very fertile.

example.zh: 他不是单靠天才成功的,背后还有长期训练。
example.py: Tā bú shì dān kào tiāncái chénggōng de, bèihòu hái yǒu chángqī xùnliàn.
example.en: He did not succeed through genius alone; there was long-term training behind it.

example.zh: 请在申请表中添加你的联系方式和紧急联系人。
example.py: Qǐng zài shēnqǐng biǎo zhōng tiānjiā nǐ de liánxì fāngshì hé jǐnjí liánxì rén.
example.en: Please add your contact details and emergency contact to the application form.

example.zh: 学校的田径队每天下午都在操场训练。
example.py: Xuéxiào de tiánjìng duì měi tiān xiàwǔ dōu zài cāochǎng xùnliàn.
example.en: The school’s track and field team trains on the sports ground every afternoon.

example.zh: 这种布料使用天然纤维,穿起来比较舒服。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng bùliào shǐyòng tiānrán xiānwéi, chuān qǐ lái bǐjiào shūfu.
example.en: This fabric uses natural fibres and feels relatively comfortable to wear.

example.zh: 许多城市正在逐步减少对天然气的依赖,转向更多可再生能源。
example.py: Xǔduō chéngshì zhèngzài zhúbù jiǎnshǎo duì tiānránqì de yīlài, zhuǎnxiàng gèng duō kě zàishēng néngyuán.
example.en: Many cities are gradually reducing their reliance on natural gas and turning to more renewable energy.

example.zh: 他小时候迷恋天文,常常半夜起来观察星空。
example.py: Tā xiǎoshíhou míliàn tiānwén, chángcháng bànyè qǐ lái guānchá xīngkōng.
example.en: He was fascinated by astronomy as a child and often got up at midnight to observe the stars.

example.zh: 他走遍天下,最后还是觉得家乡的饭菜最让人安心。
example.py: Tā zǒubiàn tiānxià, zuìhòu háishì juéde jiāxiāng de fàncài zuì ràng rén ānxīn.
example.en: He travelled all over the world, but in the end he still felt most comforted by the food of his hometown.

example.zh: 她的想法有些天真,但其中也包含真诚的善意。
example.py: Tā de xiǎngfǎ yǒuxiē tiānzhēn, dàn qízhōng yě bāohán zhēnchéng de shànyì.
example.en: Her idea is somewhat naive, but it also contains sincere kindness.

example.zh: 空调可以自动调节温度,保持室内舒适。
example.py: Kōngtiáo kěyǐ zìdòng tiáojié wēndù, bǎochí shìnèi shūshì.
example.en: The air conditioner can automatically adjust the temperature and keep the room comfortable.

example.zh: 他从十岁开始练跳水,动作一直非常稳定。
example.py: Tā cóng shí suì kāishǐ liàn tiàoshuǐ, dòngzuò yìzhí fēicháng wěndìng.
example.en: He has practised diving since the age of ten, and his movements have always been very steady.

example.zh: 这部纪录片的题材虽然沉重,却引发了广泛讨论。
example.py: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn de tícái suīrán chénzhòng, què yǐnfā le guǎngfàn tǎolùn.
example.en: The subject matter of this documentary is heavy, but it sparked wide discussion.

example.zh: 她从小练体操,所以身体的平衡能力特别强。
example.py: Tā cóng xiǎo liàn tǐcāo, suǒyǐ shēntǐ de pínghéng nénglì tèbié qiáng.
example.en: She has practised gymnastics since childhood, so her balance is particularly strong.

meaning: to press close to; close, intimate

example.zh: 这部纪录片贴近普通人的生活,所以很容易引起共鸣。
example.py: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn tiējìn pǔtōng rén de shēnghuó, suǒyǐ hěn róngyì yǐnqǐ gòngmíng.
example.en: This documentary is close to ordinary people’s lives, so it easily resonates with viewers.

example.zh: 这种设备体积小,适合安装在普通家庭里。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng shèbèi tǐjī xiǎo, shìhé ānzhuāng zài pǔtōng jiātíng lǐ.
example.en: This device is small in volume and is suitable for installation in ordinary homes.

example.zh: 这个孩子平时很听话,但今天显得有些不安。
example.py: Zhè ge háizi píngshí hěn tīnghuà, dàn jīntiān xiǎnde yǒuxiē bù'ān.
example.en: This child is usually very well-behaved, but today seems a little uneasy.

example.zh: 长期戴耳机音量过大,可能会逐渐损害听觉。
example.py: Chángqī dài ěrjī yīnliàng guò dà, kěnéng huì zhújiàn sǔnhài tīngjué.
example.en: Using earphones at too high a volume for a long time may gradually damage one’s sense of hearing.

example.zh: 领导在作出决定前,应该认真听取基层员工的意见。
example.py: Lǐngdǎo zài zuòchū juédìng qián, yīnggāi rènzhēn tīngqǔ jīcéng yuángōng de yìjiàn.
example.en: Before making a decision, leaders should carefully listen to the opinions of frontline employees.

example.zh: 研究人员从样本中提取了少量有效成分。
example.py: Yánjiū rényuán cóng yàngběn zhōng tíqǔ le shǎoliàng yǒuxiào chéngfèn.
example.en: The researchers extracted a small amount of active ingredients from the sample.

example.zh: 页面上的错误提示不够清楚,很多用户不知道该怎么操作。
example.py: Yèmiàn shàng de cuòwù tíshì bú gòu qīngchu, hěn duō yònghù bù zhīdào gāi zěnme cāozuò.
example.en: The error prompt on the page is not clear enough, so many users do not know what to do.

example.zh: 公司正在建立一套更完善的培训体系。
example.py: Gōngsī zhèngzài jiànlì yí tào gèng wánshàn de péixùn tǐxì.
example.en: The company is building a more complete training system.

example.zh: 这座雕像表面覆盖着一层铜,几年后颜色会慢慢变深。
example.py: Zhè zuò diāoxiàng biǎomiàn fùgài zhe yì céng tóng, jǐ nián hòu yánsè huì mànmàn biàn shēn.
example.en: The surface of this statue is covered with a layer of copper, and its colour will slowly darken after a few years.

example.zh: 登山时要随时留意同伴的体力,不能只顾自己向前走。
example.py: Dēngshān shí yào suíshí liúyì tóngbàn de tǐlì, bù néng zhǐ gù zìjǐ xiàng qián zǒu.
example.en: When climbing a mountain, you should always pay attention to your companion’s strength and not just push ahead yourself.

example.zh: 地铁站临时关闭了一条通道,乘客只能从东门进出。
example.py: Dìtiězhàn línshí guānbì le yì tiáo tōngdào, chéngkè zhǐ néng cóng dōngmén jìnchū.
example.en: The metro station temporarily closed one passage, so passengers could only enter and exit through the east gate.

example.zh: 新装修的房间至少要通风几周,再让孩子长期居住。
example.py: Xīn zhuāngxiū de fángjiān zhìshǎo yào tōngfēng jǐ zhōu, zài ràng háizi chángqī jūzhù.
example.en: A newly renovated room should be ventilated for at least several weeks before a child lives there long-term.

meaning: to work in the same profession; colleague

example.zh: 作为同行,他能理解我在这个行业里遇到的压力。
example.py: Zuòwéi tóngháng, tā néng lǐjiě wǒ zài zhège hángyè lǐ yùdào de yālì.
example.en: As a colleague in the same profession, he can understand the pressure I face in this industry.

example.zh: 这部动画改编自一则北欧童话,但加入了现代环保主题。
example.py: Zhè bù dònghuà gǎibiān zì yì zé Běi'ōu tónghuà, dàn jiārù le xiàndài huánbǎo zhǔtí.
example.en: This animation is adapted from a Nordic fairy tale, but it adds a modern environmental theme.

example.zh: 我们通话了将近两个小时,终于把误会解释清楚了。
example.py: Wǒmen tōnghuà le jiāngjìn liǎng ge xiǎoshí, zhōngyú bǎ wùhuì jiěshì qīngchu le.
example.en: We talked on the phone for nearly two hours and finally cleared up the misunderstanding.

example.zh: 把积压已久的问题说出来后,他感到十分痛快。
example.py: Bǎ jīyā yǐ jiǔ de wèntí shuō chūlái hòu, tā gǎndào shífēn tòngkuài.
example.en: After saying aloud the problem that had been building up for a long time, he felt greatly relieved.

example.zh: 这种药物与同类产品相比,副作用更小。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng yàowù yǔ tónglèi chǎnpǐn xiāngbǐ, fùzuòyòng gèng xiǎo.
example.en: Compared with similar products, this medicine has fewer side effects.

example.zh: 她在决赛中获得铜牌,赛后仍然激动得落泪。
example.py: Tā zài juésài zhōng huòdé tóngpái, sài hòu réngrán jīdòng de luòlèi.
example.en: She won a bronze medal in the final and was still moved to tears afterwards.

example.zh: 两家公司一直通过电子邮件通信,以便留下完整记录。
example.py: Liǎng jiā gōngsī yìzhí tōngguò diànzǐ yóujiàn tōngxìn, yǐbiàn liú xià wánzhěng jìlù.
example.en: The two companies have been communicating by email in order to leave a complete record.

example.zh: 灾区的通讯一度中断,家属无法确认亲人的情况。
example.py: Zāiqū de tōngxùn yídù zhōngduàn, jiāshǔ wúfǎ quèrèn qīnrén de qíngkuàng.
example.en: Communications in the disaster area were interrupted for a time, and families could not confirm their relatives’ situations.

example.zh: 这套安全标准在多个行业通用,执行起来比较方便。
example.py: Zhè tào ānquán biāozhǔn zài duō ge hángyè tōngyòng, zhíxíng qǐ lái bǐjiào fāngbiàn.
example.en: This set of safety standards is commonly used across several industries, making it fairly convenient to implement.

example.zh: 他承认自己偷了公司的资料,但拒绝说明动机。
example.py: Tā chéngrèn zìjǐ tōu le gōngsī de zīliào, dàn jùjué shuōmíng dòngjī.
example.en: He admitted that he had stolen the company’s materials, but refused to explain his motive.

meaning: to penetrate, to pass through; thorough

example.zh: 光线太强,窗帘几乎挡不住,阳光全透进来了。
example.py: Guāngxiàn tài qiáng, chuānglián jīhū dǎng bú zhù, yángguāng quán tòu jìnlai le.
example.en: The light is so strong that the curtains can hardly block it, and the sunlight is coming right through.

example.zh: 透过这组数据,我们能看到消费习惯正在发生变化。
example.py: Tòuguò zhè zǔ shùjù, wǒmen néng kàndào xiāofèi xíguàn zhèngzài fāshēng biànhuà.

example.zh: 经理在会议上透露,公司下半年可能会调整销售策略。

example.en: The manager revealed at the meeting that the company may adjust its sales strategy in the second half of the year.

example.zh: 这个机构承诺让预算使用更加透明,接受社会监督。
example.py: Zhège jīgòu chéngnuò ràng yùsuàn shǐyòng gèngjiā tòumíng, jiēshòu shèhuì jiāndū.
example.en: This organisation promises to make the use of its budget more transparent and accept public oversight.

example.zh: 面对复杂局面,领导者必须保持清醒的头脑。
example.py: Miànduì fùzá júmiàn, lǐngdǎo zhě bìxū bǎochí qīngxǐng de tóunǎo.
example.en: Facing a complex situation, a leader must keep a clear mind.

example.zh: 全体成员将在明天投票决定是否修改章程。
example.py: Quántǐ chéngyuán jiāng zài míngtiān tóupiào juédìng shìfǒu xiūgǎi zhāngchéng.
example.en: All members will vote tomorrow to decide whether to revise the charter.

example.zh: 如果服务长期没有改善,消费者有权正式投诉。
example.py: Rúguǒ fúwù chángqī méiyǒu gǎishàn, xiāofèi zhě yǒu quán zhèngshì tóusù.
example.en: If the service does not improve for a long time, consumers have the right to make a formal complaint.

example.zh: 他偷偷把资料备份到私人邮箱,后来受到处分。
example.py: Tā tōutōu bǎ zīliào bèifèn dào sīrén yóuxiāng, hòulái shòudào chǔfèn.
example.en: He secretly backed up the materials to a private email account and was later disciplined.

example.zh: 这家公司决定投资新能源项目,以降低未来的运营成本。
