example.en: This company has decided to invest in new energy projects in order to reduce future operating costs.

example.zh: 在公共场所随地吐口水既不卫生,也很不礼貌。
example.py: Zài gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ suídì tǔ kǒushuǐ jì bù wèishēng, yě hěn bù lǐmào.
example.en: Spitting in public places is both unhygienic and very impolite.

example.zh: 他晕车很严重,刚下车就吐了。
example.py: Tā yùnchē hěn yánzhòng, gāng xià chē jiù tù le.
example.en: He gets carsick badly and vomited as soon as he got out of the car.

example.zh: 这条围巾上的图案来自当地传统手工艺。
example.py: Zhè tiáo wéijīn shàng de tú'àn láizì dāngdì chuántǒng shǒugōngyì.
example.en: The pattern on this scarf comes from local traditional handicrafts.

example.zh: 面对困难时,团队越团结,解决问题的能力就越强。
example.py: Miànduì kùnnan shí, tuánduì yuè tuánjié, jiějué wèntí de nénglì jiù yuè qiáng.
example.en: When facing difficulties, the more united a team is, the stronger its ability to solve problems becomes.

example.zh: 这个团体长期关注儿童阅读和社区教育。
example.py: Zhège tuántǐ chángqī guānzhù értóng yuèdú hé shèqū jiàoyù.
example.en: This group has long focused on children’s reading and community education.

example.zh: 春节期间,许多人都会赶回家和亲人团圆。
example.py: Chūnjié qījiān, xǔduō rén dōu huì gǎn huí jiā hé qīnrén tuányuán.
example.en: During the Spring Festival, many people rush home to reunite with their relatives.

example.zh: 这份报告通过图表展示了近五年的收入变化。
example.py: Zhè fèn bàogào tōngguò túbiǎo zhǎnshì le jìn wǔ nián de shōurù biànhuà.
example.en: This report uses charts to show changes in income over the past five years.

example.zh: 老师傅对徒弟要求严格,希望他真正掌握基本功。
example.py: Lǎo shīfu duì túdì yāoqiú yángé, xīwàng tā zhēnzhèng zhǎngwò jīběngōng.
example.en: The old master is strict with his apprentice, hoping he will truly master the basic skills.

example.zh: 面对突发事件,学校必须及时通知家长并保护学生安全。
example.py: Miànduì tūfā shìjiàn, xuéxiào bìxū jíshí tōngzhī jiāzhǎng bìng bǎohù xuéshēng ānquán.
example.en: When facing a sudden incident, the school must promptly inform parents and protect students’ safety.

example.zh: 目前证据不足,警方只能根据现场情况进行推测。
example.py: Mùqián zhèngjù bùzú, jǐngfāng zhǐ néng gēnjù xiànchǎng qíngkuàng jìnxíng tuīcè.
example.en: At present there is not enough evidence, so the police can only speculate based on the situation at the scene.

example.zh: 出口企业需要按规定提交材料,才能办理退税。
example.py: Chūkǒu qǐyè xūyào àn guīdìng tíjiāo cáiliào, cái néng bànlǐ tuìshuì.
example.en: Export companies need to submit the required documents before they can process a tax refund.

example.zh: 他不喜欢那种夸大效果的推销方式。
example.py: Tā bù xǐhuān nà zhǒng kuādà xiàoguǒ de tuīxiāo fāngshì.
example.en: He does not like that kind of sales method that exaggerates the effects.

example.zh: 政府准备在全国范围内推行新的垃圾分类制度。
example.py: Zhèngfǔ zhǔnbèi zài quánguó fànwéi nèi tuīxíng xīn de lājī fēnlèi zhìdù.
example.en: The government plans to implement a new waste-sorting system nationwide.

example.zh: 解决这个问题不能只靠行政命令,还需要更稳定的法律途径。
example.py: Jiějué zhège wèntí bùnéng zhǐ kào xíngzhèng mìnglìng, hái xūyào gèng wěndìng de fǎlǜ tújìng.
example.en: Solving this problem cannot rely only on administrative orders; it also needs more stable legal channels.

example.zh: 他太饿了,几乎没嚼就把面包吞了下去。
example.py: Tā tài è le, jīhū méi jiáo jiù bǎ miànbāo tūn le xiàqu.
example.en: He was so hungry that he swallowed the bread almost without chewing.

example.zh: 他把沉重的行李一路拖到车站,累得满头是汗。
example.py: Tā bǎ chénzhòng de xíngli yílù tuō dào chēzhàn, lèi de mǎn tóu shì hàn.
example.en: He dragged the heavy luggage all the way to the station and was sweating heavily.

example.zh: 不及时处理小问题,只会拖延整个工程的进度。
example.py: Bù jíshí chǔlǐ xiǎo wèntí, zhǐ huì tuōyán zhěnggè gōngchéng de jìndù.
example.en: Failing to deal with small problems promptly will only delay the progress of the whole project.

example.zh: 这件行李太大,必须在柜台办理托运。
example.py: Zhè jiàn xíngli tài dà, bìxū zài guìtái bànlǐ tuōyùn.
example.en: This piece of luggage is too large and must be checked in at the counter.

example.zh: 科研团队在电池技术上取得了重要突破。
example.py: Kēyán tuánduì zài diànchí jìshù shàng qǔdé le zhòngyào tūpò.
example.en: The research team has made an important breakthrough in battery technology.

example.zh: 长期使用化学肥料,可能会改变土壤的结构。
example.py: Chángqī shǐyòng huàxué féiliào, kěnéng huì gǎibiàn tǔrǎng de jiégòu.
example.en: Long-term use of chemical fertilisers may change the structure of the soil.

example.zh: 医生根据图像判断伤口是否已经影响到骨头。
example.py: Yīshēng gēnjù túxiàng pànduàn shāngkǒu shìfǒu yǐjīng yǐngxiǎng dào gǔtou.
example.en: The doctor judged from the image whether the wound had already affected the bone.

example.zh: 哇,这座图书馆比照片里看起来还要壮观。
example.py: Wā, zhè zuò túshūguǎn bǐ zhàopiàn lǐ kàn qǐlai hái yào zhuàngguān.
example.en: Wow, this library looks even more magnificent than it does in the photos.

example.zh: 工人沿着道路挖了一条沟,准备铺设新的管道。
example.py: Gōngrén yánzhe dàolù wā le yì tiáo gōu, zhǔnbèi pūshè xīn de guǎndào.
example.en: The workers dug a ditch along the road to prepare for laying new pipes.

example.zh: 墙上的画挂歪了,看起来有点不舒服。
example.py: Qiáng shang de huà guà wāi le, kàn qǐlai yǒudiǎn bù shūfu.
example.en: The picture on the wall is hanging crooked, which looks a bit uncomfortable.

example.zh: 他的外表看起来很冷淡,其实内心十分热情。
example.py: Tā de wàibiǎo kàn qǐlai hěn lěngdàn, qíshí nèixīn shífēn rèqíng.
example.en: His appearance seems rather cold, but in fact he is very warm-hearted inside.

example.zh: 两国通过外交渠道解决了边境地区的争议。
example.py: Liǎng guó tōngguò wàijiāo qúdào jiějué le biānjìng dìqū de zhēngyì.
example.en: The two countries resolved the border-area dispute through diplomatic channels.

example.zh: 公司暂时拒绝向外界透露收购的具体金额。
example.py: Gōngsī zànshí jùjué xiàng wàijiè tòulù shōugòu de jùtǐ jīn'é.
example.en: The company has temporarily refused to reveal the specific acquisition amount to the outside world.

example.zh: 这家医院的外科技术在当地很有名。
example.py: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de wàikē jìshù zài dāngdì hěn yǒumíng.
example.en: The surgical techniques of this hospital are very well known locally.

example.zh: 外来物种如果没有天敌,可能会破坏本地生态平衡。
example.py: Wàilái wùzhǒng rúguǒ méiyǒu tiāndí, kěnéng huì pòhuài běndì shēngtài pínghéng.
example.en: If an introduced species has no natural enemies, it may damage the local ecological balance.

example.zh: 我外甥今年上小学,已经能自己读简单的故事书了。
example.py: Wǒ wàisheng jīnnián shàng xiǎoxué, yǐjīng néng zìjǐ dú jiǎndān de gùshìshū le.
example.en: My nephew is in primary school this year and can already read simple storybooks by himself.

example.zh: 她站在窗前,静静地望着远处的海面。
example.py: Tā zhàn zài chuāng qián, jìngjìng de wàng zhe yuǎnchù de hǎimiàn.
example.en: She stood by the window, quietly gazing at the sea in the distance.

example.zh: 这家公司正在建立覆盖全国的物流网,以便更快地配送商品。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhèngzài jiànlì fùgài quánguó de wùliú wǎng, yǐbiàn gèng kuài de pèisòng shāngpǐn.
example.en: The company is building a nationwide logistics network in order to deliver goods more quickly.

example.zh: 往后遇到类似问题,你可以先查资料,再决定怎么处理。
example.py: Wǎnghòu yùdào lèisì wèntí, nǐ kěyǐ xiān chá zīliào, zài juédìng zěnme chǔlǐ.
example.en: From now on, when you encounter similar problems, you can check the information first and then decide how to handle them.

example.zh: 两地之间的商务往来日益频繁,航班也增加了不少。
example.py: Liǎng dì zhījiān de shāngwù wǎnglái rìyì pínfán, hángbān yě zēngjiā le bùshǎo.
example.en: Business exchanges between the two places are becoming more frequent, and quite a few flights have been added.

example.zh: 与往年相比,今年报名参加考试的人数明显增加。
example.py: Yǔ wǎngnián xiāngbǐ, jīnnián bàomíng cānjiā kǎoshì de rénshù míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
example.en: Compared with previous years, the number of people signing up for the exam has clearly increased this year.

example.zh: 童话里的王子总是在最后一刻出现,解决所有困难。
example.py: Tónghuà lǐ de wángzǐ zǒng shì zài zuìhòu yí kè chūxiàn, jiějué suǒyǒu kùnnán.
example.en: The prince in fairy tales always appears at the last moment and solves all the difficulties.

example.zh: 这支球队在落后的情况下表现得十分顽强。
example.py: Zhè zhī qiúduì zài luòhòu de qíngkuàng xià biǎoxiàn de shífēn wánqiáng.
example.en: This team showed great tenacity while falling behind.

example.zh: 这条山路十分弯曲,新手开车时要特别小心。
example.py: Zhè tiáo shānlù shífēn wānqū, xīnshǒu kāichē shí yào tèbié xiǎoxīn.
example.en: This mountain road is very winding, so new drivers need to be especially careful.

example.zh: 春雨过后,万物似乎都重新有了生机。
example.py: Chūnyǔ guòhòu, wànwù sìhū dōu chóngxīn yǒu le shēngjī.
example.en: After the spring rain, all things seem to have regained vitality.

example.zh: 这个布娃娃虽然旧了,却一直陪着她长大。
example.py: Zhège bù wáwa suīrán jiù le, què yìzhí péizhe tā zhǎngdà.
example.en: Although this cloth doll is old, it has accompanied her throughout her childhood.

example.zh: 这份报告尚未提交,经理已经开始催了。
example.py: Zhè fèn bàogào shàng wèi tíjiāo, jīnglǐ yǐjīng kāishǐ cuī le.
example.en: This report has not yet been submitted, and the manager has already started urging them.

example.zh: 价格高的产品未必适合所有用户。
example.py: Jiàgé gāo de chǎnpǐn wèibì shìhé suǒyǒu yònghù.
example.en: An expensive product is not necessarily suitable for every user.

example.zh: 平台必须保护未成年人的个人信息。
example.py: Píngtái bìxū bǎohù wèichéngniánrén de gèrén xìnxī.
example.en: The platform must protect minors’ personal information.

example.zh: 生产成本不断上升,为此公司决定调整价格。
example.py: Shēngchǎn chéngběn búduàn shàngshēng, wèicǐ gōngsī juédìng tiáozhěng jiàgé.
example.en: Production costs kept rising, so the company decided to adjust its prices.

example.zh: 任何违规操作都必须记录,并向主管汇报。
example.py: Rènhé wéiguī cāozuò dōu bìxū jìlù, bìng xiàng zhǔguǎn huìbào.
example.en: Any rule-breaking operation must be recorded and reported to a supervisor.

example.zh: 他为何突然改变计划,会上没有人说明。
example.py: Tā wèihé tūrán gǎibiàn jìhuà, huì shàng méi yǒu rén shuōmíng.
example.en: No one at the meeting explained why he suddenly changed the plan.

example.zh: 工程师每周都会维护系统,确保数据安全。
example.py: Gōngchéngshī měi zhōu dōu huì wéihù xìtǒng, quèbǎo shùjù ānquán.
example.en: Engineers maintain the system every week to ensure data security.

example.zh: 企业如果不能及时调整,可能会陷入严重的经营危机。
example.py: Qǐyè rúguǒ bù néng jíshí tiáozhěng, kěnéng huì xiànrù yánzhòng de jīngyíng wēijī.
example.en: If an enterprise cannot adjust in time, it may fall into a serious business crisis.

example.zh: 感冒以后,他的味觉变得不太灵敏。
example.py: Gǎnmào yǐhòu, tā de wèijué biàn de bú tài língmǐn.
example.en: After catching a cold, his sense of taste became less sensitive.

example.zh: 天气太热时,很多人的胃口都会下降。
example.py: Tiānqì tài rè shí, hěn duō rén de wèikǒu dōu huì xiàjiàng.
example.en: When the weather is too hot, many people's appetite drops.

example.zh: 这个要求让工作人员很为难,因为规定并不允许例外。
example.py: Zhège yāoqiú ràng gōngzuò rényuán hěn wéinán, yīnwèi guīdìng bìng bù yǔnxǔ lìwài.
example.en: This request put the staff in a difficult position because the rules do not allow exceptions.

meaning: to be scheduled for, to last

example.zh: 公司安排了一次为期两周的海外培训。
example.py: Gōngsī ānpái le yí cì wéiqī liǎng zhōu de hǎiwài péixùn.
example.en: The company arranged an overseas training course lasting two weeks.

example.zh: 爷爷年轻时学过围棋,现在还经常和邻居下棋。
example.py: Yéye niánqīng shí xué guò wéiqí, xiànzài hái jīngcháng hé línjū xià qí.
example.en: Grandad learnt Go when he was young and still often plays with his neighbours.

example.zh: 她明明做了很多工作,却被批评得很委屈。
example.py: Tā míngmíng zuò le hěn duō gōngzuò, què bèi pīpíng de hěn wěiqu.
example.en: She had clearly done a lot of work, yet she felt very wronged after being criticised.

example.zh: 医生建议他多吃蔬菜,以补充维生素。
example.py: Yīshēng jiànyì tā duō chī shūcài, yǐ bǔchōng wéishēngsù.
example.en: The doctor advised him to eat more vegetables to get more vitamins.

example.zh: 客户委托律师处理合同纠纷。
example.py: Kèhù wěituō lǜshī chǔlǐ hétong jiūfēn.
example.en: The client entrusted a lawyer to handle the contract dispute.

example.zh: 实验中的微小变化都可能影响最终结果。
example.py: Shíyàn zhōng de wēixiǎo biànhuà dōu kěnéng yǐngxiǎng zuìzhōng jiéguǒ.
example.en: Even tiny changes in an experiment can affect the final result.

example.zh: 到目前为止,项目进展比预期顺利。
example.py: Dào mùqián wéizhǐ, xiàngmù jìnzhǎn bǐ yùqī shùnlì.
example.en: So far, the project has progressed more smoothly than expected.

example.zh: 请把会议纪要整理成正式文档。
example.py: Qǐng bǎ huìyì jìyào zhěnglǐ chéng zhèngshì wéndàng.
example.en: Please organise the meeting minutes into a formal document.

example.zh: 这位教授态度温和,但要求非常严格。
example.py: Zhè wèi jiàoshòu tàidu wēnhé, dàn yāoqiú fēicháng yángé.
example.en: This professor has a gentle manner, but his standards are very strict.

example.zh: 开学前,家长们忙着给孩子准备文具。
example.py: Kāixué qián, jiāzhǎngmen máng zhe gěi háizi zhǔnbèi wénjù.
example.en: Before school starts, parents are busy preparing stationery for their children.

example.zh: 他高中选择了文科,后来读了法律。
example.py: Tā gāozhōng xuǎnzé le wénkē, hòulái dú le fǎlǜ.
example.en: He chose liberal arts in senior secondary school and later studied law.

example.zh: 排队是一种基本的文明习惯。
example.py: Páiduì shì yì zhǒng jīběn de wénmíng xíguàn.
example.en: Queuing is a basic civilised habit.

example.zh: 这座小城因古老的桥梁而闻名。
example.py: Zhè zuò xiǎochéng yīn gǔlǎo de qiáoliáng ér wénmíng.
example.en: This small city is famous for its ancient bridges.

example.zh: 她说话温柔,却很有原则。
example.py: Tā shuōhuà wēnróu, què hěn yǒu yuánzé.
example.en: She speaks gently, yet she has strong principles.

example.zh: 这件文物虽然残缺,却记录了重要的历史信息。
example.py: Zhè jiàn wénwù suīrán cánquē, què jìlù le zhòngyào de lìshǐ xìnxī.
example.en: Although this cultural relic is incomplete, it records important historical information.

example.zh: 写论文前,学生必须查阅大量相关文献。
example.py: Xiě lùnwén qián, xuésheng bìxū cháyuè dàliàng xiāngguān wénxiàn.
example.en: Before writing a thesis, students must consult a large amount of relevant literature.

example.zh: 学校每年都会举办文艺演出,鼓励学生展示才华。
example.py: Xuéxiào měi nián dōu huì jǔbàn wényì yǎnchū, gǔlì xuésheng zhǎnshì cáihuá.
example.en: The school holds a literary and artistic performance every year to encourage students to show their talents.

example.zh: 我误把他的沉默理解成了反对。
example.py: Wǒ wù bǎ tā de chénmò lǐjiě chéng le fǎnduì.
example.en: I mistakenly understood his silence as opposition.

example.zh: 这只乌龟动作很慢,却总能找到安全的地方。
example.py: Zhè zhī wūguī dòngzuò hěn màn, què zǒng néng zhǎodào ānquán de dìfang.
example.en: This tortoise moves slowly, but it can always find a safe place.

example.zh: 如果不及时说明,双方的误解会越来越深。
example.py: Rúguǒ bù jíshí shuōmíng, shuāngfāng de wùjiě huì yuè lái yuè shēn.
example.en: Without a timely explanation, the misunderstanding between the two sides will deepen.

example.zh: 博物馆展示了古代士兵使用过的武器。
example.py: Bówùguǎn zhǎnshì le gǔdài shìbīng shǐyòng guo de wǔqì.
example.en: The museum displays weapons once used by ancient soldiers.

example.zh: 未经处理的污水不能直接排入河流。
example.py: Wèi jīng chǔlǐ de wūshuǐ bù néng zhíjiē pái rù héliú.
example.en: Untreated sewage must not be discharged directly into rivers.

meaning: to be indifferent, not to matter

example.zh: 你选择哪一天开会,我都无所谓。
example.py: Nǐ xuǎnzé nǎ yì tiān kāihuì, wǒ dōu wúsuǒwèi.
example.en: Whichever day you choose for the meeting, I do not mind.

example.zh: 这个物体的表面很光滑,几乎看不出任何接缝。
example.py: Zhège wùtǐ de biǎomiàn hěn guānghuá, jīhū kàn bù chū rènhé jiēfèng.
example.en: The surface of this object is very smooth, and hardly any seams can be seen.

example.zh: 这次合作无疑会提升公司的国际影响力。
example.py: Zhè cì hézuò wúyí huì tíshēng gōngsī de guójì yǐngxiǎnglì.
example.en: This cooperation will undoubtedly enhance the company's international influence.

example.zh: 别突然从门后出来吓孩子,他会哭的。
example.py: Bié tūrán cóng mén hòu chūlai xià háizi, tā huì kū de.
example.en: Do not suddenly come out from behind the door to frighten the child; he will cry.

example.zh: 顾客下单后,系统会自动发送确认邮件。
example.py: Gùkè xiàdān hòu, xìtǒng huì zìdòng fāsòng quèrèn yóujiàn.
example.en: After a customer places an order, the system will automatically send a confirmation email.

meaning: to put in effort, to work hard

example.zh: 要把发音练准,必须在声调上下功夫。
example.py: Yào bǎ fāyīn liàn zhǔn, bìxū zài shēngdiào shang xià gōngfu.
example.en: To get pronunciation accurate, you must put effort into the tones.

example.zh: 这个夏令营把科学实验和户外活动结合起来。
example.py: Zhège xiàlìngyíng bǎ kēxué shíyàn hé hùwài huódòng jiéhé qǐlai.
example.en: This summer camp combines science experiments with outdoor activities.

example.zh: 他嫌房间太吵,要求换到安静一点的楼层。
example.py: Tā xián fángjiān tài chǎo, yāoqiú huàn dào ānjìng yìdiǎn de lóucéng.
example.en: He found the room too noisy and asked to move to a quieter floor.

example.zh: 这次调整效果不显,需要继续观察几个月。
example.py: Zhè cì tiáozhěng xiàoguǒ bù xiǎn, xūyào jìxù guānchá jǐ ge yuè.
example.en: The effect of this adjustment is not obvious and needs to be observed for a few more months.

meaning: thread, line; measure word for lines

example.zh: 这条线代表去年销售额的变化趋势。
example.py: Zhè tiáo xiàn dàibiǎo qùnián xiāoshòu'é de biànhuà qūshì.
example.en: This line represents the trend in last year’s sales.

example.zh: 影院规定每人限购两张特价票。
example.py: Yǐngyuàn guīdìng měi rén xiàngòu liǎng zhāng tèjià piào.
example.en: The cinema stipulates that each person is limited to buying two discounted tickets.

example.zh: 山路又窄又险,司机必须放慢速度。
example.py: Shānlù yòu zhǎi yòu xiǎn, sījī bìxū fàng màn sùdù.
example.en: The mountain road is narrow and dangerous, so drivers must slow down.

example.zh: 现存资料不足以证明这个判断完全正确。
example.py: Xiàncún zīliào bù zúyǐ zhèngmíng zhège pànduàn wánquán zhèngquè.
example.en: The existing materials are insufficient to prove that this judgement is completely correct.

example.zh: 忍耐也有一定限度,长期加班会影响健康。
example.py: Rěnnài yě yǒu yídìng xiàndù, chángqī jiābān huì yǐngxiǎng jiànkāng.
example.en: Tolerance also has a certain limit; long-term overtime affects health.

example.zh: 两个方案的成本相差不大,但执行难度完全不同。
example.py: Liǎng ge fāng'àn de chéngběn xiāngchà bù dà, dàn zhíxíng nándù wánquán bùtóng.
example.en: The costs of the two plans do not differ much, but their difficulty of implementation is completely different.

example.zh: 这家店的香肠味道很重,最好配一些清淡的蔬菜。
example.py: Zhè jiā diàn de xiāngcháng wèidào hěn zhòng, zuìhǎo pèi yìxiē qīngdàn de shūcài.
example.en: The sausages in this shop have a strong flavour, so they are best paired with some light vegetables.

meaning: to hand down, to pass on

example.zh: 相传这座古桥是几百年前由当地工匠建成的。
example.py: Xiāngchuán zhè zuò gǔqiáo shì jǐ bǎi nián qián yóu dāngdì gōngjiàng jiànchéng de.
example.en: It is said that this ancient bridge was built hundreds of years ago by local craftsmen.

example.zh: 合同规定,双方的权利和责任基本相等。
example.py: Hétong guīdìng, shuāngfāng de quánlì hé zérèn jīběn xiāngděng.
example.en: The contract states that the rights and responsibilities of both parties are basically equal.

example.zh: 两座城市由一条高速铁路相连,往来十分方便。
example.py: Liǎng zuò chéngshì yóu yì tiáo gāosù tiělù xiānglián, wǎnglái shífēn fāngbiàn.
example.en: The two cities are connected by a high-speed railway, making travel between them very convenient.

example.zh: 她把那条项链锁进保险箱,因为它是母亲留下的纪念品。
example.py: Tā bǎ nà tiáo xiàngliàn suǒ jìn bǎoxiǎnxiāng, yīnwèi tā shì mǔqīn liú xià de jìniànpǐn.
example.en: She locked that necklace in the safe because it was a keepsake left by her mother.

example.zh: 爷爷每天傍晚都在小区门口和邻居下象棋。
example.py: Yéye měitiān bàngwǎn dōu zài shèqū ménkǒu hé línjū xià xiàngqí.
example.en: Every evening, Grandpa plays Chinese chess with neighbours at the entrance of the community.

example.zh: 那段相声把日常生活中的矛盾说得很幽默。
example.py: Nà duàn xiàngsheng bǎ rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng de máodùn shuō de hěn yōumò.
example.en: That crosstalk routine described conflicts in daily life in a very humorous way.

example.zh: 她不喜欢味道太浓的香水,觉得在办公室不太合适。
example.py: Tā bù xǐhuan wèidào tài nóng de xiāngshuǐ, juéde zài bàngōngshì bù tài héshì.
example.en: She does not like perfume with too strong a scent, and feels it is not very suitable for the office.

example.zh: 他一直向往一种更自由的生活方式。
example.py: Tā yìzhí xiàngwǎng yì zhǒng gèng zìyóu de shēnghuó fāngshì.
example.en: He has always yearned for a freer way of life.

example.zh: 政策调整后,企业需要制定相应的培训计划。
example.py: Zhèngcè tiáozhěng hòu, qǐyè xūyào zhìdìng xiāngyìng de péixùn jìhuà.
example.en: After the policy adjustment, companies need to develop corresponding training plans.

example.zh: 这款相机目前没有现货,需要等两周才能发货。
example.py: Zhè kuǎn xiàngjī mùqián méiyǒu xiànhuò, xūyào děng liǎng zhōu cáinéng fāhuò.
example.en: This camera is currently not in stock and will take two weeks to dispatch.

example.zh: 这部纪录片立场鲜明,却没有忽视复杂的事实。
example.py: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn lìchǎng xiānmíng, què méiyǒu hūshì fùzá de shìshí.
example.en: This documentary has a clear standpoint, yet it does not ignore complicated facts.

example.zh: 先前提交的材料不完整,需要重新补充证明。
example.py: Xiānqián tíjiāo de cáiliào bù wánzhěng, xūyào chóngxīn bǔchōng zhèngmíng.
example.en: The materials submitted previously were incomplete, so supporting evidence needs to be added again.

meaning: to fall into, to be caught in

example.zh: 如果缺乏清晰的目标,团队很容易陷入无休止的讨论。
example.py: Rúguǒ quēfá qīngxī de mùbiāo, tuánduì hěn róngyì xiànrù wúxiūzhǐ de tǎolùn.
example.en: If there is no clear goal, the team can easily fall into endless discussion.

example.zh: 这条线索虽然很小,却帮助警方找到了关键证人。
example.py: Zhè tiáo xiànsuǒ suīrán hěn xiǎo, què bāngzhù jǐngfāng zhǎodào le guānjiàn zhèngrén.
example.en: Although this clue was small, it helped the police find a key witness.

example.zh: 春天的花坛颜色鲜艳,吸引了不少游客拍照。
example.py: Chūntiān de huātán yánsè xiānyàn, xīyǐn le bù shǎo yóukè pāizhào.
example.en: In spring, the flowerbeds are brightly coloured and attract many visitors to take photos.

example.zh: 由于时间有限,今天的讨论只能限于预算问题。
example.py: Yóuyú shíjiān yǒuxiàn, jīntiān de tǎolùn zhǐ néng xiànyú yùsuàn wèntí.
example.en: Because time is limited, today's discussion can only be limited to budget issues.

example.zh: 新药在降低血压方面取得了显著效果。
example.py: Xīn yào zài jiàngdī xuèyā fāngmiàn qǔdé le xiǎnzhù xiàoguǒ.
example.en: The new drug achieved a significant effect in lowering blood pressure.

example.zh: 这项改革旨在消除城乡之间的教育差距。
example.py: Zhè xiàng gǎigé zhǐ zài xiāochú chéngxiāng zhījiān de jiàoyù chājù.
example.en: This reform aims to eliminate the education gap between urban and rural areas.

example.zh: 进入实验室前,所有工具都必须彻底消毒。
example.py: Jìnrù shíyànshì qián, suǒyǒu gōngjù dōu bìxū chèdǐ xiāodú.
example.en: Before entering the laboratory, all tools must be thoroughly disinfected.

example.zh: 商场每半年都会组织一次消防演练。
example.py: Shāngchǎng měi bàn nián dōu huì zǔzhī yí cì xiāofáng yǎnliàn.
example.en: The shopping centre organises a fire drill once every six months.

example.zh: 长时间开空调会消耗大量电力。
example.py: Cháng shíjiān kāi kōngtiáo huì xiāohào dàliàng diànlì.
example.en: Running the air conditioner for a long time consumes a large amount of electricity.

example.zh: 今年的干旱影响了小麦产量,农民很担心。
example.py: Jīnnián de gānhàn yǐngxiǎng le xiǎomài chǎnliàng, nóngmín hěn dānxīn.
example.en: This year's drought affected the wheat yield, and the farmers are very worried.

example.zh: 农民希望用更环保的方法消灭害虫。
example.py: Nóngmín xīwàng yòng gèng huánbǎo de fāngfǎ xiāomiè hàichóng.
example.en: Farmers hope to eliminate pests using more environmentally friendly methods.

example.zh: 他并不是小气,只是觉得这笔费用没有必要。
example.py: Tā bìng bú shì xiǎoqi, zhǐshì juéde zhè bǐ fèiyòng méiyǒu bìyào.
example.en: He is not being stingy; he just thinks this expense is unnecessary.

example.zh: 听到录取消息后,她脸上露出了久违的笑容。
example.py: Tīngdào lùqǔ xiāoxi hòu, tā liǎn shàng lùchū le jiǔwéi de xiàoróng.
example.en: After hearing the news of her admission, a long-absent smile appeared on her face.

example.zh: 警察很快抓住了那个在车站偷钱包的小偷儿。
example.py: Jǐngchá hěn kuài zhuāzhù le nà ge zài chēzhàn tōu qiánbāo de xiǎotōur.
example.en: The police quickly caught the thief who had stolen wallets at the station.

example.zh: 这项政策的长期效应还需要进一步观察。
example.py: Zhè xiàng zhèngcè de chángqī xiàoyìng hái xūyào jìnyíbù guānchá.
example.en: The long-term effect of this policy still needs further observation.

example.zh: 会议结束后,请把测试账号及时下线。
example.py: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, qǐng bǎ cèshì zhànghào jíshí xiàxiàn.
example.en: After the meeting ends, please take the test account offline promptly.

example.zh: 新规定预计五月下旬正式公布。
example.py: Xīn guīdìng yùjì wǔ yuè xiàxún zhèngshì gōngbù.
example.en: The new regulations are expected to be officially announced in late May.

example.zh: 科学家正在研究这种药物对癌细胞的影响。
example.py: Kēxuéjiā zhèngzài yánjiū zhè zhǒng yàowù duì ái xìbāo de yǐngxiǎng.
example.en: Scientists are studying the effect of this drug on cancer cells.

example.zh: 连续开了四个小时车,他决定在服务区歇一会儿。
example.py: Liánxù kāi le sì ge xiǎoshí chē, tā juédìng zài fúwùqū xiē yíhuìr.
example.en: After driving for four hours in a row, he decided to rest for a while at the service area.

example.zh: 乘客不得携带危险品进入地铁站。
example.py: Chéngkè bùdé xiédài wēixiǎnpǐn jìnrù dìtiězhàn.
example.en: Passengers may not carry dangerous goods into the underground station.

example.zh: 行业协会发布了新的服务标准,要求会员单位认真执行。
example.py: Hángyè xiéhuì fābù le xīn de fúwù biāozhǔn, yāoqiú huìyuán dānwèi rènzhēn zhíxíng.
example.en: The industry association issued new service standards and required member organisations to implement them carefully.

example.zh: 项目经理需要协调各部门的进度,避免资源浪费。
example.py: Xiàngmù jīnglǐ xūyào xiétiáo gè bùmén de jìndù, bìmiǎn zīyuán làngfèi.
example.en: The project manager needs to coordinate the progress of all departments to avoid wasting resources.

example.zh: 警方请求市民协助寻找失踪儿童。
example.py: Jǐngfāng qǐngqiú shìmín xiézhù xúnzhǎo shīzōng értóng.
example.en: The police asked citizens to assist in searching for the missing child.

example.zh: 她的媳妇在医院工作,平时很少有完整的周末。
example.py: Tā de xífu zài yīyuàn gōngzuò, píngshí hěn shǎo yǒu wánzhěng de zhōumò.
example.en: Her daughter-in-law works at a hospital and rarely has a full weekend off.

example.zh: 这部喜剧表面轻松,实际上讨论了很现实的社会问题。
example.py: Zhè bù xǐjù biǎomiàn qīngsōng, shíjì shàng tǎolùn le hěn xiànshí de shèhuì wèntí.
example.en: This comedy seems light on the surface, but actually discusses very real social issues.

example.zh: 高温可以杀死部分细菌,降低食物中毒的风险。
example.py: Gāowēn kěyǐ shāsǐ bùfen xìjūn, jiàngdī shíwù zhòngdú de fēngxiǎn.
example.en: High temperatures can kill some bacteria and reduce the risk of food poisoning.

example.zh: 出版社计划推出一系列面向青少年的科普读物。
example.py: Chūbǎnshè jìhuà tuīchū yì xìliè miànxiàng qīngshàonián de kēpǔ dúwù.
example.en: The publisher plans to release a series of popular science books for teenagers.

example.zh: 她把心爱的书包送给了刚上小学的妹妹。
example.py: Tā bǎ xīn'ài de shūbāo sòng gěi le gāng shàng xiǎoxué de mèimei.
example.en: She gave her beloved schoolbag to her younger sister, who had just started primary school.

example.zh: 他心底一直记得那位老师当年的鼓励。
example.py: Tā xīndǐ yìzhí jìde nà wèi lǎoshī dāngnián de gǔlì.
example.en: Deep in his heart, he has always remembered that teacher's encouragement from those years.

example.zh: 购买配件前,请先确认设备的具体型号。
example.py: Gòumǎi pèijiàn qián, qǐng xiān quèrèn shèbèi de jùtǐ xínghào.
example.en: Before buying accessories, please first confirm the exact model of the device.

example.zh: 如果预算有限,这款电脑的性价比确实很高。
example.py: Rúguǒ yùsuàn yǒuxiàn, zhè kuǎn diànnǎo de xìngjiàbǐ quèshí hěn gāo.
example.en: If your budget is limited, this computer really offers good value for money.

example.zh: 新系统上线后,服务器的性能明显提升了。
example.py: Xīn xìtǒng shàngxiàn hòu, sìfúqì de xìngnéng míngxiǎn tíshēng le.
example.en: After the new system went online, the server's performance improved significantly.

example.zh: 近几年,远程办公在许多行业迅速兴起。
example.py: Jìn jǐ nián, yuǎnchéng bàngōng zài xǔduō hángyè xùnsù xīngqǐ.
example.en: In recent years, remote working has rapidly risen in many industries.

example.zh: 城市的商业形态正在随着消费习惯的变化而调整。
example.py: Chéngshì de shāngyè xíngtài zhèngzài suízhe xiāofèi xíguàn de biànhuà ér tiáozhěng.
example.en: The commercial forms of the city are adjusting as consumption habits change.

example.zh: 这家店刚推出新款手机,价格比上一代高不少。
example.py: Zhè jiā diàn gāng tuīchū xīnkuǎn shǒujī, jiàgé bǐ shàng yí dài gāo bù shǎo.
example.en: This shop has just launched a new phone model, and the price is quite a bit higher than the previous generation.

example.zh: 只有长期保持透明,企业才能赢得消费者的信赖。
example.py: Zhǐyǒu chángqī bǎochí tòumíng, qǐyè cái néng yíngdé xiāofèizhě de xìnlài.
example.en: Only by remaining transparent over the long term can a company win consumers' trust.

example.zh: 音乐能安慰人的心灵,尤其是在压力很大的时候。
example.py: Yīnyuè néng ānwèi rén de xīnlíng, yóuqí shì zài yālì hěn dà de shíhou.
example.en: Music can comfort the human heart, especially at times of great pressure.

example.zh: 新媒体改变了公众获取新闻的方式。
example.py: Xīnméitǐ gǎibiàn le gōngzhòng huòqǔ xīnwén de fāngshì.
example.en: New media has changed the way the public obtains news.

example.zh: 在很多学生心目中,他是一位严格但公平的老师。
example.py: Zài hěn duō xuésheng xīnmù zhōng, tā shì yí wèi yángé dàn gōngpíng de lǎoshī.
example.en: In the minds of many students, he is a strict but fair teacher.

example.zh: 新能源汽车的普及正在改变传统能源结构。
example.py: Xīnnéngyuán qìchē de pǔjí zhèngzài gǎibiàn chuántǒng néngyuán jiégòu.
example.en: The spread of new-energy vehicles is changing the traditional energy structure.

example.zh: 面对连续失败,他依然没有放弃最初的信念。
example.py: Miànduì liánxù shībài, tā yīrán méiyǒu fàngqì zuìchū de xìnniàn.
example.en: Facing repeated failures, he still did not give up his original belief.

example.zh: 这份工作的薪水不高,但学习机会很多。
example.py: Zhè fèn gōngzuò de xīnshui bù gāo, dàn xuéxí jīhuì hěn duō.
example.en: The salary for this job is not high, but there are many learning opportunities.

example.zh: 看到孩子累得说不出话来,母亲十分心疼。
example.py: Kàndào háizi lèi de shuō bù chū huà lái, mǔqīn shífēn xīnténg.
example.en: Seeing the child so tired that he could not speak, his mother felt very distressed.

example.zh: 新兴行业往往需要更灵活的管理方式。
example.py: Xīnxīng hángyè wǎngwǎng xūyào gèng línghuó de guǎnlǐ fāngshì.
example.en: Emerging industries often need more flexible management methods.

example.zh: 这个广告的角度很新颖,难怪能引起讨论。
example.py: Zhège guǎnggào de jiǎodù hěn xīnyǐng, nánguài néng yǐnqǐ tǎolùn.
example.en: The angle of this advertisement is very novel, so it is no wonder it can spark discussion.

example.zh: 她最大的心愿,是让父母安心地过上更轻松的生活。
example.py: Tā zuì dà de xīnyuàn, shì ràng fùmǔ ānxīn de guò shàng gèng qīngsōng de shēnghuó.
example.en: Her greatest wish is to let her parents live a more relaxed life with peace of mind.

example.zh: 长期缺乏运动会增加心脏负担,也会影响整体健康。
example.py: Chángqī quēfá yùndòng huì zēngjiā xīnzàng fùdān, yě huì yǐngxiǎng zhěngtǐ jiànkāng.
example.en: A long-term lack of exercise can increase the burden on the heart and affect overall health.

example.zh: 他深吸一口气,感觉胸里的压力终于轻了一些。
example.py: Tā shēn xī yì kǒu qì, gǎnjué xiōng lǐ de yālì zhōngyú qīng le yìxiē.
example.en: He took a deep breath and felt that the pressure in his chest had finally eased a little.

example.zh: 公司应当从这次失败中吸取教训,而不是急于找借口。
example.py: Gōngsī yīngdāng cóng zhè cì shībài zhōng xīqǔ jiàoxùn, ér bú shì jíyú zhǎo jièkǒu.
example.en: The company should absorb the lessons from this failure rather than rush to make excuses.

example.zh: 中国戏曲不仅重视唱腔,也讲究身段和表情。
example.py: Zhōngguó xìqǔ bùjǐn zhòngshì chàngqiāng, yě jiǎngjiū shēnduàn hé biǎoqíng.
example.en: Chinese traditional opera values not only singing style, but also posture and facial expression.

example.zh: 家里有了喜事,亲戚朋友都赶来祝贺。
example.py: Jiā li yǒu le xǐshì, qīnqi péngyou dōu gǎn lái zhùhè.
example.en: When there was a happy event in the family, relatives and friends all came to offer congratulations.

example.zh: 长途飞行结束后,她只想尽快洗漱休息。
example.py: Chángtú fēixíng jiéshù hòu, tā zhǐ xiǎng jǐnkuài xǐshù xiūxi.
example.en: After the long flight, she only wanted to wash up and rest as soon as possible.

example.zh: 春节期间贴春联是许多地方保留下来的习俗。
example.py: Chūnjié qījiān tiē chūnlián shì xǔduō dìfang bǎoliú xiàlai de xísú.
example.en: Putting up Spring Festival couplets is a custom preserved in many places.

example.zh: 教材出版前,专家组还会根据试用反馈再次修订内容。
example.py: Jiàocái chūbǎn qián, zhuānjiāzǔ hái huì gēnjù shìyòng fǎnkuì zàicì xiūdìng nèiróng.
example.en: Before the textbook is published, the expert group will revise the content again based on trial feedback.

example.zh: 技术人员正在修复数据库,部分功能暂时无法使用。
example.py: Jìshù rényuán zhèngzài xiūfù zīliàokù, bùfen gōngnéng zànshí wúfǎ shǐyòng.
example.en: Technicians are repairing the database, so some functions are temporarily unavailable.

example.zh: 他把袖子卷起来,亲自帮老人搬运箱子。
example.py: Tā bǎ xiùzi juǎn qǐlai, qīnzì bāng lǎorén bānyùn xiāngzi.
example.en: He rolled up his sleeves and personally helped the old man move the boxes.

example.zh: 这份报告的分析很细致,连小样本的变化都注意到了。
example.py: Zhè fèn bàogào de fēnxī hěn xìzhì, lián xiǎo yàngběn de biànhuà dōu zhùyì dào le.
example.en: The analysis in this report is very meticulous, even noting changes in small samples.

example.zh: 学校将通过公开比赛选拔代表队成员。
example.py: Xuéxiào jiāng tōngguò gōngkāi bǐsài xuǎnbá dàibiǎoduì chéngyuán.
example.en: The school will select members of the representative team through an open competition.

example.zh: 大学期间,他选修了心理学课程,对后来工作很有帮助。
example.py: Dàxué qījiān, tā xuǎnxiū le xīnlǐxué kèchéng, duì hòulái gōngzuò hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
example.en: During university, he took a psychology course as an elective, which was very helpful for his later work.

example.zh: 机器启动后,中心部件会高速旋转,操作时必须保持距离。
example.py: Jīqì qǐdòng hòu, zhōngxīn bùjiàn huì gāosù xuánzhuǎn, cāozuò shí bìxū bǎochí jùlí.
example.en: After the machine starts, the central component rotates at high speed, so a safe distance must be kept during operation.

example.zh: 长期缺乏运动会影响血管健康,增加患病风险。
example.py: Chángqī quēfá yùndòng huì yǐngxiǎng xuèguǎn jiànkāng, zēngjiā huànbìng fēngxiǎn.
example.en: A long-term lack of exercise can affect blood vessel health and increase the risk of illness.

example.zh: 这个学会每年都会举办一次国际学术会议。
example.py: Zhège xuéhuì měinián dōu huì jǔbàn yí cì guójì xuéshù huìyì.
example.en: This learned society holds an international academic conference every year.

example.zh: 申请这个岗位时,硕士学位不是硬性要求,但会被优先考虑。
example.py: Shēnqǐng zhège gǎngwèi shí, shuòshì xuéwèi bú shì yìngxìng yāoqiú, dàn huì bèi yōuxiān kǎolǜ.
example.en: When applying for this position, a master's degree is not a strict requirement, but it will be given priority consideration.

example.zh: 做学问不能只追求速度,还要重视证据和方法。
example.py: Zuò xuéwen bù néng zhǐ zhuīqiú sùdù, hái yào zhòngshì zhèngjù hé fāngfǎ.
example.en: In serious study, one should not only pursue speed, but also value evidence and method.

example.zh: 献血前,工作人员会先确认志愿者的血型。
example.py: Xiànxuè qián, gōngzuò rényuán huì xiān quèrèn zhìyuànzhě de xuèxíng.
example.en: Before blood donation, staff first confirm the volunteer’s blood type.

example.zh: 父亲每天早晨都会测量血压,并把结果记录下来。
example.py: Fùqīn měitiān zǎochén dōu huì cèliáng xuèyā, bìng bǎ jiéguǒ jìlù xiàlai.
example.en: My father measures his blood pressure every morning and records the result.

example.zh: 血液检查可以帮助医生发现一些早期问题。
example.py: Xuèyè jiǎnchá kěyǐ bāngzhù yīshēng fāxiàn yìxiē zǎoqī wèntí.
example.en: Blood tests can help doctors discover some early-stage problems.

example.zh: 本期培训共有三十名学员,其中一半来自基层单位。
example.py: Běn qī péixùn gòng yǒu sānshí míng xuéyuán, qízhōng yíbàn láizì jīcéng dānwèi.
example.en: This training programme has thirty trainees in total, half of whom come from grassroots organisations.

example.zh: 未经学校许可,任何单位不得在校园内进行商业宣传。
example.py: Wèi jīng xuéxiào xǔkě, rènhé dānwèi bùdé zài xiàoyuán nèi jìnxíng shāngyè xuānchuán.
example.en: Without the school's permission, no organisation may carry out commercial promotion on campus.

example.zh: 这套系统可以让冷却水循环使用,减少浪费。
example.py: Zhè tào xìtǒng kěyǐ ràng lěngquè shuǐ xúnhuán shǐyòng, jiǎnshǎo làngfèi.
example.en: This system allows cooling water to be circulated and reused, reducing waste.

example.zh: 企业正在寻求新的增长点,以应对市场变化。
example.py: Qǐyè zhèngzài xúnqiú xīn de zēngzhǎngdiǎn, yǐ yìngduì shìchǎng biànhuà.
example.en: The company is seeking new growth points in order to respond to changes in the market.

example.zh: 报告应当客观叙述事件经过,避免加入个人猜测。
example.py: Bàogào yīngdāng kèguān xùshù shìjiàn jīngguò, bìmiǎn jiārù gèrén cāicè.
example.en: The report should objectively describe the course of the incident and avoid adding personal speculation.

example.zh: 虽然只获得亚军,队员们仍然赢得了观众的尊重。
example.py: Suīrán zhǐ huòdé yàjūn, duìyuánmen réngrán yíngdé le guānzhòng de zūnzhòng.
example.en: Although they only won second place, the team members still earned the audience’s respect.

example.zh: 这位老师要求很严,但学生都知道他是为大家好。
example.py: Zhè wèi lǎoshī yāoqiú hěn yán, dàn xuésheng dōu zhīdào tā shì wèi dàjiā hǎo.
example.en: This teacher is very strict, but the students all know he does it for their good.

example.zh: 暴雨过后,低洼地区被积水淹了半米深。
example.py: Bàoyǔ guòhòu, dīwā dìqū bèi jīshuǐ yān le bàn mǐ shēn.
example.en: After the heavy rain, low-lying areas were flooded half a metre deep.

example.zh: 他仰着头看夜空,试图找到那颗行星。
example.py: Tā yǎng zhe tóu kàn yèkōng, shìtú zhǎodào nà kē xíngxīng.
example.en: He looked up at the night sky, trying to find that planet.

example.zh: 展厅里展示了十几样传统手工艺品。
example.py: Zhǎntīng lǐ zhǎnshì le shí jǐ yàng chuántǒng shǒugōng yìpǐn.
example.en: The exhibition hall displayed more than ten kinds of traditional handicrafts.

example.zh: 最近换了洗衣液后,他的手臂一直很痒。
example.py: Zuìjìn huàn le xǐyīyè hòu, tā de shǒubì yìzhí hěn yǎng.
example.en: After recently changing laundry detergent, his arms have been itchy.

example.zh: 这个城市正在完善养老服务,让老人能在社区得到照顾。
example.py: Zhè ge chéngshì zhèngzài wánshàn yǎnglǎo fúwù, ràng lǎorén néng zài shèqū dédào zhàogù.
example.en: This city is improving elderly care services so that older people can be looked after in the community.

example.zh: 这家养老院离医院很近,家属探望也方便。
example.py: Zhè jiā yǎnglǎoyuàn lí yīyuàn hěn jìn, jiāshǔ tànwàng yě fāngbiàn.
example.en: This nursing home is very close to the hospital, and it is also convenient for family members to visit.

example.zh: 高原地区氧气稀薄,初到的人容易感到头晕。
example.py: Gāoyuán dìqū yǎngqì xībó, chū dào de rén róngyì gǎndào tóuyūn.
example.en: In plateau areas the oxygen is thin, and people who have just arrived easily feel dizzy.

example.zh: 从长远眼光看,这项投资并不算冒险。
example.py: Cóng chángyuǎn yǎnguāng kàn, zhè xiàng tóuzī bìng bù suàn màoxiǎn.
example.en: From a long-term perspective, this investment is not really risky.

example.zh: 沿海城市在发展贸易方面通常具有明显优势。
example.py: Yánhǎi chéngshì zài fāzhǎn màoyì fāngmiàn tōngcháng jùyǒu míngxiǎn yōushì.
example.en: Coastal cities usually have clear advantages in developing trade.

example.zh: 在严寒的冬夜,救援人员仍然坚持搜寻失踪者。
example.py: Zài yánhán de dōngyè, jiùyuán rényuán réngrán jiānchí sōuxún shīzōngzhě.
example.en: On a bitterly cold winter night, rescuers still kept searching for the missing person.

example.zh: 宴会开始前,工作人员再次核对了宾客名单。
example.py: Yànhuì kāishǐ qián, gōngzuò rényuán zàicì héduì le bīnkè míngdān.
example.en: Before the banquet began, the staff checked the guest list again.

example.zh: 图书馆内严禁吸烟,违者将被请出场馆。
example.py: Túshūguǎn nèi yánjìn xīyān, wéizhě jiāng bèi qǐng chū chǎngguǎn.
example.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited in the library; violators will be asked to leave.

meaning: soon, in a moment; to see something happen

example.zh: 眼看会议就要开始,他才匆匆赶到现场。
example.py: Yǎnkàn huìyì jiù yào kāishǐ, tā cái cōngcōng gǎndào xiànchǎng.
example.en: Just as the meeting was about to begin, he hurriedly arrived at the scene.

example.zh: 面对数据造假,监管部门采取了严厉措施。
example.py: Miànduì shùjù zàojiǎ, jiānguǎn bùmén cǎiqǔ le yánlì cuòshī.
example.en: Facing data falsification, regulators took severe measures.

example.zh: 巨大的海浪几乎淹没了岸边的旧码头。
example.py: Jùdà de hǎilàng jīhū yānmò le ànbiān de jiù mǎtóu.
example.en: The huge waves almost submerged the old pier by the shore.

example.zh: 由于材料没有及时到达,项目只能延期一周。
example.py: Yóuyú cáiliào méiyǒu jíshí dàodá, xiàngmù zhǐ néng yánqī yì zhōu.
example.en: Because the materials did not arrive in time, the project can only be postponed by one week.

example.zh: 炎热的天气使户外工作变得格外辛苦。
example.py: Yánrè de tiānqì shǐ hùwài gōngzuò biàn de géwài xīnkǔ.
example.en: Hot weather makes outdoor work especially hard.

example.zh: 这条地铁线将向北延伸,方便郊区居民出行。
example.py: Zhè tiáo dìtiě xiàn jiāng xiàng běi yánshēn, fāngbiàn jiāoqū jūmín chūxíng.
example.en: This metro line will extend north, making travel easier for suburban residents.

example.zh: 专家们围绕城市老化问题进行了深入研讨。
example.py: Zhuānjiāmen wéirào chéngshì lǎohuà wèntí jìnxíng le shēnrù yántǎo.
example.en: The experts held an in-depth discussion on the problem of urban ageing.

example.zh: 这项传统已经延续了几百年,至今仍有活力。
example.py: Zhè xiàng chuántǒng yǐjing yánxù le jǐ bǎi nián, zhìjīn réng yǒu huólì.
example.en: This tradition has continued for several hundred years and still has vitality today.

example.zh: 在紧张场合,谨慎的言语比激烈的态度更有效。
example.py: Zài jǐnzhāng chǎnghé, jǐnshèn de yányǔ bǐ jīliè de tàidu gèng yǒuxiào.
example.en: In a tense situation, careful words are more effective than an aggressive attitude.

example.zh: 如果炎症持续不退,最好及时去医院检查。
example.py: Rúguǒ yánzhèng chíxù bú tuì, zuìhǎo jíshí qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
example.en: If the inflammation continues and does not go down, it is best to go to hospital for a check promptly.

example.zh: 研究人员需要通过实验验证这个假设是否可靠。
example.py: Yánjiū rényuán xūyào tōngguò shíyàn yànzhèng zhè ge jiǎshè shìfǒu kěkào.
example.en: Researchers need to verify through experiments whether this hypothesis is reliable.

example.zh: 她今晚将在音乐厅演奏一首新改编的古曲。
example.py: Tā jīnwǎn jiāng zài yīnyuètīng yǎnzòu yì shǒu xīn gǎibiān de gǔqǔ.
example.en: Tonight she will perform a newly arranged traditional piece in the concert hall.

example.zh: 汇报前,请把这份材料的要点整理成一页纸。
example.py: Huìbào qián, qǐng bǎ zhè fèn cáiliào de yàodiǎn zhěnglǐ chéng yí yè zhǐ.
example.en: Before the presentation, please organise the key points of this material onto one page.

example.zh: 这个问题要么今天解决,要么就推迟到下周。
example.py: Zhè ge wèntí yàome jīntiān jiějué, yàome jiù tuīchí dào xià zhōu.
example.en: This problem must either be solved today, or be postponed until next week.

example.zh: 资金、技术和人才是这个项目成功的三大要素。
example.py: Zījīn, jìshù hé réncái shì zhè ge xiàngmù chénggōng de sān dà yàosù.
example.en: Funding, technology and talent are the three major factors in the success of this project.

example.zh: 对很多孩子来说,太空仍然是一个遥远而神秘的地方。
example.py: Duì hěn duō háizi lái shuō, tàikōng réngrán shì yí gè yáoyuǎn ér shénmì de dìfang.
example.en: For many children, space is still a distant and mysterious place.

example.zh: 为了节省空间,我把照片压缩后再上传。
example.py: Wèile jiéshěng kōngjiān, wǒ bǎ zhàopiàn yāsuō hòu zài shàngchuán.
example.en: To save space, I compressed the photos before uploading them.

example.zh: 旅游业恢复得很快,带动了当地餐饮和交通收入。
example.py: Lǚyóuyè huīfù de hěn kuài, dàidòng le dāngdì cānyǐn hé jiāotōng shōurù.
example.en: The tourism industry recovered quickly and boosted local catering and transport income.

example.zh: 春天一到,路边的野花很快就开满了山坡。
example.py: Chūntiān yí dào, lùbiān de yěhuā hěn kuài jiù kāi mǎn le shānpō.
example.en: As soon as spring arrives, the wild flowers by the road quickly cover the hillside.

example.zh: 你想先休息一下也好,等精神好了再处理这件事。
example.py: Nǐ xiǎng xiān xiūxi yíxià yěhǎo, děng jīngshen hǎo le zài chǔlǐ zhè jiàn shì.
example.en: It’s fine if you want to rest first; handle this after you feel better.

example.zh: 这里的湿地保护了许多野生鸟类的栖息地。
example.py: Zhèlǐ de shīdì bǎohù le xǔduō yěshēng niǎolèi de qīxīdì.
example.en: The wetlands here protect the habitats of many wild birds.

example.zh: 这种透明液体看起来像水,但不能直接饮用。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng tòumíng yètǐ kàn qǐlai xiàng shuǐ, dàn bù néng zhíjiē yǐnyòng.
example.en: This transparent liquid looks like water, but it cannot be drunk directly.

example.zh: 在野外工作时,团队必须随身携带通信设备。
example.py: Zài yěwài gōngzuò shí, tuánduì bìxū suíshēn xiédài tōngxìn shèbèi.
example.en: When working outdoors, the team must carry communication equipment with them.

example.zh: 我姨退休后搬到海边,生活节奏比以前慢了很多。
example.py: Wǒ yí tuìxiū hòu bān dào hǎibiān, shēnghuó jiézòu bǐ yǐqián màn le hěn duō.
example.en: My aunt moved to the seaside after retiring, and her pace of life became much slower than before.

example.zh: 他一辈子都在研究地方戏曲,积累了大量珍贵资料。
example.py: Tā yíbèizi dōu zài yánjiū dìfāng xìqǔ, jīlěi le dàliàng zhēnguì zīliào.
example.en: He spent his whole life researching local opera and accumulated a large amount of valuable material.

example.zh: 请提前提交申请材料,以便工作人员及时审核。
example.py: Qǐng tíqián tíjiāo shēnqǐng cáiliào, yǐbiàn gōngzuò rényuán jíshí shěnhé.
example.en: Please submit the application materials in advance so that staff can review them promptly.

example.zh: 这座古城保存着丰富的文化遗产,吸引了很多学者前来研究。
example.py: Zhè zuò gǔchéng bǎocún zhe fēngfù de wénhuà yíchǎn, xīyǐn le hěn duō xuézhě qiánlái yánjiū.
example.en: This ancient city preserves a rich cultural heritage, attracting many scholars to come and study it.

example.zh: 设备运行异常,工程师立即停止了实验。
example.py: Shèbèi yùnxíng yìcháng, gōngchéngshī lìjí tíngzhǐ le shíyàn.
example.en: The equipment was operating abnormally, so the engineer stopped the experiment immediately.

example.zh: 适度运动对心脏和血压都有明显益处。
example.py: Shìdù yùndòng duì xīnzàng hé xuèyā dōu yǒu míngxiǎn yìchù.
example.en: Moderate exercise has clear benefits for the heart and blood pressure.

example.zh: 有些疾病与遗传因素有关,但生活习惯同样重要。
example.py: Yǒuxiē jíbìng yǔ yíchuán yīnsù yǒuguān, dàn shēnghuó xíguàn tóngyàng zhòngyào.
example.en: Some diseases are related to genetic factors, but lifestyle habits are equally important.

example.zh: 学校附近一带交通复杂,放学时需要特别注意安全。
example.py: Xuéxiào fùjìn yídài jiāotōng fùzá, fàngxué shí xūyào tèbié zhùyì ānquán.
example.en: The area around the school has complicated traffic, so extra attention to safety is needed after school.

example.zh: 会议结束后,几位专家一道去现场查看情况。
example.py: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, jǐ wèi zhuānjiā yídào qù xiànchǎng chákàn qíngkuàng.
example.en: After the meeting ended, several experts went together to the site to check the situation.

example.zh: 创业过程不可能总是一帆风顺,关键是及时调整方向。
example.py: Chuàngyè guòchéng bù kěnéng zǒng shì yìfān-fēngshùn, guānjiàn shì jíshí tiáozhěng fāngxiàng.
example.en: The process of starting a business cannot always go smoothly; the key is to adjust direction in time.

example.zh: 他一贯重视细节,所以负责审核这类文档很合适。
example.py: Tā yíguàn zhòngshì xìjié, suǒyǐ fùzé shěnhé zhè lèi wéndàng hěn héshì.
example.en: He has always valued detail, so it is very suitable for him to be responsible for reviewing such documents.

example.zh: 读完说明后,他仍然对收费标准感到疑惑。
example.py: Dú wán shuōmíng hòu, tā réngrán duì shōufèi biāozhǔn gǎndào yíhuò.
example.en: After reading the explanation, he still felt confused about the charging standard.

example.zh: 多年过去了,这条老街依旧保留着从前的风貌。
example.py: Duō nián guòqù le, zhè tiáo lǎo jiē yījiù bǎoliú zhe cóngqián de fēngmào.
example.en: Many years have passed, but this old street still preserves its former appearance.

meaning: in one breath, without a break

example.zh: 他一口气跑到山顶,累得几乎说不出话来。
example.py: Tā yìkǒuqì pǎo dào shāndǐng, lèi de jīhū shuō bù chū huà lái.
example.en: He ran to the top of the mountain without stopping and was so tired he could barely speak.

example.zh: 如果企业过度依赖单一客户,经营风险会明显增加。
example.py: Rúguǒ qǐyè guòdù yīlài dānyī kèhù, jīngyíng fēngxiǎn huì míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
example.en: If a company relies too much on a single customer, its business risk will clearly increase.

example.zh: 这所大学拥有一流的实验设备和研究团队。
example.py: Zhè suǒ dàxué yōngyǒu yīliú de shíyàn shèbèi hé yánjiū tuánduì.
example.en: This university has first-class laboratory equipment and research teams.

example.zh: 进入实验室前,所有人员一律必须完成安全培训。
example.py: Jìnrù shíyànshì qián, suǒyǒu rényuán yílǜ bìxū wánchéng ānquán péixùn.
example.en: Before entering the laboratory, all personnel must complete safety training without exception.

example.zh: 会后大家都在议论这项新政策会带来什么影响。
example.py: Huì hòu dàjiā dōu zài yìlùn zhè xiàng xīn zhèngcè huì dàilái shénme yǐngxiǎng.
example.en: After the meeting, everyone was discussing what impact the new policy would bring.

example.zh: 出发前请确认路线,以免在山里迷路。
example.py: Chūfā qián qǐng quèrèn lùxiàn, yǐmiǎn zài shān lǐ mílù.
example.en: Please confirm the route before setting off so as not to get lost in the mountains.

example.zh: 为了让孩子接受更好的教育,他们决定移民到另一个国家。
example.py: Wèile ràng háizi jiēshòu gèng hǎo de jiàoyù, tāmen juédìng yímín dào lìng yí gè guójiā.
example.en: To let their child receive a better education, they decided to immigrate to another country.

example.zh: 这两份文档的内容几乎一模一样,可能是复制出来的。
example.py: Zhè liǎng fèn wéndàng de nèiróng jīhū yìmú-yíyàng, kěnéng shì fùzhì chūlái de.
example.en: The contents of these two documents are almost exactly the same and may have been copied.

example.zh: 文件上的印已经模糊,难以验证真伪。
example.py: Wénjiàn shàng de yìn yǐjīng móhu, nányǐ yànzhèng zhēnwěi.
example.en: The stamp on the document has become blurred, making it difficult to verify whether it is genuine.

example.zh: 航班因大雾延误,乘客只能在机场等候通知。
example.py: Hángbān yīn dàwù yánwù, chéngkè zhǐ néng zài jīchǎng děnghòu tōngzhī.
example.en: The flight was delayed because of heavy fog, so passengers could only wait for notices at the airport.

example.zh: 老师用一个真实案例引出今天的讨论主题。
example.py: Lǎoshī yòng yí ge zhēnshí ànlì yǐn chū jīntiān de tǎolùn zhǔtí.
example.en: The teacher used a real case to lead into today’s discussion topic.

example.zh: 这只银手镯保存得很好,表面几乎没有划痕。
example.py: Zhè zhī yín shǒuzhuó bǎocún de hěn hǎo, biǎomiàn jīhū méiyǒu huáhén.
example.en: This silver bracelet has been preserved very well, with almost no scratches on the surface.

example.zh: 为了保护隐私,系统会自动隐藏部分个人信息。
example.py: Wèile bǎohù yǐnsī, xìtǒng huì zìdòng yǐncáng bùfen gèrén xìnxī.
example.en: To protect privacy, the system automatically hides part of the personal information.

example.zh: 家长不应只责备孩子,而要耐心引导他们解决问题。
example.py: Jiāzhǎng bù yīng zhǐ zébèi háizi, ér yào nàixīn yǐndǎo tāmen jiějué wèntí.
example.en: Parents should not only blame their children, but should patiently guide them to solve problems.

example.zh: 这条消息在网上迅速传播,引发了公众对隐私保护的讨论。
example.py: Zhè tiáo xiāoxi zài wǎngshàng xùnsù chuánbō, yǐnfā le gōngzhòng duì yǐnsī bǎohù de tǎolùn.
example.en: The news spread quickly online and triggered public discussion about privacy protection.

example.zh: 婴儿的听觉很敏感,突然的噪音容易把他吓醒。
example.py: Yīng'ér de tīngjué hěn mǐngǎn, tūrán de zàoyīn róngyì bǎ tā xià xǐng.
example.en: A baby's sense of hearing is very sensitive, and sudden noise can easily wake him up with a fright.

example.zh: 消防员在火灾中救出老人,被大家称为英雄。
example.py: Xiāofángyuán zài huǒzāi zhōng jiù chū lǎorén, bèi dàjiā chēng wéi yīngxióng.
example.en: The firefighter rescued an elderly person from the fire and was called a hero by everyone.

example.zh: 傍晚的阳光把树的影子拉得很长。
example.py: Bàngwǎn de yángguāng bǎ shù de yǐngzi lā de hěn cháng.
example.en: The evening sunlight stretched the tree's shadow very long.

example.zh: 汉语拼音中,每个汉字通常对应一个音节。
example.py: Hànyǔ pīnyīn zhōng, měi ge Hànzì tōngcháng duìyìng yí ge yīnjié.
example.en: In Hanyu Pinyin, each Chinese character usually corresponds to one syllable.

example.zh: 她在决赛中发挥稳定,最终获得一枚银牌。
example.py: Tā zài juésài zhōng fāhuī wěndìng, zuìzhōng huòdé yì méi yínpái.
example.en: She performed steadily in the final and eventually won a silver medal.

example.zh: 学校计划引入新的评价体系,以便更全面地了解学生表现。
example.py: Xuéxiào jìhuà yǐnrù xīn de píngjià tǐxì, yǐbiàn gèng quánmiàn de liǎojiě xuésheng biǎoxiàn.
example.en: The school plans to introduce a new evaluation system so that it can understand students' performance more fully.

example.zh: 医院必须严格保护患者隐私,未经许可不得公开资料。
example.py: Yīyuàn bìxū yángé bǎohù huànzhě yǐnsī, wèijīng xǔkě bùdé gōngkāi zīliào.

example.zh: 以往的经验提醒我们,任何改革都需要充分沟通。

example.zh: 他一向说话谨慎,很少在公开场合随便表态。

example.zh: 医药行业的发展离不开严格的质量监管。

example.zh: 会议开始前,主持人把需要表决的事项一一说明清楚。

example.zh: 这种界面设计简单清楚,易于老人操作。

example.en: The teacher repeatedly reminded the students not to touch dangerous instruments during the experiment.

example.en: A sudden burst of urgent knocking came from outside the door.

example.zh: 药物只能暂时抑制症状,不能代替正式治疗。

example.en: Medicine can only temporarily suppress the symptoms; it cannot replace formal treatment.

example.zh: 考古队在山脚下发现了一处古代遗址。
example.py: Kǎogǔduì zài shānjiǎo xià fāxiàn le yí chù gǔdài yízhǐ.
example.en: The archaeological team discovered an ancient site at the foot of the mountain.

example.zh: 代表团抵达后,先在酒店用餐,然后参加欢迎仪式。

example.zh: 这份旧资料虽然年代久远,但对研究项目仍有用处。

example.zh: 她平时很用功,所以考试前并不显得紧张。
example.py: Tā píngshí hěn yònggōng, suǒyǐ kǎoshì qián bìng bù xiǎnde jǐnzhāng.

example.zh: 企业用人不能只看学历,还要重视实际能力。

example.zh: 新技术发展后,市场上涌现出许多创新型企业。
example.py: Xīn jìshù fāzhǎn hòu, shìchǎng shàng yǒngxiàn chū xǔduō chuàngxīnxíng qǐyè.
example.en: After new technologies developed, many innovative companies emerged in the market.

example.zh: 这家餐厅虽然不大,但每道菜都做得很用心。

example.en: Although this restaurant is not large, every dish is prepared with great care.

example.zh: 年轻研究者要勇于提出不同意见,而不是只重复前人的结论。
example.py: Niánqīng yánjiūzhě yào yǒngyú tíchū bùtóng yìjiàn, ér bú shì zhǐ chóngfù qiánrén de jiélùn.
example.en: Young researchers should be brave enough to put forward different opinions rather than merely repeat the conclusions of those before them.

example.zh: 技术团队正在优化系统,以减少用户等待时间。
example.py: Jìshù tuánduì zhèngzài yōuhuà xìtǒng, yǐ jiǎnshǎo yònghù děngdài shíjiān.
example.en: The technical team is optimizing the system to reduce users' waiting time.

example.zh: 这家农场主要种植有机蔬菜,并通过网络直接销售。
example.py: Zhè jiā nóngchǎng zhǔyào zhòngzhí yǒujī shūcài, bìng tōngguò wǎngluò zhíjiē xiāoshòu.
example.en: This farm mainly grows organic vegetables and sells them directly online.

example.zh: 喝完热汤后,他觉得身上又有劲了。
example.py: Hē wán rè tāng hòu, tā juéde shēnshang yòu yǒujìn le.
example.en: After drinking the hot soup, he felt strong again.

example.zh: 关于这个地名的由来,当地老人有不同的说法。

example.en: Regarding the origin of this place name, local elderly people have different explanations.

example.zh: 志愿者引导观众有序进入会场。

example.en: Volunteers guided the audience to enter the venue in an orderly way.

example.zh: 他在田径比赛中表现优异,最终获得了银牌。

example.zh: 本次研讨会将于下月上旬在上海举行。

example.zh: 这座园林原本属于私人住宅,后来才对公众开放。

example.en: This garden originally belonged to a private residence and was only later opened to the public.

example.zh: 这家工厂主要依赖进口原材料,因此成本容易受汇率影响。

example.zh: 北方人在正月十五常吃元宵,象征团圆。

example.zh: 法律不仅约束个人行为,也维护社会秩序。

example.en: He often got carsick when he was young, so he was nervous before every long journey.

example.en: The rescue team is transporting drinking water and medicine to the disaster-hit area.

example.zh: 系统运行稳定以后,用户投诉明显减少了。
example.py: Xìtǒng yùnxíng wěndìng yǐhòu, yònghù tóusù míngxiǎn jiǎnshǎo le.
example.en: After the system operated stably, user complaints decreased noticeably.

example.zh: 这家平台通过优化内容推荐提高了运营效率。
example.py: Zhè jiā píngtái tōngguò yōuhuà nèiróng tuījiàn tígāo le yùnyíng xiàolǜ.
example.en: This platform improved its operational efficiency by optimizing content recommendations.

example.zh: 与其反复抱怨,不如把问题一一列出来。
example.py: Yǔqí fǎnfù bàoyuàn, bùrú bǎ wèntí yīyī liè chūlai.
example.en: Rather than complaining repeatedly, it is better to list the problems one by one.

example.zh: 新能源项目的收益没有达到投资者的预期。
example.py: Xīnnéngyuán xiàngmù de shōuyì méiyǒu dádào tóuzīzhě de yùqī.
example.en: The profit from the new energy project did not meet investors' expectations.

example.zh: 北方冬天严寒,出门最好穿厚一点的羽绒服。
example.py: Běifāng dōngtiān yánhán, chūmén zuìhǎo chuān hòu yìdiǎn de yǔróngfú.

example.en: The content of this report is too mixed, so readers find it hard to grasp the main points.

example.zh: 这场灾让许多家庭失去了原本稳定的生活。

example.en: Coastal areas need to prepare in advance to guard against disasters such as typhoons.

example.en: The reason why he did not reply in time was that he was dealing with a sudden matter.

example.zh: 这个职位要求申请者既懂技术,又具备良好的沟通能力。
example.py: Zhège zhíwèi yāoqiú shēnqǐngzhě jì dǒng jìshù, yòu jùbèi liánghǎo de gōutōng nénglì.
example.en: This position requires applicants to both understand technology and have good communication skills.

example.zh: 他在会议上说明了自己的职务范围,避免以后发生误解。
example.py: Tā zài huìyì shang shuōmíng le zìjǐ de zhíwù fànwéi, bìmiǎn yǐhòu fāshēng wùjiě.
example.en: He explained the scope of his duties at the meeting to avoid misunderstandings later.

example.zh: 演出结束后,工作人员维持现场秩序,引导观众有序离场。
example.py: Yǎnchū jiéshù hòu, gōngzuò rényuán wéichí xiànchǎng zhìxù, yǐndǎo guānzhòng yǒuxù líchǎng.
example.en: After the performance ended, staff maintained order at the scene and guided the audience to leave in an orderly way.

example.zh: 有专家质疑这项数据的来源,要求公开调查过程。
example.py: Yǒu zhuānjiā zhìyí zhè xiàng shùjù de láiyuán, yāoqiú gōngkāi diàochá guòchéng.
example.en: Some experts questioned the source of this data and requested that the investigation process be made public.

meaning: to go so far as to; as for, as to

example.zh: 至于具体的费用,我们会在合同里写得很清楚。
example.py: Zhìyú jùtǐ de fèiyòng, wǒmen huì zài hétong lǐ xiě de hěn qīngchu.
example.en: As for the specific costs, we will write them very clearly in the contract.

example.zh: 前台职员耐心解释流程,让第一次办理业务的人放心不少。
example.py: Qiántái zhíyuán nàixīn jiěshì liúchéng, ràng dì yī cì bànlǐ yèwù de rén fàngxīn bù shǎo.
example.en: The front-desk staff member patiently explained the process, which reassured people handling the matter for the first time.

example.zh: 不要急于指责任何人,先把事情的真相调查清楚。
example.py: Bú yào jíyú zhǐzé rènhé rén, xiān bǎ shìqing de zhēnxiàng diàochá qīngchu.
example.en: Do not be quick to accuse anyone; first investigate the truth of the matter clearly.

example.zh: 每个岗位的职责都应写清楚,不能只靠口头说明。
example.py: Měi ge gǎngwèi de zhízé dōu yīng xiě qīngchu, bù néng zhǐ kào kǒutóu shuōmíng.
example.en: The responsibilities of every post should be written clearly and not rely only on verbal explanation.

example.zh: 我侄子今年上初中,对天文和乐器都很感兴趣。
example.py: Wǒ zhízi jīnnián shàng chūzhōng, duì tiānwén hé yuèqì dōu hěn gǎn xìngqù.
example.en: My nephew is in junior secondary school this year and is very interested in astronomy and musical instruments.

meaning: to hit, to be hit by

example.zh: 这支箭正好中了靶心,赢得了全场掌声。
example.py: Zhè zhī jiàn zhènghǎo zhòng le bǎxīn, yíngdé le quánchǎng zhǎngshēng.
example.en: This arrow hit the bullseye exactly and won applause from the whole audience.

example.zh: 他不小心撞到桌角,膝盖很快就肿了起来。
example.py: Tā bù xiǎoxīn zhuàngdào zhuōjiǎo, xīgài hěn kuài jiù zhǒng le qǐlai.
example.en: He accidentally hit the corner of the table, and his knee quickly swelled up.

example.zh: 这款手机性能中等,但性价比还算不错。
example.py: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī xìngnéng zhōngděng, dàn xìngjiàbǐ hái suàn búcuò.
example.en: This phone has moderate performance, but the cost-performance ratio is still quite good.

example.zh: 祖父一辈子种地,对土壤和节气特别熟悉。
example.py: Zǔfù yíbèizi zhòngdì, duì tǔrǎng hé jiéqì tèbié shúxī.
example.en: Grandfather farmed all his life and was especially familiar with soil and seasonal changes.

example.zh: 马拉松的终点设在体育馆门口,方便观众观看最后冲刺。
example.py: Mǎlāsōng de zhōngdiǎn shè zài tǐyùguǎn ménkǒu, fāngbiàn guānzhòng guānkàn zuìhòu chōngcì.
example.en: The marathon’s finish line was set at the entrance of the stadium, making it convenient for spectators to watch the final sprint.

example.zh: 食物保存不当,容易引起集体中毒事件。
example.py: Shíwù bǎocún bùdàng, róngyì yǐnqǐ jítǐ zhòngdú shìjiàn.
example.en: Improper food storage can easily cause a mass poisoning incident.

example.zh: 因为网络故障,会议被迫中断了十分钟。
example.py: Yīnwèi wǎngluò gùzhàng, huìyì bèipò zhōngduàn le shí fēnzhōng.
example.en: Because of a network fault, the meeting was forced to stop for ten minutes.

example.zh: 他买彩票只是图个乐,没想到真的中奖了。
example.py: Tā mǎi cǎipiào zhǐ shì tú ge lè, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhòngjiǎng le.
example.en: He bought a lottery ticket just for fun and did not expect to actually win a prize.

example.zh: 面对突发火灾,众人没有慌乱,而是按指挥有序撤离。
example.py: Miànduì tūfā huǒzāi, zhòngrén méiyǒu huāngluàn, ér shì àn zhǐhuī yǒuxù chèlí.
example.en: Faced with a sudden fire, everyone stayed calm and evacuated in order under instructions.

example.zh: 他把推广乡村教育视为自己的终身事业。
example.py: Tā bǎ tuīguǎng xiāngcūn jiàoyù shì wéi zìjǐ de zhōngshēn shìyè.
example.en: He regards promoting rural education as his lifelong career.

example.zh: 连续在烈日下工作,他很快出现了中暑症状。
example.py: Liánxù zài lièrì xià gōngzuò, tā hěn kuài chūxiàn le zhòngshǔ zhèngzhuàng.
example.en: After working continuously under the blazing sun, he quickly developed symptoms of heatstroke.

example.zh: 众所周知,长期缺乏睡眠会影响注意力和判断力。
example.py: Zhòngsuǒzhōuzhī, chángqī quēfá shuìmián huì yǐngxiǎng zhùyìlì hé pànduànlì.
example.en: As everyone knows, long-term lack of sleep affects concentration and judgement.

example.zh: 他在候车室等了两个钟头,才听到检票通知。
example.py: Tā zài hòuchēshì děng le liǎng ge zhōngtóu, cái tīngdào jiǎnpiào tōngzhī.
example.en: He waited in the waiting room for two hours before hearing the ticket-checking announcement.

example.zh: 搬运大型设备时,必须先判断它的重心位置。
example.py: Bānyùn dàxíng shèbèi shí, bìxū xiān pànduàn tā de zhòngxīn wèizhi.
example.en: When moving large equipment, you must first judge the position of its centre of gravity.

meaning: middle ten days of a month

example.zh: 项目计划在六月中旬完成第一轮测试。
example.py: Xiàngmù jìhuà zài liù yuè zhōngxún wánchéng dì yī lún cèshì.
example.en: The project is planned to complete its first round of testing in mid-June.

example.zh: 广场中央立着一座纪念碑,四周种满了松树。
example.py: Guǎngchǎng zhōngyāng lìzhe yí zuò jìniànbēi, sìzhōu zhòng mǎn le sōngshù.
example.en: A monument stands in the centre of the square, surrounded by pine trees.

example.zh: 这个州的沿海地区每年都会受到台风影响。
example.py: Zhè ge zhōu de yánhǎi dìqū měi nián dōu huì shòudào táifēng yǐngxiǎng.
example.en: The coastal areas of this state are affected by typhoons every year.

example.zh: 胃口不好时,她只想喝一碗热粥。
example.py: Wèikǒu bù hǎo shí, tā zhǐ xiǎng hē yì wǎn rè zhōu.
example.en: When she has no appetite, she only wants to drink a bowl of hot porridge.

example.zh: 景区周边开了不少民宿,带动了当地就业。
example.py: Jǐngqū zhōubiān kāi le bù shǎo mínsù, dàidòng le dāngdì jiùyè.
example.en: Many guesthouses have opened around the scenic area, promoting local employment.

example.zh: 前台服务很周到,连孩子的拖鞋都提前准备好了。
example.py: Qiántái fúwù hěn zhōudào, lián háizi de tuōxié dōu tíqián zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
example.en: The front desk service was very thoughtful; they had even prepared children’s slippers in advance.

example.zh: 这种植物的生长周期较短,适合做课堂观察实验。
example.py: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù de shēngzhǎng zhōuqī jiào duǎn, shìhé zuò kètáng guānchá shíyàn.
example.en: This plant has a relatively short growth cycle and is suitable for classroom observation experiments.

example.zh: 这株老茶树经历了百年风雨,仍然每年发芽。
example.py: Zhè zhū lǎo cháshù jīnglì le bǎi nián fēngyǔ, réngrán měi nián fāyá.
example.en: This old tea tree has endured a century of wind and rain, yet it still sprouts every year.

example.zh: 工人把一块块砖整齐地码在墙边。
example.py: Gōngrén bǎ yí kuài kuài zhuān zhěngqí de mǎ zài qiáng biān.
example.en: The workers stacked the bricks neatly by the wall.

example.zh: 风扇一直在转,房间里的空气终于流动起来。
example.py: Fēngshàn yìzhí zài zhuàn, fángjiān lǐ de kōngqì zhōngyú liúdòng qǐlai.
example.en: The fan kept turning, and the air in the room finally began to move.

example.zh: 只要轻轻转动旋钮,水流大小就能调节。
example.py: Zhǐyào qīngqīng zhuàndòng xuánniǔ, shuǐliú dàxiǎo jiù néng tiáojié.
example.en: With a gentle turn of the knob, the flow of water can be adjusted.

example.zh: 这支救援队装备了最新的通讯设备,以便进入灾区后保持联系。
example.py: Zhè zhī jiùyuán duì zhuāngbèi le zuìxīn de tōngxùn shèbèi, yǐbiàn jìnrù zāiqū hòu bǎochí liánxì.
example.en: This rescue team was equipped with the latest communication equipment so that it could stay in contact after entering the disaster area.

example.zh: 连续的阵雨让田里的庄稼长得更有劲了。
example.py: Liánxù de zhènyǔ ràng tián lǐ de zhuāngjia zhǎng de gèng yǒujìn le.
example.en: The continuous showers made the crops in the field grow more vigorously.

example.zh: 这套软件可以把语音自动转换成文字。
example.py: Zhè tào ruǎnjiàn kěyǐ bǎ yǔyīn zìdòng zhuǎnhuàn chéng wénzì.
example.en: This software can automatically convert speech into text.

meaning: to pass on, to hand over

example.zh: 请把这份文档转交给负责审核的主管。
example.py: Qǐng bǎ zhè fèn wéndàng zhuǎnjiāo gěi fùzé shěnhé de zhǔguǎn.
example.en: Please pass this document on to the supervisor responsible for reviewing it.

example.zh: 这家专科医院在治疗眼科疾病方面很有经验。
example.py: Zhè jiā zhuānkē yīyuàn zài zhìliáo yǎnkē jíbìng fāngmiàn hěn yǒu jīngyàn.
example.en: This specialist hospital has a great deal of experience in treating eye diseases.

example.zh: 这家公司为新能源技术申请了多项专利。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī wèi xīnnéngyuán jìshù shēnqǐng le duō xiàng zhuānlì.
example.en: This company has applied for several patents for new energy technology.

example.zh: 公司决定把部分专利转让给合作伙伴。
example.py: Gōngsī juédìng bǎ bùfen zhuānlì zhuǎnràng gěi hézuò huǒbàn.
example.en: The company decided to transfer some patents to its partner.

example.zh: 他听到有人招呼自己,立刻转身望向门口。
example.py: Tā tīng dào yǒu rén zhāohu zìjǐ, lìkè zhuǎnshēn wàng xiàng ménkǒu.
example.en: Hearing someone call him, he immediately turned round and looked towards the door.

example.zh: 会议专门设置了一个专题,讨论城市更新的实际困难。
example.py: Huìyì zhuānmén shèzhì le yí gè zhuāntí, tǎolùn chéngshì gēngxīn de shíjì kùnnan.
example.en: The conference set up a special topic to discuss the practical difficulties of urban renewal.

example.zh: 为了避免洪水,村民被迅速转移到安全区域。
example.py: Wèile bìmiǎn hóngshuǐ, cūnmín bèi xùnsù zhuǎnyí dào ānquán qūyù.
example.en: To avoid the flood, the villagers were quickly transferred to a safe area.

example.zh: 这条通道是消防车辆专用的,任何私家车不得占用。
example.py: Zhè tiáo tōngdào shì xiāofáng chēliàng zhuānyòng de, rènhé sījiāchē bùdé zhànyòng.
example.en: This passage is reserved for fire vehicles, and no private car may occupy it.

example.zh: 她做实验时非常专注,几乎没有注意到外面的噪声。
example.py: Tā zuò shíyàn shí fēicháng zhuānzhù, jīhū méiyǒu zhùyì dào wàimiàn de zàoshēng.
example.en: She was very focused while doing the experiment and hardly noticed the noise outside.

example.zh: 本次研讨会由当地大学主办,吸引了不少学者参加。
example.py: Běn cì yántǎohuì yóu dāngdì dàxué zhǔbàn, xīyǐn le bù shǎo xuézhě cānjiā.
example.en: This seminar was hosted by the local university and attracted many scholars.

example.zh: 她没有选择昂贵的珠宝,而是把钱捐给了学校。
example.py: Tā méiyǒu xuǎnzé ángguì de zhūbǎo, ér shì bǎ qián juān gěi le xuéxiào.
example.en: She did not choose expensive jewellery, but donated the money to the school.

meaning: to host a live stream; live streamer

example.zh: 这位主播每天晚上介绍新书,积累了稳定的观众群。
example.py: Zhè wèi zhǔbō měi tiān wǎnshang jièshào xīn shū, jīlěi le wěndìng de guānzhòng qún.
example.en: This live-stream host introduces new books every evening and has built a steady audience.

example.zh: 在这次改革中,技术部门主导了系统升级。
example.py: Zài zhè cì gǎigé zhōng, jìshù bùmén zhǔdǎo le xìtǒng shēngjí.
example.en: In this reform, the technical department led the system upgrade.

example.zh: 新政策实施后,诸多企业开始调整招聘计划。
example.py: Xīn zhèngcè shíshī hòu, zhūduō qǐyè kāishǐ tiáozhěng zhāopìn jìhuà.
example.en: After the new policy was implemented, many companies began adjusting their recruitment plans.

example.zh: 婚礼结束时,亲友们把最真诚的祝福送给了新人。
example.py: Hūnlǐ jiéshù shí, qīnyǒu men bǎ zuì zhēnchéng de zhùfú sòng gěi le xīnrén.
example.en: At the end of the wedding, relatives and friends gave their most sincere blessings to the newlyweds.

example.zh: 她主管财务事务,对每一笔支出都非常严格。
example.py: Tā zhǔguǎn cáiwù shìwù, duì měi yì bǐ zhīchū dōu fēicháng yángé.
example.en: She is in charge of financial affairs and is very strict with every expenditure.

example.zh: 事故原因尚未查清,相关部门不会急于追究个人责任。
example.py: Shìgù yuányīn shàng wèi cháqīng, xiāngguān bùmén bú huì jíyú zhuījiū gèrén zérèn.
example.en: Before the cause of the accident is clear, the relevant department will not rush to hold individuals responsible.

example.zh: 这部电影的主角并不是英雄,而是一个普通工人。
example.py: Zhè bù diànyǐng de zhǔjué bìng bú shì yīngxióng, ér shì yí gè pǔtōng gōngrén.
example.en: The protagonist of this film is not a hero, but an ordinary worker.

example.zh: 新来的助理负责整理文档和安排会议。
example.py: Xīn lái de zhùlǐ fùzé zhěnglǐ wéndàng hé ānpái huìyì.
example.en: The new assistant is responsible for organising documents and arranging meetings.

example.zh: 短视频已经成为年轻人获取信息的主流方式之一。
example.py: Duǎn shìpín yǐjīng chéngwéi niánqīng rén huòqǔ xìnxī de zhǔliú fāngshì zhī yī.
example.en: Short videos have already become one of the mainstream ways for young people to obtain information.

example.zh: 孩子在花园里捉蝴蝶,却不小心踩坏了花。
example.py: Háizi zài huāyuán lǐ zhuō húdié, què bù xiǎoxīn cǎi huài le huā.
example.en: The child was catching butterflies in the garden but accidentally stepped on the flowers.

example.zh: 这个软件助手可以自动生成图表,提高办公效率。
example.py: Zhège ruǎnjiàn zhùshǒu kěyǐ zìdòng shēngchéng túbiǎo, tígāo bàngōng xiàolǜ.
example.en: This software assistant can automatically generate charts and improve office efficiency.

example.zh: 这部电视剧由一位年轻演员主演,反响却非常好。
example.py: Zhè bù diànshìjù yóu yí wèi niánqīng yǎnyuán zhǔyǎn, fǎnxiǎng què fēicháng hǎo.
example.en: This TV drama stars a young actor, yet the response has been very good.

meaning: to wish, to express good wishes

example.zh: 校长祝愿毕业生在新的岗位上一切顺利。
example.py: Xiàozhǎng zhùyuàn bìyèshēng zài xīn de gǎngwèi shàng yíqiè shùnlì.
example.en: The headteacher wished the graduates every success in their new positions.

example.zh: 这片住宅区靠近地铁,生活成本却相对较低。
example.py: Zhè piàn zhùzhái qū kàojìn dìtiě, shēnghuó chéngběn què xiāngduì jiào dī.
example.en: This residential area is close to the underground, yet the cost of living is relatively low.

example.zh: 他主张在制定政策前,先听取基层职员的意见。
example.py: Tā zhǔzhāng zài zhìdìng zhèngcè qián, xiān tīngqǔ jīcéng zhíyuán de yìjiàn.
example.en: He advocates listening to the opinions of front-line staff before making policy.

example.zh: 他的著作系统地介绍了中国古代园林的发展。
example.py: Tā de zhùzuò xìtǒng de jièshào le Zhōngguó gǔdài yuánlín de fāzhǎn.
example.en: His work systematically introduces the development of ancient Chinese gardens.

example.zh: 这家公司需要更多资本来扩大新能源项目。
example.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī xūyào gèng duō zīběn lái kuòdà xīnnéngyuán xiàngmù.
example.en: This company needs more capital to expand its new energy project.

example.zh: 企业合并后,双方将重新评估全部资产。
example.py: Qǐyè hébìng hòu, shuāngfāng jiāng chóngxīn pínggū quánbù zīchǎn.
example.en: After the companies merge, both sides will reassess all the assets.

example.zh: 能代表学校参加全国比赛,他感到非常自豪。
example.py: Néng dàibiǎo xuéxiào cānjiā quánguó bǐsài, tā gǎndào fēicháng zìháo.
example.en: He felt very proud to be able to represent his school in a national competition.

example.zh: 台风过后,部分社区的自来水供应中断了。
example.py: Táifēng guòhòu, bùfen shèqū de zìláishuǐ gōngyìng zhōngduàn le.
example.en: After the typhoon, the tap-water supply in some communities was interrupted.

example.zh: 良好的自律能帮助学生在远程学习中保持效率。
example.py: Liánghǎo de zìlǜ néng bāngzhù xuéshēng zài yuǎnchéng xuéxí zhōng bǎochí xiàolǜ.
example.en: Good self-discipline can help students maintain efficiency in remote learning.

example.zh: 这部纪录片提供中英文字幕,方便不同观众理解。
example.py: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn tígōng Zhōng-Yīngwén zìmù, fāngbiàn bùtóng guānzhòng lǐjiě.
example.en: This documentary provides Chinese and English subtitles, making it easier for different audiences to understand.

example.zh: 这部电影没有直接描写自杀,而是关注人物的心理变化。
example.py: Zhè bù diànyǐng méiyǒu zhíjiē miáoxiě zìshā, ér shì guānzhù rénwù de xīnlǐ biànhuà.
example.en: This film does not directly depict suicide, but focuses on the character’s psychological changes.

example.zh: 成熟的人既要坚持自我,也要学会听取不同意见。
example.py: Chéngshú de rén jì yào jiānchí zìwǒ, yě yào xuéhuì tīngqǔ bùtóng yìjiàn.
example.en: A mature person should both maintain a sense of self and learn to listen to different opinions.

example.zh: 他一边整理资料,一边自言自语地重复关键数字。
example.py: Tā yìbiān zhěnglǐ zīliào, yìbiān zìyán-zìyǔ de chóngfù guānjiàn shùzì.
example.en: While organising the materials, he talked to himself and repeated the key figures.

example.zh: 许多居民自愿参加社区的环保活动。
example.py: Xǔduō jūmín zìyuàn cānjiā shèqū de huánbǎo huódòng.
example.en: Many residents voluntarily took part in the community’s environmental activities.

example.zh: 这家酒店采用自助入住系统,旅客可以节省时间。
example.py: Zhè jiā jiǔdiàn cǎiyòng zìzhù rùzhù xìtǒng, lǚkè kěyǐ jiéshěng shíjiān.
example.en: This hotel uses a self-service check-in system, so travellers can save time.

example.zh: 新任总裁上任后,立即宣布了数字化转型计划。
example.py: Xīnrèn zǒngcái shàngrèn hòu, lìjí xuānbù le shùzìhuà zhuǎnxíng jìhuà.
example.en: After taking office, the new CEO immediately announced a digital transformation plan.

example.zh: 本次活动共有三百人报名,总计收取费用六万元。
example.py: Běn cì huódòng gòng yǒu sānbǎi rén bàomíng, zǒngjì shōuqǔ fèiyòng liù wàn yuán.
example.en: A total of 300 people signed up for this event, and the fees collected totalled 60,000 yuan.

example.zh: 总理在记者会上回应了有关外交政策的提问。
example.py: Zǒnglǐ zài jìzhěhuì shàng huíyìng le yǒuguān wàijiāo zhèngcè de tíwèn.
example.en: The prime minister responded to questions about foreign policy at the press conference.

example.zh: 他选了一件棕色外套,看起来稳重又自然。
example.py: Tā xuǎn le yí jiàn zōngsè wàitào, kàn qǐlai wěnzhòng yòu zìrán.
example.en: He chose a brown coat, which looked calm and natural.

example.zh: 经过再三验证,工程总算达到了预期标准。
example.py: Jīngguò zàisān yànzhèng, gōngchéng zǒngsuàn dádào le yùqī biāozhǔn.
example.en: After repeated verification, the project finally reached the expected standard.

example.zh: 端午节临近,超市里各种口味的粽子都摆在显眼的位置。
example.py: Duānwǔ Jié línjìn, chāoshì lǐ gè zhǒng kǒuwèi de zòngzi dōu bǎi zài xiǎnyǎn de wèizhi.
example.en: As the Dragon Boat Festival approaches, zongzi of various flavours are placed in prominent positions in the supermarket.

example.zh: 医院的走廊里很安静,只有护士推车经过的声音。
example.py: Yīyuàn de zǒuláng lǐ hěn ānjìng, zhǐyǒu hùshi tuīchē jīngguò de shēngyīn.
example.en: The hospital corridor was very quiet; there was only the sound of nurses pushing trolleys past.

example.zh: 这份报告足有两百页,读完需要不少时间。
example.py: Zhè fèn bàogào zú yǒu liǎngbǎi yè, dú wán xūyào bù shǎo shíjiān.
example.en: This report is fully two hundred pages long, so it will take quite some time to finish reading.

example.zh: 资金不足会阻碍新技术在农村地区的推广。
example.py: Zījīn bùzú huì zǔ'ài xīn jìshù zài nóngcūn dìqū de tuīguǎng.
example.en: Insufficient funding will hinder the promotion of new technology in rural areas.

example.zh: 工人用机器在墙上钻了一个小孔。
example.py: Gōngrén yòng jīqì zài qiáng shàng zuān le yí ge xiǎo kǒng.
example.en: The worker used a machine to drill a small hole in the wall.

example.zh: 临时围栏阻挡了车辆进入施工区域。
example.py: Línshí wéilán zǔdǎng le chēliàng jìnrù shīgōng qūyù.
example.en: Temporary barriers blocked vehicles from entering the construction area.

example.zh: 无论走到哪里,他都始终关注祖国的发展。
example.py: Wúlùn zǒu dào nǎlǐ, tā dōu shǐzhōng guānzhù zǔguó de fāzhǎn.
example.en: No matter where he goes, he always pays attention to the development of his motherland.

example.zh: 法院认为证据不足,不能认定他有罪。
example.py: Fǎyuàn rènwéi zhèngjù bùzú, bù néng rèndìng tā yǒu zuì.
example.en: The court held that the evidence was insufficient and that he could not be found guilty.

example.zh: 许多传统节日都与纪念祖先有关。
example.py: Xǔduō chuántǒng jiérì dōu yǔ jìniàn zǔxiān yǒuguān.
example.en: Many traditional festivals are connected with honouring ancestors.

example.zh: 这些数据足以证明市场需求正在发生变化。
example.py: Zhèxiē shùjù zúyǐ zhèngmíng shìchǎng xūqiú zhèngzài fāshēng biànhuà.
example.en: These data are sufficient to prove that market demand is changing.
